jobs.title: Logistikkoordinator (vikariat)
jobs.description:
E.ON i Sverige är en del av den internationella energikoncernen E.ON SE med huvudkontor i Essen, Tyskland. Inom koncernen arbetar runt 70 000 personer i 17 länder. Runt om i Sverige arbetar runt 2100 engagerade medarbetare. Vårt nordiska huvudkontor finns i Malmö. I Sverige levererar vi el, värme och smarta energilösningar till drygt en miljon hushåll och företag. E.ON:s roll är att ta ansvar för och driva utvecklingen framåt, för att fler ska kunna ställa om. Med våra investeringar och våra kunders vilja att bidra arbetar vi för att fortsätta elektrifiera samhället och möta framtidens energibehov.

Om oss

Välkommen till oss på Logistik & Avtalshantering på E.ON. På Logistik & Avtalshantering säkerställer vi att rätt utrustning finns tillgänglig vid rätt tidpunkt och på rätt plats i vår försörjningskedja. Vi eftersträvar effektivitet, hållbarhet och hög servicegrad i våra materialflöden.

Vi säkerställer också att våra avtal upphandlas, utvecklas och efterlevs enligt rådande lagstiftning och verkar för gynnsamma samarbeten med våra leverantörer och entreprenörer.



Din roll

För att kunna hantera flödet av elmätare och se till att ha effektivitet och kvalitet behöver vi väldefinierade och smarta logistiska processer och system. Som Logistikkoordinator är du med i det operativa arbetet men med lika mycket fokus på att utveckla våra processer och arbetssätt.

Mer konkret innefattar rollen:

•                           Utveckling och implementering av processer och arbetssätt

•                           Avrop och inköpsplanering av mätare och kringutrustning

•                           Lagerhantering, provning och skrotning av mätare och kringutrustning

•                           Ansvar för inventering och materialuppföljning

•                           Koordinering och ansvar för avtal rörande logistikverksamhet



Rollen innebär flera kontaktytor och du har dagligen ett nära samarbete med kollegor och avdelningar internt hos oss men även externa leverantörer och samarbetspartners. Dina kollegor består av 10 engagerade medarbetare som sitter utspridda i Malmö, Hässleholm och Norrköping.



Tjänsten är ett vikariat på ett år med start så snart som möjligt.



Dina erfarenheter

För att verkligen trivas i den här rollen vill du fördjupa dig inom logistik och komplexa flöden och du har lätt för att se nya kreativa lösningar. Vi tror att du antingen har en relevant utbildning/erfarenhet med dig men värdesätter lika mycket erfarenhet inom exempelvis verksamhet för elmätning eller energibranschen i stort. Viktigast för oss är du tycker att ovanstående beskrivning känns lockade, rolig och utmanande!



Hur är det hos oss?

Din närmsta chef, Jakob, är en involverande och coachande ledare som förespråkar ett transparent och öppet klimat. Han ser fram emot att du kommer med nya infallsvinklar och idéer till verksamheten. Tillsammans med teamet kommer han se till att du får bästa möjliga förutsättningar att sätta dig in i och växa i din roll.



På E.ON arbetar vi aktivt med inkludering - det är avgörande för att driva energiomställningen framåt. Vi vill att just du ska känna dig välkommen! Vi strävar efter att skapa en trygg arbetsmiljö med meningsfulla arbetsuppgifter och goda möjligheter till utveckling. Vi fortsätter hela tiden att utmana oss själva för att skapa en välkomnande arbetsplats, där vi hoppas att du kommer att trivas.



Vi arbetar för ett mer hållbart energisamhälle, men det är minst lika viktigt att våra medarbetare har förutsättningar att värna om sin egen hållbarhet. Vi erbjuder diärför bra förmåner för att du ska må bra och ha god balans mellan arbete och fritid. Några av dessa är t.ex. arbetstidsförkortning som är högre än branschens standard, hälsoförsäkring, fri sjukvård och mer därtill!

jobs.title: Affärsingenjör till Regionnätsaffären
jobs.description:
Om oss

Energimarknaden förändras snabbt och övergången till ett mer elektrifierat samhälle pågår för fullt. Allt fler aktörer vill ansluta förnybar elproduktion, energilager, datacenter och ny grön industri till E.ONs elnät. Det skapar nya möjligheter och driver utvecklingen av våra kundrelationer, affärsupplägg och arbetssätt.

Inom Regionnätsaffären arbetar vi med några av E.ONs största och mest komplexa kundanslutningar. Genom nära kunddialog, nya affärslösningar och ökad digitalisering skapar vi värde för våra kunder, E.ON och samhället. Nu söker vi en Affärsingenjör som vill vara med och utveckla framtidens regionnätsaffär.

Din roll

Som Affärsingenjör håller du ihop affären från kundens första förfrågan fram till avtal och vidare mot genomförande. Du blir en viktig länk mellan kunden och olika delar av vår verksamhet och driver affären framåt genom såväl kommersiella som tekniska frågeställningar.

I rollen kommer du bland annat att:

    Driva kundanslutningar från förfrågan och analys till affärsförslag och avtal.
    Utveckla affärsupplägg och ta fram investeringsbedömningar och projektkalkyler tillsammans med kollegor inom olika delar av verksamheten.
    Bygga förtroendefulla kundrelationer och skapa framdrift tillsammans med interna och externa parter.
    Bidra till att utveckla våra arbetssätt genom digitalisering, data och nya tekniska möjligheter.



Dina erfarenheter

Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av att driva komplexa projekt eller affärer i en teknisk verksamhet, där kunddialog har varit en naturlig del av ditt arbete. Du har troligen en ingenjörsbakgrund, men du kan också ha byggt upp din tekniska förståelse genom din erfarenhet. Erfarenhet från elkraft eller högspänning är värdefullt, men inget krav. Det viktigaste är att du är nyfiken och vill lära dig mer om vår verksamhet.

Som person trivs du med många kontaktytor, har lätt för att bygga förtroende och känner dig trygg i dialogen med såväl kunder som tekniska specialister. Du är van vid att skapa struktur och framdrift när flera perspektiv och intressenter behöver mötas. Du uppskattar att hitta lösningar tillsammans med andra och är mån om att bidra med engagemang, dela kunskap och skapa en god stämning i teamet. Vi befinner oss i en verksamhet som förändras snabbt, där digitalisering och AI skapar nya möjligheter. Därför tror vi att du är nyfiken på ny teknik och hur den kan bidra till att utveckla både kundmötet och våra arbetssätt.

Hur är det hos oss?

Vi ser fram emot att välkomna dig till Säljrelationer inom Regionnätsaffärer, ett team med sju kollegor där vi arbetar nära varandra, delar kunskap och tar hjälp av varandras kompetenser. Din närmaste chef, Magnus Andersson, har en bakgrund inom Key Account Management i energibranschen och vill vara en sparringpartner i ditt arbete. Han ger dig stor frihet och uppskattar initiativ, nya perspektiv och viljan att utveckla befintliga arbetssätt, samtidigt som han finns nära som stöd när du behöver det.

Välkommen att söka och var med oss på vägen mot ett hållbart samhälle! Sista ansökningsdatum är den 20 oktober.

Avdelningen Projekt är en del av regionnätsaffären och arbetar med investeringar och anslutningar i vårt regionnät. Vi är cirka 35 kollegor på flera orter i Sverige och arbetar nära projektledare, specialister, entreprenörer och andra delar av E.ON. Hos oss finns hög teknisk kompetens, stort engagemang och en vilja att tillsammans utveckla våra arbetssätt och projekt.



Din roll
Som Kvalitetsingenjör inom regionnät får du en central roll i att utveckla kvalitetssäkring och kvalitetskontroll i genomförandet av våra regionnätsprojekt inom 30–130 kV.

En viktig del av uppdraget är att driva och utveckla vår beställarkontrollfunktion. Våra beställarkontrollanter är i huvudsak externa konsulter som fungerar som tekniskt stöd till projektledarna och säkerställer att våra anläggningar byggs enligt tekniska krav och bestämmelser.

    utveckla och standardisera arbetssätt för kvalitetskontroll, konstruktionsgenomgångar, egenkontroller och besiktningar

    ansvara för kvalificering, certifiering och introduktion av nya beställarkontrollanter
    följa upp kvalitetsavvikelser, besiktningsanmärkningar och beställarkontrollfunktionen i projekten
    driva rotorsaksanalyser tillsammans med projektledare och entreprenörer
    stötta projektledare i kvalitets- och arbetsmiljöfrågor samt samverka med HSE-organisationen för att utveckla säkerhetskulturen.

Rollen kombinerar strategiskt utvecklingsarbete med en nära koppling till projekten och tekniken ute i verksamheten. Du får också en viktig samordnande roll för kontrollfunktionen och behöver därför trivas med att skapa struktur, leda och få med dig andra.

Tjänsten kan vara placerad i Malmö, Hässleholm, Kalmar, Växjö, Norrköping eller Sundsvall. Resor till våra projekt runt om i Sverige är en naturlig del av rollen.



Dina erfarenheter
Vi söker dig som har en relevant teknisk utbildning inom elkraft och god kunskap om regionnätsanläggningar inom 30–130 kV. Du har erfarenhet från regionnätsprojekt och har exempelvis arbetat med projektering, konstruktion eller provning av regionnätsstationer eller regionnätsledningar. Du kan också ha erfarenhet av beställarkontroll, besiktning eller liknande arbete nära genomförandet av elkraftsanläggningar. Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av kvalitetssäkring eller kvalitetskontroll inom entreprenadverksamhet. Kunskap inom problemlösningsmetodik, entreprenadjuridik samt arbetsmiljö- och elsäkerhetsregler är meriterande.

Som person är du strukturerad, självgående och utvecklingsorienterad. Du är trygg i din tekniska kompetens och har lätt för att samarbeta, bygga förtroende och få med dig andra i förändring.

Vi erbjuder också bra förmåner för att du ska må bra och ha god balans mellan arbete och fritid, bland annat arbetstidsförkortning som är högre än branschens standard, hälsoförsäkring och fri sjukvård.

jobs.title: Business Owner
jobs.description:
E.ON i Sverige är en del av den internationella energikoncernen E.ON SE med huvudkontor i Essen, Tyskland. Inom koncernen arbetar runt 70 000 personer i 17 länder. Runt om i Sverige arbetar runt 2100 engagerade medarbetare. Vårt nordiska huvudkontor finns i Malmö. I Sverige levererar vi el, värme och smarta energilösningar till drygt en miljon hushåll och företag. E.ON:s roll är att ta ansvar för och driva utvecklingen framåt, för att fler ska kunna ställa om. Med våra investeringar och våra kunders vilja att bidra arbetar vi för att fortsätta elektrifiera samhället och möta framtidens energibehov.

Inom Meter Management ansvarar vi för E.ON:s elmätare, mätdatainsamling och de system som gör det möjligt att samla in och använda mätdata från över en miljon kunder. Vårt insamlingssystem hanterar omkring 400 miljoner mätarställningar varje dygn, vilket ställer höga krav på stabilitet, kvalitet och välfungerande systemlösningar.

Våra system stödjer hela kedjan från mätaren och insamlingen av mätdata till bland annat fakturering, rapportering och drift av elnätet. Nu söker vi en Business Owner som vill ta ansvar för vårt insamlingssystem och vara med och utveckla hur vi använder mätdata som en möjliggörare i framtidens elnät.



Din roll
Som Business Owner får du en central roll i en tekniskt komplex miljö där stora mängder data, IT och elnätsverksamhet möts. Du ansvarar för att vårt insamlingssystem förvaltas och utvecklas utifrån verksamhetens behov och arbetar nära bland annat vår IT Service Owner, leverantörer och olika delar av elnätsverksamheten.

Tillsammans med IT tar du fram roadmap och förvaltningsplan, prioriterar utvecklingsbehov och följer upp systemets drift, risker och förbättringsinitiativ. En viktig del av rollen är också att skapa förståelse för verksamhetens framtida behov och omsätta dem till hållbara systemlösningar.

Du kommer bland annat att:

    ansvara för förvaltning och kontinuerlig utveckling av vårt insamlingssystem
    driva och prioritera verksamhetens krav och behov tillsammans med IT och andra intressenter
    projektleda IT-implementationen kopplad till införandet av nya mätarlösningar
    följa upp KPI:er, risker och utvecklingsinitiativ samt bidra till en stabil och säker systemdrift
    samordna olika interna och externa parter, exempelvis IT, verksamhet och leverantörer
    bidra till utvecklingen av hur mätdata kan användas för ett mer digitaliserat, automatiserat och proaktivt elnät.

De kommande åren står vi inför flera spännande förändringar. Nya mätarlösningar ska implementeras samtidigt som mätdata får en allt viktigare roll i utvecklingen av framtidens nätverksamhet. Här får du möjlighet att både säkerställa det som behöver fungera idag och vara med och forma hur våra system ska möta morgondagens behov.



Dina erfarenheter
För att trivas och lyckas i rollen tror vi att du har flera års erfarenhet från elnäts- eller energibranschen och en god förståelse för mätdatainsamling, kommunikationslösningar eller liknande tekniskt komplexa systemmiljöer. Du har erfarenhet av storskalig datainsamling och förstår de möjligheter och begränsningar som finns när stora mängder data ska samlas in, kommuniceras och användas i verksamhetskritiska system. För tjänsten behöver du kunna kommunicera obehindrat på svenska, både i tal och skrift.

Vi ser också gärna att du har erfarenhet av att leda projekt eller större förändringsinitiativ inom IT. Du är van vid att samarbeta med flera olika kompetenser och kan skapa struktur, driva frågor framåt och omsätta verksamhetens behov till tydliga krav och prioriteringar.

Som person är du nyfiken och lösningsorienterad och tycker om att förstå både tekniken och verksamheten bakom. Du bygger förtroendefulla samarbeten och får med dig andra när nya lösningar ska utvecklas och införas. Samtidigt trivs du med att ta ansvar för ditt område och har tålamodet och uthålligheten som krävs för att driva förändring i stora och komplexa systemmiljöer.

Hur är det hos oss?
Hos oss blir du en del av ett engagerat och kunnigt team där vi är stolta över det vi gör och gärna delar kunskap och erfarenheter med varandra. Gruppen finns på flera orter och består av olika systemrelaterade kompetenser, men vi arbetar nära tillsammans med ett gemensamt fokus på kvalitet, utveckling och våra kunders behov. Din chef Sara leder med empati, nyfikenhet och lyhördhet. Hon vill skapa förutsättningar för varje medarbetare att använda sina styrkor, utvecklas och känna både ansvar och glädje i sitt arbete.

På E.ON arbetar vi aktivt med inkludering - det är avgörande för att driva energiomställningen framåt. Vi vill att just du ska känna dig välkommen! Vi strävar efter att skapa en trygg arbetsmiljö med meningsfulla arbetsuppgifter och goda möjligheter till utveckling. Vi fortsätter hela tiden att utmana oss själva för att skapa en välkomnande arbetsplats, där vi hoppas att du kommer att trivas.

jobs.description:
Välkommen till E.ON - och till en startpunkt för dig som vill växa med energiomställningen. I vårt Graduate Program får du utforska framtidens energilösningar tillsammans med engagerade kollegor, kunder och partners. Här får du möjlighet att utvecklas, bidra med nya perspektiv och vara med och forma hur el och värme produceras, används och återvinns smartare. Om du har nyfikenhet, driv och tror på kraften i att arbeta tillsammans är E.ON platsen för dig.



Traineeprogrammet
Hos oss får du mer än ett traineeprogram - du får en startpunkt för att växa, utforska och vara med och driva energiomställningen framåt. Under 16 månader formar du din utvecklingsresa utifrån både dina intressen och verksamhetens behov. Genom fyra olika placeringar, med möjlighet till en period utomlands, får du lära känna alla delar av E.ON och bygga en bred förståelse för hur vi tillsammans utvecklar smarta energilösningar, skapar värde för våra kunder och bidrar till ett mer hållbart samhälle.

Du kommer att omges av engagerade kollegor och erfarna ledare som vill se dig lyckas. Genom mentorskap, löpande feedback och nya perspektiv får du både stöd och utmaningar som hjälper dig att utvecklas både professionellt och personligt. På E.ON tror vi på kraften i att arbeta tillsammans, och här får du vara med och bidra till smartare, mer hållbara energilösningar för framtiden.

Vi söker
Vi söker dig som är nyfiken på hur teknik, energi och hållbarhet kan samspela för att skapa lösningar som gör verklig skillnad. Du har en teknisk utbildning på masternivå, exempelvis inom energisystem, teknisk fysik, industriell ekonomi eller ett annat relevant område, och vill använda din kunskap för att bidra till framtidens energilösningar.

Som trainee med kompetens inom engineering får du möjlighet att utvecklas i nära samarbete med erfarna kollegor och specialister som delar ditt intresse för teknik, innovation och energiomställning. Du kommer att få inblick i olika delar av vår verksamhet och vara med i projekt och initiativ som bidrar till smartare, mer hållbara och robusta energilösningar för våra kunder och samhället.

Vi ser att du trivs i en miljö där du får kombinera analytiskt tänkande med nyfikenhet och problemlösning. Du gillar att förstå hur saker fungerar, ser möjligheter i komplexa utmaningar och vill vara med och utveckla lösningar som tar oss närmare ett mer hållbart energisystem.

Krav:

    Nyligen avslutat dina studier, eller har upp till 12 månaders arbetslivserfarenhet efter examen, exklusive sommarjobb
    En utbildning på masternivå, exempelvis inom industriell ekonomi, energisystem, maskinteknik eller annat relevant område
    Kunna arbeta professionellt på både svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift
    Ett stort intresse för energibranschen, hållbarhet och framtidens energilösningar
    Nyfikenhet på kundrelationer, ekonomi och affärsutveckling
    Placering Malmö





Våra traineer har till exempel varit involverade i:
• Utveckling av nya energilösningar och flexibilitetsprodukter för kunder
• Analys av framtida affärsmöjligheter inom stödtjänstmarknaden
• Projekt kopplade till E.ONs långsiktiga hållbarhetsarbete
• Bevakning och analys av energi- och klimatpolitik i Sverige och EU
• Utveckling av AI-baserade lösningar för omvärldsbevakning och policyanalys
• Affärs- och produktutveckling inom fjärrvärme och kundnära energilösningar



När du väljer E.ON väljer du att bli en del av något större. Här får du möjlighet att bidra med dina perspektiv, växa tillsammans med engagerade kollegor och vara med och utveckla smarta energilösningar för framtiden. Vi tror på kraften i att arbeta tillsammans och hos oss får du en viktig roll i energiomställningen från första dagen. Tillsammans skapar vi förutsättningar för ett mer hållbart samhälle.

jobs.description:
At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. 🚀

Engagement Management is a new and fast-growing practice at ClickUp, and it's quickly becoming central to how we serve our enterprise customers. Our EMs bring program leadership, service delivery and change management together in one role. As a ClickUp Senior Engagement Manager you will lead the formation and orchestration of post-sale strategy and execution for the company’s largest and most strategic clients. We're looking for someone hungry, who excels in building, and who takes genuine pride in the quality of their work.

Here, Engagement Managers are the single point of accountability for outcomes. You own everything between the contract being signed and the client seeing measurable results: what was sold gets delivered, on time and on margin, and we can prove it worked.

You'll lead enterprise SaaS implementations across the full engagement lifecycle, from shaping scope in pre-sales, mobilizing the team and delivery, go-live, stabilization and a clean handover to the account team. You'll run work-stream programs with Paid TAMs, AI specialists, Product and Engineering, and the client's own project team, and you'll be the trusted advisor to the client's executive sponsor.

 

Simply put: you are the single point of accountability for delivery, the client's partner in getting value from ClickUp, and a thought leader for how we deliver.

 

Your role

  • Stakeholder Management

    • Serve as the primary client contact for delivery

    • Build strong relationships with stakeholders while ensuring delivery remains aligned to client objectives and contractual commitments.

    • Build trusted relationships with client executive sponsors and program leads at VP and C-level, acting as their primary point of contact for delivery.

    • Navigate complex enterprise stakeholder environments and competing priorities across client functions (IT, PMO, business sponsors, procurement) and broker alignment when they conflict.

  • Project Delivery Oversight

    • Deliver engagements against agreed scope, schedule, hours budget and quality, using rigorous change control to protect timelines and delivery margin.

    • Translate customer business requirements into internal deliverables and milestones

    • Own engagement governance, including kickoffs, weekly working sessions, sponsor check-ins and SteerCos, and provide clear, concise status reporting to clients and internal stakeholders.

    • Lead and coordinate multidisciplinary teams, fostering a collaborative, accountable and high-performing delivery culture while providing coaching, direction and support.

    • Proactively manage risks, issues and dependencies through the RAID log, and act as the primary escalation point.

    • Manage engagement financials, including hours burn, forecasting, utilisation and margin, flagging overrun risk early and agreeing recovery plans.

  • Drive AI adoption

    • Guide clients from manual workflows to AI-assisted and agent-driven operations, and own post-go-live adoption outcomes.

  • Drive Value and Business Outcomes

    • Identify expansion opportunities through delivery and co-sell with Account Executives, bringing the delivery credibility that secures follow-on work.

    • Establish a value baseline before configuration begins, track benefits through go-live, and produce the value assessment that underpins renewal and expansion.

  • Governance

    • Design and run governance mechanisms

    • Track delivery efficacy, timelines, value realization and customer experience

    • Create continuous-improvement mechanisms

  • Change Management & Communication

    • Own communications around delivery status, risks and outcomes

    • Manage escalation and communication across customer/internal teams

    • Assess change readiness and resistance across impacted teams; build sponsor and champion networks to carry the rollout.

    • Design the communications and enablement plan with the client, and sequence go-live to match the organization's capacity for change.

  • Role Development

    • Contribute to building the Engagement Management practice by iterating on templates, playbooks and AI workflows that make every engagement faster and more consistent.

 

Your skills and experience

  • 5+ years of software and/or services delivery experience, with at least 2 years as the accountable project, program or engagement lead.

  • Proven track record taking enterprise SaaS deployments from kickoff through go-live and into adoption, ideally in work management, PSA, CRM, ITSM or collaboration platforms.

  • Strong grasp of SaaS implementation fundamentals: workspace and data architecture, permissions and SSO, integrations, data migration, change management and enablement. No coding required, but you can challenge an unrealistic technical scope.

  • Comfortable with Agile, Waterfall and hybrid delivery, and knowing which one the client actually needs.

  • Commercial acumen: you've managed engagement budgets, SoWs, change requests and margin, and you know when to push for expansion vs when to stabilize.

  • Executive presence: you can run a SteerCo, deliver bad news early with a recovery plan, and hold a line on scope with a CIO in the room.

  • Experience leading cross-functional and distributed teams you don't directly manage, across client, partner and internal resources.

  • Strategic judgment to separate genuine product gaps from client process or training gaps.

  • Hands-on with AI: you already use AI to work faster, and you can credibly advise clients on where agents and automation fit.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication. Status reports people actually read.

 

Nice to have: Experience in work management or SaaS software, professional services firms, agencies or regulated industries. PMP Certification.

 

What you'll love about working here

  • Impact: Lead high-visibility enterprise engagements with global brands, and see the result in their day-to-day work.

  • Build something: Engagement Management is a new function. You'll help define the methodology, tooling and AI workflows that become the standard.

  • AI at the centre: Work on the frontier of AI-driven work management, with ClickUp Brain and Super Agents in your own delivery toolkit.

  • Career growth: A clear path from Engagement Manager to Senior or Principal Engagement Manager.

  • Community: Learn alongside Paid TAMs, AI specialists and delivery leaders across EMEA and NA.

Privacy Notice

ClickUp collects and processes personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws. You can find further details by viewing our Global Candidate Privacy Notice.

If you are a Philippine Job Applicant, please also see our Philippine Data Privacy Notice for further details.

Visa Sponsorship

Please note we are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for roles outside of engineering and product at this time. Sponsorship for engineering and product roles is not guaranteed, but is instead based on the business needs for that specific role at that time. Please reach out to the recruiter with any questions.

jobs.title: Product Analyst
jobs.description:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

Payments is where our customers feel Allica every single day. We’ve built an award-winning business current account for established SMEs that pairs genuinely great technology with bestin-class customer experience – and goes beyond payments to make running a business’s finances simple and painless.

You’ll be part of the Payments Tribe, supporting the squads that together cover the full product. Product, engineering, design and data work side by side, in close partnership with Distribution, Operations, Compliance and Risk. Our job is to take the complex problems SMEs face, the ones the big banks have neglected for years, and solve them with simple, elegant products. If you want to see your work ship quickly and make a real difference to UK SMEs, this is the place to do it.

Role Description

  • As Product Analyst, you’ll help shape and deliver our Business Rewards Account and its card and payment features, working alongside the Senior Product Owner and the wider Tribe.

  • You’ll turn data, customer feedback and business requirements into clear insight and well-defined user stories, so the squads build the right things – and builds them well.

  • Success looks like decisions backed by evidence, a sharp and well-prioritised backlog, and processes that are simpler and more automated than when you found them. 

  • It’s a great opportunity to learn product ownership inside a high-growth bank, with real scope to grow your product career.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Support the Senior Product Owner in defining and delivering features for our business current account, from discovery through to release 

  • Gather, analyse and document requirements from Distribution, Operations, Compliance and Risk, turning them into clear user stories and acceptance criteria 

  • Help maintain and prioritise the squad and wider Tribe backlogs, keeping them aligned to the roadmap and product and business OKRs 

  • Track and report on product performance – such as balances, usage and customer behaviour – and surface insights that inform decisions 

  • Gather and analyse customer feedback, then propose and lead product improvements

  • Work day-to-day with engineers and designers to clarify requirements, answer questions and test what’s delivered 

  • Manage relationships with key vendors to keep delivery focused and on track

  • Map and improve processes, spotting opportunities to simplify and automate

  • Keep product documentation, tracking and risk logs accurate and up to date, flagging issues early 

  • Use AI tools to build and ship small changes to production

Personal Attributes & Experience

  • Experience as a Business Analyst, Product Analyst or in a similar role (around 2+ years), ideally working on digital products in payments or financial services

  • Working knowledge of UK payment schemes (e.g. Faster Payments, Bacs, CHAPS) and card payments; awareness of payments regulation is a plus

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and comfortable working with data – SQL or similar is a plus 

  • Great attention to detail, without losing sight of the bigger picture

  • Clear, concise written and verbal communication – able to explain complex things simply 

  • Organised and proactive, able to juggle priorities in a fast-moving or high-growth environment 

  • Exposure to Agile ways of working and tools such as Jira and Confluence 

  • Curious and keen to learn, with examples of where you’ve gone the extra mile, taken on a new challenge or stood out from your peers

  • A genuine curiosity about AI, with hands-on experience of experimenting with AI tools, at work or elsewhere 

  • A design-minded approach, with an eye for user experience

Working at Allica Bank

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

  • Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

  • Options for flexible working

  • Regular social activities

  • Pension contributions

  • Discretionary bonus scheme

  • Private health cover

  • Life assurance

  • Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

Don’t tick every box?

Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!

Flexible working

We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

Diversity

We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Customer Success Manager

🌍 About us

Plinth is a fast-growing tech startup working with charities, foundations and local government. Small and local charities are highly effective but largely hidden. They have no spare time and no spare money. We're building the tools these organisations need and shining a light on the work they do. Read more on our blog.

🚀We're growing fast. 3-4x this year. We get 7+ new clients a month and we're shipping new features every few days. This means things move quickly and your work directly shapes how we scale. You'll have real responsibility from day one.

❤️It's really impactful work. Our clients are charities and grassroots organisations across the UK, and soon internationally. When you help them succeed with our platform, you're directly amplifying their impact. Every successful onboarding means a charity spends less time fighting with their systems and more time on their actual mission.

🤝You'll work with impressive people. Our team is talented, collaborative and slightly strange(?). We value impact, speed and openness. We work in person in our office in Old Street because we genuinely enjoy each other's company (most of the time). It’s a high trust, creative space where if you think something's a good idea, you just go do it.

💼 You need to be able to:

  • Work both fast and slow: You'll navigate slow public sector procurement cycles one minute, then help us ship a new feature over lunch the next. The whiplash is intense but it keeps things interesting.

  • Keep it real: You'll be getting the train to community centres and youth clubs where the heating doesn't work and where the paint is peeling off the walls. It’s rarely glamourous. You need to be willing to meet clients where they are, literally and figuratively.

  • Listen to problems, ignore solutions: Clients will tell you exactly what they think they need. Your job is to understand the actual problem and guide them to what will really work, even when they're convinced they already know the answer. This requires self-confidence, understanding of the platform and genuine listening in equal measure.

  • Teach people: Most of our clients don't love shiny gadgets. If you're the kind of person who enjoys teaching your gran to use a smartphone, this is ideal. You need to explain some fairly complex systems clearly without being condescending and still getting user adoption

  • Automate and document yourself away:🤖 We're small and growing fast. Build systems and processes that make your job increasingly redundant. There’s always plenty more to do.

  • Understand the difference between "urgent" and 🚨 URGENT — When you're managing 4-8 concurrent client projects and everyone thinks their issue is critical, you need to distinguish between what must happen for launch versus what can wait. This is harder than it sounds.

  • Grow with the role: we need someone who is comfortable with our clients and team doubling every 6 months. Your role will rapidly change to reflect that, but it leaves you with lots of room to grow in responsibility.

🧩 What kind of background do we think would be a good fit?

We’d expect a few years experience in something like the following:

  • Coaching / Tutoring: You know how to meet people where they are and guide them to better outcomes

  • Hospitality management: Service mindset, de-escalation skills, managing expectations when things don't go to plan, letting the customer think they’re right when they aren’t

  • Event/production management: Used to juggling moving pieces, keeping stakeholders calm, making last-minute pivots when things go wrong

  • Community organising/activism: Already comfortable in the spaces you'll be visiting, get the mission, used to working with limited resources

  • Consulting: You're used to parachuting into chaos, extracting actionable tasks, and keeping multiple clients calm simultaneously

  • User research/UX: Good at understanding what people actually need versus what they say they need, synthesising feedback into actionable insights

  • Knowledge of the charity sector is a significant advantage, whether that’s as an employee, consultant or as a long term volunteer.

  • It would also definitely be helpful if you have any technical experience to help with managing data migrations.

Importantly, This is a list of suggestions.

If you have experience in only some of this, or have only some of these skills, please do apply anyway.

📈 How can you measure your success?

  • Speed of getting customers successfully using Plinth: From signed contract to actively using the platform and seeing value.

  • Positive recommendations: Clients recommending us positively to their networks — it’s a big source of our growth.

  • Increasing use of Plinth: Clients expanding how they use the platform over time, not just maintaining baseline usage

🧠 The role

Client Onboarding (70%) — Lead onboarding from kick-off to go-live. Break down complex projects into clear phases. Manage timelines, priorities, and expectations across 7+ new clients per month. Stay on top of new features we ship every few days. Push back when needed and teach anyone regardless of background.

Operations & Process Improvement (30%) — Audit and optimise our support systems (expect to manage Intercom chat a couple of days a week). Refine onboarding workflows. Keep documentation current. Work with engineering to communicate what's urgent versus what's just a problem. Track feature requests across clients and synthesise them into product improvements.

💵 What we offer

  • Salary: £42,000 - £75,000 depending on experience

  • Equity as part of your package

  • Location: In-person, Old Street, London

☎️ Interview process

  1. Quick (20-30 min) call with Chris as a sanity check

jobs.title: People Operations Advisor
jobs.description:
About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing the People Team at Trainline 👋
At Trainline, the People Team is central to supporting the company’s ambition and growth plans.

We are looking for a People Operations Advisor to join our UK People Operations team. Reporting into our UK People Operations Team Manager, you’ll work on all things HR and be responsible for supporting employees across the business and helping to make Trainline a great place to work. You’ll provide high quality support in relation to both core HR processes and ad-hoc projects and quickly become an integral part of the team and wider business.

If you’re successful in your application, you’ll be joining an enthused and high performing team, one which prides itself on providing stellar service at every stage of the employee life cycle, from on-boarding to off-boarding and everything in between.

As a People Operations Advisor at Trainline, you will...🚅

  • Provide high-quality first-line support to Trainliners and resolving HR process and policy queries professionally and within agreed SLAs.

  • Produce and maintain accurate people data, ensuring high data integrity in our HRIS (HiBob) and that updates are completed promptly. Apply a data-literate, analytical mindset to validate information and produce reports that support People Ops delivery and decision-making.

  • Deliver change alongside day-to-day People services by contributing to People Ops projects such as system enhancements, process redesign, and embedding AI-enabled solutions, while balancing inbox SLAs, operational deadlines, and project work through effective planning and prioritisation to ensure reliable delivery.

  • Work with People Business Partners to support cyclical People processes and document and implement employee lifecycle changes, including personal and contractual updates.

  • Support the preparation, validation, and processing of the monthly UK payroll, ensuring accurate and timely data inputs and alignment between HiBob and payroll workflows.

  • Deliver day-to-day benefits administration, managing enrolments and changes accurately and resolving benefit-related issues efficiently.

  • Manage employee lifecycle administration, including pre-boarding, contracts, background checks, Right to Work documentation, and visa sponsorship, ensuring employee data is accurate across systems and workflows.

  • Process People-related invoices and purchase orders accurately, partnering with accounts payable and supporting effective financial administration.

  • Support and manage the improvement, implementation, and documentation of People policies, processes, and templates, ensuring they remain up to date, user-friendly, and aligned with a tech-first, self-service culture.

Based on the sensitive nature of the role, it’s important that you bring the appropriate degree of discretion and empathy in the way you operate. To this end, you’ll be responsible for identifying escalation points and making sure that any issues are managed appropriately and are dealt with efficiently. Furthermore, being heavily involved in all our HR processes means that you’ll be ideally placed to contribute towards the development of new solutions that further enhance the quality, competence and effectiveness of our current offering.

We'd love to hear from you if you have...🔍

  • You bring a solid foundation in People Operations and are motivated to continue learning and developing in a fast-moving, tech-enabled environment.

  • Working understanding of HR best practices, employment law, and core HR processes, with the ability and curiosity to stay up to date with regulatory change.

  • Experience supporting payroll administration, including maintaining payroll data, running checks, and a working understanding of UK tax, NI, and statutory requirements.

  • Comfortable working with HR systems (ideally HiBob or similar HRIS), with a genuine interest in using technology to improve People processes.

  • Data-literate, with the ability to produce, interpret, and validate reports, ensure data quality, and use insights to support People Partners and business needs

  • Exposure to process and ways-of-working improvement, such as documenting workflows, testing system enhancements, refining templates, or supporting change implementation.

  • Strong attention to detail, particularly when handling people data, contracts, payroll inputs, or employee records.

  • Clear and professional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain policies and processes confidently.

  • Strong organisational and time-management skills, able to manage competing priorities, balance BAU and project work, and work to agreed SLAs.

  • Confident using Microsoft Office or Google Workspace, particularly Excel / Sheets for data handling and reporting.

We’re looking for a team player with a ‘roll your sleeves up’ attitude. A self-starter with a helpful, people-orientated demeanour and a high degree of integrity and confidentiality, someone itching expand upon their HR and payroll experience. Super-strong organisation and interpersonal skills are essential, and you’ll also bring the ability to work at pace and with agility.

An HR qualification isn’t necessary - as long as you can demonstrate your interest in HR and show a comprehensive understanding of HR processes and policies, we’ll provide you with the necessary professional development to make you an HR superhero.

This is fantastic opportunity for someone who is passionate about HR, keen to work in a fast-moving, forward-thinking technology business, and looking to develop their career. This is a UK-based role, but we also support offices in France, Spain and Italy. Experience working with employees in these countries would be helpful, but is not essential.

More information:

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. 

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! 

We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.

That's why we're committed to creating inclusive places to work, where everyone belongs and differences are valued and celebrated.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - AI Foundations
jobs.description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

AI is a key investment area for Kraken Technologies. A crucial part of this is building the shared foundations that let every team use AI well and move faster on our mission.

You'll work in AI Foundations. We build the platform that lets teams across Kraken build and run AI agents. Our work covers four areas:

  • Access: connecting people and systems to approved AI models and tools

  • Context: grounding AI in trusted Kraken knowledge, data and systems

  • Enablement: reusable building blocks for AI-powered workflows and products

  • Governance: permissions, safety, quality, cost and visibility across the lifecycle


🏡 Where you'll fit in
We're hiring Senior Software Engineers to join one of our three squads:

  • Context: Build the Kraken-specific knowledge layer to make LLMs useful. This covers our internal AI assistant, a structured "client brain" that captures client context and decisions, and pipelines that collect knowledge from tools like Notion, Slack and GitHub.

  • Tooling: deliver LLMs into people's hands. We run the AI Hub (usage insights, MCP gateway, self-serve and specialist agents), the LiteLLM gateway behind Claude Code, Codex and Claude Desktop, and secure cloud dev boxes for AI-assisted engineering.

  • Evals & Observability: covers skill evals, internal benchmarking, agent safety and guardrails, and observability for live AI runs.

Squads are flexible: when priorities shift, people move. This is a hands-on senior individual-contributor role. With your squad lead and the wider team, you'll own large parts of our platform, turn ideas into production systems, shape architecture decisions and help raise the engineering bar.

👾 What you'll own

  • Build shared AI platform services: Design, build and run Python services that other teams rely on, such as gateways, agent runtimes, knowledge pipelines and eval harnesses.

  • Build and run agents: Work out how agents are triggered, authenticated, monitored and governed across systems like Slack, GitHub, Notion and Asana. Ship both self-serve agents and specialist agents.

  • Ground AI in Kraken context: Collect, structure and serve company knowledge so agents give answers that are correct, current and safe to use.

  • Measure and prove quality: Define meaningful test cases, build evals whose results can be reproduced, and add tracing so we know how AI behaves in real use.

  • Build in safety and governance: Turn permissions, guardrails, budgets and data-access rules into software you can maintain, working with Security and TechOps.

  • Operate in AWS: Deploy and support services on AWS and Kubernetes, and make sound reliability, performance and cost trade-offs.

  • Drive adoption: Work directly with engineers and non-technical teams, run workshops, write clear docs and turn feedback into product.

  • Raise the engineering bar: Review designs and code, mentor others, and create patterns that can be reused across AI Foundations.


🧠 What you bring to the party

  • Strong senior-level software engineering: You have owned complex services end to end, from design through testing, deployment and operation.

  • Deep engineering fundamentals: Good judgement on system design, concurrency, security, testing and architecture trade-offs. Strong production Python.

  • Hands-on LLM and agent experience: You have built real things with LLMs, you know where they fail, and you use AI coding tools every day.

  • Cloud experience: You're comfortable running services in AWS and owning their reliability and scalability.

  • Product sense: You care whether people actually use what you build.

  • Clear communication: You can explain trade-offs to technical and non-technical people and challenge ideas constructively.

  • Learning agility: You pick up new tools and domains quickly in a field that changes every month.


🚀 What success looks like

  • Adoption: You ship platform features that teams across Kraken adopt and rely on.

  • Solid systems: The services you own are observable, secure, scalable and cost-aware.

  • Trust at scale: Teams can build and trust agents without rebuilding the basics.

  • Team impact: You make your squad, and the teams around it, better.


⭐️ Bonus points:

  • AI engineering: Pydantic AI, LiteLLM, LangChain, MCP servers

  • Knowledge and retrieval: RAG, search, embeddings, knowledge graphs

  • Evals and safety: Inspect AI, Ragas, OpenAI Evals, NeMo Guardrails, red teaming

  • Platform: Kubernetes, sandboxed or cloud dev environments, AWS Bedrock

  • Backend: Django

  • Observability: Datadog, OpenTelemetry

jobs.title: ICT Systems Administrator
jobs.description:
Als ICT Systems Administrator maak je samen met 2 collega's deel uit van het Datacenter team dat instaat voor de uitbating en de verdere uitbouw van de centrale infrastructuur en bijbehorende operations. Je rapporteert aan Thomas De Baerdemaecker - Teamlead daily operations en je werkt nauw samen met jouw collega's binnen Directie ICT

Een greep uit je takenpakket:

  • Je staat mee in voor het dagelijkse beheer, de monitoring en de verdere uitbouw van de VMware-omgeving, waaronder de ESXi-hosts, vCenter en de virtuele machines;
  • Je beheert en controleert de back-upomgeving met Veeam. Je volgt de uitvoering van back-ups en replicaties op en voert regelmatig restore-tests uit;
  • Je werkt mee aan updates, upgrades en capaciteitsbeheer van de VMware- en Veeam-omgeving en helpt de beschikbaarheid en continuïteit van de infrastructuur te garanderen;
  • Security is een constant aandachtspunt, een deel van je taken zal zich dan ook toespitsen op het monitoren en verbeteren van de ICT-infrastructuur op dit vlak;
  • Samen met je collega's sta je in voor de 2de en 3de-lijngebruikersondersteuning en het oplossen van systeemgerelateerde incidenten en problemen;
  • Je volgt het serverpark op door middel van management- en monitoringtools, en helpt mee aan de constante verbetering en uitbouw ervan;
  • Je documenteert de configuratie en procedures die je dagdagelijks uitvoert;
  • Je kan meewerken om de ICT-infrastructuurvisie om te zetten in een technische implementatie;
  • Door middel van een vlotte communicatie en transparante werking ben je een aanspreekpunt voor zowel de collega's binnen ICT alsook de betrokken businessdepartementen;
  • Je draagt proactief bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van het VUB ICT Operations team en informeert je over de nieuwe evoluties.

Voor deze functie zal Brussels Humanities, Sciences & Engineering Campus (Elsene) je thuisbasis worden, in combinatie met thuiswerk.

Wat verwachten wij van jou?

  • Je hebt een bachelor in de informatica, systeem- en netwerkbeheerder of gelijkaardig, of bent gelijkwaardig door ervaring
  • Idealiter heb je minstens drie jaar relevante werkervaring in systeembeheer of het beheer van datacenterinfrastructuur. Ook als gemotiveerde starter met de juiste technische basis en ambitie kan je in aanmerking komen;
  • Je hebt kennis van virtualisatie en bij voorkeur ervaring met VMware (ESXi, vCenter);
  • Je hebt kennis van back-up en restore, bij voorkeur met Veeam Backup & Replication;
  • Je hebt ervaring met het beheer, de monitoring en beveiliging van Windows Server, en een goede kennis van Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS en DHCP;
  • Je hebt basiskennis van server- en storage-infrastructuur en PowerShell en staat open voor verdere automatisering;
  • Kennis van Linux, Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID, Intune en beheer- of monitoringtools is een pluspunt;
  • Je bent vertrouwd met tweede- en derdelijnsondersteuning of bent bereid je hierin verder te ontwikkelen;
  • Je werkt nauwkeurig en gestructureerd, documenteert duidelijk en hebt aandacht voor informatieveiligheid, beschikbaarheid, back-up en disaster recovery;
  • Je werkt zelfstandig én goed in team, neemt verantwoordelijkheid en bent klant- en oplossingsgericht;
  • Je communiceert zeer vlot in het Nederlands en beschikt over een goede professionele kennis van het Engels;
  • Last but not least ben je ook eenvoudigweg een fijne collega om mee samen te werken;

VUB wil een weerspiegeling zijn van de maatschappij waar ieders talent wordt gewaardeerd, ongeacht het gender, geslacht, leeftijd, religie, huidskleur, migratieachtergrond, functiebeperking en de neurodiversiteit.

About the Role
Are you a hands-on technical professional who enjoys troubleshooting industrial equipment as much as carrying out practical maintenance and repair work?

For an industrial production site in Louvain-la-Neuve, we are looking for an Electromechanic & Technical Handyman to join the team.

This is a varied role combining 50% industrial electromechanical maintenance and 50% general technical maintenance. You will play an important role in ensuring the reliability of the production line while keeping the company's facilities and infrastructure in good condition.

Your Responsibilities
50% – Electromechanical Maintenance
Monitor the production line and identify technical faults or malfunctions.
Diagnose electrical and mechanical problems and determine their root causes.
Carry out repairs and implement effective technical solutions to minimize production downtime.
Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on production equipment.
Check the proper functioning of machines and production installations.
Inspect electrical wiring and cabling and carry out troubleshooting when necessary.
Identify potential technical improvements to increase equipment reliability and performance.
Follow all applicable safety, quality and hygiene procedures.
50% – Technical Handyman & Facility Maintenance
Carry out general maintenance and repair work throughout the company.
Perform painting, minor renovation and finishing work.
Repair and maintain gates, doors and other company infrastructure.
Handle minor electrical, mechanical and technical repairs within your area of competence.
Identify maintenance needs and take the necessary corrective actions.
Ensure that buildings, facilities and work areas remain safe, functional and well maintained.
Support the team with various practical maintenance tasks as required.

We are looking for a versatile, hands-on professional with a strong technical background and a proactive approach.

You ideally have:

Previous experience in industrial maintenance.
Good knowledge of industrial electricity and mechanics.
Strong knowledge of electrical wiring and cabling.
The ability to diagnose faults, identify their causes and find practical solutions.
Knowledge of pneumatics, hydraulics or automation is an advantage.
Experience in the food, pharmaceutical or chemical industry is a strong asset.
Practical skills in general maintenance, repairs and basic building work.
A good understanding of safety procedures and technical instructions.
A structured, methodical and independent approach to your work.
A strong sense of responsibility, flexibility and problem-solving skills.

 

Languages
English: Very good proficiency.

You must be comfortable communicating in both languages in a professional working environment.

Monday to Friday.

jobs.title: Assistent restaurantmanager
jobs.description:
Onze klant is één van de grootste onafhankelijke retailers ter wereld.

De groep heeft een uitgebreid netwerk van vestigingen op internationale markten in Noord-Amerika, Europa en Australië.

Op vandaag is het bedrijf een toonaangevende speler op het gebied van food-to-go bij tankstations.

Onze klant wordt erkend voor zijn investeringsmodel, handelsprestaties en, nog belangrijker, het bieden van de beste ervaring in Retail, Foodservice en Brandstof.

De groep biedt een aantrekkelijk gamma aan erkende wereldmerken (zoals Starbucks, KFC en Burger King) die hun vestigingen omvormen tot een bestemming voor maaltijden en detailhandel die in meerdere behoeften van de klanten voorziet: van koffie over belegde broodjes tot fast food-maaltijden.

Elke dag leveren toegewijde medewerkers onvermoeibaar producten en diensten aan miljoenen klanten en steunen zij de lokale gemeenschappen waarin ze actief zijn.


Jobomschrijving

3 redenen om voor deze job te kiezen

  • Je werkt in een enthousiast, familiaal team
  • Je krijgt een goede verloning en extra voordelen
  • De job is afwisselend met doorgroeimogelijkheden


Zo ziet je job er uit

Als Assistent Restaurantmanager bij deze fastfoodketen ben jij de onmisbare rechterhand van de manager en draag je bij aan het dagelijks succes van de vestiging.

Jouw job bestaat uit:

  • het leiden van het team en samen met de collega's voor een klantgerichte werking zorgen
  • een enthousiaste en gemotiveerde sfeer op de werkvloer creëren
  • het opvolgen en streven naar het behalen van de verkoopdoelstellingen
  • nauw samenwerken met de manager, waarbij je rapporteert over de resultaten
  • assisteren bij taken zoals het opstellen van werkroosters, het beheren van de voorraad en het uitvoeren van kassawerkzaamheden
  • inspringen in de keuken of de bediening waar nodig om op die manier een voorbeeldfunctie te bekleden en de voeling met het dagelijks reilen en zeilen van het restaurant te behouden
  • het opnemen van de eindverantwoordelijkheid bij afwezigheid van de manager

Je draagt kortom bij aan de groei van het restaurant door je enthousiasme en klantgerichtheid, en je bent steeds bereid om operationele uitdagingen aan te pakken.

Dit heb je nodig voor de job

De perfecte Assistant Restaurantmanager herkent zich in onderstaande eigenschappen:

  • je hebt ervaring in horeca
  • je kan terugblikken op een eerste leidinggevende ervaring waarbij je een team moest aansturen
  • je bent enerzijds klantgericht, maar ook een echte teamplayer naar collega's toe
  • je bent energiek, positief en hands-on ingesteld
  • je kan goed plannen, organiseren en motiveren
  • je werkt graag in een afwisselend uurrooster met werkuren tussen 4u 's ochtends en 23u 's avonds
  • je bent bereid om in het weekend te werken, zowel op zaterdag als zondag
De ideale collega is...

De ideale collega is een geboren leider met een passie voor voeding en horeca.

Je hebt zin om te groeien in een leidinggevende functie, waarbij je administratieve taken combineert met operationeel meewerken op de vloer.

Je haalt energie uit een afwisselende job en bent in staat om een team te coachen en aan te sturen. Jij bent een expert in organiseren, delegeren en het nemen van initiatief. Ook onder druk weet je steeds het overzicht te bewaren.

Werken met een variabel uurrooster, inclusief weekends, schrikt jou niet af – integendeel, je geniet van de dynamiek die dit met zich meebrengt.

Je houdt van orde, netheid en zorgt ervoor dat de vestiging er altijd piekfijn uitziet. Je bent nauwkeurig bij het uitvoeren van papier- en kassawerk en weet klanten altijd met een grote glimlach te verwelkomen.

Je volgt samen met de manager de commerciële en financiële resultaten op en bent steeds op zoek naar verbeteringen.

Je steekt graag de handen uit de mouwen en bent flexibel inzetbaar.

Kortom, jij bent een enthousiaste Assistant Restaurantmanager die het verschil maakt.

Our flagship solution, the AV1 robot, is deployed in 19 countries with 5,000+ units, supporting schools to sustain attendance, belonging, and continuity of learning for children who cannot be physically present. Families consistently describe AV1 as life-changing - it rebuilds connection and continuity, bringing back everyday happiness and helping students stay on track to pass their grades.


The Opportunity — Backend Engineering

Join us to build the core systems that enable thousands of children through the AV1 robot. As a Backend Engineer proficient in Golang, you will be at the intersection of complex, real-time technical challenges.

Our solutions are scaling across continents, and we need your expertise to improve existing services and implement novel features. The backend you will co-own and further develop supports real-time communication between our fleet of robots, mobile apps, and web clients. You will be engineering high-performance systems to handle live video, audio, events, and last but not least, massive data collection to enable new customer value through our growing unique proprietary dataset.

You will design, build, and evolve the APIs, services, modules and system integrations that are vital to our ecosystem. You will be entrusted to make critical architectural decisions, model data for correctness and scale, and engineer for resilience. You will enjoy the focus on writing well-instrumented code and will get the chance to further raise the bar for how we design and operate our systems to deliver reliable, life-changing experiences for the children and schools we serve.


What You’ll Do — Scope & Responsibilities

Backend systems design & implementation

  • Design and implement backend APIs and shared modules, primarily in Golang, that connect robots, mobile apps, web clients, and cloud services

  • Select and configure the right paradigms for the job, including WebRTC, gRPC, web sockets, REST, and newer technologies

  • Develop data models, schemas, and safe up/down migrations across relational, NoSQL, and analytical stores

  • Design container-based, event-driven services and asynchronous processing pipelines that handle real-world usage patterns

  • Align on system design and architecture in collaboration with peers, and maintain clear troubleshooting runbooks

  • Embrace both unit and end-to-end testing so we ship confidently

  • Collaborate closely with frontend/mobile, platform, and embedded teams to shape APIs, contracts, and integration patterns

Team collaboration & enablement

  • Role-model AI tooling adoption (e.g., Claude Code, custom agents) to accelerate backend engineering in a safe, deliberate way

  • Contribute to developer experience by refining tooling, local dev environments, and shared libraries for backend work

  • Document key flows, patterns, and decisions so others can self-serve and move faster with confidence

  • Support internal stakeholders with data and internal tools that reduce 3rd-line support load and improve incident handling

  • Help evolve our data pipelines and assets for analytics, user insights, and future predictive modelling

Operational security and reliability

  • Instrument backend services with top observability standards

  • Collaborate with Platform Engineering on container deployment and orchestration (Kubernetes, Terraform)

  • Build for correctness, durability, resilience, and performance by design, not as an afterthought

  • Participate in incident response, debugging, and post-incident reviews

  • Embed secure coding practices throughout the development lifecycle, from design reviews to code reviews and rollout

  • Apply robust AuthN/AuthZ patterns, encryption, data-integrity controls, and secure service-to-service communication


What You Bring — Experience & Capabilities

  • Backend engineering: Deep experience in Golang, API design, backend architecture, and distributed systems. You have implemented services using e.g. WebRTC, gRPC, sockets, REST, and other web protocols. You can strike trade-offs between cost and performance

  • Operational familiarity: Proven experience with AWS services. You have been hands-on with the likes of Sentry and Grafana. You are comfortable with some exposure to Terraform and Kubernetes

  • Data & storage competence: Solid experience with relational, NoSQL, OLAP databases and caches (e.g. MySQL, MongoDB, ClickHouse, Redis). You know how to model data, optimize queries, tune performance, and design for failover and recovery

  • Security & quality mindset: You build systems that are correct, predictable, secure, and maintainable. You inform key security aspects such as proper secrets handling, encryption standards, rate limiting and vulnerability management

  • Technical collaboration: Clear, direct communication, with empathy when working with frontend/mobile, embedded, platform, and non-technical peers. You are comfortable leading technical discussions, and are able to change your mind in light of new evidence

  • Technical education and experience: Higher education in a STEM field (BSc/MSc). Practical experience in backend engineering. You have worked at product companies before, ideally across multiple stacks or domains


Why You'll Love it Here

  • Purpose with scale: Your work keeps thousands of children connected, learning, and included every single day

  • Real systems, real impact: From fleets of robots to real-time apps, you will tackle backend and reliability challenges that matter in the physical world, not just on a dashboard

  • Autonomous ownership: As a key Backend Engineer in a tight-knit cross-functional engineering team, you will shape our backend domain

  • Work with exceptional leaders: Build, learn, and grow alongside our Director of Engineering (Jerome Ginss) to shape a high-trust, learning-driven engineering culture, and impact KPIs valued by the executive team

  • Grow your craft: Elevate your skills in a lean, fast environment, with freedom to pitch in what you assess to be best practices


Our Tech Stack

Think container services, mobile apps, multiple web apps, and fleets of connected robots. It’s a rapidly growing ecosystem, wired by WebRTC, web sockets, Rest APIs and more. We pride ourselves with a choice of modern and exciting, yet battle-tested technologies. We balance hosting versus buying core systems pragmatically.

  • Languages & frameworks: Golang, React, React Native, Rust (Embassy), Python

  • Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS, Kubernetes, Traefik, Terraform, Ansible

  • Observability: Grafana stack, Prometheus

  • Development: GitLab, Sentry, Linear, OhDear

  • Platforms: Linux, Android, iOS, our custom Yocto distributions

  • Data & Analytics: MySQL, MongoDB, ClickHouse, Redis, Metabase


Location

This role is based in Oslo with hybrid flexibility at our headquarters. We welcome all qualified applicants. Due to current visa/work-permit processes, we can progress candidates already in Norway or relocating from within the EU/EEA. (This note is about work authorization only; no sensitive personal data is required.)


How to Apply

Please click Apply and upload your CV and a short cover letter outlining your motivation.

If you want your engineering craft to shape technology that genuinely changes lives, and you lead with rigor and empathy, we’d love to hear from you.

🎥 You may watch how AV1 transforms inclusion in education here: vimeo.com/1098745115 🌍 You may explore our mission and impact stories at noisolation.com


We kindly ask external recruitment agencies to refrain from contacting us regarding this position.

We help educators bring learning and belonging to every child. School absence is the biggest challenge facing education. Our AV1 robots connect absent students, ensure learning and belonging, and support reintegration back to the classroom. Today, there are over 3,500 active AV1 robots used across 18 European countries. Positioned in the EdTech sector, AV1 is a unique solution to the growing issue of persistent absence, supporting both the academic and social needs of students. No Isolation works across Europe, with 45 employees across Europe and in offices in Oslo, Munich and London. Join us in our growth journey!

jobs.title: Technical Support & Operations Engineer
jobs.description:
Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include the most energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges.

Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions

Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀 

About the Role

As part of the continued growth of our activities and the deployment of our photonic Quantum Processing Units (QPUs) to international customers, we are looking for a Technical Support & Operations Technician / Engineer to join our team.

You will contribute to the operational monitoring of Quandela's QPUs and other hardware products deployed at customer sites, ensuring their proper operation and supporting maintenance activities, both remotely and on site.

Working at the interface between Quandela's technical teams and system users, you will develop a broad understanding of our products, particularly the interactions between hardware equipment and software control interfaces. You will perform initial technical investigations when issues arise and involve the relevant technical experts when required.

The role combines technical support, maintenance, field interventions, training and continuous improvement in a complex and international technological environment.

Internal training will provide you with the specific knowledge required to understand our technology and systems. No previous experience in quantum computing is required.

As our support and maintenance activities are still being structured, you will also contribute to improving our processes, tools and operational methods.

Your Key Responsibilities:  

System operations & technical support

You will contribute to maintaining the operational performance and availability of QPUs and other hardware products deployed at customer sites.

    • Monitor the operation and performance of installed systems.
    • Analyse operational data and identify anomalies or performance degradation.
    • Perform initial technical investigations to characterise issues and help determine the appropriate resolution path.
    • Follow up on technical incidents and corrective actions with the relevant teams.
    • Maintain accurate technical records of systems and interventions.
    • Provide remote technical support to customers and trained personnel working on the systems.

Maintenance & customer-site interventions

You will contribute to the preparation and follow-up of preventive and corrective maintenance activities.

    • Track maintenance schedules and anticipate upcoming interventions.
    • Identify the resources, equipment, spare parts and technical expertise required for each intervention.
    • Perform diagnostic, maintenance and system recovery operations according to established procedures.
    • Support technicians and technical experts remotely or on site during interventions.
    • Perform functional checks and testing following maintenance activities.
    • Track completed actions, outstanding issues and upcoming maintenance requirements.

The role involves business travel within France and internationally, with frequency and duration depending on the needs of our installed systems.

User training & technical guidance

You will help customers and technical operators become increasingly autonomous in operating and maintaining our QPUs.

    • Train users and technical operators on routine QPU operation and maintenance activities.
    • Support users in operating the systems and their control interfaces.
    • Share best practices for operation, troubleshooting and maintenance.
    • Contribute to the creation and improvement of training materials and technical documentation.

Documentation & continuous improvement

You will ensure the traceability of technical operations and contribute to structuring our support and maintenance activities.

    • Prepare technical monitoring, intervention and maintenance reports.
    • Maintain up-to-date technical documentation for installed systems.
    • Contribute to writing and improving diagnostic, maintenance and operating procedures.
    • Capitalise on field experience to improve reliability and facilitate future interventions.
    • Contribute to implementing tools and methods for the structured monitoring of our installed systems.

Requirements

Education & experience

  • Associate's, Bachelor's or Master's degree in instrumentation, applied physics, optoelectronics or a related technical field.
  • The position is open to both experienced technicians and engineers with a strong interest in hands-on, operational activities.
  • Previous experience in operations, system integration, maintenance or technical support for complex systems is preferred.
  • Experience working in a multidisciplinary hardware/software environment is highly valued.
  • Experience supporting or maintaining technical equipment installed at customer sites would be an advantage.

Technical skills Required

  • Good understanding of complex technical systems combining hardware and software.
  • Knowledge of electronics, instrumentation and/or control systems.
  • Ability to analyse operational data and characterise technical issues.
  • Ability to perform diagnostic and maintenance operations according to established procedures.
  • Ability to identify and involve the appropriate technical experts when required.
  • Strong organisational skills and ability to rigorously track interventions, deadlines and outstanding actions.
  • Ability to follow, write and improve technical procedures.
  • Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken, as you will interact directly with international customers and colleagues, deliver training sessions and produce technical documentation.
  • Willingness and ability to travel internationally.

Nice to have

  • Knowledge of optics, photonics and/or cryogenics.
  • Hands-on experience with optical systems, including basic optical alignment.
  • Experience operating or maintaining cryogenic systems.
  • Basic programming or scripting skills, particularly Python.
  • Experience maintaining scientific or industrial equipment.
  • Experience delivering technical training to users or operators.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience
  • Profit-sharing & company savings plan
  • 100% health coverage (Alan)
  • 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus
  • Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support
  • Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000)

What we offer

  • A meaningful role with real ownership, from day one
  • A team eager to collaborate and grow with you
  • A hybrid work model (3 days/week onsite in Massy, 1 day in Paris, 1 to 2 days remotely)
  • Daily exposure to the entire quantum stack — from high-level APIs to low-level firmware, and everything in between.

Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview (30' - 45')
  • Hiring Manager Interview (45')
  • Use Case (a live use case or one to be prepared at home and presented afterward)
  • Meeting with the teams
  • 2 reference check
  • Offer

(This process is provided for guidance only and may evolve depending on the roles)

At Quandela, we believe that the strength of our team is the plurality of experiences, perspectives, and journeys. We are committed to building a respectful, inclusive, and welcoming work environment. All applications are welcome.

jobs.description:
Jouw uitdagingen als HEV3 technieker (batterijhersteller):

Voor onze site in Aalter zijn we op zoek naar een HEV3 technieker (batterijhersteller). In deze functie speel je een cruciale rol in de toekomst van elektrische mobiliteit.

Je staat in voor de diagnose en de herstelling van hoog-voltage (HV) batterijen en elektrische aandrijfsystemen van hybride en volledig elektrische voertuigen. Je werkt nauw samen met diagnosetechniekers om voertuigen veilig en efficiënt terug op de baan te krijgen.

Als HEV3 technieker (batterijhersteller) ben je verantwoordelijk voor:

· Uitvoeren van diagnoses op HV-batterijen en elektrische aandrijflijnen.

· Herstellen, reviseren en vervangen van batterijmodules, HV-componenten en koelsystemen.

· Veilig werken volgens HEV3/HV-veiligheidsprocedures en interne richtlijnen.

· Analyseren van foutcodes, batterijprestaties en thermische problemen.

· Uitvoeren van software-updates, kalibraties en HV-testprocedures.

· Documenteren van uitgevoerde interventies en rapporteren aan de technische leiding.

· Samenwerken met collega’s om processen te optimaliseren en kwaliteit te waarborgen.

Waarmee kan je ons team versterken?

  • Je behaalde minimaal een diploma automechanica of bent gelijkwaardig door ervaring. Een bachelor autotechnologie is zeker een troef.
  • Je behaalde een HEV2 of HEV3-certificaat.
  • Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als diagnosetechnieker of kan reeds ervaring voorleggen in een gelijkaardige rol.
  • Je beschikt over sterke kennis van elektriciteit en elektronica.
  • Je bent nauwkeurig en hebt oog voor veiligheid binnen de werkplaats.
