jobs.title: Software & Cloud Engineer, Aventra
jobs.description:
Aventra Oy on identiteetinhallinnan, käyttövaltuuksien hallinnan ja sähköisen tunnistamisen ratkaisuihin erikoistunut asiantuntijayritys. Vuonna 2004 perustettu Aventra on kasvanut vakaasti ja työllistää nykyisin yli 30 alan huippuosaajaa. Suunnittelemme, toteutamme ja ylläpidämme asiakkaillemme toimivia, turvallisia ja kustannustehokkaita ratkaisuja, jotka integroituvat saumattomasti asiakkaiden olemassa oleviin järjestelmäympäristöihin.

Erityisosaamistamme ovat identiteetti- ja käyttövaltuushallinta (IAM), sähköinen tunnistaminen sekä pilvipohjaiset palveluympäristöt. Toimitamme asiakkaillemme kokonaisratkaisuja aina arkkitehtuurista tuotantokäyttöön ja ylläpitoon asti.

Nopeus, ketteryys ja tiivis yhteistyö asiakkaidemme kanssa ovat toimintamme kulmakiviä. Korkein AAA-luottoluokitus sekä pitkä historia onnistuneista asiakasprojekteista mahdollistavat jatkuvan panostamisen omaan tuotekehitykseen ja uusien teknologioiden hyödyntämiseen.

[https://images.teamtailor-cdn.com/images/s3/teamtailor-production/original-v3/image_uploads/d96b5c45-ea65-4e34-890d-a6236dd21a72/original.png]

Mitä tulisit meillä tekemään?
Haemme nyt Software & Cloud Engineeria vahvistamaan järjestelmätuotteidemme kehitystiimiä. Toimintamme kasvaessa etsimme tiimiimme uutta osaajaa työskentelemään Azure-pohjaisten ratkaisujen, modernin ohjelmistokehityksen sekä identiteetinhallinnan parissa.

Roolissa yhdistyvät pilvikehitys ja ohjelmistokehitys. Osallistut sekä Aventran omien tuotteiden kehittämiseen että asiakasratkaisujen suunnitteluun ja toteutukseen. Käytännössä työsi voi sisältää Azure-ympäristöjen suunnittelua, kehittämistä ja ylläpitoa, automaation rakentamista sekä Infrastructure as Code-, CI/CD- ja DevOps-ratkaisujen kehittämistä. Lisäksi osallistut sovelluskehitykseen Microsoft-teknologioilla ja teet tiivistä yhteistyötä niin tuotekehitys- kuin asiakasprojektitiimien kanssa.

Pääset työskentelemään monipuolisesti sekä uusien ratkaisujen kehittämisen että olemassa olevien palveluiden jatkuvan kehittämisen parissa. Työnkuvaa voidaan myös painottaa kiinnostuksesi ja osaamisesi mukaan esimerkiksi pilviarkkitehtuuriin, ohjelmistokehitykseen, DevOpsiin tai teknisten ratkaisujen suunnitteluun.

Työsuhde on vakituinen ja kokoaikainen, ja se solmitaan suoraan Aventran kanssa. Työskentelemme joustavalla hybridimallilla ja meillä on viihtyisät, uudet toimistotilat Pitäjänmäessä, junaradan ja Raide-Jokerin varrella. Toivomme erityisesti alkuvaiheessa säännöllistä läsnäoloa toimistolla, jotta pääset tutustumaan tiimiimme ja toimintatapoihimme.

Mitä toivomme sinulta?
Tehtävässä onnistumisen perustana on vahva käytännön ohjelmistokehitysosaaminen. Voit olla taustaltasi esimerkiksi full stack- tai backend-kehittäjä tai pilvikehitykseen suuntautunut ohjelmistokehittäjä. Tärkeintä on, että viihdyt koodin parissa ja innostut modernien pilvipohjaisten ratkaisujen kehittämisestä.

Toivomme sinulta kokemusta ohjelmistokehityksestä C#:lla ja .NET-teknologioilla sekä Azuresta tai muista pilviympäristöistä. Arvostamme myös osaamista Infrastructure as Code -ratkaisuista, Azure DevOpsista tai vastaavista CI/CD-työkaluista sekä Gitistä ja moderneista DevOps-käytännöistä. Kokemus Vue.js:stä, Reactista tai muista moderneista frontend-teknologioista tukee menestymistä tehtävässä.

Eduksesi katsomme kokemuksen REST-rajapinnoista ja integraatioista, Microsoft Entra ID:stä, SQL Serveristä, Entity Frameworkista sekä tietoturvaan, identiteetinhallintaan ja käyttövaltuushallintaan liittyvistä ratkaisuista.

Teknisen osaamisen lisäksi arvostamme oma-aloitteista työotetta, vastuunkantoa ja hyviä ongelmanratkaisutaitoja. Haluat kehittää osaamistasi jatkuvasti, työskentelet luontevasti sekä itsenäisesti että osana tiimiä ja osaat viestiä teknisistä asioista selkeästi niin kollegoille kuin asiakkaillekin. Tehtävässä tarvitset sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa.

Mitä me tarjoamme?
Olemme ketterä softatalo, joka näkyy meillä joustavuutena ja rentona työilmapiirinä. Työntekijämme viihtyvät meillä, koska kannustavan työilmapiirin lisäksi tarjoamme hyvät mahdollisuudet kehittyä sekä vaikuttaa omaan työnkuvaan. Meillä pääset työskentelemään oman tuotekehityksen parissa ja kehittämään ratkaisuja, joita käytetään vaativissa identiteetin- ja käyttövaltuushallinnan ympäristöissä.

Tarjoamme kattavan ja hyvän perehdytyksen sekä kokeneiden kollegoiden tuen. Meillä voit myös sovittaessa lomailla vuoden aikana myös perinteisten loma-aikojen ulkopuolella ja muutenkin pystymme joustamaan melko yksilöllisesti eri elämäntilanteiden mukaan. Pidämme myös huolta työntekijöistämme, ja esimerkiksi ylityötunneista sovitaankin meillä aina etukäteen.

Työntekijöillemme tarjoamme kattavat työsuhde-edut, kuten lounas-, liikunta-, kulttuuriedun sekä työterveyspalvelut. Tehtävän palkkahaitari on alustavasti 3 500–5 000 euroa kuukaudessa, ja lopullinen palkka määräytyy osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi perusteella.

Kiinnostuitko?
Mikäli mielenkiintosi heräsi, haluamme ehdottomasti kuulla sinusta lisää! Laitathan hakemuksesi linkin kautta mahdollisimman pian, kuitenkin viimeistään 5.11.2026 mennessä. Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana.

Rekrytointiprosessi toteutetaan yhteistyössä Biisonin kanssa. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Biisonin rekrytointikonsultti Nea Repo, nea.repo@biisoni.fi [nea.repo@biisoni.fi]

Huomioithan, että käsittelemme vain rekrytointijärjestelmämme kautta tulleet hakemukset, emme ota hakemuksia vastaan sähköpostitse.

jobs.title: Autorisert sykepleier
jobs.description:
Vil du være med å utvikle fremtidens hjemmetjeneste i Øvre Eiker? 

 

Hjemmetjenesten i Øvre Eiker er i kontinuerlig utvikling. Vi arbeider hver dag for å sikre at innbyggerne våre får gode tjenester, samtidig som vi utvikler arbeidsformer, fagmiljøer og kompetanse for fremtidens helse- og omsorgstjenester.

Hjemmetjenesten er organisert i fire soner. Sone 1 og 2 følger opp hjemmeboende innbyggere med vedtak om hjemmesykepleie, mens sone 3 består av fagteam innen demens, mestring og rus/psykiatri. Sone 4 omfatter omsorgsboliger med stedlig bemanning. Sone 1-3 er samlokalisert på Eikertun helsehus i Hokksund.

Vi søker nå en engasjert og faglig trygg sykepleier til en fast stilling på inntil 100% i sone 2. i tillegg har vi 1-2 spennende svangerskapsvikariater ledige i sammen sone. 

Kanskje er du en erfaren sykepleier som ønsker nye utfordringer? Eller kanskje du er nyutdannet og nysgjerrig på om hjemmetjenesten kan være noe for deg? Du vil møte faglige utfordringer som uansett utgangspunkt gir rom som utvikling.

Sykepleierrollen hos oss er variert, selvstendig og faglig utfordrende. Du vil møte brukere med sammensatte behov og få muligheten til å bruke hele bredden av sykepleiefaget i deres eget hjem.

De sykepleiefaglige oppgavene i hjemmetjenesten har økt både i omfang og kompleksitet. Vi gir sammensatte tjenester og utfører avanserte prosedyrer hjemme hos brukerne. Høsten 2026 innfører vi nytt pasientjournalsystem, og vi videreutvikler kontinuerlig organiseringen av tjenestene våre for å sikre riktig kompetanse til riktig oppgave. Hos oss får du derfor muligheten til å være med på utviklingen av en moderne hjemmetjeneste hvor fag, kvalitet og innovasjon står sentralt.

Arbeidshverdagen består blant annet av kliniske vurderinger, avanserte prosedyrer, palliativ oppfølging, legemiddelhåndtering, tverrfaglig samarbeid og koordinering av tjenester rundt brukerne. Som sykepleier samarbeider du tett med kollegaer på tvers av soner og fagmiljøer for å sikre helhetlige og trygge tjenester.

Å starte i ny jobb innebærer mye nytt å sette seg inn i. Hos oss får du derfor en egen mentor som støtter deg gjennom opplæringsperioden og bidrar til at du blir trygg i rollen, kjent med arbeidsplassen og godt integrert i fagmiljøet.

Ønsker du å være med på laget og bidra til videreutviklingen av hjemmetjenesten i Øvre Eiker? Da håper vi å høre fra deg!

 


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Ha ansvar for helhetlig sykepleiefaglig oppfølging av hjemmeboende brukere
  • Gjennomføre kliniske vurderingen og bidra til gode beslutninger og pasientforløp
  • Bidra til at brukerne mestrer hverdagen og kan bo trygt hjemme lengst mulig
  • Samarbeide tett med pårørende, fastleger og andre faggrupper
  • Veilede kollegaer, studenter og pårørende ved behov
  • Bidra til fagutvikling, kvalitetsforbedring og gode tjenester
  • Dokumentere og følge opp pasientforløp i tråd med krav til kvalitet og pasientsikkerhet
  • Holde deg faglig oppdatert og ta i bruk relevante digitale verktøy og velferdsteknologi
Kvalifikasjoner

Vi søker deg som har

  • Norsk autorisasjon som sykepleier
  • Gode norskkunnskaper, minimum bestått B2
  • Relevante IT-kunnskaper
  • Ønskelig med erfaring innen hjemmesykepleie, men ikke krav

Stillingen krever førerkort klasse B

Politiattest må fremlegges før oppstart

 

 

Personlige egenskaper
  • Trives med å jobbe både selvstendig og i team
  • Fleksibel, tydelig og pålitelig
  • Er nysgjerrig på nye løsninger og ønsker å bidra til utvikling
  • Ser verdien av samarbeid, deling av kunnskap og et godt arbeidsmiljø
  • Ser muligheter der andre ser begrensninger 
  • Møter brukere, pårørende og kollegaer med respekt og engasjement
Vi tilbyr

Ny hos oss? 

Vi ønsker at nye medarbeidere skal få en trygg og god start. Derfor for alle nyansatte egen mentor som følger deg gjennom introduksjonsperioden. Mentoren bidrar med faglig støtte, veiledning og hjelp til å bli kjent med både arbeidsoppgaver, rutiner og kollegaer.

  • Lønn etter avtale
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsvilkår
  • Hyggelige kollegaer i et utviklingsorientert arbeidsmiljø
  • Todelt turnus med mulighet for langvakter på helg
  • Velferdsforening

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Vedlagt søknaden legges relevante vitnemål og attester.

Øvre Eiker kommune er et godt sted å bo og jobbe! Vi har fokus på kvalitet, arbeidsglede, inkludering og god ledelse for å fremme mestring hos de ansatte. Øvre Eiker er i utvikling på mange områder, og hos oss jobber folkevalgte, administrativ ledelse, ansatte og innbyggere tett sammen for å løse utfordringer og se nye muligheter.

Vi er opptatt av mangfold og oppfordrer kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke uansett alder, kjønn, funksjonsevne eller kulturell bakgrunn. Våre verdier er respekt, mot, samspill og tilhørighet. 

Øvre Eiker kommune har over 20.000 innbyggere og er en virksomhet med ca 1.200 ansatte. Sammen skaper vi et livskraftig Øvre Eiker.

Øvre Eiker kommune praktiserer meroffentlighet ved tilsettinger. Det innebærer at søkere må begrunne særskilt hvis en søknad ønskes unntatt offentlighet. Begrunnelsen vil bli vurdert i henhold til reglene i Offentlighetsloven. Dersom det etter kommunens vurdering ikke foreligger en særskilt grunn, vil søknaden bli offentliggjort. Søkere blir informert og får muligheten til eventuelt å trekke sin søknad før offentliggjøring.

Offentlig tjenestepensjon
Med jobben følger en av Norges beste pensjonsordninger, offentlig tjenestepensjon. Dette gir deg mer enn du kanskje tror.
Øvre Eiker kommune sparer pensjon for deg. Vi betaler inn hele 15 – 20% av lønnen din, avhengig av hvilken lønn du har.  I tillegg setter du selv av 2 %. Dette beløpet trekkes automatisk fra lønnsutbetalingen din hver måned.

Gjennom pensjonsordningen sparer du til fremtidig alderspensjon og AFP. I tillegg er du sikret ved sykdom og død gjennom uførepensjon og etterlattepensjon.

Den endelige pensjonsutbetalingen blir bestemt blant annet av hvor mye du har jobbet og hvor mye du har tjent. Offentlig tjenestepensjon har en livsvarig utbetaling, til forskjell fra det private hvor utbetaling ofte kun skjer over 10 år.

 

Følg oss gjerne i sosiale medier! 

NB! Øvre Eiker kommune ber aldri om din BankID-informasjon i søknadsprosessen. Blir du bedt om dette, kan det være forsøk på svindel.

jobs.title: Swedish speaking employee needed for Swedish debt collection service - PART TIME
jobs.description:
Do you speak fluent Swedish and are you good at talking to different people through the phone?
Perhaps you are studying or already have a job, but are looking for some extra hours for an additional income?

We are looking for someone who can primarily help us during our busiest periods of every month and on somewhat regular basis outside of that. The hours will vary from month to month and differ throughout the month as well, depending on our shifting workload and customer volume.

Our daily tasks primarily consists of calling existing customers of the banks we work with and make payment agreements on their late or missing payments.
We need someone with a well-developed ability to work with a variety of people over the phone and someone who can ensure the customer always gets a good experience. Whether it’s regarding a customer who just missed a payment by accident or if it’s a customer who’s in a vulnerable situation right now, we need to be ready to meet every customer at their level and offer good solutions.

Qualities we value in you:

- You know how to smile through the phone

- Self-confidence and the ability to work as part of a team

- Great communication skills and the ability to create a good connection with a variety of people

- Can work full days during our peak periods (this normally lasts from a few days to a full week every month)

- Stability and reliability

What you can expect from us:

- Fixed hourly wage

- A social work environment with a pleasant atmosphere

- A multinational workplace with an informal tone

- Offices located in both Copenhagen and Malmö, with the possibility of working from both locations

- Only a few work days a month, but flexible working hours and good connections to public transportation near our offices.



Who are we and what do we do?
Nordiccom ApS is a growing Nordic company located in the heart of Copenhagen and Malmö. The companies we represent are major banking and insurance companies in Europe. With the entire Northern European market as our workplace, and the phone as our tool, we provide solutions for sales and customer service for a wide range of companies in the financial sector. Therefore, we comply with the banks’ standards and code of conduct, so quality is ensured. In Nordiccom you will meet both Danes, Finns and Swedes. Nordiccom consists of about 150 employees divided into different teams. In Nordiccom, we emphasize professionalism, and it is important that we thrive when we are at work. jobs.title: Helsefagarbeider
jobs.description:
Virksomhet Livsmestring 1 bofellesskap består av ti bofellesskap som gir tjenester til mennesker med utviklingshemming og autisme. Vi er en virksomhet som har fokus på tverrfaglig samarbeid, kunnskapsdeling i praksis og arbeidsglede blant våre ansatte.

Madam Arnesens vei gir tjenester til 10 brukere med ulik grad av utviklingshemming og psykiske lidelser, og vi teller i dag ca. 25 årsverk. Målet vårt er å bidra til at den enkelte får en trygg, meningsfull og aktiv hverdag. Vi søker deg som er opptatt av å gi gode tjenester, er faglig engasjert og løsningsorientert, og som ønsker å bidra til et godt arbeidsmiljø.

Livsmestring 1 bofellesskap søker en autorisert helsefagarbeider/hjelpepleier til et vikariat i 100 % stilling i årsturnus.

Er du en trygg, positiv og faglig engasjert helsefagarbeider? Da oppfordrer vi deg til å søke stilling hos oss!


Arbeidsoppgaver

Som medarbeider på Madam Arnesens vei, vil du bli del av en personalgruppe med høy fagkompetanse og erfaring. Videre er vi opptatt av å gi hver enkelt bruker gode tjenester i eget hjem.

Arbeidsoppgavene dine vil blant annet være å yte praktisk og personlig bistand. Du må like å jobbe i andres hjem, og bidra til at brukerne har så gode og meningsfulle dager som mulig ut ifra deres ønsker, behov og forutsetninger. Vi jobber mot at brukere skal ha god livskvalitet ut ifra deres forutsetninger.  Arbeidet består blant annet av å veilede og bistå brukere i personlig hygiene, matlaging, husarbeid, og aktiviteter. Samt legge til rette for deltakelse på sosiale arenaer som kor, ridning og svømming.

En stor og viktig del av tjenestetilbudet er å se den enkelte bruker, være lydhøre, og ivareta brukerstemmen. Å bygge trygge og gode relasjoner til brukerne er også en viktig del av miljøarbeidet.

I teamet jobber vi tverrfaglig med medarbeidere med ulik profesjonsbakgrunn som vernepleiere, sykepleiere, barnehagelærere, barne- og ungdomsarbeidere og helsefagarbeidere. Vi har lærlinger og vernepleiere som har praksis på Madam Arnesens vei

Kvalifikasjoner
  • Autorisasjon som helsefagarbeider 
  • Relevant arbeidserfaring er ønskelig. 
  • Personlig egnethet vektlegges.
  • Gode norskkunnskaper både muntlig og skriftlig
  • Førerkort klasse B, fortrinnsvis manuell. 
Personlige egenskaper
  • Ønsker å bidra til at våre tjenestemottakere får en bedre hverdag.
  • Er fremoverlent og tar en utfordring på strak arm.
  • Ikke er redd for å ta ansvar.
  • Har gode samarbeidsevner, men kan samtidig stå alene i faglige utfordringer.
  • Er en lagspiller som er fleksibel i forhold til arbeidsoppgaver.
  • Har kunnskap om systematisk målrettet miljøarbeid, forebygging av utfordrende atferd og erfaring med konflikthåndtering.
  • Reflekterer over egen praksis og kan lære av dine feil.
  • Er god på relasjonsbygging.
  • Har god skriftlig fremstillingsevne og gode IKT kunnskaper.


Vi ønsker deg som er rolig og trygg, og evner det å stå i situasjoner som kan oppleves utfordrende.

Vi tilbyr
  • Lønn etter kompetanse og kvalifikasjoner ihht gjeldende lover og regler.
  • Gode pensjons og forsikringsordninger.
  • Årsturnus med 16 helger per år.
  • Tverrfaglig miljø og nettverk. Spennende arbeidsoppgaver med gode utviklingsmuligheter.
  • Et godt fagmiljø som villig svarer på dine spørsmål.
  • God opplæring

    Øvrig vilkår/annet: 
    Det forventes at du som medarbeider etterlever  Sarpsborg kommunes plattform for ledelse og medarbeiderskap " Vi i Sarpsborg", og at vår visjon «Sammen skaper vi Sarpsborg» og verdiene "Framtidsrettet, åpen, respektfull og troverdig" vises gjennom ditt arbeid.

    Gyldig politiattest må fremlegges ved ansettelse. Vedlegg som har betydning for ansiennitetsberegning bes laster opp i Webcruiter. Eksempel Vitnemål, autorisasjon og tjenestebevis.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Sammen skaper vi Sarpsborg! Det er vår visjon, og sammen jobber vi hver dag for at våre innbyggere skal ha gode dager. For å klare dette, trenger vi dyktige medarbeidere. 

Her i Sarpsborg kommune jobber vi etter verdiene framtidsrettet, åpen, respektfull og troverdig. For å levere gode tjenester og skape gode arbeidsmiljøer skal alle ansatte vise handling gjennom å våge, lede, lære, mobilisere og samarbeide. Dette er beskrevet i vår plattform for ledelse og medarbeiderskap, som vi har valgt å kalle for «Vi i Sarpsborg». Les hele plattformen «Vi i Sarpsborg her».

Over 60 000 innbyggere bor i Sarpsborg og hos oss i kommunen har vi cirka 6.900 fast ansatte og 4.200 årsverk (tall fra 2026). Her skal det være godt å bo, jobbe og besøke. Vil du søke jobb hos oss og være med på å utgjøre en forskjell for andre?

Sarpsborg kommune ønsker medarbeidere med ulik faglig, sosial, etnisk og geografisk bakgrunn. Dette inkluderer: ulik kompetanse, erfaring, oppvekstsvilkår, tro- og livssyn, perspektiv, nettverk, språk og dialekt, interesser, alder, funksjonsevne, seksuell orientering og kjønn- og kjønnsidentitet.  Vi trenger historier, stemmer og erfaringer fra hele befolkningen.

jobs.title: Asiakasneuvoja, Sastamala
jobs.description:
Me Terveystalossa teemme työksemme tärkeintä, terveyttä. Työllämme on suuri merkitys, ei vain asiakkaillemme, vaan koko yhteiskunnalle. Meitä tärkeimmän tekijöitä on Terveystalossa jo yli 14 000 lähes 400 toimipaikassa eri puolilla Suomea. Siellä, missä ihmiset elävät arkeaan ja missä kotimaista työtämme tarvitaan.

Etsimme nyt Asiakasneuvojaa Sastamalaan.

Mitä työ asiakasneuvojana pitää sisällään?

Meillä asiakasneuvojana Terveystalossa pääset tekemään monipuolisia ja haastavia asiakaspalvelun tehtäviä sekä hyödyntämään ja kasvattamaan osaamistasi motivoituneen ja innostuneen tiimin parissa. Haluamme tarjota asiakkaille ensiluokkaista ja yksilöllistä asiakaspalvelua, sillä meille jokainen asiakaskohtaaminen on tärkeä. Haluamme tukea asiakkaan asiointia sen kaikissa vaiheissa, ja asiakkaan ystävällinen kohtaaminen on asiakaspalveluumme ydin. Me Terveystalon asiakaspalvelussa olemme asiakaskohtaamisen ammattilaisia ja vastaamme Terveystalon asiakkaiden onnistuneesta asiakaskokemuksesta.

Asiakaspalvelussa tärkeä osa työtäsi on huolehtia asiakkaan sujuvasta saapumisesta Terveystaloon, ajanvarauksista ja maksutilanteiden hoitamisesta. Ohjaat ammattitaidollasi asiakkaita sekä toimipaikan tiloissa että asiakaspalvelupisteellä. Asiakasneuvojana tehtävänäsi on varmistaa asiakkaillemme katkeamaton hoitopolku, jossa luomme asiakkaalle välittävän ja turvallisen tunteen. Tämä tarkoittaa, että suosittelet rohkeasti palveluita asiakkaille eri palvelukanavanissa ja varmistat näin hoidon jatkuvuuden. Osana työtehtäviäsi huolehdit myös toimipisteemme arjen sujuvuudesta ja neuvot ammattitaidollasi myös toimipaikan terveydenhuollon ammattilaisia.

Työsuhde tehtävässä on kokoaikainen ja toistaiseksi voimassa oleva. Työtä tehdään kahdessa vuorossa toimipaikan aukioloaikojen mukaisesti klo 7.30-19.30 välillä. Työhön sisältyy vuoroja tarpeen mukaan myös Nokian toimipaikassa arkisin ja viikonloppuisin.

Tärkein ensin kuvastaa hyvin sitä, mikä on Terveystalossa tärkeintä. Teemme kaikki työssämme kaikkemme, jotta asiakas saa hyvän kokemuksen ja tuntee olonsa turvalliseksi koko hoitopolun ajan. Terveystalon asiakasneuvoja.


Terveystalon kokonaispalkitseminen muodostuu tehtäväkohtaisesta palkasta ja mahdollisesta henkilökohtaisesta palkanosasta sekä työsuhde-eduista.

- Työtehtävässä noudatetaan yksityisen terveyspalvelualan työehtosopimusta (TPTES), jonka mukaan tehtäväkohtainen palkka muodostuu. Tehtävä on määritetty Terveystalossa vaativuusryhmään VR3, jonka mukainen vähimmäispalkka asiakasneuvojalle on 2414,15 €/kk.
- Lisäksi palkkaan vaikuttavat mahdollinen henkilökohtainen osuus (erityinen osaaminen, aiempi työkokemus) ja erityistekijälisät (lisävastuut työssä) sekä vuosisidonnaisuus (4 vuotta +6 %, ja 7 vuotta +11 % tehtäväkohtaisesta palkasta). Tämän päälle maksetaan TES:n mukaiset vuorolisät.
- Terveystalon tärkeimmän tekijät pääsevät myös nauttimaan monipuolisista työsuhde-eduista, joihin kuuluvat lounas- ja liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointietu, kumppanialennukset sekä kattava työterveyshuolto. Työterveyshuolto sisältää peruspalveluiden lisäksi muun muassa lähetteelliset erikoislääkärikäynnit ja mielen hyvinvoinnin palveluita, kuten lyhytpsykoterapian.

Miksi töihin Terveystaloon?

Meillä arki rakentuu sujuvuudesta ja toisista välittämisestä, jatkuvasta halusta kehittyä ja ennen kaikkea inhimillisistä kohtaamisista. Vaikka maailma muuttuu, meidän tapamme tehdä työtä säilyy: Terveystalossa sinä voit keskittyä tekemään sitä, mikä on tärkeintä – terveyttä.
- Osaamisen tuki. Meillä muutokset ovat arkipäivää. Tarjoamme ammattilaisillemme tukea osaamisen ylläpitämiseen ja kehittämiseen jatkuvasti kehittyvässä ympäristössä. - Arkemme on sujuvaa. Panostamme lähijohtamiseen ja esihenkilötyöhön, jotta jokainen ammattilaisemme saa työssään tarvittavan tuen. Ammattirajat ylittävä tiimityö, joustavuus ja edistykselliset hoitopolkumme tukevat arjen työtä. - Välitämme toisistamme. Meillä jokainen on oma arvostettu itsensä, oman alansa huippuosaaja ja tärkeä osa työyhteisöä. Osaajatutkimuksemme mukaan ammattilaisemme arvostavat muun muassa lämmintä työyhteisöämme, hyvää esihenkilötyötä ja lähijohtamista sekä mahdollisuutta onnistua omassa työssä. - Teemme vaikuttavaa työtä. Terveystalossa on ainutkertaista osaamista aina ennaltaehkäisystä perusterveydenhuoltoon, suunterveyteen ja erikoissairaanhoitoon. Käytössämme ovat ainutlaatuiset oman työn laatumittarit ja digitaaliset hoitopolut kaikkiin yleisimpiin sairauksiin. Panostamme myös ammattilaistemme laadukkaaseen kouluttautumiseen, kehittymiseen ja ammatilliseen kasvuun. - Kotimainen ja vastuullinen. Vastuullisuus on meille sydämen asia. ISS ESG:n arvioinnissa kuulumme globaalisti oman alamme kärkeen, ja Suomalainen työ ry on myöntänyt meille Avainlippu-tunnuksen osoituksena Suomessa tuotetusta ja työllistävästä palvelusta. Teemme työtä suomalaisten terveyden ja koko yhteiskunnan hyvinvoinnin eteen tinkimättömällä ammattitaidolla. Suomen suurimpana yksityisenä terveydenhuoltoalan toimijana vaalimme kotimaisia juuria ja olemme ylpeitä suomalaisista omistajistamme. - Monimuotoinen ja yhdenvertainen. Terveystalossa olemme kaikki samanarvoisia riippumatta sukupuolesta, iästä, etnisestä tai kansallisesta taustasta, kansalaisuudesta, kielestä, uskonnosta, vakaumuksesta, mielipiteestä, vammasta, terveydentilasta, seksuaalisesta suuntautumisesta tai muusta ominaisuudesta.
Mitä toivomme sinulta?

Tehtävän pätevyysvaatimuksena on terveysalan koulutus, esimerkiksi lähihoitajan tai sairaanhoitajan tutkinto. Etsimme joukkoomme henkilöä, jolla on aito halu ja innostus tarjota erinomaista asiakaspalvelua jokaiselle asiakkaalle. Toivomme sinulta asiakaspalveluhenkisyyttä ja sitä, että olet yhteistyötaitoinen tiimipelaaja, joka ei kavahda muuttuvia tilanteita. Toivomme sinulta myös aktiivisia vuorovaikutustaitoja ja positiivista asennetta erinomaisen asiakaskokemuksen aikaansaamiseksi. Sinulta löytyy myös taitoa ratkaista asiakkaiden ongelmatilanteita. Odotamme, että uskallat rohkeasti suositella asiakkaille palveluitamme ja huolehtia siten asiakkaan hoitopolun toteutumisesta.

Aiempi kokemus asiakaspalvelutehtävistä katsotaan eduksi, mutta tärkeintä on halu oppia, kehittyä ja kyky innostua muutoksista. Ruotsin ja englannin kielen taito edesauttaa tehtävässä onnistumista.

Kiinnostuitko tehtävästä?

⏰ Arbeidstid: Ettermiddag/kveld i ukedager. Øvrige arbeidstider etter avtale.

Jeg er en glad gutt på snart 13 år som bor i Haugesund sammen med familien min. Jeg trives godt med turer og ulike aktiviteter, men etter skolen, når jeg har BPA, har jeg et ekstra behov for ro og hvile. Derfor er det viktig for meg at du både kan trives i rolige omgivelser og samtidig ønsker å bidra til gode sanseopplevelser.

Jeg liker å se på barne-TV, høre på musikk og dra på turer i turvognen. Jeg har et ikke-verbalt språk og kommuniserer gjennom lyder og smil. Etter hvert som du blir bedre kjent med meg, vil du lettere forstå hva jeg ønsker å uttrykke.

Jeg kan ikke gå eller bevege armene mine selv, og har derfor behov for hjelp og støtte i de fleste situasjoner i hverdagen. Som min assistent vil du blant annet hjelpe meg med personlig stell, forflytning og praktiske gjøremål. Jeg trenger også hjelp i forbindelse med måltider, både til tilberedning av mat og til selve spisesituasjonen.

Siden jeg har behov for mye ro og hvile, har jeg et eget anneks som vi benytter når du er på jobb hos meg. Annekset ligger i tilknytning til huset vårt. Det er en fordel om du bor i Haugesund eller nærliggende område, og har fleksibilitet til å bidra i ferieperioder.

Hvis dette høres ut som en jobb som kan passe for deg, håper jeg du vil søke! 😊

Stillingsstørrelse og arbeidstid

Jeg er nå på utkikk etter 2–3 fleksible tilkallingsvikarer som kan stille opp ved behov, for eksempel ved sykdom, ferier og på røde dager i grunnskolen.

Mine assistenter jobber hovedsakelig ettermiddager og kvelder i ukedagene, men det kan også være aktuelt med både dag-, kveld- og nattevakter. Dette avtales nærmere ut fra behov og hva som passer begge parter.

Det er mulighet for fast stilling på sikt.

Arbeidsoppgaver:

• Hjelp og støtte ved forflytning

jobs.title: Leiter Automatisierungstechnik Siemens TIA
jobs.description:
About EH Group Engineering

EHG is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product is a significantly more compact fuel cell with high power density and lower costs of production. Faced with the challenges of climate change and the transition to a decentralised energy system, EHG seeks to provide high performance and cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To help bring this vision to life, we are looking for a Senior Control Engineer to coordinate our efforts in designing control strategies for containerized systems integrating our fuel cell technology alongside equipment such as gas reformers, batteries, and climate control units. You will coordinate the control team and play a key role in shaping how these complex, multi-equipment systems operate safely and efficiently in the field.

Based in the US? You’re welcome to apply. This is an on-site role in Nyon, Switzerland. We ask that you relocate within 3 months of starting, and we’ll support you with a relocation package.

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate the control engineering activities and define the control architecture and technical roadmap for our fuel cell and containerized power systems

  • Develop control strategies, models and algorithms for test-benches, fuel cell system and containerized power supply systems using Matlab/Simulink and Siemens PLCs

  • Coordinate the transition of prototype control algorithms from Simulink to industrial-quality code in TIA Portal Step 7

  • Implement, tune and validate controllers for thermal, air, fuel and power subsystems

  • Define and own control requirements, state machines and safety/diagnostic logic

  • Drive the continuous improvement (performance, efficiency and robustness) of our products

  • Define and oversee model-in-the-loop (MIL) testing and validation procedures

  • Manage the complete software life cycle, from requirements through release and maintenance, including dataset management

  • Establish coding standards, conduct code reviews and ensure compliance with industrial and certification requirements

  • Coordinate and develop the control team, including task planning and prioritization

  • Act as the main control interface with embedded, test and electrical engineering, as well as external partners and suppliers

 

Skills and Experience Required:

  • BSc/MSc in control, electrical, mechatronic or automation engineering is mandatory

  • Minimum 7 years of experience in control engineering, including at least 2 years in a technical lead or senior role

  • Skill 1 : Strong experience in process control engineering, particularly with containerized power supply systems; knowledge of programming and implementing safety PLCs is a strong plus

  • Skill 2 : Strong experience with TIA Portal (Step 7, WinCC, Test Suite), with the ability to structure code to industrial standards and meet certification requirements

  • Experience with functional safety (e.g. IEC 61508, ISO 13849), including SIL/PL determination and implementation of safety functions

  • Experience across the complete V-model development cycle, including hazard and risk assessment, requirements definition, safety requirements specification (SRS), verification and validation, and dataset management

  • Experience with stationary and maritime power applications, with a focus on the US and EU markets and their respective standards and certification requirements

  • Proven team player, with the ability to:
    (i) Coordinate and mentor the control team by clearly explaining your code and helping the team adopt robust industrial methods: you will take the responsibility in developing Skill 1 and Skill 2 across the team
    (ii) Collaborate effectively within interdisciplinary teams

  • Solid knowledge of control theory, state machines and system identification

  • Strong experience with MATLAB/Simulink and model-based design is a plus

  • Professional working language is in English.

     

Start date: Immediately

jobs.title: Responsable Qualité Multi-Sites - Piles à Combustible
jobs.description:
About EHG

EH Group (EHG) is a rapidly growing fuel cell power platform delivering onsite power to AI data centers, defense, and industry. Our fuel-agnostic proton exchange membrane (PEM) systems scale from kW-scale units to GW-scale power plants, and we design, manufacture, and deploy them for customers worldwide.

Founded in Switzerland, EHG is now expanding into the United States, fueled by exponential AI data center power demand and a soon-to-be-announced major investment round. This is a defining, high-growth chapter for the company.

 

The opportunity

We're hiring a Quality Manager to own a single quality system across both of our production streams — our established MW-scale facility in Nyon, Switzerland and our new US operation in Houston, Texas.

You'd be based in Nyon, where our production and process knowledge sits today, and own quality for the US operation as it stands up. The requirement is explicit: quality must be identical at both sites. Same specifications, same control plans, same acceptance criteria, same records. A customer taking delivery of a system should not be able to tell which site built the stack inside it, and our certification and warranty position depends on being able to demonstrate that.

Our customers are data center operators, defense programs, and industrial sites where reliability is the product. In your first year you'd harmonize our quality management system across both entities, establish controls in Houston that match those proven in Nyon as manufacturing technology transfers, build supplier quality alongside Supply Chain for a shared global supply base, and support certification of our systems for both European and US markets.

Location & travel: Nyon-based. Regular travel to Houston is expected as the US operation stands up, along with travel to supplier and partner sites in Europe and the US.

 

What you'll own

  • One quality management system across both entities — a common QMS covering Nyon and Houston, including the path to ISO 9001 certification in the US and alignment with what is already established in Switzerland.

  • Equivalence between sites. A single set of product specifications, control plans, inspection criteria, and acceptance standards, with a defined process for how any change is applied at both sites rather than one.

  • In-process quality for fuel cell stack production at both locations, including the process controls that matter most in stack assembly — cleanliness and contamination control, leak testing, torque and compression control, and alignment.

  • Supplier quality for a shared global supply base, working with Supply Chain on qualification, audits, first article inspection, part submission, and ongoing performance, with one qualification standard regardless of which site a supplier serves.

  • Quality oversight of contract manufacturing and assembly partners building balance of plant and containerized systems on our behalf in both regions — audits, quality agreements, source inspection, and acceptance criteria.

  • Nonconformance and corrective action across both sites, including NCR and CAPA processes and structured problem solving, with findings at one site systematically applied at the other.

  • Traceability and product records — a common lot genealogy model from raw material through stack serial to delivered system, and the test and inspection data that supports warranty, certification, and customer acceptance, held consistently across both entities.

  • Certification across regions, working with external certification partners on the standards applicable to stationary hydrogen power systems in Europe and the US, authority having jurisdiction approvals, and marine classification where relevant.

  • Quality culture on both floors, including operator training, work instruction discipline, and establishing the habits in Houston that are already proven in Nyon, as US headcount grows quickly.

  • Building the US quality capability, defining what needs to sit on the ground in Houston versus what is run centrally from Nyon, and recruiting into it as volumes grow.

 

What we're looking for

Core experience

  • Owning quality across more than one manufacturing site, ideally in more than one country, with a demonstrated ability to hold two sites to genuinely the same standard from a distance.

  • Establishing or substantially rebuilding a quality function, including authoring a quality management system rather than administering an existing one.

  • Hands-on in-process and incoming quality in a production setting, with real familiarity with control plans, inspection methods, measurement systems, and process capability.

  • Supplier quality experience, including auditing suppliers and holding them to standard.

  • Structured problem solving and root cause analysis, with a track record of permanently closing out recurring defects.

  • Working knowledge of product certification processes and the evidence they require, ideally in energy, power equipment, or another regulated product category. Exposure to both European and US regimes is a strong advantage.

  • The judgment to know which controls are essential at low volume and which can wait, and the confidence to hold a quality position under schedule pressure.

  • Comfort working across time zones and influencing a site you are not physically based at, including building quality capability remotely.

Especially compelling

  • Fuel cell, battery cell, or similar electrochemical assembly experience.

  • Experience with cleanliness-critical or contamination-sensitive assembly processes.

  • Experience supporting a technology transfer between sites or countries, and establishing quality at the receiving end.

  • Experience qualifying and auditing contract manufacturers or system integrators.

  • Startup or scale-up experience as an early hire during hyper-growth.

  • Experience working between Europe and the US, and with US codes and certification practice in particular. French is useful but not required.

 

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation and meaningful equity, calibrated to the market and discussed directly with you.

  • Relocation support to Nyon, Switzerland.

  • The opportunity to build EHG's global quality function during a defining phase of hyper-growth.

Note: Swiss work authorization or eligibility is required for this role, along with the ability to travel to the United States.

 

EH Group is an equal opportunity employer. We value a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Robotics Integration Engineer
jobs.description:
About Enact

The next defining technological breakthrough will be in the physical world. We stand at a historical inflection point: bringing general-purpose intelligence into robotics.

At Enact we rethink the entire robotic tech stack from model architectures and data pipelines, to the actuators and sensors that feed the model. Pushing beyond pure vision and language approaches, we build a proprioceptive nerve system, and the cortex that makes sense of it, to solve dexterity through whole-body force-awareness and deploy robots for thousands of tasks in industry and beyond.

We are shaping a company where brilliant and unconventional people thrive together on solving the hardest challenges of our time. We are truth seekers. We reason from first principles, test our beliefs against reality, and trust that the best ideas can come from anyone. We move fast. We care deeply about our work and colleagues and are driven by passion to change the status quo.

If this resonates, we're excited to hear from you.

In This Role You Will

  • Design, integrate and test the electromechanical systems at the core of our dexterous robots: actuator modules, joints, and end-effectors, sensors, PCBs, and cable harnesses into compact, reliable units for high-DoF robotics

  • Bring hardware to life: lead system assembly & bring-up, debug across mechanics, electronics, and firmware, and work with controls & AI engineers to build a fully vertically integrated manipulation system

  • Develop & build automated test setups to validate performance, durability, and reliability, and take systems from prototype to series production

What We're Looking For

  • Degree (BSc/MSc/PhD) in mechatronics, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or a related field

  • 3+ years of work experience developing complex mechatronic systems that bridge mechanical design, electronics, and software

  • Solid understanding of electric motors, encoders, sensors, and motor drivers, and how to integrate them into a working system

  • Experience with system-level debugging and testing using tools such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, logic analyzers, and data acquisition systems

  • Comfortable with programming for test automation and data analysis (e.g., Python)

  • Familiarity designing parts in CAD (e.g. Onshape)

  • Hands-on experience with rapid prototyping, workshop tools, soldering, 3D printing, and prototype assembly/testing

  • Fluency in English (spoken and written), with strong interpersonal and communication skills

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Hands-on development experience with high-DoF robotic systems (e.g., robotic arms, end-effectors, dexterous hands, or humanoids)

  • Development experience with actuator systems (frameless motors, gearboxes, encoders, and integrated drives)

  • Experience with motor control and communication buses such as EtherCAT or CAN

  • Experience with PCB design or schematic review, and cable harness design

  • Thermal management for compact, high-power electronics and actuators

What we offer

  • The opportunity to make a real impact working on some of the biggest challenges of our time

  • A fast-paced learning environment alongside an outstanding, driven team

  • Ownership from day one, with the ability to iterate quickly and see your impact firsthand in an early-stage startup

  • Visa sponsorship & relocation benefits to hire the best in the world

  • A world-class in-person setup in central Zürich, with excellent prototyping, robotics, and technical infrastructure for hands-on builders

  • Competitive compensation and meaningful equity participation

jobs.title: Manager Operations Planning & Performance
jobs.description:
Bij Crisp hebben we een missie: eten met meer smaak bereikbaar maken voor iedereen. Daarvoor moet elke schakel in onze operatie, van warehouse tot voordeur, dagelijks naadloos op elkaar aansluiten. Als Manager Operations Planning & Performance ben jij de spil tussen wat de klant bestelt en hoe wij dat logistiek waarmaken. Je brengt alle operationele schakels samen in één strakke, integrale planning en bouwt mee aan een betrouwbare operatie die klaar is om slim door te groeien.

Wat je gaat doen

Je bent eigenaar van de integrale operationele planning. Je vertaalt verwachte klantvraag naar concrete capaciteit op de weg (hoeveel bezorgers hebben we per dag en per hub nodig?) en bepaalt samen met de Operations Manager de planningsstrategie voor de korte en middellange termijn. Je zorgt voor een strakke planning tussen Delivery, Retentie en Warehouse. Zo werkt iedereen vanuit dezelfde basis en tilt jouw scherpe blik onze processen naar een hoger niveau.

  • Je geeft leiding aan een team van routeplanners (werkstudenten en starters). Samen zorgen jullie dagelijks voor de meest efficiënte bezorgroutes. Jouw team staat in direct contact met de bezorghubs, het warehouse en de growth afdeling om de capaciteit af te stemmen

  • Je werkt nauw samen met teams door de hele organisatie, van Tech en Analytics tot Recruitment. Om te weten wat er speelt, ben je regelmatig te vinden waar het gebeurt: op onze bezorghubs en in het warehouse.

  • Je stuurt op operationele KPI’s (zoals Drops per Hour en Time per Stop) en beheert belangrijke kostenlijnen. Samen met de Regiomanager en Business Analyst Delivery blijf je ons bezorgnetwerk continu optimaliseren.

  • Je bent eindverantwoordelijk voor de lijn tussen ons warehouse en de hubs. Je onderhoudt de contacten met vrachtwagenvervoerders, stuurt op prestaties (On Time) en kosten (Cost per Drop) en maximaliseert de vulgraad.

  • Je kijkt altijd naar wat beter kan, houdt trends en innovaties in de markt in de gaten en draagt dit actief aan wanneer je hier kansen ziet. Je signaleert kansen in de operatie, maakt de impact inzichtelijk en leidt verbeterprojecten van idee tot implementatie, bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van servicetijd, automatisering van planningstaken of de inrichting van ons netwerk.

  • Je bent onderdeel van het Delivery team en rapporteert aan de Head of Delivery.

Dit ben jij

  • Je hebt HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau en minimaal 3 jaar werkervaring in operationele planning, logistiek of supply chain, bij voorkeur in een snelgroeiende e-commerce- of retailomgeving.

  • Je beweegt je makkelijk door de hele organisatie, van de vloer tot het management. Je zoekt actief de samenwerking op en krijgt verschillende teams moeiteloos op één lijn. Je creëert draagvlak en krijgt mensen mee in een gezamenlijke aanpak, ook als je geen formele zeggenschap over ze hebt

  • Je bent sterk met data. Je duikt zelf in de cijfers, bouwt een model of dashboard als dat nodig is, en vertaalt analyses naar concrete keuzes voor de operatie. Ervaring met SQL, BigQuery en Data Studio is een pré.

  • Jij kijkt verder dan je eigen scope en overziet de hele keten. Je begrijpt hoe een keuze in de planning doorwerkt in het warehouse, op de weg en bij de klant, en je weet de juiste balans te vinden tussen kosten en kwaliteit.

  • Je bent resultaatgericht en weet wat het is om eigenaarschap te nemen. Jij maakt dingen graag makkelijk en concreet. Complexe vraagstukken zet jij gemakkelijk om naar begrijpelijke acties.

  • Je houdt het hoofd koel als het even spannend wordt. Pieken, onverwachte uitval of last-minute wijzigingen brengen je niet van je stuk; je prioriteert, plant opnieuw en zorgt dat de operatie doordraait.

  • Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en Engels.

Wat wij bieden

  • Werken bij een B Corp gecertificeerd bedrijf, waarbij je de kans krijgt om je stempel te drukken op het Europese voedselsysteem.

  • 27 vakantiedagen om bij te komen en op te laden.

  • Een extra vrije dag per jaar om je in te zetten voor vrijwilligerswerk en iets goeds te doen.

  • Aandacht voor je mentale gezondheid met online begeleiding van erkende psychologen via OpenUp.

  • Voor straks een perfect pensioen via BPFL.

  • Elke maand food for thought, met workshops en talks via de Crisp University.

  • Regelmatig tastings of workshops op kantoor of bij een van onze leveranciers, om te zien hoe onze lekkerste producten worden gemaakt – en natuurlijk ook te proeven.

  • Dagelijks een uitgebreide, georganiseerde lunch op kantoor.

  • Enthousiaste, slimme collega’s en tijd om elkaar te leren kennen tijdens sport, events en proeverijen.

  • En... fikse korting op je Crisp boodschappen, omdat je thuis natuurlijk ook goed wilt eten.

Onze selectieprocedure

Solliciteer via onderstaande button. Hoe meer je kunt delen over jezelf en de reden dat je solliciteert, hoe beter.
Bij Crisp streven we naar een inclusieve en diverse werkomgeving waarin iedereen welkom is, ongeacht hun achtergrond, geslacht, leeftijd, etniciteit, seksuele geaardheid, religie of beperking. Wij moedigen sollicitanten met diverse perspectieven en achtergronden aan om te solliciteren en geloven in gelijke kansen voor iedereen. We waarderen de unieke bijdragen die elke medewerker kan leveren en zijn vastbesloten om een inclusieve werkplek te creëren waarin iedereen wordt gerespecteerd en gewaardeerd.

jobs.title: Project Leider Bouw
jobs.description:
Monumental automatiseert de bouw met robotica en software. Onze missie is om de bouw software-defined en autonoom te maken – een toekomst waarin mooie gebouwen op maat in één dag verrijzen, met minimale inzet van handwerk.

We zijn een groeiend team van engineers, operators en technici, afkomstig van bedrijven als Palantir, Qualcomm, Dyson, Shopify, Tesla, Meta en Google DeepMind. We staan nog aan het begin van het opbouwen van dit bedrijf, en dit is je kans om buitenproportioneel veel impact te maken op een probleem dat écht uitmaakt. Vanaf dag één werk je samen met een ervaren foundingteam, met een Series B van $32M achter ons onder leiding van Khosla Ventures en Plural.

Monumental zit in het centrum van Amsterdam, in een prachtig pand met een volledig uitgeruste werkplaats en een eigen testvloer voor robots. We bouwen de hele stack in-house – hardware én software. We zijn uitdrukkelijk geen hybride of remote-first bedrijf: robots en muren bouw je niet vanaf je keukentafel, dus we werken vijf dagen per week op locatie.

Lees meer over waarom wij vinden dat je je tijd aan de bouw zou moeten besteden, en over onze visie en ons bedrijf. Misschien vind je ons YouTube-kanaal interessant, de film van Based in Europe over hoe we het Europese woningtekort aanpakken, of deze video van Andreas Klinger over hoe ons kantoor eruitziet.

Over de functie

De afgelopen jaren is Monumental gegroeid van een werkend product en de eerste proefprojecten naar bouwen op grote schaal. Inmiddels hebben we een vloot van meer dan 150 robots, die metselwerk hebben uitgevoerd voor meer dan 90 woningen, een school, een buurthuis, een hotel en meer dan 150 meter kanaalwand.

Elke maand nemen we meer bouwprojecten aan, intern noemen we die ‘deployments’. We werken met meer robots en meer mensen en breiden vanuit Nederland uit naar het Verenigd Koninkrijk en de VS.

Als Hub Lead zet je onze eerste vestiging buiten het hoofdkantoor op, in het noorden van Nederland. Je begint met ons grootste bouwproject tot nu toe. Naarmate er meer projecten bijkomen, bouw je het team en de operatie verder uit.

We zoeken mensen die breed inzetbaar zijn en een bouwproject willen leiden alsof het hun eigen bedrijf is. Achter elk project staat een Deployment Manager die van begin tot eind verantwoordelijk is. In de praktijk vervul je vijf rollen tegelijk: uitvoerder, operationeel manager, accountmanager, analist en projectmanager. Je maakt het bouwplan, voert het met je team als onderaannemer uit, onderhoudt het contact met de aannemer en zorgt dat we goed metselwerk op tijd opleveren. Dat doe je in de bouw, waar plannen voortdurend veranderen. Uiteindelijk leid je meerdere projecten tegelijk, waaronder complexe projecten waarbij veel op het spel staat.

De ene dag sta je bij zonsopgang op en ga je naar de bouwplaats. Je zaagt stenen, bewaakt de planning, stemt af met de hoofdaannemer en ziet je bouwplan steen voor steen werkelijkheid worden. De volgende dag zit je op onze vestiging, analyseer je de winst- en verliesrekening van je project en werk je aan systemen waarmee je bij het volgende project een betere marge haalt. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de oplevering en geeft knelpunten die je op de bouwplaats tegenkomt door aan ons R&D-team.

Dit is intensief, praktisch werk op locatie, waar je veel voldoening uit kunt halen. Robots gaan kapot, het weer slaat om en de aannemer verandert het plan. Jij zorgt dat de bouw doorgaat.

Je krijgt veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid. De rol past goed bij je als je eerder een bedrijf hebt opgericht, of als je een ondernemende functie zoekt waarin je veel invloed hebt op het resultaat.

Wat je gaat doen

  • De logistiek van een bouwproject plannen. Je bepaalt hoeveel en welke robots en mensen nodig zijn, stemt af met andere onderaannemers en maakt de dagelijkse planning. Tegelijk houd je het grotere geheel in het oog en begrijp je wat jouw keuzes betekenen voor de kosten en opbrengsten per project.

  • Op de bouwplaats het team aansturen, begeleiden en motiveren. Je onderhoudt het contact met hoofdaannemers en andere betrokkenen, vertegenwoordigt Monumental en legt uit wat we doen. Je schakelt net zo makkelijk met steigerbouwers als met de CEO’s van de grootste hoofdaannemers en onze engineers.

  • Operationele systemen opzetten waarmee elk project beter verloopt dan het vorige. Je ziet waar tijd en middelen verloren gaan, past processen aan en verbetert de marge.

  • Samenwerken met bestaande klanten en zorgen dat daar nieuwe bouwprojecten uit voortkomen. In de toekomst doe je dat ook voor aanverwante productlijnen buiten het metselwerk.

  • Verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor de winst- en verliesrekening van je project en voorstellen doen om de kosten en opbrengsten per project steeds verder te verbeteren.

  • Helpen bij het werven en interviewen van nieuwe robotoperators en deployment operators.

Wat we zoeken

  • Minimaal drie jaar ervaring startupervaring, als operator, manager, of founder.

  • Nederlands als moedertaal. De bouwsector is sterk lokaal georganiseerd, dus dit is een vereiste voor de functie.

  • Je communiceert helder en makkelijk met mensen met uiteenlopende achtergronden.

  • Je bent bereid om letterlijk je handen vuil te maken om het werk gedaan te krijgen.

  • Je komt snel in actie, zet door en krijgt dingen voor elkaar. In deze functie draait het vooral om uitvoeren.

  • Je kunt goed omgaan met hoge werkdruk. Op bouwplaatsen gaat regelmatig iets mis en staat er veel op het spel. Daar komt bij dat we nieuwe technologie inzetten waarvan we nog niet alle mogelijke storingen kennen.

  • Je denkt scherp en leert graag. Welke achtergrond je ook hebt, je zult in deze rol veel en snel moeten leren. Het werk kan elke drie tot zes maanden als een nieuwe baan voelen. Je leert veel over de bouw, robotica en werken in een snelgroeiend technologiebedrijf.

  • Je hebt ervaring met het aansturen van een klein team en weet hoe je mensen begeleidt en motiveert.

  • Je bent operationeel en analytisch sterk. Je kunt een helder operationeel plan uitwerken in een spreadsheet, een winst- en verliesrekening presenteren en verschillende scenario’s doorrekenen, inclusief de factoren die het resultaat bepalen. Je bent een sterke projectmanager.

Waarom Monumental?

Bij Monumental werken betekent vooroplopen in een beweging die de bouwsector wezenlijk wil veranderen. Jouw werk heeft hier niet alleen impact op het bedrijf, maar op de toekomst van hoe we bouwen. Als je gedreven wordt door innovatie, graag complexe uitdagingen aanpakt en klaar bent om echt verschil te maken, horen we graag van je.

Voor open sollicitaties (als je geen rol ziet die precies past) kun je ons mailen op:

Helaas bieden we op dit moment geen stageplekken aan.

Voldoe je niet aan alle eisen hierboven, maar ben je enthousiast over Monumental en denk je dat je ons toch kunt helpen moeilijke problemen op te lossen? Neem dan contact op. We verwelkomen generalisten die op resultaat gericht zijn en graag on the job leren.

jobs.title: Director, Expanded Access Program Operations
jobs.description:
About myTomorrows 

myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options.   

We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem.   

We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection.   

With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business.  

Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. 

The opportunity: Director of EAP Operations (Expanded Access Programs and Site Management)

This is a high‑impact leadership role at the heart of how myTomorrows delivers Expanded Access Programs (EAPs) globally—where operational excellence meets commercial acumen.

As Director of EAP Operations, you’ll own the end‑to‑end operational delivery of our EAP portfolio, integrating Program Management and Site Management into one scalable, outcome‑driven model. Beyond ensuring quality, compliance, speed, and resilience, you’ll be expected to think like an entrepreneur: spotting opportunities, optimising processes, and driving commercially sound decisions that enable sustainable growth.

You’ll be a core member of the Operations Leadership Team and report directly to our COO (Vanessa says hi). This role is perfect for someone who thrives on complexity, builds high‑performing teams, and raises the operational bar—while balancing patient‑first decision‑making with a strong commercial mindset.

Geographic Requirement: This role is open to candidates in The Netherlands, United Kingdom, Canada and USA. For candidates in North America, to ensure seamless collaboration with our teams, applicants must reside within the EST or CST time zones.

What you'll do in this role:

  • Own the end-to-end operating model for EAP Program + Site Management, ensuring scalable and compliant delivery

  • Translate strategy and portfolio forecasts into capacity planning, org design and hiring priorities

  • Build resilient coverage and escalation models across the portfolio (no single points of failure)

  • Lead the EAP Program Management team to deliver consistent execution across clients and geographies

  • Lead the EAP Site Management team to ensure strong site engagement, workload balance and service performance

  • Drive standardisation and continuous improvement across ways of working, tooling and operational excellence

  • Set and run a strong governance rhythm: KPIs, performance reviews, risk management and quality oversight

  • Act as senior escalation point for complex delivery, regulatory and stakeholder challenges

  • Grow a bar-raising leadership bench through coaching, performance management and succession planning

  • Partner with Finance, People and Operations on budgeting, workforce planning and scale-up decisions

What you bring to the table:

  • You have 8–10+ years experience leading and managing expanded access programs.

  • Experience in a market access setting and with multi-country reimbursement strategies is a plus.

  • You understand the EAP business, and have a strong and proven commercial and client service mindset.

  • You have proven experience building and leading high performance teams.

  • You know how to lead managers and scale operational teams in complex settings

  • You have an exceptionally strong understanding of compliance, regulatory frameworks and operational requirements in the context of Expanded Access Programs

  • You have a track record of operational excellence: scaling delivery, managing risk, and raising performance standards

  • You are a strategic thinker with strong execution focus — you simplify complexity and drive outcomes

  • You are a confident stakeholder manager who can align senior leaders and external partners

  • You hold a high bar for quality and accountability, with calm leadership under pressure

What success in the first 6 months looks like:

  • Have full grip on the EAP portfolio and delivery realities — and you can clearly articulate the biggest operational opportunities and risks (and have recommendations on how to address them)

  • Create clarity across Program & Site Management: ownership, workflows, escalation paths, and what “great” looks like

  • Have strengthened the operating model to improve consistency, speed and resilience across the portfolio

  • Have managed to deliver on the expected ramp-up of the EAP business both in terms of patients served, and revenue generated.

  • Have implemented a clear KPI rhythm (quality, timelines, compliance, service levels) with transparent performance reporting

  • Have improved capacity planning and coverage, educing single points of failure and enabling predictable delivery

  • Have made at least 1–2 concrete operational improvements (process / tooling / standardisation) that measurably improve delivery outcomes

  • Are seen as a trusted Operations Leadership Team member who raises the bar and builds momentum.

Equal opportunities

myTomorrows is an Equal Opportunity Employer and, beyond upholding discrimination-free practices, we are committed to cultivating a workplace where difference and diversity are protected and celebrated. The best work comes from our best selves, and we go to great lengths in supporting our team members to be just that.

jobs.description:
About the Role

Former Auditor - Senior Customer Success Manager

As a Senior Customer Success Manager (+Audit Background) at DataSnipper, you own the success of a portfolio of accounts - and you bring something additional to the role: direct experience in audit. You understand how audit teams work, what drives their priorities, and how to connect DataSnipper to the workflows that matter most inside a firm.

You are a reliable, independent operator who applies established CS frameworks and uses your audit knowledge to accelerate adoption, build credibility with audit stakeholders, and design enablement that non-audit CSMs cannot replicate. You manage onboarding, QBRs, health monitoring, and renewals with predictability and follow-through and you do it in a language audit professionals trust.

You may still be developing the full breadth of CS scope, but your audit domain credibility opens doors and unlocks conversations that are otherwise harder to access at this level.

 

About DataSnipper

Audit and finance are still massively manual and we are changing that. DataSnipper is a $1B, bootstrapped unicorn with 600,000+ users across 180+ countries, already embedded in the daily workflows of top audit and accounting firms.

Now, we are taking things further with our Excel Agent, bringing AI directly into where the work actually happens. Unlike generic AI tools, we do not sit on the sidelines. Our AI operates inside Excel, with access to real documents and audit evidence, meaning it does not just generate answers, it does the work, with full traceability.

We are not just applying AI, we are redefining how audit gets done. If you want to build something category-defining at scale, this is the place.

 

What You Will Do

  • Act as a Credible Audit Advisor: Serve as a trusted partner to Audit Managers, Senior Auditors, and engagement team leads. You are someone who understands customer workflows, their quality standards, and their firm's operating model. Translate DataSnipper's capabilities into language and use cases that resonate with audit professionals directly.

  • Drive Adoption Aligned to Audit Workflows: Run onboarding and training sessions that are grounded in how audit teams actually work - mapping DataSnipper features to real engagement tasks, sample testing approaches, and evidence management requirements.

  • Manage Account Health with Audit Context: Use product data, stakeholder signals, and your understanding of audit operating rhythms to monitor portfolio health. Recognize when signals carry firm-wide implications such as low adoption and respond or escalate with the right context.

  • Build Audit-Grounded Success Plans: Create success plans that connect DataSnipper capabilities to audit-specific outcomes: engagement efficiency, sample coverage, review cycle speed, and quality compliance. Align milestones to audit calendar realities and firm methodology, not just generic product adoption targets.

  • Communicate ROI in Audit Terms: Articulate the business impact DataSnipper delivers using metrics and framing that carry weight with audit professionals - time saved per engagement, risk reduction, quality improvement. Run QBRs and stakeholder conversations with the credibility of someone who has worked in the field.

  • Support Expansion Using Domain Knowledge: Identify expansion signals within your portfolio and use your understanding of firm structure such as service lines, team hierarchies, engagement types to surface credible growth opportunities. Support Sales in building ROI cases that resonate with audit leadership.

  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally with Audit Insight: Share audit workflow intelligence with Product, Sales, and Solutions Engineering. Surface patterns that require audit expertise to interpret - methodology gaps, adoption friction specific to audit processes, feedback that non-audit CSMs are less positioned to identify.

  • Contribute Audit Knowledge to the Team: Help peers understand audit customer context. Act as an accessible internal resource for audit-specific questions to help raise the team's collective ability to serve audit accounts.

  • Maintain Systems and Portfolio Data: Keep customer data, health signals, and portfolio records accurate and up to date in internal systems. Use this data to make better decisions and support reliable reporting.

     

What You Bring

  • Audit Domain Credibility: You have worked in or directly alongside audit teams. You understand engagement lifecycles, sample testing, evidence management, team hierarchies, and the quality standards that govern audit work. This is not background knowledge - it is something you apply directly in customer conversations and account planning.

  • Experience: Ideally you have experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a similar client-facing role in B2B SaaS, combined with direct experience in audit - whether as an auditor, audit technology specialist, or in a client-facing role embedded in audit workflows. You understand how audit engagements are structured, what drives adoption in audit teams, and how to speak credibly to audit professionals.

  • Audit-Specific Enablement Design: You can design and execute onboarding and training programs that map to real audit workflows - including audit cycle timing, firm methodology, and engagement team structure. This requires audit fluency that cannot be substituted with general CS experience.

  • Reliable Execution: You follow through. You manage a portfolio independently, hit your commitments, and deliver consistent outcomes without needing close supervision.

  • Data-Driven Approach: You use product data and health signals to stay ahead of risks and make decisions. You are comfortable in CS tools and CRM platforms.

  • Clear Communication across Contexts: You communicate clearly in both audit professional language and CS/GTM contexts. You can navigate stakeholder conversations with audit managers and firm leadership, and translate those conversations back into internal action.

  • Ownership Mindset: You take responsibility for your accounts and your own development. You ask for feedback, apply it, and look for ways to improve.

  • Collaborative Spirit: You contribute to the team including by sharing audit knowledge that makes peers more effective on audit accounts.

  • Adaptability: You handle change well. You adjust when priorities shift and keep a constructive attitude in a fast-moving environment.

  • Excellence in Communication: Professional fluency in English and Dutch (written and spoken), with the ability to engage stakeholders at all levels - from audit associates to C-suite.

     

What we offer

jobs.title: Team Lead, Data Engineering
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Data Engineering Team Lead to lead the Data Platform team at DataSnipper.

Every decision DataSnipper makes about its products runs through the data platform: which features land, which customers are getting value, what we bill for, what we fix next, and which AI capabilities add the most value. You will lead a team of two data engineers who own the systems that make that possible. That means how usage events get captured across a growing set of products, how they become trustworthy models in Snowflake, and how Customer Success, Product and GTM get to answers without waiting on us.

This is a player-coach role in a small, high-ownership team. You are responsible for the people, the roadmap and the technical direction, and you stay hands-on enough to ship alongside the team and make architectural calls credibly. At DataSnipper, Team Lead is our entry point into engineering management: the same people, delivery and product responsibilities as an Engineering Manager, on a smaller team.

We are a handful of people serving the whole company, so your judgment about what not to build matters as much as what the team ships.

About DataSnipper

DataSnipper is the driving force behind an intelligent automation platform that’s transforming the world of audit and finance.

Founded in 2017, DataSnipper has skyrocketed and is now OFFICIALLY the fastest-growing software company in the Netherlands according to Deloitte Fast50 and recently achieved Unicorn status in our latest funding round. With over 400.000 users in 125+ countries and a second base in the heart of New York City, DataSnipper is shaking things up. And we’re not stopping there. At DataSnipper, we’re always on the lookout for innovators who think outside of the box. New ideas aren’t just welcomed at DataSnipper–they’re essential.

What your team owns

The Data Platform team works across three areas:

  • Data Platform: reliable, scalable infrastructure that gets the right data to the right place

  • Internal Analytics: a self-service platform so every team can be data-informed without a ticket

  • Customer-facing Analytics: the dashboards and exports customers use to see the value they get from DataSnipper

Concretely, you would be walking into billions of usage events flowing from our Excel Add-in, web apps and product backends through Azure Event Hubs into Snowflake; a dbt estate built on medallion principles and managed in dbt Cloud; Terraform-managed Snowflake and Azure infrastructure; and a set of product teams shipping AI agents faster than we can instrument them.

You will also find real, named open problems rather than a tidy platform: event capture mid-consolidation, multiple methods of user attribution, and a data quality layer that is designed but not yet built. We would rather tell you that up front.

What you will do

Lead the team

  • Lead a team of two data engineers through outcomes, not tasks: set clear goals with the team and trust them to figure out how

  • Make the team measurably better: raise the engineering bar, grow each engineer into bigger problems, and address performance issues directly when they arise

  • Run regular 1:1s, give clear and timely feedback, and own each engineer's goals and development

  • Foster a culture of experimentation, learning, documentation and operational excellence

  • Take part in hiring and help shape the team's scope as it evolves

Own direction and delivery

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Customer Success and GTM to shape the team's roadmap, turning vague data requests into scoped, well-defined work

  • Make the trade-offs a small team serving the whole company needs: what to build, what to defer, and when a request shouldn't become a pipeline

  • Set the technical direction and make the architectural calls that shape the team's systems

  • Keep Snowflake performance and cost, tech debt, dependencies and compliance obligations (audit logging, vulnerability remediation, Vanta evidence) visible and under control

  • Be the person other engineering teams come to when they need to instrument something new

Stay hands-on in the data platform

  • Contribute to the event ingestion architecture end to end: Azure Event Hubs, Snowpipe, Fivetran, and our shared Python/TypeScript event client libraries

  • Build and review dbt transformation pipelines that stay reliable as volume, source count and model complexity grow

  • Define and enforce event contracts and schemas so product teams can instrument new features without silent breakage downstream

  • Evolve the core data models (event, user, license, company) and integrate new sources such as product backends, MongoDB, HubSpot and billing

  • Guide reverse ETL and activation work that pushes modeled data back into HubSpot, MongoDB, Postgres and GTM reporting

What you bring

Leadership

  • At least 1 year leading engineers as a team lead or engineering manager: 1:1s, feedback, goal setting, performance, and development

  • An empowerment style of leadership: you lead through outcomes and trust, not by assigning tasks

  • Early evidence of growing engineers and raising a team's bar, and the willingness to address performance issues directly

  • Strong product aptitude: you can challenge the framing of a request, translate stakeholder needs into technical solutions, and make roadmap trade-offs


Data engineering

  • 7+ years in data engineering or a closely related backend/platform role, with a track record of owning a data platform area end to end

  • Deep SQL and strong Python, including query optimization and performance tuning on a cloud warehouse

  • Production experience with a cloud data warehouse (we use Snowflake) and a modern transformation framework (we use dbt)

  • Experience with event-driven / streaming ingestion and its failure modes: schema drift, duplication, late data, backfills

  • Experience on a cloud platform at the infrastructure level (we're on Azure; AWS/GCP transfers fine)

  • Solid data modeling fundamentals and the ability to defend a modeling decision to both engineers and business stakeholders

  • Experience operating data systems in production with a focus on reliability, observability and maintainability


How you work

  • Excellent communication in English and genuine comfort working directly with non-technical stakeholders

  • Bias to action, a strong sense of ownership, and the judgment to prioritize when demand exceeds capacity

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in a startup or scale-up, ideally as an early member of a data team

  • Experience hiring engineers or helping a team expand its scope

  • Experience with product analytics tooling (Mixpanel, RudderStack) and warehouse-native BI (Netspring/Optimizely Analytics, Omni, Embeddable, or similar)

  • Experience building data products for AI or agent consumption: semantic layers, metrics layers, MCP servers, or governed self-service access

  • Experience with Terraform, Docker and data governance at scale

  • Reverse ETL experience and familiarity with CRM data models (HubSpot, Salesforce) or customer success platforms


What we offer

  • Being part of one of the fastest-growing scale-ups in the Netherlands

  • Make an impact by disrupting the audit industry with us

  • A step into engineering management, with Engineering Manager scope on a small team

  • 28 vacation days

  • Excellent salary

  • Pension plan

  • Stock participation plan

  • Hybrid work (Amsterdam-based)

  • International team and environment

  • Daily lunch

  • Mental health support (OpenUp)

  • Social events and team activities

Recruitment steps

  1. Recruiter screen

  2. Hiring Manager interview

  3. System design interview

  4. Product interview

  5. Final interviews with Engineering leadership

jobs.title: DNA Synthesis Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments.

We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.

We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.

Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.

We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.

About the Role

We're looking for a hands-on scientist-engineer to help build our next-generation DNA synthesis platform, enabling high-throughput, cost-effective production of large and diverse DNA libraries. You'll work at the intersection of chemistry, materials science, bioengineering, and hardware development, designing and building prototypes, running experiments, and optimizing processes to turn new synthesis technologies into reliable, scalable production systems.

DNA synthesis is a fundamental part of our protein engineering platform. We're developing new approaches to dramatically increase synthesis throughput while reducing cost and turnaround time.

You'll work closely with our scientific and engineering teams to develop and prototype new DNA synthesis technologies. Your focus will be on translating scientific concepts into working hardware and experimental systems, designing and building prototypes, testing different approaches, and continuously improving their performance.

This is a highly hands-on, interdisciplinary role combining experimental science with practical engineering. You'll take ownership of prototype development, experimental validation, and process optimization, helping move promising technologies from early concepts to reliable, scalable systems.

We're looking for someone who enjoys building things, solving technical problems, and working across disciplines. You don't need to be an expert in DNA synthesis, but you should have strong scientific fundamentals, an engineering mindset, and experience turning ideas into working prototypes.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and test prototypes for next-generation DNA synthesis technologies.

  • Translate scientific and technical requirements into practical engineering designs and experimental setups.

  • Scope and evaluate different technical approaches, components, materials, and equipment for prototype development.

  • Develop and optimize the chemistry, materials, and processes underlying the synthesis platform.

  • Design and execute experiments to characterize performance, identify limitations, and improve reliability.

  • Work closely with mechanical, electronics, software, and automation engineers to develop integrated experimental systems.

  • Troubleshoot complex technical problems across chemistry, hardware, and process engineering.

  • Develop analytical methods and quality control strategies to measure performance and guide optimization.

  • Help scale successful prototypes into robust, reproducible systems suitable for routine production.

  • Work with external suppliers and engineering partners to source components, evaluate technologies, and accelerate development.

What We're Looking For
