If you want to know more about the position please contact consultant Liv Nielsen on email liv.nielsen@randstad.dk. All inquiries will be handled confidentially.

Randstad is the world’s largest talent company and a partner of choice to clients. As a Partner for Talent, we are committed to providing equitable opportunities to people from all backgrounds and helping them remain relevant in the rapidly changing world of work.

We have a deep understanding of the labour market and help our clients to create the high-quality, diverse and agile workforces they need to succeed. We support people to realise their true potential throughout their entire working life. This is what we do and what motivates us every day.

jobs.title: Tenure track assistant professor/Associate professor positions in Veterinary medicine
jobs.employer: Technical Sciences - Institut for Husdyr- og Veter
jobs.description:
The Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences (ANIVET) is seeking three new staff members for teaching and research in veterinary medicine. The positions are available from 1 August 2027 or soon thereafter.

The educational activities for these positions are aimed at students in veterinary medicine at both the bachelor’s and master’s levels.

The veterinary medicine programme is organised into courses covering educationally relevant themes and integrates a range of disciplines, and this is done with the vision to create a professional engagement while ensuring scientific depth for the students of veterinary medicine.

ANIVET is part of the Faculty of Technical Sciences at Aarhus University. The department is located near Viborg (Campus AU Viborg – Research Centre Foulum) and encompasses five research units with approximately 200 dedicated employees of which 50% are scientific staff. The AU Viborg campus will gradually grow to a student population of 800 – 900. The positions will be integrated into the department’s existing scientific research units, in which scientists at all career stages work together with skilled technical staff such as laboratory technicians and data analysts.

The positions
  1. Clinical veterinary science – livestock
  2. Veterinary public health
  3. Veterinary pathology

If you wish to apply for more than one position, please apply for each position separately. Please read more down below in “How to apply”.

1. Tenure track assistant professor or Associated Professor in Clinical veterinary science – livestock
We are seeking a candidate with a clinical background in veterinary science within production animals - Livestock.

Research tasks
The focus of the position is to:
  • Perform clinical veterinary science within production animals, with emphasis on individual or group-level animal diagnostics, clinical decision-making, and evidence-based treatment and prevention strategies.
  • Research in major production diseases in cattle and/or pigs of significant importance in Europe, including development of clinically applicable knowledge and tools supporting veterinary decision-making in practice.
  • Integrate clinical findings with herd-level data to improve disease prevention and health management in modern production systems.



Within his/her area of expertise, it is expected that in addition the candidate will:
  • Conduct research-based advisory work for authorities and have an active role in externally funded research projects.
  • Contribute to the development and delivery of teaching in clinical veterinary science for production animals, with emphasis on case-based and hands-on learning.
  • Provide academic leadership within the clinical production animal field, including mentoring and coordination of junior teaching staff (e.g., assistant lecturers/teaching assistants).
  • Contribute to strengthening collaboration with the veterinary profession and industry stakeholders in Denmark.


Your profile
The preferred candidate should demonstrate:
  • The ability to independently conduct research within veterinary clinical science related to pig or cattle production
  • Danish authorization as a veterinarian or can achieve it
  • Preferably experiences within obstetrics



2. Tenure track assistant professor or Associated Professor in Veterinary Public Health
We are seeking a candidate with strong expertise in veterinary public health, including popu-lation-level animal health, food safety/meat inspection, and the role of veterinarians in society.

Research tasks
The focus of the position is to:
  • Conduct research within veterinary public health, including epidemiology, zoonoses, food safety/meat inspection, disease dynamics, risk assessment or animal welfare.
  • Contribute to interdisciplinary One Health research integrating animal, human and environmental health on population level.
  • Support evidence-based policy and advisory work for authorities.
  • Participate in externally funded research projects.


Within his/her area of expertise, it is expected that in addition the candidate will:
  • Develop and deliver teaching in Veterinary Public Health for example to apply case-based and problem-oriented teaching methods with focus on real-world scenarios in veterinary services.
  • Do research within monitoring of animal welfare issues across the EU.
  • Contribute to teaching across the veterinary curriculum where public health perspectives are relevant.

Your profile
The preferred candidate should demonstrate:
  • The ability to independently conduct research within veterinary public health preferably with an interdisciplinary research profile integrating biological, social and economic aspects in projects
  • Danish authorization as a veterinarian or can achieve it. Experience with Danish conditions is an advantage.
  • Preferably, experience with antimicrobial use at the population level.


3. Tenure track assistant professor or Associated Professor in Veterinary Pathology
We are seeking a candidate with a broad background in veterinary pathology, encompassing both gross and histopathological examinations for diagnostic purposes with a strong interest in developing and innovating teaching within veterinary pathology.

Research tasks
The focus of the position is:
  • General and comparative veterinary pathology, including the mechanisms, diagnosis, and characterization of disease processes across animal species.
  • Diagnostic pathology, encompassing post-mortem investigations, histopathology, and the integration of pathological findings into veterinary practice and meat inspection.
  • Pathological assessment of animal welfare aspects of mortality in livestock


Within his/her area of expertise, it is expected that in addition the candidate will:
  • Teach and supervise students and early-career researchers at bachelor, master, and PhD levels.
  • Conduct research-based advisory work for authorities and have an active role in externally funded research projects.
  • Contribute to the collection and curation of pathological specimens for teaching purposes and reporting of findings to referring veterinarians and animal owners.
  • Contribute to the continued development of the department's digital histopathology teaching platform, TUTOR.
  • Support in the administration and further development of the department's animal donor programme for anatomy and pathology.

Your profile
The preferred candidate should have experience with:
  • Post-mortem examinations, including diagnostic necropsies, case reporting, and communication of findings.
  • Diagnostic histopathology.


Your profle as Tenure Track assistant professor
You are a skilled researcher with a solid background within your specific field of research, and you possess:
  • Documented research qualifications at a high international level
  • Teaching and supervision experience
  • Qualifications for the Tenure-Track assistant professor level at Aarhus University must include postdoctoral training or similar with a relevant research profile and a strong scientific publication record in one or more of the areas of the position you are applying for.

Please refer to the tenure track guidelines for the tenure review criteria and for the tenure review process.

Your profile as Associate professor
You are established as a prominent researcher within your specific field of research, and you possess:
  • The ability to carry out independent and well-organized research work, as well as work as part of an interdisciplinary team.
  • Documented teaching qualifications at a high international level.
  • Experience with project management

In order to be assessed as qualified as associate professor, you must meet the academic criteria as outlined here

How to apply
  • You must indicate the specific position you are applying for by selecting it in the menu. You may only select one position. If you wish to apply for one of the other positions, you must submit a separate application for each position.
  • Please also indicate in your written application which position you are applying for.
  • Furthermore, please indicate whether you are applying for a tenure-track assistant professor position, an associate professor position, or both by ticking the box. .

Who we are
The Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences is well-known for its skilled and very innovative interdisciplinary research environments with a high international impact. We perform world-class research, which contributes with solutions to address essential societal challenges within the green transition; the food production and veterinary medicine – nationally and globally.

The department generates novel research at the highest international level within sustainable food production, the environment, climate, and the health and welfare for animals and humans. The activities form the basis for our research-based public authority consultancy and degree programmes covering bachelor’s, master’s and PhD degree programmes within animal science and veterinary medicine. We offer a lively, engaged and innovative learning and study environment, which is closely integrated with the research environment.

Our department has unique and advanced animal experimental research facilities and technologies located close to the research environment, and a comprehensive national and international research network and strong industrial and professional collaborations.

What we offer
  • A well-developed research infrastructure, laboratories and access to shared equipment and animal experimental facilities.
  • An informal and multicultural research environment with high professionalism and close collaboration and networking activities.
  • A workplace characterised by equality and a good work-life balance, and open discussions across different fields of research.


Living in Denmark
Please visit the international staff https://internationalstaff.au.dk/prearrival/ for information about arriving to and living in Denmark for both the applicants and their potential families.

Area of employment and place of work
The area of employment is Aarhus University (AU), with related departments The place of work is AU Viborg, Research Centre Foulum, Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences, Blichers Allé 20, DK-8830 Tjele.
AU Viborg is approximately 10 km from Viborg. You can read more about it here: https://international.viborg.dk/

Contact
For further information, please contact Deputy head of department, Professor Henrik Callesen (henrik.callesen@anivet.au.dk)
or Head of department, Professor Charlotte Lauridsen (charlotte.lauridsen@anivet.au.dk)

Technical Sciences Tenure Track
Aarhus University offers talented scientists from around the world attractive career perspectives via the Technical Sciences Tenure Track Programme. Highly qualified candidates are appointed as Assistant Professors for a period of six years with the prospect of performance- based advancement to a tenured Associate Professorship.

The aim of the Technical Sciences Tenure Track Programme is to:
  • attract outstanding talented individuals that are competitive at an international level
  • to promote the early development of independent research success early in the career of scientists
  • to create transparency in the academic career path

As part of the tenure track position, the candidate is offered:
  • access to research infrastructure
  • capability development, including postgraduate teacher training
  • a mentoring programme
  • support to develop scientific networks and to secure interdisciplinary research at the highest level

As part of the Aarhus University Tenure Track Programme, the University carries out a mid-way evaluation to review the progress of the tenure track candidate after three years, according to the same criteria used in the final tenure review. The final tenure review is conducted after five and a half years. If the review is positive, the candidate will be offered a tenured position as Associate Professor at Aarhus University.

Please refer to the tenure track guidelines for the tenure review criteria and for the tenure review process.

Application procedure
Shortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the assessment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. The selection is made on the basis of an assessment of who of the candidates are most relevant considering the requirements of the advertisement. All applicants will be notified within 6 weeks whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee and will receive his/her assessment.

Read the full text and apply online

jobs.title: Erfaren personlig assistent sökes till en tjej i 30 årsåldern – bli en
jobs.description:
Jag söker dig som har tålamodet att låta en relation få ta tid att växa. Dig som står kvar även när dagarna är tuffa, som möter motgångar med lugn och som förstår att tillit är något man bygger tillsammans, steg för steg.

För mig handlar personlig assistans om så mycket mer än praktiskt stöd. Det handlar om trygghet, närvaro och att ha någon vid min sida som hjälper mig att våga mer, utvecklas och hitta tillbaka till modet när livet känns svårt. Därför söker jag nu en erfaren personlig assistent som vill bli en viktig del av min vardag på lång sikt.

Om tjänsten

Tjänsten är till att börja med en timanställning, men för rätt person finns goda möjligheter att utöka omfattningen framöver. Arbetstiderna varierar och kan vara förlagda till dag, kväll och helg. Om du endast har möjlighet att arbeta vissa tider är du ändå varmt välkommen att söka, eftersom personlig kemi och rätt inställning är det allra viktigaste.

Vem är du?

Jag tror att du är en trygg, varm och positiv tjej i min egen ålder som har förmågan att skapa lugn även i utmanande situationer. Du har erfarenhet av arbete inom social omsorg och lågaffektivt bemötande och känner dig bekväm med att möta människor med respekt, tålamod och lyhördhet. Du har även utbildning inom det sociala området.

Du är initiativrik, ser möjligheter snarare än hinder och drivs av att hjälpa andra att leva ett så självständigt och meningsfullt liv som möjligt. Om du dessutom tycker om djur och natur är det ett stort plus.

För att kunna arbeta hos mig behöver du vara rökfri samt ha körkort och tillgång till egen bil eftersom jag bor en bit utanför stan.

Det som kommer att vara avgörande är inte bara vad du har gjort tidigare, utan vem du är som person. Om vi trivs tillsammans finns goda möjligheter till både långsiktighet och utveckling i uppdraget, och du kommer självklart att få introduktion och möjlighet till vidare kompetensutveckling.

Din ansökan

Jag tycker om att få en känsla för personen bakom ansökan. Därför blir jag väldigt glad om du bifogar en bild på dig själv. Har du möjlighet får du också gärna skicka med en kort videohälsning där du berättar lite om vem du är. Det hjälper mig att lära känna dig redan från start.

Vi ser fram emot att få höra från dig!

Om rekryteringsprocessen

Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, vilket innebär att tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. Som en del av rekryteringsprocessen genomför vi en bakgrundskontroll via Fortcheck. Kontrollen genomförs på dina villkor, där du själv väljer om du vill dela resultatet med oss eller inte.

Om JAG som arbetsgivare

Hos JAG Personlig Assistans blir du en del av en organisation där människan alltid står i centrum. Vi har kollektivavtal med Kommunal och erbjuder bland annat betald introduktion, fortbildning och friskvårdsbidrag.

Som personlig assistent hos JAG gör du skillnad varje dag. Du bidrar till att skapa trygghet, självständighet och livskvalitet för en annan människa – samtidigt som du får ett meningsfullt arbete där relationen står i fokus.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Om rekryteringsprocessen: Vi tar löpande kontakt med intressanta kandidater och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdagen. Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess genomför vi alltid en bakgrundskontroll via Fortcheck som skickas ut till dig som kandidat via mejl och sms. Bakgrundskontrollen sker helt på dina villkor - du utför själv kontrollen och får ta del av resultatet. Du väljer sedan huruvida du vill skicka vidare informationen till oss eller avbryta.

Om JAG som arbetsgivare: Vi har kollektivavtal med Kommunal och erbjuder alla anställda betald introduktion, fortbildning och friskvårdsbidrag. Här kan du läsa om alla förmåner du erbjuds som personlig assistent hos oss.

Som anställd i JAG gör du skillnad varje dag. Välkommen du också!

Vill du veta mer om yrket personlig assistent?

Läs mer om oss på JAG.SE

Vi är Sveriges största privata assistansanordnare som drivs utan vinstsyfte. Assistansen är särskilt utformad för personer med flera stora funktionsnedsättningar där en är den intellektuella förmågan. Organisationen har en stark ideologisk förankring som bottnar i alla människors lika värde. Namnet JAG valdes för att symbolisera varje assistansanvändares rätt att vara huvudperson i sitt liv, oavsett funktionsnedsättning. Vi finns i hela Sverige och har systerbolag i Norge och Finland.

Välkommen till oss du också!

jobs.title: Tender Project Engineer
jobs.description:
The opportunity

Energy is the foundation of a functioning society — and the energy systems of the future require well‑engineered, competitive, and reliable solutions. Are you interested in working close to technology, cost, and delivery in some of the world’s most advanced power transmission projects?

Hitachi Energy delivers power grid technologies that supply electricity to more than three billion people worldwide. We are now looking for a Tender Project Engineer to join our HVDC organization in Ludvika, Sweden.

As a Tender Project Engineer, you support the early phases of HVDC projects by defining technical solutions and contributing to competitive tender proposals. You work closely with engineering, commercial, project management, and supply chain teams to define technical solutions, scope, risks, and cost drivers.

You contribute to shaping complete system solutions and ensure that technical proposals meet customer requirements, internal standards, and contractual conditions — all under demanding timelines.

This role is based in Ludvika, Sweden.

How you’ll make an impact

    Lead and coordinate technical work during the tender and proposal phases
    Analyze and interpret customer specifications and technical requirements
    Collaborate with the engineering, supply chain and project management teams to develop cost-optimized HVDC-system solutions
    Identify technical risks, constraints and opportunities and propose mitigation during the tender phase
    Provide accurate technical inputs to costing, planning assumptions and commercial offers
    Preparation of technical documentation for tenders and customer submissions
    Participate in technical meetings with customers and internal stakeholders
    Handover of technical scope to project execution teams

Your background

    Clear communication and coordination skills
    Experience in engineering, project engineering or technical projects
    Knowledge of HVDC, power systems, or energy infrastructure is a plus
    A structured approach to technical and commercial complexity
    Strong analytical mindset with the ability to balance technical-, cost-, schedule-, and risk factors
    Tender, proposal, contract, or customer requirements experience is a plus
    Proficient in English, both written and spoken. Swedish language skills are considered an advantage.

More about us

We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.​

Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes: ​

    Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2)​
    Group life insurance and additional insurances.​
    Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank​
    Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager)​
    Health care and wellness allowance​
    Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction)​
    Psychological support program​​
    Supplementary compensation for parental leave​
    Various trainings and education supporting employee development ​
    Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally​
    Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks​

The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and contract type. Eligibility is subject to local regulations.​

Are you ready for a new and exciting opportunity? Does this role sound like a good match for your skills and ambitions? Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply today.

Recruiting Manager Perilla Kilström, pernilla.kilstrom@hitachienergy.com, will answer your questions about the position. All other questions can be directed to Talent Acquisition Partner Oliver Chicaiza, oliver.chicaiza@hitachienergy.com

jobs.title: Senior Test Lead  Quality Assurance & Test Management - 20099
jobs.description:
Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.

Job Overview

Assignment Description

We are looking for an experienced Senior Test Lead to take overall responsibility for testing activities within a large-scale IT programme. You will define and drive the test strategy, coordinate testing teams, and ensure that testing is aligned with technical requirements and business objectives throughout the project lifecycle.

You will work closely with business stakeholders, Product Owners, agile team leads, and internal and external delivery teams to ensure effective test planning, execution, risk management, and quality reporting.

What You Will Work On

    Define and maintain the overall test strategy and test plan.

    Lead and coordinate testing activities and test execution across teams.
    Monitor test progress, defects, and quality metrics.
    Identify testing risks and define appropriate mitigation actions.
    Communicate test status, issues, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders.
    Coordinate QA, business, and delivery teams to ensure testing meets business and technical needs.
    Maintain test plans, test cases, test results, and defect reports.
    Support testing practices in Agile and DevOps environments.

What You Bring

    Proven experience as a Test Lead in large and complex IT programmes.

    Experience leading teams and coordinating end-to-end testing activities.
    Experience working in Agile and DevOps environments.
    Good understanding of CI/CD processes and test automation frameworks.
    Strong analytical, problem-solving, and risk management skills.
    Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
    Fluent English, both written and spoken.

Meritorious

    Experience with AWS services.
    Experience with test case management tools.
    Experience with JMeter or similar performance testing tools.
    Experience in large-scale and complex technology environments.
    ISTQB Certified Test Manager or equivalent certification.

jobs.title: Telineasentaja, rakennustelineet ja sääsuojarakenteet (Helsinki)
jobs.description:
Kiinteistöjen rakennus- ja saneeraustöiden tekeminen laadukkaasti sekä turvallisesti edellyttää tarkoituksenmukaisia teline- ja sääsuojaratkaisuja. Erikoistuminen ja tasokas ammattiosaaminen pitää yrityksen tilauskannan positiivisena seesteisinäkin aikoina ja ympäri vuoden sekä luo kasvupotentiaalia. Etsimmekin nyt telineasentajaa alalla jo vuosikymmeniä toimineen asiakasyrityksemme tehtäviin pääkaupunkiseudulle pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen.

Työt koostuvat rakennustelineiden ja sääsuojarakenteiden / sääsuojien asennus- ja purkutehtävistä. Työt tehdään ryhmässä tai asentajaparin kanssa. Työkohteet sijaitsevat pääkaupunkiseudulla sekä ympäristökunnissa ja niihin tyypillisesti kuljetaan omalla autolla. Työntekijälle maksetaan TES:n mukainen korvaus päivittäisistä matkakustannuksista kotoa työkohteeseen sekä km-korvaus mahdollisista työkohteiden välisistä ajoista. Tekijän asuinpaikasta riippuen useimpiin työkohteisiin pääsee joustavasti myös julkisilla liikennevälineillä.

Työ on arkisin tehtävää päivätyötä klo 7:00 - 15:30, pääasiassa 40 h/vko. Työpäivien pituudessa voi esiintyä jonkin verran vaihtelua. Tehtävässä noudatetaan rakennusalan työehtosopimusta. Palkkaus kokemuksen ja sopimuksen mukaisesti.

Arvostamme hakijassa luonnollisesti kokemusta vastaavista asennustöistä, sillä telineiden ja konsoleiden asennus lujasti ja turvallisesti on ensisijaisen tärkeätä. Otamme haussa huomioon myös alaa kokemattomat tehtävään soveltuvat hakijat. Työssä menestymiseen siivittää halu sekä kyky aktiiviseen ja fyysiseen tekemiseen sekä vastuullinen työote. Oleellista on säilyttää toimintakyky korkeammallakin työskennellessä. Tehtävään annetaan asianmukainen perehdytys ja kollegoiden tuki sekä työhön kuuluvat varusteet.

Tehtävässä voidaan aloittaa pikaisestikin sopivan henkilön löydyttyä kauttamme määräaikaisella vuokratyösuhteella, jonka päätteeksi tekijän on tarkoitus jatkaa vakituisessa työsuhteessa asiakasyrityksessämme pitkäaikaisesti.

Tässä on toimeliaalle tekijälle hyvä työ hyvin hoidetussa ja työntekijöistään välittävässä yrityksessä. Tarjoamme työvaatetuksen, perustasoa kattavammat työterveyspalvelut sekä Clickin oman yhteyshenkilön vahvan tuen.

Haastatteluja tehdään jo hakuaikana, joten täytähän pikaisesti hakemus oheisen linkin kautta. Voit laittaa hakemuksen ja ansioluettelosi myös sähköpostilla. Kerro hakemuksessa mahdollisimman tarkasti osaamisestasi ja aikaisemmasta työkokemuksestasi. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa rekrytointia hoitava rekrytointikonsultti Jan Kollin puhelimitse arkisin klo 9.00-16.00. Puh. 050 411 0390 ja sähköposti on muotoa etunimi.sukunimi@click-hp.fi

jobs.title: Are you studying for an IT degree and looking for a student job where you'll gain hands-on experience with modern workplace technology, cloud services, cybersecurity, and IT operations? Then join us!
jobs.employer: International Council for The Exploration Of The Sea
jobs.description:
We have an exciting opportunity for a service-minded IT student to join our team as a Student Assistant in Copenhagen.

About ICES

The International Council for the Exploration of the Sea (ICES) is an intergovernmental organization which advances marine science and promotes sustainable use of the seas. Our Secretariat is located in central Copenhagen and consists of approximately 85 staff representing more than 30 nationalities.

We are a small, collaborative workplace with an international outlook and a strong focus on learning, innovation, and knowledge sharing.

Your role

As our new Student Assistant, you'll help support the day-to-day IT needs of colleagues across an international workplace. Working alongside four other members of the IT team, you'll gain practical experience with modern workplace technologies while helping ensure that staff can work securely and effectively both in the office and remotely.

Responsibilities
You will help with:

  • IT support and troubleshooting

  • Device setup and user administration

  • Microsoft 365 services and workplace technology

  • Meeting room and conferencing equipment

  • IT improvements, documentation, and security activities

  • Support cybersecurity and compliance activities, including CIS controls, using cloud and Microsoft 365 security solutions.

Who we are looking for

We are looking for a student who has completed at least 3 years of education within IT, computer science, business informatics, technical engineering, or a related field, and who is currently pursuing further studies.

You do not need to know everything already. We are more interested in your curiosity, motivation, and willingness to learn.

For this role, we expect you to have:

  • A strong interest in IT support and workplace technology

  • Good understanding of Windows and Microsoft 365

  • Confidence troubleshooting common technical issues

  • Strong communication skills in English, both written and spoken

  • A structured and detail-oriented approach to your work

  • The ability to work independently while also being a strong team player

Experience with Microsoft 365 administration, cloud technologies, device management, cybersecurity, or scripting is an advantage, but not required.

Why join ICES?

At ICES, you'll do more than provide IT support. You'll gain practical experience with modern workplace technology, work closely with experienced colleagues, and help support an international community of staff and scientists. We offer flexible working hours to fit around your studies, along with plenty of opportunities to learn and develop your skills.

Terms of Appointment

This is a paid student role, and the working hours are 15 hours per week. This position will be established with an initial duration of 6 months, with a starting date as soon as possible (preferably January 2027).

Apply Now!

Don’t miss out on this opportunity to kickstart your IT career with us! Submit your application (CV and letter of motivation) by clicking the following link: Student Assistant (IT Support and Cybersecurity) Vacancy - ICES

Deadline for application submission is midnight 28 October 2026.

Questions about the role can be directed to IT Team Lead and Enterprise Architect, Nasrullah Iqbal (nas@ices.dk)

For more information about ICES, please visit our website:  www.ices.dk

jobs.description:
Spar Nord Arena - Aalborg Væddeløbsbane SØGER NY BANEFORVALTER

Da vores nuværende baneforvalter ønsker at gå ned i tid, søger vi en ny til at afløse ham.

Spar Nord Arena – Aalborg Væddeløbsbane er med 40 årlige løbsdage Danmarks mest aktive væddeløbsbane. Vi afvikler både trav- og galopløb på vores 18 ha. store område, og som baneforvalter får du ansvaret for at både vores baner og vores område spiller til såvel løb som træning. Stillingen er fuld tid, og vores nye baneforvalter skal i tæt samarbejde med ledelsen og tre kollegaer der hjælper med at passe bane og område, sikre at vi opretholder et højt niveau på vores sportslige faciliteter og omgivelser.

Dine vigtigste arbejdsopgaver bliver:

·At passe opvisnings- og træningsbaner.

·At foretage reparationer / vedligehold på maskiner og bygninger.

·At passe vores grønne område.

·Øvrigt forefaldende arbejde.

Din profil: Vi lægger vægt på at du har erfaring med traktorer, redskaber og maskiner i almindelighed. Du må gerne have hænderne skruet rigtigt på, så du uden problemer kan udføre løbende reparationer.

Indgangsvinklen til jobbet kan f.eks. være maskinfører, landmand, greenkeeper, vicevært, banemand eller aktiv udøver.

Da vores løb afvikles når andre har fri (aften og/eller weekend), er det et krav, at du kan arbejde på disse dage.

Vi tilbyder: Et godt og stabilt job med frihed under ansvar. En løn som matcher dine kvalifikationer.

Vi ønsker stillingen besat hurtigst muligt, men vi venter gerne på den rette. Da vi afholder samtaler løbende, opfordrer vi dig til at søge stillingen hellere i dag end i morgen.

For yderligere oplysninger om stillingen kontakt banechef Lars Hellerup.

jobs.title: Tule keittiön vuoropäälliköksi Rauman Rossoon!

RAUMA

Etsimme keittiön vuoropäällikköä upouuteen Rauman Rossoon. Tehtävä on vakituinen ja kokoaikainen.

Vuoropäällikkönä olet tärkeässä roolissa keittiön sujuvassa arjessa. Johdat työvuoroa omalla esimerkilläsi, autat tiimiä onnistumaan ja osallistut aktiivisesti ruoanvalmistukseen. Huolehdit esivalmisteluista, raaka-aineista ja tilauksista sekä siitä, että annokset lähtevät asiakkaille laadukkaina ja hyvällä otteella. Tehtäviisi kuuluvat myös hävikin ja kustannusten seuranta, omavalvonta sekä raportointi esihenkilöille.

Etsimme kokemusta kartuttanutta keittiöammattilaista, joka tarttuu toimeen, pitää kokonaisuuden hallussa myös kiireessä ja haluaa kehittää tekemistä yhdessä muun tiimin kanssa. Kokemus esihenkilö- tai ohjaustyöstä katsotaan eduksi.

Edellytämme hygieniapassia, sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa ja kokemusta keittiötyöstä.

Tarjoamme vastuullisen ja monipuolisen työn lisäksi S-ryhmän monipuoliset henkilöstöedut, MaRaVa:n työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkan sekä ammattitaitoisen työporukan tuen.

jobs.title: Kotisiivooja
jobs.description:
ETSIMME KUOPION ALUEELLE KOTISIIVOOJAA OSA-AIKAISEEN TYÖHÖN

MITÄ KOTISIIVOOJAN TYÖ SISÄLTÄÄ?

Kotipalvelussa työsi on monipuolista, itsenäistä ja ihmisläheistä. Työsi sisältää monipuolisia kotisiivouksen työtehtäviä aina ikkunanpesusta perussiivoukseen vaihtelevissa asiakaskohteissa.

Kotipalvelussa jokainen työpäivä on erilainen. Pääset hyödyntämään ammattitaitoasi laaja-alaisesti ja tekemään työtä, joka tuo iloa asiakkaidemme arkeen.


MITÄ TARJOAMME SINULLE?

* Itsenäisen työn

* Mahdollisuuden hyödyntää ja kehittää omaa osaamistasi laajasti

* Ammattitaitoisen ja kannustavan työyhteisön tueksesi

* Laadukkaat työvälineet

* Yksityisen sosiaalialan työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkan


MITÄ TOIVOMME SINULTA?

* Työtä vastaavaa tutkintoa tai alan työkokemusta

* Asiakaslähtöistä, vastuullista ja lämminhenkistä työotetta

* Kykyä itsenäiseen työskentelyyn ja päätöksentekoon

* Erinomaista suomen kielen taitoa

* Oman auton käyttömahdollisuus katsotaan eduksi, sillä liikut asiakaskohteiden välillä

Kiinnostuitko? Jätä hakemuksesi! Haastattelemme jo hakuajan aikana.

Nähdään Alinassa!

----------------------------------------

Haluatko tietää lisää meistä? Löydät lisätietoa verkkosivuiltamme [https://alinahoivatiimi.fi/].

Alina on valtakunnallinen ketju, joka työllistää jo 350 alan ammattilaista. Paikallisia Alina-yrityksiä on jo yli 40 eri puolilla Suomea. Työtyytyväisyytemme sai arvosanaksi 4,39/5 vuonna 2025.

Alina on osa Norlandiaa [https://norlandiacare.fi/], joka tarjoaa innovatiivisia ja monipuolisia hyvinvointi- ja terveyspalveluita kaikille vauvasta vaariin sekä nelijalkaisille ystävillemme. jobs.title: Perheohjaaja, Lastensuojelun laitospalvelut, Turku
jobs.description:
Tehtäväsi

Työskentelet perheohjaajana Turussa sijaitsevassa lastensuojelun perhekuntoutusyksikössä, joka on osa Varsinais-Suomen hyvinvointialueen omien lastensuojelulaitosten kokonaisuutta.

Perheohjaajana vastaat yhdessä työryhmän kanssa perheiden tilanteen kartoituksesta sekä tavoitteellisesta kuntoutusprosessin mukaisesta työskentelystä. Asiakasperheiden elämäntilanteet ovat usein kriisiytyneitä, ja he tarvitsevat tehostettua lastensuojelullista tukea. Työskentelysi voi tapahtua päivittäin kuntoutusasunnossa perheen arjen rinnalla tai intensiivisesti perheen omassa kodissa.

Työtäsi ohjaavat suhdeperustainen työote, systeeminen ajattelu sekä muutokseen tähtäävä tavoitteellisuus. Hyödynnät työssäsi mentalisaatio- ja kiintymyssuhdeperusteista arviointia ja kuntoutusta.

Toimit osana moniammatillista tiimiä ja laajaa verkostoa, jossa lapsi ja hänen perheensä ovat kaiken työn keskiössä. Vahvistat työssäsi lapsen asemaa ja näkökulmaa perheessä sekä hyödynnät erilaisia työmenetelmiä ja tiimin yhteistä osaamista.

Työpaikan osoite on Kunnallissairaalantie 36, 20810 Turku.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle

Tarjoamme sinulle merkityksellisen työn lastensuojelun perhekuntoutuksessa, jossa pääset työskentelemään tiiviisti perheiden arjen ja muutoksen tukena.

jobs.title: Site Manager till FirstOffice Stockholm
jobs.description:
Om företaget

FirstOffice, en affärsenhet inom det börsnoterade fastighetsbolaget Corem, erbjuder flexibla kontorslösningar med arbetsplatser, mötesrum och service i professionella och inspirerande miljöer. Konceptet bygger på att det ska vara enkelt att flytta in och enkelt att vara kund – kontor, service och gemensamma ytor samlas i en flexibel helhetslösning där företagen kan fokusera på sin egen verksamhet.

Läs mer om FirstOffice här: FirstOffice

Om rollen

Som Site Manager ansvarar du för flera av FirstOffice enheter i Stockholm. Rollen är bred, självständig och affärsnära, där du är naturlig del av den dagliga verksamheten och har regelbunden kontakt med kunder och medlemmar. Du arbetar med allt från visningar, uthyrning och inflyttningar till att lösa praktiska frågor och säkerställa att service och drift håller en hög nivå.

Teamet du ingår i utgår från Kista och där finns även FirstOffice tjänstebilar. Du kommer att ha fasta dagar då du jobbar från kontoret i Kista och övriga dagar utgår du från de FirstOffice-enheter du ansvarar för.

Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsområden

I rollen ansvarar du för att skapa en välfungerande vardag för våra kunder och samtidigt driva affären framåt. Du arbetar både operativt och relationsskapande, med tydligt fokus på service, uthyrning och resultat.

Du kommer bland annat att:

    

Driva och utveckla dina enheter mot uppsatta mål inom uthyrning, kundnöjdhet och resultat

    

Bearbeta leads, genomföra visningar och driva uthyrningsprocessen från första kontakt till tecknat avtal

    

Bygga och utveckla långsiktiga relationer med både befintliga och potentiella kunder

    

Säkerställa en hög servicenivå och en välfungerande daglig drift på enheterna

    

Arbeta aktivt med nätverkande, kundaktiviteter och lokal marknadsbearbetning

    

Ansvara för budget, resultatuppföljning samt planering och utveckling av dina enheter

    

Samarbeta nära med övriga Site Managers, Service Managers och andra funktioner inom FirstOffice och Corem

Vi söker

Vi söker dig som trivs i en bred och operativ roll där du är nära både verksamheten och kunderna. Du har ett naturligt affärsdriv, tycker om att bygga relationer och ser möjligheter i det dagliga kundmötet. Du är prestigelös och lösningsorienterad och trivs med att växla mellan kundkontakt, praktiska frågor och administration. För dig är hög service och en välfungerande drift grunden för nöjda kunder och goda resultat. Du kommunicerar tydligt och professionellt, är lyhörd för människor omkring dig och trivs i en miljö där det förväntas att du tar egna initiativ.

För att trivas i rollen ser vi gärna att du:

    

Har erfarenhet av försäljning, kundnära och affärsdriven roll

    

Är strukturerad och van vid att självständigt planera och prioritera ditt arbete

    

Har god administrativ förmåga och är bekväm med budget, uppföljning och digitala verktyg

    

Är kommunikativ, lyhörd och tydlig i samarbetet med såväl kunder som kollegor

    

Är prestigelös och trivs med att växla mellan operativa, praktiska och mer affärsstrategiska arbetsuppgifter

    

Har eftergymnasial utbildning eller motsvarande relevant arbetslivserfarenhet

    

Kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och har goda kunskaper i engelska, både i tal och skrift

    

Har B-körkort

Tidigare erfarenhet från kontorshotell, coworking, fastighet, uthyrning eller liknande serviceverksamhet är meriterande, men inget krav. Vi kommer att lägga stor vikt vid din personlighet och din förmåga att skapa förtroende och få saker att hända.

Om Carotte

Carotte Staff är Carotte Groups specialistbolag för bemanning och rekrytering inom service och värdskap. Med 40 års erfarenhet av servicebranschen i ryggen levererar vi självgående och engagerad personal till hotell, konferens, kontorsservice, restaurang och fastighetsmiljöer. Genom Carotte Academy utbildar vi kontinuerligt våra konsulter inom service och värdskap. Vi finns med kontor i Stockholm och Göteborg och verkar över hela Sverige.

Ansökan

Detta är ett hyrrekrytering via Carotte Staff, vilket innebär att du inledningsvis är anställd av oss och därefter går över i tillsvidareanställning hos FirstOffice. Anställningsform: tillsvidareanställning med inledande provanställning Arbetstider: kontorstider Startdatum: Omgående

Urval sker löpande, så vänta inte med din ansökan. Har du frågor om rollen är du välkommen att kontakta ansvarig rekryterare på Carotte Staff.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan.

jobs.title: Senior Application Security Engineer
jobs.description:
About Nabla

Nabla delivers a unified clinical AI platform used by healthcare organizations across specialties and care settings. The platform includes:

Ambient AI documentation that captures clinical conversations and generates structured notes.

AI-powered dictation and clinical workflow tools embedded directly within EHR systems.

Agentic AI capabilities that support multi-step clinical and administrative tasks.

Enterprise-grade infrastructure built for secure deployment across health systems.

About the Role

We are scaling our healthcare AI platform, with more products, integrations and AI agents, and more protected health information (PHI) flowing through them. To keep pace, we're growing our security engineering team and looking for an exceptional Senior Security Engineer.

Our cloud infrastructure handles highly sensitive healthcare data, so security is core to everything we do. Our engineers already ask the right questions every day: can we use a one-time token here? How long should it live? How do we scope this OAuth Client?

You'll work directly with our Lead Security Engineer to bring real AppSec expertise into the product squads, and to strengthen security well beyond them.

This is a hands-on, high-impact role. About half your time goes to AppSec, but it is deliberately a broad security engineering role, not a pure code-review or pentest job. You'll regularly cross into platform and cloud, CI/CD and detection, and you'll own problems from start to finish. Code scanning, SCA and AI-driven code review are already running, but there is no AppSec process to undo. The threat-modeling practice, the security review loop, the triage rhythm and the secure-by-default libraries don't exist yet. You'll build them and run them.

If you're pragmatic, love working shoulder to shoulder with developers, and want your work to protect patients' most sensitive data, this role is for you.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with the product squads as their go-to security engineer: design reviews, per-feature threat modeling, and fast, opinionated answers on authN/authZ, tokens and session design.

  • Secure our authentication and authorization surfaces (OAuth clients, one-time codes, multi-org tenancy, the Core API user API, embedded/postMessage SDKs) and hunt for BOLA, IDOR and broken access control before attackers do.

  • Run the code-security findings loop: triage and prioritize results from our SAST, SCA, secrets and IaC scanners and AI-driven code review, route them to the right owners with SLAs, and drive the dependency-vulnerability backlog down, fixing issues yourself when that's faster.

  • Secure our AI/LLM features and internal agents, covering prompt injection, tool and permission scoping for autonomous agents, PHI leakage, de-identification assurance and model/API egress.

  • Run the external testing program: scope and run pentests (web, mobile, backoffice), validate fixes, operate our vulnerability disclosure program, and stand up a bug bounty.

  • Build secure-by-default guardrails (secure coding guidelines, hardened libraries and patterns, pre-commit and PR checks) so the secure path is the easy path.

Qualifications

  • 5 to 8+ years in security engineering, including at least 2 to 3 years in application or product security, or experience as a software engineer with a strong security focus.

  • Deep understanding of modern web and API security: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, session and token design, multi-tenancy, and the OWASP Top 10 and API Top 10. You can find access-control flaws by reading code.

  • Strong coder, comfortable reading and fixing production code (mostly Kotlin and Python, plus web, mobile and desktop clients) and automating in Python.

  • Experience running threat modeling and security design reviews, and operating SAST, SCA and secrets scanning in CI with a real triage loop, not just a dashboard.

  • Genuine breadth: comfortable moving between an API design review, a supply-chain hardening PR and an incident in the same week, and honest about what you don't know yet.

  • Excellent communicator who earns developers' trust and works well with engineering, compliance and IT.

  • Full professional fluency in French and English (oral and written).

Nice to have: LLM / AI agent security, mobile app security, pentest or bug bounty experience, GCP / GKE, or experience in healthcare or another regulated industry.

Life at Nabla

When you join Nabla, you join a team that is driven by excellence, curiousity, and kindness. Together, we’re committed to making clinicians’ lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe clinicians should be able to focus on what they were trained to do, caring for their patients, and that no patient should feel their visit was rushed.

We work hard and make time to have fun, too. Our #nablabla channel is just as active as #feature-show-off. We support well-being with workday activities at least three times a week; choose from yoga, running, Pilates, or HIIT. We also host regular off-sites, meet up across New York, Paris, San Francisco, and other cities, and keep the chocolate and nuts well stocked.

If this sounds like an environment where you’ll thrive, we look forward to reading your application.

Our Values at Nabla

Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion.

Every day is a new chance to excel

We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day.

Stay humble

There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture.

Feedback is a gift

We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions.

Committed to diversity

We recognize the ongoing challenge of diversity in tech. Our responsibility starts with fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond.

As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive.

Avoid recruitment scams: Stay safe and informed

There is an active employment and financial scam which uses Nabla to collect personal information. If you’re contacted by a Nabla recruiter, please ensure they are utilizing a nabla.com email address. We will never ask for the exchange of any money or credit card details during the recruitment process. Nabla utilizes a hiring platform for all applications; please be aware of any suspicious email activity. You can find more information following this link.


Nabla does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruiters or employment agencies in response to the Nabla Careers page or a Nabla social media post. Any unsolicited CVs, including those submitted directly to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of Nabla.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys working cross-functionally in a dynamic international environment while contributing to the advancement of sustainable energy solutions. This role is based in Ludvika, Sweden, and requires frequent presence at the office due to the nature of the role.

More about us​

jobs.title: Undersköterska Villa Tollare (äldreomsorg)
jobs.description:
Tillsammans med engagerade kollegor har du som huvudsaklig uppgift att ge stöd åt och skapa en rolig och meningsfull vardag för våra äldre som bor hos oss.

Är du en person med hög servicekänsla och engageras av att ge våra äldre en bra vardag? Då är du rätt person att söka till oss!

Teamarbete för god kvalitet

Vi arbetar i team runt den boende med undersköterskor, sjuksköterskor, arbetsterapeut, aktivitetscoach och fysioterapeut för att kunna erbjuda en hälsofrämjande vård och omsorg av mycket god kvalitet. Det innebär också att du har ett tryggt stöd från kollegor, både omsorgspersonal och övriga yrkesroller. På Villa Tollare hittar du även vår förskola som ligger i samma lokaler, vilket bidrar till härliga möten mellan barn och de äldre.

Som undersköterska hos oss ger du individuell och trygg omsorg genom att arbeta i en nära relation med den äldre och hens närstående och du ser den äldre ur ett helhetsperspektiv. Du sköter ett visst medicinskt omvårdnadsarbete utifrån delegering av sjuksköterska. För att lyckas i rollen hos oss är det viktigt att du har god samarbets- och initiativförmåga och tar ansvar för att vara med och driva en äldreomsorg av högsta kvalitet.

Vi behöver säkerställa att du som söker jobb hos oss har rätt att arbeta i Sverige. Om du går vidare i processen så kommer vi att begära in handlingar som styrker din rätt att arbeta i Sverige.

Vi söker dig som är utbildad undersköterska och har erfarenhet av att arbeta med människor som har somatiska besvär.

Som person tar du initiativ i arbetet och ser vad som behöver prioriteras ur ett helhetsperspektiv. Du har hög servicekänsla och är hjälpsam gentemot dina kollegor och ser till att dina arbetsuppgifter blir genomförda på ett kvalitetsmässigt vis. Du är trygg i din yrkesroll och är ansvarstagande och noggrann. Vidare är det ett krav att du har bra kunskaper i det svenska språket i både tal och skrift samt god vana av att dokumentera.

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning med provanställning och start enligt överenskommelse.

Utdrag ur belastningsregistret ska uppvisas innan anställning. Vi ser gärna att det visas digitalt, exempelvis via Kivra.

Vid frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta:

Rekryteringsansvarig som du hittar längst ner i annonsen.

Om du har fackliga frågor är du välkommen att höra av dig via mejl till adressen nedan:

Email: pvo.skondal.stockholm@kommunal.se

Rekrytering sker löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. Välkommen med din ansökan!

Vi är en idéburen och icke vinstutdelande organisation inom stöd, vård, omsorg, utbildning och forskning. Att vi inte delar ut någon vinst gör att vi kan satsa alla resurser på att utföra vårt uppdrag så bra som möjligt. Sedan 1905 har verksamheter inom Stiftelsen Stora Sköndal utvecklats, förändrats och förbättras. Vissa verksamheter består, andra är helt nya. Men en sak förändras inte: Vi arbetar fortfarande utifrån övertygelsen om alla människors lika värde.

Varje dag vill vi göra livet bättre för alla de människor vi möter i våra verksamheter. Idag är vi ca 1100 medarbetare, både månadsanställda och timanställda som tillsammans arbetar mot vår vision - ett samhälle med en självklar plats för alla. Vår kultur genomsyras av våra värderingar - jämlikhet, omtanke och förändring.

Läs mer om oss på www.storaskondal.se

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator Miele Professional Sverige
jobs.description:
Are you a hands-on marketing professional who enjoys turning ideas into action? Would you like to take ownership of local marketing activities while being part of a global premium brand?

At Miele Professional, we are looking for a proactive and digitally skilled Marketing Coordinator to join our B2B team in Solna. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys a varied role, combining digital marketing, campaign execution, content creation and close collaboration with sales and international marketing teams.

Your role

As Marketing Coordinator for Sweden, you will be responsible for coordinating and implementing local marketing activities within our HCS and LMD customer segments. You will play a key role in bringing regional and international marketing strategies to life in the Swedish market, ensuring that campaigns, product launches and communication activities are relevant, engaging and effectively executed.

This is a hands-on role with considerable independence, where you will work closely with the Swedish sales and service teams while collaborating with regional marketing colleagues and other stakeholders across our international organisation.

What you will be doing

Bringing marketing plans to life

You will translate regional marketing strategies and corporate objectives into effective local activities for the Swedish market. This includes coordinating product launches, promotions and marketing campaigns, ensuring that international initiatives are successfully adapted and implemented locally.

Working closely with the Regional Marketing Directors you will provide local market insights and input regarding products, consumables, digital services and pricing.

Driving digital marketing and customer engagement

A key part of your role will be to attract new customers, strengthen brand awareness and support customer retention, both directly and through our partners. You will coordinate and execute lead generation initiatives and digital marketing activities, ensuring that Miele Professional remains visible and relevant across digital channels.

You will also create, adapt and enrich local marketing content, including articles, customer success stories and reference cases for online and offline communication. Ensuring the quality and relevance of our Swedish marketing materials will be another important responsibility.

Supporting sales and strengthening Mieles premium positioning

You will work closely with our Swedish sales and service teams to ensure that marketing activities support commercial priorities and customer needs.

This includes developing and providing relevant sales and marketing materials, as well as planning and coordinating local events, trade fairs and training activities in line with corporate.

Managing project, budgets and stakeholders

You will coordinate the local marketing plan and budget, ensuring that activities are delivered on time, within budget and to a high standard.

As part of an international matrix organisation, you will collaborate with a broad network of stakeholders, including the Regional Management Team, sales and service teams, business partners, marketing colleagues across North West Europe and external marketing agencies.

Who are you?

We believe you are an experienced and hands-on marketing professional who enjoys taking ownership and making things happen. You have a strong understanding of B2B marketing and know how to turn marketing strategies into practical activities that generate results. You are equally comfortable coordinating a digital campaign, adapting content for a local audience, supporting a product launch or collaborating with sales colleagues on lead generation initiatives.

You thrive in an international environment, enjoy working with different stakeholders and are confident managing several projects simultaneously. Most importantly, you are someone who takes initiative, identifies opportunities and drives activities forward independently, while knowing when to involve and collaborate with others.

Your background

We are looking for someone with:

· A bachelor's or master's degree in marketing or a related field.

· Relevant marketing experience, with a strong operational and hands-on focus.

· Experience coordinating and implementing local marketing activities in line with regional or international strategies.

· Proven digital marketing experience, including areas such as performance marketing, SEO, social media and AI-supported marketing tools.

· Excellent Swedish communication and strong communication skills in English.

· Experience working in an international matrix organisation and managing cross-functional projects is an advantage.

What we offer

At Miele Professional, you will have the opportunity to work with a well-established global premium brand in a role that combines local ownership with international collaboration.

You will be part of a professional and supportive environment where your initiative, expertise and ability to deliver results can make a real difference.

Practical information

Location: Solna, Sweden

Employment: Full-time, temporary position covering parental leave

Period: Ideally November 2026 – February 2028

Ready to make an impact?

We look forward to receiving your application and learning more about how you could contribute to Miele Professional's continued growth in Sweden.

jobs.title: AI Adoption Specialist  Generative AI & Developer Enablement - 20102
jobs.description:
Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.

Job Overview

Assignment Description

We are looking for an AI Adoption Specialist to drive practical adoption of AI tools within software development teams through hands-on training, workshops, and coaching.

You will plan and deliver several practical workshops each week, tailored to developers' needs and daily workflows. The role focuses on generative AI, GitHub Copilot, prompting, AI agents, and AI-assisted software development and testing.

You will help teams turn AI knowledge into effective working practices, identify adoption barriers, and transfer knowledge to internal AI ambassadors. This is a hands-on training and coaching role rather than a project management or AI architecture position.

What You Will Work On

    Plan and deliver practical AI workshops and training sessions for development teams.
    Train developers in generative AI, GitHub Copilot, prompting, context management, and AI-assisted workflows.
    Demonstrate AI agents and AI-supported development and testing techniques.
    Adapt exercises and training materials to different roles, skill levels, and development tasks.
    Coach teams in applying AI tools to their everyday software development work.
    Identify adoption challenges and translate them into targeted training and coaching activities.
    Explain AI tool limitations, safe usage, and the importance of human review.
    Develop and maintain reusable training materials, exercises, and practical examples.
    Support knowledge transfer to internal AI trainers and AI ambassador networks.
    Work closely with developers using React, MUI, .NET 10, Java, SQL Server, VS Code, and Visual Studio.

What You Bring

    Practical experience with generative AI and AI-assisted software development.
    Hands-on experience with GitHub Copilot, including prompting, context, instructions, and AI-assisted development workflows.
    Ability to independently plan and lead practical AI training sessions and workshops.
    Experience adapting training to different technical roles, skill levels, and real-world tasks.
    Ability to identify team needs and turn them into effective coaching and training activities.
    Understanding of AI tool limitations, secure usage, and human oversight.
    Strong communication and teaching skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly.
    A proactive, self-directed, and delivery-focused working style.
    Ability to engage development teams and communicate both the benefits and limitations of AI tools.

Meritorious

    Experience in regulated industries such as banking or insurance.
    Practical experience with AI agents and automated workflows.
    Experience using AI for test design, test automation, and quality assurance.

jobs.title: Asiakkuuspäällikkö
jobs.description:
Etsimme MainosLähde Oy tiimiin asiakkuuspäällikköä, joka haluaa olla mukana kehittämässä asiakkaidemme liiketoimintaa, rakentamassa pitkäaikaisia asiakassuhteita ja luomassa tuloksellisia markkinointiratkaisuja.

Asiakkuuspäällikkönä toimit asiakkaidemme keskeisenä yhteyshenkilönä ja vastaat sekä nykyisten asiakkuuksien kehittämisestä että uusien asiakassuhteiden rakentamisesta. Tehtävässä yhdistyvät asiakkuuksien johtaminen, tavoitteellinen myyntityö, markkinoinnin suunnittelu sekä projektien koordinointi yhteistyössä MainosLähteen asiantuntijatiimin kanssa.

Työskentelet monipuolisesti eri toimialojen yritysten ja organisaatioiden kanssa. Tavoitteenasi on ymmärtää asiakkaidemme liiketoimintaa, tunnistaa heidän markkinointiin ja näkyvyyteen liittyviä tarpeitaan sekä tarjota ratkaisuja, jotka tukevat asiakkaiden kasvua ja liiketoiminnallisia tavoitteita.

Keskeiset työtehtäväsi

**Asiakkuuksien hoitaminen ja kehittäminen**

- Vastaat nimettyjen asiakkuuksien kokonaisvaltaisesta hoitamisesta ja asiakastyytyväisyydestä.

- Rakennat ja ylläpidät pitkäaikaisia, luottamuksellisia asiakassuhteita.

- Tunnistat asiakkaiden liiketoiminnan tavoitteita ja kehität heidän markkinointiaan yhdessä asiantuntijatiimimme kanssa.

- Suunnittelet ja toteutat asiakastapaamisia sekä huolehdit aktiivisesta yhteydenpidosta.

- Tunnistat nykyisissä asiakkuuksissa uusia yhteistyö- ja kasvumahdollisuuksia.


**Uusasiakashankinta ja myyntityö**

- Vastaat aktiivisesta uusasiakashankinnasta ja uusien liiketoimintamahdollisuuksien tunnistamisesta.

- Kontaktoit potentiaalisia asiakkaita ja sovit asiakastapaamisia.

- Kartoitat asiakkaiden tarpeita ja esittelet heille soveltuvia markkinointi- ja viestintäratkaisuja.

- Laadit tarjouksia ja osallistut sopimusneuvotteluihin.

- Viet myyntiprosesseja suunnitelmallisesti eteenpäin ensimmäisestä yhteydenotosta asiakkuuden käynnistämiseen.

- Seuraat omaa myyntityötäsi ja sen tuloksellisuutta.


**Markkinoinnin ratkaisujen suunnittelu ja myynti**

- Osallistut asiakkaiden markkinoinnin tavoitteiden ja kehitystarpeiden määrittelyyn.

- Suunnittelet yhdessä asiantuntijoidemme kanssa asiakkaille sopivia palvelukokonaisuuksia.

- Myyt MainosLähteen palveluita, kuten verkkosivustojen suunnittelua ja toteutusta, hakukoneoptimointia (SEO), tekoälyhakuihin liittyvää näkyvyyden kehittämistä (GEO), Google Ads -mainontaa, sosiaalisen median markkinointia, sisällöntuotantoa, brändäystä sekä valo- ja videotuotantoja.

- Osallistut markkinointikampanjoiden suunnitteluun, tavoitteiden määrittelyyn ja tulosten arviointiin.

- Autat asiakkaita ymmärtämään markkinoinnin eri mahdollisuuksia ja niiden vaikutuksia liiketoimintaan.


**Projektien koordinointi ja yhteistyö**

- Toimit asiakkaan ja MainosLähteen tuotantotiimin välisenä yhteyshenkilönä.

- Huolehdit omalta osaltasi siitä, että asiakasprojektit etenevät sovittujen tavoitteiden, aikataulujen ja budjettien mukaisesti.

- Välität asiakastarpeet ja projektien tavoitteet selkeästi toteutuksesta vastaaville asiantuntijoille.

- Osallistut projektien suunnitteluun, aikatauluttamiseen ja seurantaan.

- Varmistat sujuvan asiakasviestinnän ja laadukkaan asiakaskokemuksen projektien eri vaiheissa.


**Asiakkuuksien ja myynnin tuloksellisuuden seuranta**

- Seuraat asiakkuuksien kehittymistä, myynnin tavoitteiden toteutumista ja asiakastyytyväisyyttä.

- Huolehdit asiakastietojen ja myyntimahdollisuuksien ajantasaisuudesta käytössä olevissa järjestelmissä.

- Osallistut asiakkuuksien kannattavuuden ja palvelukokonaisuuksien kehittämiseen.

- Tuot esiin uusia ideoita ja kehitysehdotuksia MainosLähteen palveluiden sekä toimintatapojen kehittämiseksi.


Millainen rooli sinulla on tiimissämme?

Asiakkuuspäällikön tehtävä on itsenäinen ja vastuullinen, mutta et työskentele yksin. Tukenasi on MainosLähteen markkinoinnin, digitaalisten ratkaisujen, visuaalisen suunnittelun ja sisällöntuotannon osaamista.

Sinun ei tarvitse itse hallita kaikkien markkinointipalveluiden teknistä toteutusta. Tärkeintä on, että ymmärrät asiakkaiden tarpeita, osaat keskustella markkinoinnin mahdollisuuksista ja pystyt rakentamaan toimivia ratkaisuja yhteistyössä asiantuntijoidemme kanssa.

Tehtävässä pääset vaikuttamaan omaan työskentelyysi, kehittämään asiakkuuksia pitkäjänteisesti ja osallistumaan myös MainosLähteen liiketoiminnan kasvattamiseen.

**Työn keskeinen tavoite on luoda kannattavia ja pitkäaikaisia asiakassuhteita, kasvattaa uusasiakashankinnan kautta yrityksen myyntiä sekä varmistaa, että asiakkaamme saavat markkinoinnistaan mahdollisimman paljon hyötyä.**

jobs.description:
- Eine etablierte Institution in der Region Hinwil sucht Verstärkung: Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH, Schwerpunkt Bezugspflege.

### Auf einen Blick: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH für die Region Hinwil

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Bezugspflege

**Pensum:** 80–100 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Hinwil

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Hinwil liegt im Zürcher Oberland und überzeugt Sie als Arbeitsort durch seine ausgezeichnete Verkehrsanbindung mit direkter S-Bahn-Verbindung nach Zürich. Die Region bietet Ihnen ein attraktives Umfeld mit guter Infrastruktur, zahlreichen Arbeitsplätzen und einer hohen Lebensqualität. Die Nähe zur Natur sowie die Kombination aus urbanem Angebot und ländlichem Charakter machen Hinwil zu einem beliebten Arbeitsstandort für Pendler und ansässige Unternehmen.

### Diese Tätigkeiten erwarten Sie in Hinwil

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Ihre Stärken für diese Stelle

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Bezugspflege

Sie arbeiten in einem betreuten Wohnumfeld: Alltag gestalten, begleiten, fördern. Hier zählt die Beziehung ebenso wie die Pflege, denn Lebensqualität entsteht aus beidem. Ein Umfeld für Menschen, die gerne ganzheitlich arbeiten.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Bezugspflege in Hinwil verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Die Region Hinwil im Kanton Zürich verzeichnet eine anhaltend hohe Nachfrage nach qualifizierten Pflegefachfrauen und Pflegefachmännern mit Diplom HF/FH, insbesondere für Positionen in der Bezugspflege mit 80-100% Pensum. Aufgrund des Fachkräftemangels bieten sich Ihnen hervorragende Chancen, schnell eine attraktive Stelle zu finden und dabei von einem stabilen Arbeitsmarkt zu profitieren. Als spezialisierter Personalvermittler kennt iPersonal die lokalen Anforderungen und Arbeitgeber in der Region und unterstützt Sie durch gezielte Vermittlung sowie individuelle Beratung beim nahtlosen Berufseinstieg. So reduzieren Sie Ihre Suchzeit erheblich und finden rasch eine Position, die Ihren Vorstellungen entspricht.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Hinwil

- Kostenlose Weiterbildungen über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – somit bekommt Ihre Karriere Rückenwind
- Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag
- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden
- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein
- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen
- Diskretion ist Ehrensache – denn Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Bezugspflege in Hinwil

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
In der Regel melden wir uns bereits innerhalb von 24 Stunden bei Ihnen, denn Ihre Zeit ist wertvoll. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja – sobald wir sprechen, nennen wir Ihnen den Namen der Institution offen. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

The Product Analysts will move between these areas as business priorities require. This role is well suited to someone who enjoys structured problem-solving, analysing data and system behaviour, identifying quality issues, and working closely with product, engineering, data science, and operations stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities

Product Analysis and Quality Support

* Support the Merchant Information product team in analysing product performance, quality signals, customer feedback, and operational data.
* Query, structure, and analyse data to identify patterns, recurring issues, inconsistencies, and opportunities for product improvement.
* Create clear visualisations, reports, and summaries that help stakeholders understand performance, quality, progress, and priority areas.
* Support product discovery and delivery by clarifying requirements, documenting expected behaviour, and translating feedback into structured findings.
* Assist with testing, validation, and quality assurance activities, including validating product behaviour during releases, migrations, and changes to data-processing logic.
* Investigate discrepancies between expected and actual product outputs and work with relevant teams to define and track resolution actions.
* Maintain lightweight documentation of findings, quality assessments, test outcomes, decisions, and follow-up actions.

Data Labeling and AI Quality Validation

* Label and classify transaction and merchant data used to train and improve machine learning and AI models.
* Review and quality assure labeled datasets to ensure accuracy, consistency, completeness, and adherence to defined guidelines.
* Validate AI-generated labels and model outputs, identifying misclassifications, edge cases, data-quality issues, and improvement opportunities.
* Analyse model and classification performance using appropriate measures, including precision, recall, accuracy, F1 score, and confusion matrices.
* Support validation activities for machine learning models and AI-assisted workflows, including models hosted on platforms such as Google Vertex AI.
* Work with Data Scientists and Machine Learning Engineers to improve labeling guidelines, training-data quality, validation processes, and model performance.
* Contribute to the evolution of internal tools, quality frameworks, validation processes, and operating practices as labeling workflows become increasingly automated.


Required Skills and Experience

* 1–3 years of relevant experience in a product analyst, data analyst, data quality, QA, product operations, data labeling, or similar role in a technology-driven environment.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with exceptional attention to detail and consistency.
* Comfortable working with data using tools such as SQL, spreadsheets, dashboards, or similar analytical tooling.
* Experience working with large datasets, data-quality processes, testing, validation, or business-rule assessment.
* Ability to investigate issues end-to-end, identify patterns and root causes, and communicate findings clearly.
* Understanding of core machine-learning concepts and workflows, including the importance of high-quality training data and model validation.
* Familiarity with classification problems and/or data annotation, labeling, or taxonomy-based workflows.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and to manage changing priorities.


Preferred Skills and Experience

* Experience analysing transaction data, merchant data, categorisation systems, or other financial-data classification problems.
* Experience with data labeling, annotation, model validation, or AI-assisted labeling workflows.
* Familiarity with model-evaluation concepts and metrics, including precision, recall, F1 score, accuracy, and confusion matrices.
* Experience supporting AI, machine-learning, MLOps, or data-platform environments.
* Familiarity with Google Vertex AI or comparable machine-learning platforms.
* Experience using SQL to investigate data issues and support product or quality analysis.
* Experience with test planning, regression testing, migration validation, or release-quality activities.
* Experience turning customer feedback or operational issues into structured analysis and product recommendations.

What You Will Deliver

During the engagement, Product Analysts will help the team to:

* Improve the accuracy, consistency, and coverage of merchant and transaction categorisation data.
* Establish reliable quality checks for labeled data, AI-generated outputs, and product behaviour.
* Identify and document product, data, and model-quality issues with clear supporting evidence.
* Provide actionable analysis that helps product, engineering, and data-science teams prioritise improvements.
* Support confident releases and migrations through structured testing and validation.
* Strengthen documentation, reporting, and quality-management practices across Data Enrichment and machine learning models.

Personal Attributes

We are looking for people who are:

* Highly detail-oriented, methodical, and quality-focused.
* Curious about how data, products, and AI systems work.
* Comfortable switching between operational execution and analytical problem-solving.
* Proactive in identifying issues and following them through to resolution.
* Able to work independently while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.
* Comfortable operating in an evolving environment where priorities may shift between product analysis, testing, data validation, and labeling work.

Why This Engagement

This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of product quality, financial data, machine learning, and AI operations. You will contribute directly to improving the data and product experiences that power our data products while gaining practical exposure to modern data and AI validation workflows.
