We are looking for a Wind Technician who enjoys a dynamic and diverse role, while also taking pride in performing routine maintenance tasks! In this position, you’ll be responsible for servicing and maintaining wind turbines at our customers’ wind farms.

How you’ll make an impact
In this role, you will primarily perform maintenance and troubleshooting on wind turbines near Mariannelund, Sweden. You will be based at our hub in Mariannelund and travel to our two sites in the surrounding area. This position offers the opportunity to apply your knowledge of electricity, hydraulics, and mechanics. Together with your team, you will solve on-site issues to ensure high operational reliability and deliver excellent service to our customers.

Other responsibilities and duties

    A great part of the job is ensuring that on-site work is always carried out with safety as the highest priority. For electrical work, we work according to the Swedish electrical standard (SS-EN 50110-1).

    You will be supporting our customers both remotely and onsite and will perform service operations and resolve product issues. This includes carrying out improvement measures and modifications.

    You will play a key role in ensuring that the annual maintenance is completed on time, carried out efficiently, and documented in a structured and organized manner.

    You are responsible for reporting and documentation of your work.

    You will work together with Siemens Gamesa colleagues but also with subcontractors. Good collaboration is an important part of your daily work.

Our employee’s knowledge is important to us. Therefore, at the beginning of your employment, you will participate in various training programs designed to support and accelerate your development with us at Siemens Gamesa.



What you bring
Passion for renewable energy and a sense for the importance to lead the change, but also:

    High school education or equivalent experience with a technical and/or focus on electricity and/or mechincal is advantageous.

    Experience in wind power is an advantage.

    Fluent in English, written and oral. Swedish is advantageous.

    Very comfortable working on high heights.

    Good computer knowledge.

    Driving license B is a must, as you will be driving to our sites.



If you get offered the position, you will need an approved health check and a drug test before you start.

We are looking for someone with strong communication skills and a flexible attitude, who has a genuine interest in technology and enjoys learning new skills. You should thrive in a team-oriented environment, collaborating effectively with colleagues and contractors, while also being proactive and capable of driving tasks forward independently.

As you'll be working in a fast-paced setting with demanding responsibilities, the ability to adapt to evolving situations and challenges is essential. As a person you are responsible and have a high safety awareness.

Siemens Gamesa is part of Siemens Energy, a global leader in energy technology with a rich legacy of innovation spanning over 150 years. Together, we are committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. As a leading player in the wind industry and manufacturer of wind turbines, we are passionate about driving the energy transition and providing innovative solutions that meet the growing energy demand of the global community.

The preferred location for this position is Vaasa, Finland, but Turku and Helsinki, Finland are also possible locations. We offer thepossibility of hybrid work.





Your role and responsibilities



As a Mechanical Design Engineer,R&D, your work will include system and component design in NX, light FEM calculations, and design reviews with fuel injection suppliers manufacturing Wärtsilä designs. The role combines design work with collaboration across Testing & Validation, Calculation & Simulation, Service, and supplier networks.



On a typical day, you might start with design activities and finish by supporting testing and validation tasks. While the role requires a high level of independence, you will be supported by experienced experts and the Calculation & Simulation department.



You will work as part of the Fuel Systems team with diverse expertise. The tasks can also be adjusted based on your individual skills and interests.





Your work will focus on these responsibilities:



Create 3D models and detailed drawings


Perform light FEM calculations and support the Calculation & Simulation department


Participate in system and component design activities


Support fuel injection manufacturers during design implementation


Support Testing & Validation activities


Support Service with field experience-related matters


Participate in design reviews with suppliers






To be able to succeed in the position, we expect you to have:



A B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in Machine Construction or a similar field


A few years of experience in mechanical design or product development


Experience in or understanding of hydraulics


Experience with NX or similar CAD tools


Good problem-solving skills


A proactive and innovative mindset


Confidence to ask questions and share ideas


Willingness to learn and continuously develop your expertise


A collaborative approach and eagerness to share knowledge with team members


Readiness to travel approximately 10% of the time




In this role, some travel is required to meet with suppliers in Finland and Central Europe. Therefore, we hope you are ready to travel approximately 10% of the time, although most meetings are held virtually.





Contact & next steps



We hope to hear from you soon by submitting your application through our Careers portal. We aim to keep you updated on the process throughout.



For further questions, please reach out toKjell Eklund, Chief Expert, System Development, via email atkjell.eklund@wartsila.com or by phone at +358 40 572 2656,or Martin Rönnberg, Expert, Fuel Systems, via email atmartin.ronnberg@wartsila.com or by phone at +358 40 583 7518 (only for questions from direct job applicants; applications submitted via email will not be recorded or responded to).



Welcome to join us in shaping the decarbonization of marine and energy!

jobs.title: Field Service Specialist
jobs.description:
Are you ready for the next step in your career?

Join Valmet as a Field Service Specialist within our Tissue Field Services Team.

In this role, you will work directly at customer sites in EMEA and worldwide, performing maintenance, troubleshooting, audits, and start-up support on key sections of the tissue machine. Your expertise and customer-oriented approach will directly contribute to improved machine performance, reliability, and customer satisfaction.

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys field work, problem-solving, and operating in dynamic and international environments. You will work independently or together with other Valmet specialists, representing our service excellence on site.

Primary Location: Karlstad (Sweden). Additional locations inside EMEA may be considered.

Your responsibilities:

    Perform field service activities on one or more tissue machine sections: Headbox, forming section, pressing area (including ViscoNip™), and reel.
    Carry out inspections, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, equipment adjustments, and technical audits.
    Support installation projects, start‑ups, shutdowns, and optimization activities.
    Prepare accurate service reports, technical documentation, and improvement recommendations.
    Collaborate closely with customer technical teams, ensuring clear communication and excellent service delivery.
    Support other services or project activities when required (maintenance, upgrades, measurement tasks).
    Maintain high safety awareness and follow Valmet safety guidelines during all site activities.
    Represent Valmet professionally, contributing to long-term, trust‑based customer relationships.

Expectations for you:

    Minimum 5 years of hands‑on experience in Tissue Machine field with solid expertise in one of the following:

– Headbox and forming section

– Pressing area (including ViscoNip™)

– Reel section operations and maintenance

    Strong mechanical and/or process competence proven through field service activities.
    Ability to independently troubleshoot complex issues, even under time pressure.
    Strong communication skills and customer‑oriented approach, with the ability to work in multicultural environments.
    Flexibility and willingness to travel about 50% of the time (international and domestic).
    Good command of English; additional languages are a plus.
    Proficiency in basic reporting tools (e.g., Microsoft Office).
    Valid B driving licence.

To succeed in this role

You bring solid technical expertise, hands‑on mechanical/process knowledge, and the ability to operate effectively in demanding on‑site environments. A proactive mindset, strong customer focus, problem‑solving ability, and clear communication skills will distinguish you in this position.

We also expect you to align with Valmet’s Leadership Principles—practical behaviors that guide how we lead, collaborate, and succeed together:

- Take accountability – Act with ownership, set clear expectations, and follow through.

- Lead with courage – Champion change, try bold ideas, and learn quickly.

- Build on trust – Listen to understand, be open, and create psychological safety.

- Collaborate for growth – Work across boundaries, value diverse perspectives, and focus on customer value.

Want to know more?

Did we catch your interest? If you need any more information, contact Raffaele Malutta, Tissue Machines Field Services Senior Manager: raffaele.malutta@valmet.com. Please note that we do not accept applications via e-mail.

If you are interested in becoming part of the team, you can apply by November 6th, 2026, by filling in our online application form.

We perform background checks and alcohol/drug testing for all employees, in line with our commitment to a safe and secure workplace. 

When everything works together

Valmet is where the best talent from a wide variety of backgrounds comes together. We work together with our customers throughout the entire lifecycle, delivering cutting-edge technologies and services as well as mission-critical automation and flow control solutions. Backed by more than 225 years of industrial experience and a global team of over 18,500 professionals close to customers, we are uniquely positioned to transform industries toward a regenerative tomorrow.

At Valmet, diversity of thought drives innovation. We are committed to a respectful and inclusive environment, where people can be themselves and are supported to contribute at their best. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make hiring decisions based on skills, experience, and potential, never on personal characteristics such as gender, gender identity, age, ethnicity, nationality, disability, neurodiversity, religion, sexual orientation, or political views.

Join the team – and lead the way with us!

jobs.title: Enhetschef till enheten för relationsvåld
jobs.description:
Jönköpings kommun är en stor arbetsgivare med hundratals olika yrkesroller. Vi växer i takt med att kommunen utvecklas med fler invånare, fler bostäder och större utbud. Vi är alltid på jakt efter ny kompetens - medarbetare med olika bakgrunder och erfarenheter, med den gemensamma drivkraften att vilja skapa en bättre kommun att besöka, leva, verka och bo i.

Vill du leda en verksamhet som varje dag gör skillnad för människor i utsatta livssituationer? Nu söker vi en enhetschef till Enheten för relationsvåld med ansvar för öppenvårdsinsatser inom våld i nära relation, KAST och MIKA. Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av arbetsledning inom behandlings- och utförarverksamhet och som vill vara med och utveckla vår verksamhet. Enheten för relationsvåld (ERV) söker nu ytterligare en enhetschef.

Ditt nya jobb

På Enheten för relationsvåld är medborgaren i fokus och arbetet utgår från en helhetssyn med målsättning att individens egna förmågor och resurser ska tillvaratas och stärkas. Delaktighet, inflytande och självbestämmande är bärande principer. Ett viktigt uppdrag för enheten är att synliggöra våldets konsekvenser, både för vuxna och barn.

Som enhetschef inom individ- och familjeomsorgen praktiserar du ett hälsofrämjande chefs- och ledarskap baserat på tillit, kunskap och lärande. Du skapar genom ditt arbete förutsättningar för medarbetare att tillsammans med medborgare möta aktuella och nya behov, förväntningar och krav på vår välfärd i en ständigt föränderlig omvärld.

Uppdraget som enhetschef för utförardelen inom ERV innebär att du har ekonomi-, arbetsmiljö- och personalansvar. Utvecklings- och förbättringsarbete är en central del av ditt ledaruppdrag, liksom att skapa förutsättningar för lärande. Du har ett stort ansvar för att bidra till god samverkan med såväl interna som externa aktörer.

Din kompetens

Du har en avklarad och godkänd högskoleexamen om lägst 180 hp, exempelvis socionomprogrammet, beteendevetenskaplig utbildning, samhällsinriktad utbildning eller annan godkänd och avslutad utbildning med examen om lägst 180 hp som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig. Erfarenhet från grundprofessionen samt ERV:s områden är ett krav. Vidare har du erfarenhet av ledarskap, gärna inom själva utförardelen, där du haft personal-, budget- och arbetsmiljöansvar och du har god kunskap om Socialtjänstlagen. Erfarenhet av utvecklingsarbete inom området samt från arbete i politiskt styrd organisation är meriterande.

Som person är du stabil, självständig och förtroendeingivande. Vi värdesätter personlig mognad och en god samarbetsförmåga, då mycket av ditt arbete utförs tillsammans med andra. Vidare är du tydlig i din kommunikation, initiativrik, resultatinriktad samt har en god förmåga att organisera och prioritera ditt och enhetens arbete. Ditt ledarskap präglas av närvaro, lyhördhet, delaktighet och engagemang vilket är extra viktiga punkter då du i din roll delar ditt ledarskap med myndighetssidans enhetschef.

Körkort B är meriterande.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper!

Vi erbjuder dig

Hos oss får du ett meningsfullt arbete där du gör skillnad och har möjlighet att påverka och utveckla verksamheten samt att du får kompetensutveckling och stöd i din ledarroll. Du kan läsa mer om våras förmåner här

Välkommen till oss

Enheten för relationsvåld (ERV) finns på Sofiahuset, centralt i Jönköping och är organisatoriskt placerad inom individ- och familjeomsorgens område vuxen. Vi vänder oss till målgrupperna våldsutsatta, personer som utövar våld, personer som köper sexuella tjänster (KAST) och för dem som har erfarenhet av någon form av sexuell exploatering, såsom sex mot ersättning.

Enheten består av en mottagning, en utredningsenhet och en öppenvård. Vi är åtta socialsekreterare och fem behandlare. På enheten arbetar också en 1:e socialsekreterare som ansvarar för det dagliga arbetet för socialsekreterare och en samordnare som ansvarar för arbetet i öppenvården, en enhetschef och en administratör.

Bra att veta

Denna rekrytering avser en tillsvidaretjänst, heltid, med tillträde enligt överenskommelse. I ansökan vill vi att det finns personligt brev, CV, bifogat examensbevis samt tidigare tjänstgöringsintyg. All din tjänstgöring ska kunna styrkas och det behöver framgå i vilken omfattning du arbetat, vilken anställningsform som varit aktuell och vilken befattning du haft. Ansökningar som saknar detta kommer inte att prioriteras. Testverktyg kommer att användas.

Urval och kallelse till intervju sker 2026-11-02 och intervjudagar är em 2026-11-05 samt förmiddag 2026-11-06. I samband med arbetsgivarens intervju sker också fackliga intervjuer. Intervju nummer 2 sker em 2026-11-10. Söker du tjänsten och blir kallad till intervju behöver du vara tillgänglig dessa dagar.

Tjänsten tillsätts förutsatt att erforderliga beslut fattas.

Den här befattningen är arbetsvärderad och enhetschef återfinns i basgrupp J. För mer information om befattningens löneintervall se: Lön och lönestatistik open_in_new

Innan eventuell anställning ska du uppvisa ett godkänt utdrag från polisens registerutdrag för arbete till en ledande befattning.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Vill du veta mer?

Rekryterande chef: Jenny Stigmer, 036-10 66 61. Fackliga representanter: Fackliga Soc

Tillsammans gör vi Jönköpings kommun bättre – för alla. Kom och jobba med oss. Välkommen att söka tjänsten!

Jönköpings kommun strävar efter att erbjuda en attraktiv arbetsplats som är fri från diskriminering och ger lika möjligheter för alla.

Inför rekryteringsarbetet har vi tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi undanber oss därför vänligt men bestämt alla samtal om annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp.

Engage in clinical supervision sessions both one-to-one and group supervision on a regular basis with the Project Leader or team leader. Experience of dealing with child protection and welfare responsibilities and responding appropriately to any concerns. Experience in carrying out assessments, including risk assessments. jobs.title: Specialistläkare Allmänmedicin, Ålidhems Hälsocentral, Umeå
jobs.description:
Region Västerbotten arbetar för att god hälsa och hållbar utveckling ska stärka varandra. Vi tar ansvar för en jämlik välfärd och för att forskning och innovation ger resultat.

Region Västerbotten bedriver bred primärvårdsverksamhet inom hela Västerbottens län och möter patienter i alla åldrar, både i tätort och glesbygd. Med 33 hälsocentraler och sjukstugor finns vi där du finns. Vi arbetar aktivt med forskning och utveckling och tar tillvara medicinska resultat för att erbjuda vård med hög kvalitet där patienten är delaktig. Vi vill att våra medarbetare ska vara delaktiga, ha inflytande och känna stolthet över att arbeta i primärvården. Viktiga utvecklingsområden för oss är behovsanpassat vårdutbud och utveckla digitala tjänster. Vi ser ett stort värde i samarbete med andra aktörer i samhället.

Primärvårdsområde Öst i Umeå är en basenhet bestående av Ålidhems och Holmsund/Obbolas hälsocentraler. Ålidhems hälsocentral är belägen på Tvistevägen nära Ålidhems centrum, Umeå universitet samt Iksu sportanläggning. Hälsocentralen har ca 22 700 listade invånare i ett varierat upptagningsområde med generellt ung befolkning. Här arbetar ca 97 medarbetare på hälsocentralen som även innefattar familjecentralen vid Ålidhems centrum och paramedicinsk mottagning på Tvistevägen 48 i Tietohusen.

Nu söker vi två nya kollegor till vårt läkarteam på Ålidhems hälsocentral. Vi är en stor läkargrupp som besitter en hög och varierande kompetens inom området allmänmedicin. Hos oss finns styrkan och fördelarna i att vara en stor hälsocentral samtidigt som vi har en nära och prestigelös relation mellan oss som jobbar på hälsocentralen. Samarbete och aktiv dialog kring förbättringsområden är något vi värderar högt. Vi erbjuder en varierande och utvecklande arbetsplats med tydligt patientfokus.

Vi jobbar nu med att ta fram ett nytt arbetssätt som möjliggör utveckling av verksamheten, stärker samarbetet med andra yrkeskategorier samt skapar en mer strukturerad och effektiv arbetsvardag. Genom att arbeta på nya sätt kan vi ta tillvara på våra gemensamma kompetenser, tydliggöra ansvar och roller samt skapa bättre förutsättningar för kommunikation och samverkan.

2 plats(er).

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Som specialistläkare hos oss bidrar du med kunskap och engagemang som får människor att känna sig trygga.

Arbetet karaktäriseras av möten med människor i alla åldrar, med alla olika sorters hälsorelaterade problem. I det allmänmedicinska specialistarbetet kommer du att följa en individs olika hälsoproblem över tid och i bedömningen väga in personens hela livssituation. Som specialist förväntas du stötta läkare som är under utbildning i deras löpande arbete samt handleda vid avsatt handledningstid. Du förväntas även vara en aktiv del i läkargruppens och hälsocentralens möten, dialoger och förbättringsarbeten.

Utifrån intresse och verksamhetens behov finns möjlighet att rikta delar av uppdraget mot äldrevård, exempelvis genom arbete med särskilda boenden, korttidsboenden och hemsjukvård.

Jourtjänstgöring på primärvårdsakuten och primärvårdsbakjour ingår i arbetet.

KVALIFIKATIONER
För detta jobb behöver du vara specialistläkare inom allmänmedicin, alternativt i slutskedet på din ST-tjänstgöring inom allmänmedicin. Intresse för handledning av studenter och utbildningsläkare är viktigt.

Du är en närvarande och positiv person som med kunskap och omsorg ser patienten och kan anpassa vården efter det behov som finns. Du tycker om att samarbeta och att finnas där för andra människor, både patienter och kollegor. Du fungerar väl i de arbetssätt som krävs inom primärvården och får din arbetsdag att fungera utifrån det åtagande som förväntas av en specialistläkare. Du ser möjligheter och kan hantera din arbetsdag även de gånger som patienttrycket är högt genom att du självständigt kan ta beslut i de frågor du ställs inför.

Vi kräver goda kunskaper i svenska språket.

Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.
Varaktighet: Tillsvidare, tillträde: Tillträde enligt överenskommelse.

Läs mer om våra förmåner för dig som jobbar med oss på webbsidan https://www.regionvasterbotten.se/nar-du-jobbar-hos-oss/formaner

Vi strävar efter en jämn könsfördelning och ser mångfald som en styrka och välkomnar därför sökande med olika bakgrund.

Inför rekryteringsarbetet har vi tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi undanbeder oss därför bestämt kontakt med mediesäljare, rekryteringssajter och liknande.

Om du har skyddad identitet och vill ansöka så kontaktar du rekryterande chef och skickar sedan in dina ansökningshandlingar via post.

jobs.title: Compliance Officer - AML & Sanctions to TFS Group Compliance Function
jobs.description:
Compliance Officer – AML & Sanctions to TFS Group Compliance Function



Role Summary

We are looking for a senior Compliance Officer – AML and Sanctions to join our Compliance Function at TFS Head Office. The role is part of the broader Anti-Financial Crime Compliance function, with a special focus on Anti-Money Laundering, Counter-Terrorist Financing and Sanctions.

The position reports to the Chief Compliance Officer and is functionally led the AFC Compliance Officer. Within this framework, you will have a high degree of autonomy and responsibility for providing regulatory expertise, risk assessment, compliance monitoring, advisory work and stakeholder management, with the opportunity to influence and strengthen how AML and Sanctions requirements are implemented across the organization.

You will work across a complex international environment, supporting not only TFS and its entities in multiple jurisdictions, but also offer the same AML support to our sister company Scania Group and its head office compliance function. We work in a collaborative environment also with other brands of the TRATON Group including MAN, International Motors and Volkswagen Truck & Bus.

The position is based in Stockholm/ Södertälje, with access to offices in both locations, with international exposure and some travel expected.  



Job Responsibilities

AML and Sanctions Adisory and Oversight  

Provide independent second-line advice and oversight on AML, CTF and Sanctions risks and regulatory requirements across the organization in TFS and Scania on AML. Assess the adequacy and effectiveness of relevant policies, processes and internal controls and provide expert compliance advice to business and senior stakeholders on complex AML and Sanctions matters.

Risk Assessments and Incident Oversight – Conduct and contribute to AML and Sanctions risk assessments, compliance monitoring and thematic reviews across regions and entities. Assess emerging financial-crime risks and control effectiveness, and provide recommendations and appropriate escalation of maternal issues, incidents and remediation activities.

Regulatory Framework Development - Contribute to the maintenance and continuous development of the AML and Sanctions compliance framework, including policies, standard, procedures and guidance. Provide specialist regulatory interpretation and translate regulatory developments into practical compliance requirements and recommendations. Support the effective implementation of AML and Sanctions requirements across relevant parts of the organisation.

Reporting & Advisory – Provide analysis and reporting on AML and Sanctions compliance, key risks, emerging issues and regulatory developments to relevant forums. Deliver forward-looking advice and recommendations to support informed decision-making and effective compliance oversight.

Stakeholder Engagement, Training & Collaboration - Build strong working relationships across Compliance, Risk, Legal and the business, including regional and entity level teams. Provide specialist guidance and support to colleagues on AML and Sanctions matters. Contribute to the development and delivery of AML and Sanctions training and awareness initiatives, and collaborate with stakeholders across TFS, Scania and the wider TRATON Group on relevant compliance activities and Group-wide initiatives.



Who You Are

You hold a Master’s degree and bring 7-10+ years of relevant experience from regulated environments, preferably within financial services, banking, insurance or similarly complex international structures.

You have deep expertise in:

    Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing
    Sanctions compliance and sanctions risk management
    AML and sanctions risk assessment
    Compliance monitoring and second line oversight
    Financial crime risks, typologies and emerging threats
    Regulatory interpretation and implementation
    Compliance frameworks, policies, and controls
    Working across complex international organizations

You have solid experience in AML regulated environments such as financial and banking services, captive finance or an internationally regulated financial institutions.

You are familiar with EU and Swedish AML and Sanctions requirements and have an understanding of international regulatory frameworks, including relevant UK and US requirements.

This Is Us

You will join a highly experienced and international GRC and Compliance Team at a time of continued development and increasing regulatory complexity. Our organization operates globally, supporting sustainable transportation through responsible financial services and you will have the ability to support and work with other colleagues in the compliance functions at both TFS and Scania as well as the respective global networks and business stakeholders.

The home office is based in Södertälje, with access to a group-wide hub in central Stockholm. We offer flexible working arrangements adapted to business needs and role requirements, including international collaboration and some travel.

TRATON Financial Services Offers

We believe great work starts with feeling supported, both professionally and personally. That’s why we offer a broad range of employee benefits designed to promote wellbeing, flexibility, and a healthy work-life balance. Employees can enjoy flexible working hours and a workplace that supports both collaboration and flexibility. With office Hubs in Södertälje and Stockholm, you will have the best preconditions to pick the best workplace for your activities.

We provide a yearly wellness contribution and you can train at our health center Gröndal in Södertälje, and you will access to occupational health services with doctors, nurses, and ergonomists. Mental health is important to us, therefore we also offer confidential staff support services for guidance related to personal challenges.

More info provided on the website - please follow the link provided.

Application

Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-10-25. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check is required for this role.

We look forward to your application!

jobs.title: Cleaner – Winter Season in Lapland Rovaniemi
jobs.description:
We are looking for a **reliable and active part-time cleaner** to join our team for the winter season in Rovaniemi. The job starts at the **beginning of November 2026 and continues until the end of March 2027**.

The work is varied and you will work in different locations around Rovaniemi. Our customers include **local businesses, Airbnb apartments and other holiday accommodation**. Sometimes you may also help at our laundry.

Working days can be **any day from Monday to Sunday, including weekends**. Working hours can change depending on the day, but most shifts are between **8:00 and 18:00**.

We are looking for someone who enjoys active and varied work. You should be able to work independently, take responsibility for your work and notice what needs to be done.

Your tasks include

- cleaning Airbnb apartments and other accommodation

- cleaning local businesses and other work spaces

- helping at our laundry when needed


The locations and tasks can be different every day. The most important thing is to make sure that every place is **clean, tidy and ready for the next guest or customer**.

What we expect from you

- a positive and active attitude

- careful and good-quality work

- ability to work independently

- ability to work on weekdays and weekends


A driving licence and the ability to drive a manual car are **required for this job**, because you will drive between different locations during the working day.

**Previous cleaning experience is a plus**, especially if you have worked with Airbnb apartments, hotels or business cleaning before. However, experience is not everything. A good attitude, willingness to learn and taking responsibility for your work are very important to us.

**English skills are a plus.**

Most of the time you will work independently, but sometimes you will also work together with other team members.

What we offer

- a job for the full winter season, from **November 2026 until the end of March 2027**

- different tasks and working days

- training before you start working independently

- a friendly and supportive team

jobs.title: Unit Head - Incident & Support VSI
jobs.description:
Unit Head – Incident & Support VSI

TRATON is a group of strong brands with a shared mission: transforming transportation together to create the future of sustainable transport solutions. Within TRATON, we include MAN, Scania, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International. As part of a global team of industry experts, you get to think bigger, experience more, and reach further. Together, we have the power to transform transportation – Let’s make a difference together. Find out more: www.traton.com





Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do.



Role Summary

This role is a part of TRATON Group R&D, located in Södertälje, Sweden

We are now looking for a Unit Head to lead our global Workshop Suite (tWS) Incident and Support organization. This team plays a critical role in enabling workshops across TRATON’s brands and serves as a key interface between R&D, IT, and workshop operations worldwide.

This role offers a unique opportunity to shape and lead a new global support capability for Workshop Suite (tWS) while building a strong network across the organization. You will play a key role in ensuring the success of one of TRATON’s most important digital transformation initiatives.



Job Responsibilities

    Lead, coach, and develop a growing team of Incident Managers and technical specialists within infrastructure support and advanced troubleshooting

·        Own and continuously improve the global support delivery for the Workshop Suite

·        Ensure stable and reliable operation of tWS while minimizing disruption to workshop operations worldwide

·        Establish a proactive and data-driven culture based on monitoring, trend analysis, and preventive actions

·        Drive efficient incident and problem management, including prevention of recurring issues

·        Ensure that learnings from incidents and customer feedback are translated into improvements of systems, services, and support processes

·        Build strong collaboration across development teams, IT organizations, suppliers, and markets



Who You Are

We believe you are a driven and collaborative leader who combines technical understanding with a passion for developing people, creating customer value, and driving change.

You have:

    Proven leadership experience and a passion for coaching and developing teams
    Experience from technical support, service delivery, IT operations, software development, or similar environments
    Experience leading cross-functional collaboration in complex organizations
    A university degree in Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent
    Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds – your unique experience and perspectives is valuable to us.



This Is Us

The Vehicle Service Information domain provides tools, information, and IT support to TRATON’s global service network. This includes everything needed to perform repairs, maintenance, diagnostics, software updates, campaigns, and spare parts sales.

The Incident & Support team consists of Incident Managers and technical specialists within infrastructure support and advanced troubleshooting. The team is responsible for ensuring stable and reliable operation of the Workshop Suite (tWS) and minimizing disruption to workshop operations worldwide.

Working closely with development teams, IT organizations, suppliers, and markets, we drive incident management, technical troubleshooting, infrastructure support, and continuous improvement. Through a proactive, data-driven approach, we focus on rapid service restoration, preventing recurring issues, and continuously improving the workshop user experience.

As a Unit Head, you will be part of a committed and collaborative management team. We value trust, open communication, and shared responsibility. Together, we continuously develop our section and support each other’s teams to succeed.

Within TRATON Group R&D, you are an important part of something bigger. Joining us means gaining access to the ins and outs of the entire transportation industry.



TRATON Offers

We offer a dynamic, flexible workplace with hybrid work options, including Scania Sergel and Midway hubs. With a structured development plan and courses, TRATON Group R&D supports your career growth both locally and internationally.

Benefits include wellness allowance, bonus, flexible hours, and company car leasing. We also host events for employees and their families, and Stockholm residents enjoy direct access to Södertälje via Scania Job express buses for an easy commute.



Application

We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.



Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-11-01. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role.



If you have questions or would like more information, please contact:

Björn Bertmar, Section Manager, bjorn.bertmar@scania.com



We look forward to your application!



This recruitment process is handled by Scania for TRATON Group R&D

jobs.title: Production Area Manager (TO & HEX Area Manager)
jobs.description:
BAT is evolving at pace into a global multi-category business. With products like VELO, VUSE and GLO we are on a mission to decrease the health impact of our industry  

To achieve our ambition, we are looking for colleagues who are ready to Be The Change. Come, join us on this journey!

British American Tobacco Sweden has an exciting opportunity for a MO Area Manager/TO+LVIV Area Manager in Malmö

The Area Manager ensures a safe, compliant, and high performing operation by embedding BAT's Health, Safety, and Environmental standards into all daily work and maintaining full adherence to the Global Operating Model and Swedish regulations. This role provides strong operational leadership through IWS, RTT, and Daily Management Systems to ensure stable production, equipment reliability, and consistent product quality. The manager drives loss elimination, supports NPI activities, and ensures effective Daily Direction Setting (DDS) along with his own qualification in different roles. The Area Manager is accountable for ensuring the team has the right capabilities and resources in place. The role's responsibilities include recruitment, setting salaries, signing employment agreements, and leading all rehabilitation processes for personnel.

Work model: On-site (factory/manufacturing environment)

Your key responsibilities will include:

    Champion BAT’s Health, Safety, and Environmental culture by embedding it into procedures and work instructions. Ensure compliance within the team and maintain a safe, risk-conscious working environment to minimize or eliminate exposure to hazards.
    Ensure full compliance with BAT’s Global Operating Model and Swedish labor laws and regulations.
    Guide teams to achieve the Compelling Business Need and Site Master Plan through meticulous application of RTT and Integrated Work System (IWS) tools.
    Full accountability to lead and set the 24-hour direction for the line(s) during the Daily Direction Setting to deliver the business results and ensure the follow-up actions are completed.
    Ensure that the quality trigger daily management system and standards are in place and used to guarantee the product quality, integrity, and full traceability, define targets and monitor the result of quality indicators as well as lead the follow-up actions to deliver high-quality product.
    Owner of Daily Management System within IWS: Incident Elimination, Quality Trigger, Clean Inspect and Lubricated and Defect Handling.
    Build and Develop High-Performing Teams, ensure appropriate skills and proficiencies.
    Responsible for all employee lifecycle activities and processes in compliance with BAT standards and people administration in HR Information Systems.

What are we looking for?

    University degree + experience from leading Production and People in Manufacturing industry.
    Deep knowledge within IWS or similar tools and subject areas. As well as familiarity with structured problem tools, such as, IPS, UPS and 6W2H
    Documented proven ability to navigate complex environments and demonstrated leadership in the area of safety and quality and continuous improvement.
    Fluent in spoken and written Swedish as well as English
    Clear understanding of budget process, resource management, CapEx management.
    Effective coaching and interpersonal skills
    Analytical capabilities, to analyze data, identify gaps and use insights for problem solving.
    Important Leadership Capabilities in this role: ability to empower & inspire teams and lead people (directly and indirectly) to achieve a common goal and to act as representative of the company, making decisions, managing conflicts and running tough conversations.

What we offer you?

    We offer a market leading annual performance bonus (subject to eligibility)
    Our range of benefits varies by country and includes diverse health plans, initiatives for work-life balance, transportation support, and a flexible holiday plan with additional incentives
    Your journey with us isn't limited by boundaries; it's propelled by your aspirations. Join us at BAT and become a part of an environment that thrives on internal advancement, where your career progression isn't just a statement – it's a reality we're eager to build together. Seize the opportunity and own your development; your next chapter starts here.
    You'll have access to online learning platforms and personalized growth programs to nurture your leadership skills
    We priorities continuous improvement within a transformative environment, preparing for ongoing changes

WHY JOIN BAT?

We’re one of the few companies named as a Global Top Employer by the Top Employers Institute – certified in offering excellent employee conditions.

At BAT, we champion collaboration, inclusion, and partnership as the bedrock of our values. We wish to foster an environment where every individual can thrive, irrespective of factors such as gender, sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, skills, experience, education, socio-economic and professional background, as well as diverse perspectives and thinking styles. We recognise that our strength lies in embracing talent from all walks of life, empowering us to develop our culture of inclusivity and better achieve our business objectives.

We view career breaks not as obstacles but as opportunities and encourage everyone, without hesitation, to apply. Through our Global Returners program, we provide support to professionals seeking to re-enter the workforce after an extended absence, be it for family care, parental leave, national service, sabbatical, or starting their own venture.

Come bring your difference and see what is possible for you at BAT. Learn more about our culture and our award winning employee experience here.

We take pride in being a Disability Confident Employer. If you need any reasonable adjustments or accommodations to be made during the recruitment process to support you performing at your best, please inform the recruitment partner who will be in touch should your profile be selected for the role you applied for. We are wholeheartedly committed to optimising your prospects of success by making suitable arrangements so that you may showcase your full potential.

jobs.title: Senior Production Engineer
jobs.description:
The opportunity

At Hitachi Energy our purpose is advancing a sustainable energy future for all. We bring power to our homes, schools, hospitals and factories. Join us and work with fantastic people, while learning and developing yourself on projects that have a real impact on our communities and society.

We are in a steep expansion, and you will be part of Hitachi Energy Cooling Systems business unit in Landskrona. We have a global responsibility for the development and manufacture of cooling systems for Power Electronic applications and other applications that require water cooling systems with high reliability and availability.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute to the green transition and create a more sustainable energy future for all. So, if you want to take the next step in your career, and contribute to develop a stronger, smarter, and greener energy system – Join us now, we are ready for you!

Your responsibilities

    Drive continues improvement projects and other projects, e.g. expansion of production capacity or taking our performance culture to the next level
    Analyzing and improving material flow and work methods
    Collaborate with our quality function e.g. root cause analysis
    Digg into deviation data, propose and enforce improvements not only in production but also errors and defi-ciencies originating from other departments such as e.g. market, construction or purchasing
    Support with "LEAN thinking" throughout the organization.
    Be involved in preparing new products and revision in the factory
    Participate in business development work
    Assist in the procurement of machinery and equipment
    When needed, prepare different work instructions

Your background

    You hold an engineering degree or similar, combined with extensive experience in production
    You hold great knowledge and knowhow regarding Lean Six Sigma
    Experience of production/performance systems inspired by TPS (Toyota Production System) is considered an advantage
    As a person, you are driven, analytic, goal-oriented, responsive and can collaborate with different profes-sional groups
    You are humble in your contact with individuals both inside and outside the company
    You can drive, implement and communicate solutions to problems that arise in our processes
    You have a good command of the Swedish and English languages and can easily express yourself in both speech and writing

More about us 

We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our ben-efits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By priori-tizing well-being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.   

Our benefits offering for our roles generally include:    

    Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2)
    Group life insurance and additional insurances.
    Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank
    Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager)
    Health care and wellness allowance
    Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction)
    Psychological support program
    Supplementary compensation for parental leave
    Various trainings and education supporting employee development
    Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally
    Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks

The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and type of contract. Eligibility is subject to local regulations.   

 Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application today.   

Questions can be directed to Talent Acquisition Partner Elina Mannelqvist, elina.mannelqvist@hitachienergy.com

jobs.title: Chef – Banqueting - Sheraton Stockholm Hotel
jobs.description:
Step into a role that redefines excellence at the Sheraton Stockholm Hotel, a hallmark of hospitality since 1971 in the heart of Sweden's bustling capital. Aligned with our innovative owners Archer Hotel Management and Marriott International, we merge rich cultural history with modern luxury and a deep dedication to sustainability.

The hotel has recently completed a full renovation, and we are now looking for a few new team members to join our Banqueting Kitchen as Chefs, working within our newly renovated Conference and Event floor.


We believe in nurturing talent and providing opportunities for professional development and offer a workplace where you can learn, grow, and thrive.


Main Responsibilities:

    Prepare and serve food for banquets, events and buffets.
    Take full responsibility for your section, including quality, preparation and presentation.
    Support ordering, stock control and stock rotation when required.
    Ensure food safety, hygiene and cleanliness standards are maintained.
    Work closely with the kitchen and Banqueting team to ensure smooth and efficient service.


Main Requirements:

    Culinary education and/or relevant on-the-job training.
    At least 3 years of culinary experience, preferably within banqueting or high-volume production.
    Strong attention to detail, quality, speed and accuracy.
    Good teamwork, communication and problem-solving skills.
    Knowledge of recipes, production methods and presentation standards.
    Flexibility according to operational needs.


What We Offer:

    Full-time or part-time employment following a 6-month probationary period, as well as hourly employment.
    Great opportunities for career growth.
    A dynamic and inclusive work environment.
    Employee discounted rates at over 8,000 hotels worldwide.


If you have a passion for hospitality and a focus on delivering outstanding guest experiences, we want to hear from you!

Selection and interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the final application deadline, so please submit your application as soon as possible.

Join our team and play a key role in creating memorable experiences for our guests!


The Sheraton brand, established in 1937, has been synonymous with excellence in hospitality. The Sheraton Stockholm Hotel, opened in 1971 as the first international 5 star hotel in Stockholm, and it’s an icon in Sweden’s capital city. As part of Marriott International, Sheraton Stockholm Hotel is providing guests with thoughtful amenities, contemporary accommodation, and the best city center location. Our commitment to sustainability aligns with our owner Archer Hotel Managements ethos, making us a unique choice for conscientious travelers.

Redefining the Essence of Hospitality
We are in the end of a  renovation journey at Sheraton Stockholm.  This marks the beginning of our mission to redefine the essence of hospitality. We have transformed all our spaces, hotel rooms, implemented new food and beverage concepts and expanded our gym and wellness. As we embark on this transformation, we are seeking the best industry people to join our team.

jobs.description:
Har du fagbrev og erfaring fra tungbil, men mangler kursingen for å bli teknisk leder? Da kan dette være muligheten du har ventet på.

Vi søker en dyktig og engasjert mekaniker/tekniker som ønsker å ta neste steg i karrieren. Hos oss får du en variert og praktisk arbeidshverdag med lastebiler, traller og annet tungt materiell – samtidig som du får muligheten til å utvikle deg mot rollen som teknisk leder.

Du trenger ikke å ha all kursingen på plass i dag. Har du fagbrevet, relevant erfaring og motivasjonen, legger vi til rette for nødvendig kurs og opplæring gjennom jobben.

Dette er først og fremst en praktisk fagstilling. Du vil jobbe ute i verkstedet med service, vedlikehold, reparasjoner, feilsøking og kontroll. I tillegg vil du fungere som stedfortreder for teknisk leder ved behov.

Dine arbeidsoppgave
Du vil blant annet jobbe med:

✔️ EU-kontroll av lastebiler, Traller og henger
✔️ Service, vedlikehold og reparasjon av lastebiler og tilhengere
✔️ Feilsøking og diagnose på moderne tungbil
✔️ Mekaniske, hydrauliske og elektriske reparasjoner
✔️ Kontroll og utbedring av feil og mangler
✔️ Dokumentasjon av utført arbeid
✔️ Teknisk problemløsning og støtte til kollegaer
✔️ Bidra til effektiv og god flyt i verkstedet
✔️ Være stedfortreder for teknisk leder ved behov
✔️ Bidra til et godt og sikkert arbeidsmiljø
✔️ Noe vaktarbeid må påregnes

Arbeidsoppgavene vil variere, og du får gode muligheter til å utvikle kompetansen din innen moderne tungbilteknologi og tradisjonelt mekanisk arbeid.

Hva du bringer til teamet

✔️ Har fagbrev som mekaniker, gjerne innen tunge kjøretøy
✔️ Har relevant erfaring fra lastebil, traller eller annet tungt kjøretøy
✔️ Har god mekanisk forståelse og interesse for faget
✔️ Er løsningsorientert og liker tekniske utfordringer
✔️ Arbeider selvstendig, strukturert og nøyaktig
✔️ Trives med å samarbeide og hjelpe kollegaer
✔️ Tar ansvar og ser hva som må gjøres
✔️ Behersker norsk muntlig og skriftlig

Har førerkort klasse C/CE – en fordel har du ikke det -legger vi til rette for nødvendig kurs og opplæring gjennom jobben.

Hvorfor TIP?

Fordi kultur ikke bare er en plakat på veggen – det er noe du skal føle hver dag. Vi er flinke i det vi gjør, og vi setter mennesker først. Vi investerer i din utvikling, verdsetter stemmen din og bryr oss virkelig om teamet vårt.

Høres dette interessant ut? Ta kontakt for en uforpliktende prat med Workshop Manager Nicolae Ceban på telefon 41886890 eller mail nicolae.ceban@tip-group.com

Fordeler inkluderer:

✅ Fast og trygg arbeidsplass i en solid virksomhet og en variert og praktisk arbeidshverdag
✅ Et arbeidsmiljø preget av samarbeid, kvalitet og godt humør
✅ Arbeidstid normalt 07:00–15:00, med noe vaktarbeid
✅ Pensjon- og forsikringsordninger
✅ Helse forsikring
✅ Globalt medarbeiderstøtteprogram
✅ Ansiennitetsbonus
✅ Fruktordning

👉 Se hvorfor folk elsker å jobbe i TIP, og utforsk våre fordeler – les mer her!

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow in tumor cell biology
jobs.description:
About the position

A 100% 3-year Postdoctoral Research Fellow position in tumor cell biology is available in the research group of Prof. Philippe Collas, project group of Dr. Marie Rogne, at the Department of Molecular Medicine, Division of Biochemistry, Institute of Basic Medical Sciences, University of Oslo (Collas Lab). The position is funded through the Norwegian Cancer Society.

Within the Institute, the Division of Biochemistry consists of a young and active community of nine research groups working on cancer biology, chromatin and nuclear dynamics, nuclear architecture, membrane trafficking, and adipocyte, muscle and vascular biology, using human, fly and mouse models. 


More about the position

The overall goal of the project is to establish knowledge of the innovative therapeutic potential of microproteins in advanced prostate cancer. In this context, the successful applicant will, in collaboration with the research team and external partners at Oslo University Hospital, examine how specific microproteins regulate the activity of the transcription factor RUNX2, using cancer cell lines and PDX mouse tumor models, for various cell-based assays. The work involves in vivo setups and is expected to necessitate optimizations. 

A postdoctoral position is intended for the employee to develop a research profile and competence that qualifies them to apply for an Associate Professor position. The position may also provide other competencies relevant to the postdoctoral fellow's future career.

A career plan shall be developed for the Postdoctoral Fellow, specifying the competencies the Postdoctoral Fellow should acquire. UiO is responsible for following up on the career plan and ensuring that the Postdoctoral Fellow has access to career guidance throughout the postdoctoral term.


Responsibilities
  • Design and execute PDX prostate cancer studies evaluating the effect of microprotein modulation and peptide therapy, using cell biological approaches.
  • Design and perform cellular assays to test microprotein function and transcription factor modulation.
  • Maintain accurate electronic lab records and contribute to data analysis and interpretation.
  • Present results at group meetings and scientific platforms and prepare manuscripts for publication.

Qualifications

Qualification requirements

  • Applicants must hold a doctoral degree – PhD or equivalent. 
  • If a doctoral degree is not yet awarded, the doctoral dissertation must be submitted for evaluation by the closing application date. Hiring will however be contingent on obtention of a doctoral degree. 
  • Solid knowledge of, and experience in, (cancer) cell biology.  
  • Experience in tumor biology.
  • Experience with cell culture and/or patient-derived xenograft (PDX) tumor models.
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English. 

Relevant Qualifications

  • Experience with molecular biology and/or epigenetics is positive. 
  • Authorization to work with laboratory animals (rodents) (e.g. LAS301, FELASA C) is a strong advantage. If you do not have such authorization, you will be required to acquire it in the first part of your employment. 
  • Experience with electronic lab-journal systems (e.g. Benchling or E-lab) is valued.

Personal skills
  • You are independent but enjoy working as part of a team towards shared, ambitious goals.
  • You are positive, structured, solution-driven and accurate, with grit and determination.
  • You have a result-oriented mindset and contribute scientific and practical inputs.
  • Communication with other team members is important: you will therefore have excellent communication and collaborative skills. 

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.


We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


We offer
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • A professionally stimulating working environment and access to top-notch equipment and resources.
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities. 
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Postdoctoral Fellow, position code 1352 in salary range NOK from 610 000 to 650 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.
  • Oslo’s family-friendly environment with rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities. 

Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.


Application

Your application should include:

  • Cover letter statement of your research interests and motivation for the position
  • CV summarizing education, positions, and academic work 
  • Copies of educational certificates (academic transcripts only)
  • Copy of relevant certification(s) for laboratory animal work, if this applies
  • List of publications and academic works; do not include the publications themselves or your dissertation. 
  • List of 3 reference persons (name, relation to you, e-mail, phone number) 

Your CV must be entered in Jobbnorge’s CV form and cannot be submitted only as an attachment. This requirement is intended to ensure correct documentation and record-keeping in accordance with the Public Administration Act, Section 15.

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

Please note that we are unable to add documentation after the application deadline. As the deadline applies equally to all applicants, this policy ensures equal treatment throughout the recruitment process. If you experience difficulties uploading documents in Jobbnorge, please contact their customer service: Phone: +47 75 54 22 20 or Email: support@grade.com 

The primary method of communication throughout the process will be e-mails and messages through the recruitment system Jobbnorge. When you receive a notification of a message in Jobbnorge, please log in to read it, as it may be important.

The best qualified candidates will be invited for interviews. 

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian) and Guidelines concerning appointment to recruitment positions at UiO. 

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees to secure the rights to all research results and related intellectual property.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Institute of Basic Medical Sciences overall objective is to promote basic medical knowledge in order to understand normal processes, provide insight into mechanisms that cause illness, and promote good health. The Institute is responsible for teaching in basic medical sciences for the programmes of professional study in medicine and the Master's programme in clinical nutrition. The Institute has more than 300 employees and is located in Domus Medica.

Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time.

Are you a registered nurse from Finland interested in taking the next step in your career in Sweden?

We are currently recruiting Finnish nurses for positions in northern Sweden. This is an opportunity to work in a modern healthcare system where quality of care, teamwork, and professional development are a priority.

You will become part of a supportive environment with experienced colleagues and a strong focus on patient-centered care.

About the role

As a general nurse, you will play an important role in delivering high-quality, patient-centered care in different healthcare settings, including:

    Hospitals, where you will be part of experienced teams working with both acute and planned care
    Health centres and outpatient clinics, focusing on continuity of care and long-term patient relationships

Your responsibilities will include administering treatments, supporting patients throughout their recovery, and contributing to individual care planning.

You will work closely with multidisciplinary teams, helping to ensure safe and effective care while contributing to continuous improvement of patient outcomes.

Requirements

    Valid nursing license from Finland (Registered nurse)
    Experience in hospital care
    Good English language skills
    Motivation to learn Swedish

Meritorious

Why northern Sweden?

This opportunity is based in a peaceful region in northern Sweden, surrounded by nature, forests, and open landscapes, ideal for those seeking a calm and balanced lifestyle. The area offers excellent public services, short commuting times, and a strong sense of community.

You will have access to outdoor activities year-round, including hiking, skiing, and other nature-based experiences. The high quality of life makes it an excellent place to live and work long-term.

    Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during, and after your employment

Curious about life in the North?

Let’s talk. We’re happy to tell you more about the region, the roles, and how we support you every step of the way.

We look forward to hearing from you.

Etsimme Power Engineering -tiimiimme verkkoinsinööriä, joka osallistuu uusiutuvan energian sähköverkkoprojektien suunnitteluun ja analysointiin eri puolilla Suomea sekä kansainvälisesti.

Power Engineering -tiimin tehtävä on auttaa asiakkaitamme heidän projekteissaan tuottamalla heille arvokasta informaatio sähköteknisen laskennan, analyysien ja suunnittelun avulla heidän hankkeissaan.

Tässä tehtävässä roolisi mukautuu osaamisesi ja kiinnostuksesi mukaan – voit keskittyä esimerkiksi verkostolaskentaan, tekniseen suunnitteluun tai asiantuntijatukeen projekteissa. Olemme edelläkävijöitä uusiutuvan energian suunnittelussa ja meillä voit rakentaa juuri sinulle sopivan asiantuntijaroolin, jossa voit hyödyntää ja kehittää osaamistasi. Desprolla työnteko ei ole sidoksissa paikkaan, vaan työtä voi tehdä joustavasti etänä tai toimistoiltamme useilla eri paikkakunnilta.



Tehtäväkenttäsi voi painottua eri tavoin – tässä esimerkkejä mahdollisista vastuualueista:

- Sähköverkon laskentojen tekeminen varmistaen verkon tehokkuuden ja luotettavuuden (kuormanjako-, loistehokapasiteetti-, vikavirta-, komponenttien kuormitus- ja mitoituslaskelmat sekä selektiivisyystarkastelut)


- Maadoituslaskelmat, -tarkastelut ja vaarajänniteselvitykset


- Verkkotietomallien ylläpito, kehittäminen sekä laskenta/analysointi


- Laskentatulosten analysointi ja raportointi suunnittelun tueksi


- Yhteistyö eri sidosryhmien välillä


- Dokumentaation laatiminen


- Osallistuminen sähköverkkosuunnittelun kehitysprojekteihin




Eduksi hakijalle lasketaan:

- Kokemus keski- ja suurjänniteverkkojen laskennasta ja suunnittelusta


- Tuntemus sähköverkon rakenteista ja toimintaperiaatteista


- Uusiutuvan energian järjestelmä- ja laitetuntemus


- Laskentaohjelmistojen (esim. PowerFactory, openDSS, PSCAD, PSS/E, Safegrid, Cableizer) hallinta


- Hyvät ongelmanratkaisu- ja analysointitaidot


- Tarkka, järjestelmällinen ja oma-aloitteinen työote


- Sujuva suomen ja/tai englannin kielen taito




Katsomme eduksi myös oppimishalukkuuden ja sinut perehdytetään työhösi, eli voit hakea työpaikkaa myös, vaikka et vielä osaisi kaikkea edellä mainittua.



Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

- Meillä tehdään merkityksellistä asiantuntijatyötä alan huipulla ja voidaan hyvin. Otamme henkilöstömme hyvinvoinnin ja osallistamisen tosissaan. Toimintaamme ohjaavat luottamus, rohkeus, arvostus ja vastuunotto. Onnistumme yhdessä joukkueena, toisiamme tukien.


- Rakennamme konkreettisin teoin hyvinvoivaa ja innostavaa työyhteisöä, jossa jokainen pääsee loistamaan omilla vahvuuksillaan. Meillä pääset vaikuttamaan niin omaan työhösi kuin asiakkaiden ja koko yhteiskunnan energiatehokkaaseen tulevaisuuteen. Tarjoamme mielenkiintoisia projekteja, erinomaiset henkilökuntaetuudet sekä kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen. Tarjoamme työntekijöillemme viimeisimmät laitteet ja ohjelmistot, jotta työnteko on mahdollisimman sujuvaa. Monipuolisen tehtävänkuvan lisäksi pääset kehittymään huippuasiantuntijoiden joukkueessa, alan edelläkävijäyrityksessä.




Kiinnostuitko?

Ota rohkeasti yhteyttä ja kysy lisää tehtävästä Sami Mattilalta (+358442430872) arkisin klo 9-15. Mikäli olen varattuna, soitan takaisin vapauduttuani.

Do you want to work at the heart of the energy sector and influence how electrical grids are designed and how they will operate in the future? jobs.title: 4 chauffører/montører søges til hvidevarer og TV – søg alene eller med din makker!
jobs.description:
4 chauffører/montører søges – fast makker, egen rute og kundeservice i topklasse!

N & S Transport Denmark ApS søger 4 dygtige og ansvarsbevidste chauffører/montører til levering, indbæring og montering af hvidevarer og TV.

I bliver fordelt på to teams med to medarbejdere i hver 8-pallers liftbil. Vi søger medarbejdere, der kan samarbejde, tage ansvar og sikre, at kunden får en god oplevelse fra ankomst til færdig montering.

Har du allerede en makker, som du arbejder godt sammen med? Så er I meget velkomne til at søge sammen! Du kan også søge alene, så sammensætter vi de rette teams.

Arbejdssted og arbejdstid

• Ruterne starter og slutter i Fredericia.
• Arbejdsdagene er mandag til fredag.
• Mødetid kl. 06.00 med forventet afslutning omkring kl. 15.00. Sluttidspunktet kan variere efter dagens opgaver.
• Forventet opstart den 2. november 2026 – den endelige dato aftales.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Sammen med din makker står du for sikker transport, indbæring, udpakning, placering og montering hos kunderne. Opgaverne omfatter:

• Opstilling og tilslutning af vaskemaskiner.
• Opstilling og tilslutning af opvaskemaskiner.
• Montering af integrerede opvaskemaskiner, herunder tilpasning og montering af frontlåge.
• Montering af integrerede køleskabe.
• Tilslutning af ovne og tørretumblere.
• Lednings- og tilslutningsopgaver, hvor de nødvendige kompetencer og eventuelle autorisationskrav er opfyldt.
• Vending af døre på køle- og fryseskabe.
• Montering af TV på væg, fod og stativ.
• Montering af udsugning/emhætte.
• Kontrol af, at leveringen og monteringen er udført korrekt.
• Registrering af leveringer, billeder og dokumentation i chaufførappen.
• Oprydning og håndtering af emballage samt eventuelle returvarer efter aftale.

Alle monterings- og tilslutningsopgaver skal udføres fagligt korrekt og efter gældende regler og producentens anvisninger.

Vi forventer, at du

• Har praktisk erfaring med levering og montering af hvidevarer og TV og kan arbejde selvstændigt med opgaverne.
• Har gyldigt kørekort til bilen og de nødvendige chaufførbeviser.
• Kan håndtere en liftbil og sikre godset forsvarligt.
• Trives med fysisk arbejde, herunder indbæring på trapper, og bruger hjælpemidler korrekt.
• Er mødestabil, omhyggelig og tager ansvar for både varer, bil og kundens hjem.
• Kan kommunikere med kunderne på dansk og forstå arbejdsinstruktioner.
• Er fortrolig med smartphone, navigation og registrering af leveringer.
• Er løsningsorienteret og bevarer en professionel tone, også når en opgave er krævende.

Vi søger medarbejdere med erfaring fra starten. Beskriv derfor tydeligt, hvilke monteringsopgaver du selv har udført, og hvilke du kan løse selvstændigt.

Vi tilbyder

• Fast kørsel mandag til fredag.
• Arbejde i et fast team med to medarbejdere pr. bil.
• En varieret hverdag med både kørsel, kundekontakt og praktiske opgaver.
• Løn og ansættelsesvilkår efter overenskomst.
• En arbejdsplads med direkte kontakt til ledelsen, tæt samarbejde og fokus på kvalitet.

Søg alene – eller sammen med din makker

Send en kort ansøgning og dit CV til info@nstransportdk.dk med emnet: “Chauffør/montør – Fredericia”.

Fortæl os:

• Hvilken erfaring du har med kørsel, hvidevarer og TV-montering.
• Hvilke kørekort og chaufførbeviser du har.
• Hvornår du kan starte.
• Om du søger alene eller sammen med en makker.

Søger I sammen, må I gerne sende én fælles ansøgning med oplysninger og CV for jer begge.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet de rette fire medarbejdere.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

N & S Transport Denmark ApS

Tlf +45 42 49 82 72

Mobil +45 21 82 83 21

jobs.title: Head of Product Data Governance
jobs.description:
How to contribute to our vision

To support growing business volumes, Siemens Energy is establishing a Product Data Governance department within the Medium Gas Turbines Product Lifecycle (MGT PLC) organization in Sweden. As Head of Product Data Management, you will set the strategic direction for product data governance, optimize Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) tools and processes, and build a high-performing team. Your work will strengthen data integrity, streamline engineering workflows, and enable effective cross-functional collaboration throughout the product lifecycle. You bring extensive experience in product data management, strong leadership capabilities in a technical environment, and a proven ability to manage complex engineering data structures.

What You Need to Make a Difference

    Strategic Data Governance & Framework Establishment

    Define, implement, and maintain the product data governance strategy, standards, and policies for the Medium Gas Turbines business area.
    Establish data quality metrics, ownership models, and compliance frameworks to ensure product data integrity across the entire lifecycle.
    Align product data governance initiatives with broader organizational digital transformation roadmaps and corporate standards.

    Tools, Processes & Lifecycle Management

    Lead the consolidation, optimization, and governance of product data tools, PLM systems, and associated engineering workflows to improve data quality, efficiency, and lifecycle traceability.
    Collaborate with engineering, IT, and operations to streamline data exchange, system integration, and configuration management processes.
    Establish and maintain standards for configuration control and product structure definition across relevant technical teams.

    Leadership & Capability Building

    Build, lead, and develop the newly formed Product Data Governance department, managing capacity planning and competency development.
    Promote data-driven ways of working across the Product Lifecycle organization and sister business units by establishing clear ownership, shared standards, and effective collaboration.
    Manage departmental budget, resource allocation, and stakeholder communications up to senior leadership levels.



Education

    Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, computer science, information management, or a related technical field.
    At least eight years of experience in product data management, product lifecycle management, or data governance within a complex engineering or manufacturing environment.
    Proven track record of leadership, team building, and managing organizational change in a multinational setup.

Skills

    Data Governance & Management: Strong expertise in Product Data Management (PDM), Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), data quality and integrity, configuration management, and Master Data Management (MDM).
    Leadership & Strategy: Proven ability to translate product data strategy into clear priorities, measurable outcomes, and sustainable ways of working, combined with strong capabilities in team leadership and development, strategic planning, stakeholder management, change management, and resource and capacity planning.
    Technical & Domain Knowledge: Strong knowledge of engineering data systems, gas turbine product structures, and process optimization, combined with excellent communication skills in Swedish and English and the ability to explain complex product data topics to both technical and senior leadership audiences.

jobs.title: Electrical Solutions Engineer, Data Centers
jobs.description:
Eltel Networks Oy is a leading provider of critical infrastructure services in the Nordics. We enable the digitalization and electrification of society through reliable solutions for power, communication and renewable energy networks.

Do you want to help deliver the next generation of critical infrastructure? Eltel is now looking for a driven and enthusiastic Electrical Solutions Engineer to join our growing Data Center team.

In this role, you will support our Data Center team in developing and evaluating electrical solutions for large-scale data center projects. Rather than focusing solely on design or reviewing the existing, you will help ensure that proposed solutions are technically robust, commercially competitive, and ready for successful execution. You will provide technical input for bids and supplier evaluations while ensuring that solutions reflect Finnish industry practices, utility requirements, and proven construction methods. Your involvement will not end at contract award; you will continue to support project teams throughout delivery, helping to evaluate design changes, resolve technical challenges during construction and commissioning, and ensure that all agreed modifications are accurately reflected in the final project documentation and handover package. You will work closely with solutions sales, suppliers, and site teams, helping bridge the gap between engineering and construction.

Your key responsibilities

Review electrical designs: Review electrical designs, models, and drawings from a contractor's perspective.

-
Assess layouts & feasibility: Assess equipment layouts, cable routing, and installation feasibility.

-
Discipline coordination: Support the coordination of electrical, mechanical, automation, and structural disciplines.

Material Take-Offs: Prepare equipment and material take-offs, including cable quantities.

Industry understanding: Good understanding of electrical distribution systems and infrastructure projects.

Evaluation skills: Ability to review and evaluate technical solutions and documentation.

We encourage open-mindedness and curiosity to continuously find better ways to work.

A workplace where people care and grow stronger together - Team spirit and peer support consistently receive high marks in Eltels employee surveys. At Eltel, people look out for one another, follow safety protocols, and ensure that everyone gets home safely every day. Sounds interesting?

Follow us on social media:
