jobs.title: Structural Analysis Engineer  Advanced CAE  Husqvarna Group
jobs.description:
Help shape robust, high-performing products through advanced structural analysis. As a Structural Analysis Engineer in our Advanced CAE team, you will turn simulations into clear engineering decisions—from early concepts to product verification.

The team is an experienced specialist team within R&D in Huskvarna and work closely with design engineers, test engineers, project teams, and other experts across Husqvarna Group. The role gives you broad exposure to the product-development process and the opportunity to influence both product design and the way we use simulation.

Role Description

In this role you will plan, perform, and evaluate structural analyses throughout the product-development process. Your work will support concept selection, design improvements, verification, and root-cause investigations. The analyses may include linear and nonlinear structural behavior, durability, dynamics, and impact, depending on product and project needs.

As a Structural Analysis Engineer, you will take technical ownership of your analyses: defining the question, selecting an appropriate method, assessing model quality and assumptions, interpreting results, and communicating conclusions and recommendations. Collaboration with physical testing and design functions to build confidence in the results is another part of this role, as is contributing to improved methods, automation, guidelines, and good CAE practices across the organisation.

Your profile

We are looking for someone who combines sound engineering judgement with curiosity and a practical approach to problem-solving. You are comfortable working independently, while actively seeking input and sharing knowledge with others. The ability to explain complex analysis results in a way that helps colleagues and project teams making well-founded decisions is also an important trait.

You structure your work, take responsibility for quality and delivery, and can balance several assignments in a project-driven environment. Just as importantly, you are motivated by learning—deepening your expertise, exploring new methods, and contributing to the development of the team.

What you bring

    A Master’s degree, or equivalent competence, in mechanical engineering, engineering physics, or a related field with a focus on structural mechanics
    Relevant professional experience in structural analysis or CAE, including finite element analysis
    The ability to define analysis tasks, assess assumptions and model quality, interpret results, and provide actionable engineering recommendations
    The ability to communicate technical content clearly in reports, presentations, and engineering discussions
    Very good spoken and written English
    Swedish-language skills, or a willingness to develop them

It is an advantage if you also have experience in one or more of the following areas:

    Pre- and post-processing in ANSA and META
    Solvers or multibody tools such as LS-DYNA, Nastran, or Adams
    Nonlinear analysis, dynamics, impact, fatigue, or correlation between simulation and physical testing
    Python scripting, workflow automation, and AI-assisted software development
    Exploring or implementing AI and agent-based solutions for simulation workflows, engineering decision support, knowledge reuse, or quality assurance
    Working in a Linux environment

Location

Huskvarna. This role requires you to work on site at our Huskvarna office at least four days per week. We believe the best ideas happen when we're connected, creating space for collaboration, creativity, and fast decision-making. This approach helps us maintain a strong culture, support learning and development, and ensure everyone has access to the people and resources they need to thrive.

Your application

Please apply with CV and Cover Letter. We do not accept applications via email due to GDPR regulations. For more questions regarding the position please contact:

Hiring Manager: Per Carlén, per.carlen@husqvarnagroup.com. For more information about the recruitment process, please contact: Recruiter: Gorjana Dubovina,gorjana.dubovina@husqvarnagroup.com.

Processing of personal data

When you send in your application we will process your personal data. In case we choose to proceed with your application, we may ask you to verify your identity before giving you a job offer. jobs.title: Machine Learning Platform Engineer I
jobs.description:
Your Opportunity

We are looking for a Machine Learning Platform Engineer to join Mollie's Machine Learning Platform team, sitting within our broader Data Domain. Our ML Platform empowers Machine Learning Scientists to develop and deploy custom ML solutions at scale across Mollie, serving domains including Risk & Fraud, Payments, Merchant Experience, Financial Services, Go-to-Market, and more. As the central team responsible for Mollie's Machine Learning Platform, we own the maintenance and continuous enhancement of the platform, ensuring it remains reliable, scalable, and fit for production-grade workloads. We work closely with domain teams to bring custom ML models into products, bridging the gap between research and real-world impact, while also designing and developing custom GenAI tooling and platforms for both internal employees and Mollie's customers.

This is a hands-on role where you will spend the majority of your time writing Python and Terraform alongside a team of skilled ML Platform Engineers. Based at Mollie's Lisbon Hub, you will be part of a geographically distributed team spanning Amsterdam and Lisbon, working in a collaborative environment that embraces both remote and hybrid ways of working.

What you’ll be doing

 

As an ML Platform Engineer, you will:

 

  • Collaborate closely with ML Platform Engineers, Machine Learning Scientists, and engineers across Mollie's domain teams to deliver scalable Machine Learning solutions

  • Deploy and operationalize ML models to production in partnership with Machine Learning Scientists, bridging the gap between experimentation and real-world impact

  • Enhance and maintain our cloud-based ML Platform on GCP, writing production-grade Python and Terraform daily

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for ML model training and inference, ensuring reliable and automated workflows across environments

  • Deploy, manage, and scale model serving endpoints on Kubernetes, ensuring low-latency, high-availability inference for production workloads

  • Assist in extending, developing, and hosting custom and open-source AI tooling ; enabling teams to rapidly build and deploy AI-powered solutions.

  • Champion MLOps best practices, implementing standards around model versioning, experiment tracking, data validation, and automated retraining

  • Ensure platform reliability by setting up observability, monitoring, and alerting for both infrastructure and deployed models

  • Maintain and enhance open-source AI tooling hosted at Mollie (such as LiteLLM and LibreChat), and further support and expand our generative AI capabilities.

What you'll bring

  • 1+ year of experience deploying and maintaining ML models in production

  • Good understanding of MLOps principles, including matters such as experiment tracking, reproducibility, pipeline automation, model versioning, and monitoring in production

  • Strong hands-on Python programming skills, with proficiency across common ML and data libraries such as scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, XGBoost, LightGBM, and MLflow

  • Familiarity with at a major cloud platform, preferably GCP

  • Experience with containerization (Docker), with preferred familiarity in container orchestration tools such as Kubernetes and Kubeflow.

  • Strong context-switching ability with sharp attention to detail, adapting quickly to shifting priorities

  • Preferably familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (IaC) tools such as Terraform

  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for ML workflows

Grow your way

At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy. If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you.

 

AI at Mollie

We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day.

AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us.

jobs.title: PhD Research Fellow in Diversity and Ecology of Marine Algae and Protistan Parasites
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for a four-year PhD Research Fellow position in the Diversity and Ecology of Marine Algae and Protistan Parasites. The position will be based at the Natural History Museum, University of Oslo, Norway, and affiliated with the national research programme Arctic Ocean 2050 (Polhavet 2050). The successful candidate will also benefit from affiliation with the national graduate research school BIOCORE.

The PhD project will investigate how climate-driven warming is reshaping Arctic microbial eukaryote communities, with a focus on the northward expansion of toxic microalgae and protistan parasites. The successful candidate will join an international research environment and contribute to a better understanding of biodiversity change in the Arctic Ocean. The position includes 25% career-enhancing work, supporting both the museum’s activities and the candidate’s professional development. Depending on the candidate’s interests and the museum’s needs, this work may include collection curation, teaching, supervision, research support, work in the Botanical Garden, or public outreach. The selected candidate will be enrolled in the PhD programme at the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences. Within two months of commencing the position, the candidate must submit a PhD agreement, including a plan for the required doctoral courses and a project description.


More about the position / The PhD project

The Arctic Ocean is expected to undergo a high rate of species turnover as climate-driven changes in habitats, including declining sea-ice cover and rising seawater temperatures, enable new species to expand northward while others decline or disappear locally. These shifts are likely to substantially reorganize Arctic food webs, with cascading effects throughout the ecosystem. This PhD project will investigate how climate-driven warming is reshaping Arctic microbial eukaryote communities, with a focus on the northward expansion of toxic microalgae and protistan parasites, and includes the option to take part in research cruises. The project will use long-read metabarcoding to develop a pan-Arctic, DNA-based biodiversity database with high taxonomic resolution, use existing data and literature to distinguish generalist from specialist taxa, and identify potential entry routes and distribution patterns of the microalgae and parasites as Arctic waters warm. The project will also detect known and novel biological associations, as well as abundance changes in toxic microalgae and protistan parasites. Key findings will be validated against microscopy data collected during research cruises. The position includes translating results into outreach for stakeholders and contributing to predictive policy recommendations. The project therefore offers an exciting opportunity to combine field-derived Arctic samples, advanced molecular and imaging tools, and ecological theory to address emerging questions at the intersection of climate change, biodiversity, and ecosystem functioning.

The position is affiliated with the national research programme Arctic Ocean 2050. The programme brings together 18 Norwegian research institutions in a major interdisciplinary collaboration aimed at strengthening Norway’s knowledge base and strategic capacity in a rapidly changing Arctic Ocean. Its goals are to improve our understanding of the present-day Arctic Ocean and how it may change towards 2050, and develop the knowledge needed for future management, sustainable use, and a safe and secure region. The ten-year programme (2026–2035) combines basic research, applied science, and innovation – offering unique opportunities for professional development and cross-disciplinary collaboration. Arctic Ocean 2050 focuses on processes within the central Arctic Ocean, its interactions with the surrounding seas, and how these dynamics connect to broader climatic and political systems. Field activities will primarily take place in the Eurasian Basin, between Fram Strait and the North Pole, as well as including the adjacent continental slopes. Pan-Arctic perspectives will be ensured through remote sensing, research on broader sociopolitical drivers, and modelling tools that cover the entire Arctic Ocean, and extensive international research collaboration. As part of Arctic Ocean 2050, the candidate will join an ambitious research environment with high societal relevance and the opportunity to contribute to new knowledge on some of the world’s most remote and important ocean regions.

This position is also affiliated with the national graduate research school BIOCORE. Led by Norway’s four university natural history museums, BIOCORE aims to train the next generation of researchers in biodiversity science to address environmental challenges. BIOCORE provides specialised courses and workshops, research and training mobility, regular seminars and networking events, and opportunities to collaborate with non‑academic and policy partners. The successful candidate will become a full member of BIOCORE, and will undertake a funded research secondment at a partner museum and receive support for course‑related travel. The candidate will be connected to a national network of biodiversity researchers, and play an important role in co‑organising BIOCORE’s quarterly webinars as well as the annual Norsk symposium i biosystematikk.

The PhD position will be supervised by Professor Micah Dunthorn, and co-supervised by Associate Professor Adriana Lopes dos Santos, Professor Torsten Struck, and Professor Josefin Titelman at the University of Oslo, and Associate Professor Anna Vader at the University Centre in Svalbard.


Qualifications 

Required qualifications:

  • an MSc degree in metabarcoding, microbiology, biodiversity, bioinformatics, ecology, or a related field
  • excellent written and verbal communication skills in English*
  • experience with analysing large metabarcoding datasets, including the use of different programmes and pipelines
  • experience in molecular laboratory methods

*For English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/EEA countries and exemptions from the requirement, see: https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8

Desired qualifications:

  • clear alignment between the PhD position and the applicant’s motivation, research interests, and career plans
  • experience working with algae or protistan parasites
  • knowledge of the Arctic marine ecosystem
  • experience working with international collaborators

Grade requirements for admission to the PhD programme:

  • average grade point for courses included in the Bachelor's degree must correspond to C or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • average grade point for courses included in the Master's degree must correspond to B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • Master's thesis must correspond to a grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system

What are we looking for in you?

Personal Skills:

  • ability to engage constructively and communicate clearly with supervisors, colleagues, project partners, and stakeholders
  • ability to contribute to a supportive, inclusive, and collegial working environment that values diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences
  • strong organisational skills and reliability in managing laboratory, computational, and field-based research tasks

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal skills.


We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. 

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


We can offer you
  • exciting and meaningful work in an organisation with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development
  • committed colleagues in a good working environment
  • a strong interdisciplinary setting for research, training, and collaboration through the Natural History Museum, Arctic Ocean 2050, and BIOCORE
  • structured onboarding, follow-up, and support throughout the employment period
  • tailored career guidance and opportunities for career-enhancing work, aligned with your individual career goals and relevant both within and beyond academia
  • good welfare schemes
  • membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse (SPK), which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes
  • Oslo’s family-friendly surroundings with their rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities
  • salary in the position of Doctoral Research Fellow (position code 1017) with a salary ranging from NOK 550 800 - 595 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2% is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund (SPK)

How to apply

The application must include (as separate and numbered documents): 
1.    cover letter including a statement of motivation and research interests (maximum 2 pages)
2.    CV summarising education, positions, academic work, scientific publications, and other relevant experiences
3.    statement explaining how the PhD position fits into your career plans (maximum 1 page)
4.    MSc thesis (or equivalent) and any published papers directly resulting from the thesis (as a single PDF)
5.    copies of educational certificates and transcripts of records (as a single PDF) 
6.    names and contact details for two to three references (i.e., name, affiliation, relation to the candidate, Email, and phone number)
7.    documentation of English proficiency (if applicable)
8.    statement on the use of AI. If AI was used in preparation of your application document, please detail its use in any documents

Applicants must submit their application and supporting documents through the electronic recruitment system Jobbnorge by clicking “Apply for this job.” Shortlisted candidates will be invited to an interview.

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, you must upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Applicants with education from outside Norway are advised to include an explanation of their university’s grading system. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

Please note that we are unable to add documentation after the application deadline. As the deadline applies equally to all applicants, this policy ensures equal treatment throughout the recruitment process. If you experience difficulties uploading documents in Jobbnorge, please contact their customer service: Phone: +47 75 54 22 20 or Email: support@grade.com 

The primary method of communication throughout the process will be e-mails and messages through the recruitment system Jobbnorge. When you receive a notification of a message in Jobbnorge, please log in to read it, as it may be important.

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews. 

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to recruitment positions at UiO and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees to secure the rights to all research results and related intellectual property.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Natural History Museum at the University of Oslo is Norway’s largest and most comprehensive natural history museum, with extensive scientific collections and a strong research environment. For nearly 200 years, the museum has collected, studied and preserved specimens of animals, fungi, plants, rocks, minerals and fossils. The museum is located at two sites in Oslo: the Botanical Garden at Tøyen, which is not only popular for recreation but is a scientific collection in itself, and Økern. The museum has a modern DNA laboratory as well as access to the Norwegian Supercomputer facilities.

jobs.title: Ohjaaja, Aurinkorinteen palvelukoti, Ilomantsi
jobs.description:
**Tule kanssamme rakentamaan pykälää parempaa arkea.**

Haemme **ohjaajaa Aurinkorinteelle Ilomantsiin** määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen 31.8.2027 saakka. Kyseessä on osa-aikainen tehtävä 80 % työajalla (30,66 h/vko).

Aurinkorinteen palvelukodissa asuu 18 aikuista, jotka tarvitsevat tukea arkeensa. Tuen tarpeen taustalla voi olla esimerkiksi kehitysvamma. Meillä arki rakentuu osallisuudesta, turvallisuudesta ja kunnioittavasta kohtaamisesta. Koti elää asukkaidensa näköisenä, ja meillä jokainen elää juuri oman näköistään elämää. Ohjaajana olet tärkeässä roolissa mukana rakentamassa tätä joka päivä.

**Tehtäväsi**

Ohjaajana tuet ja mahdollistat asukkaidemme arkea heidän omien toiveidensa, tarpeidensa ja tavoitteidensa mukaisesti. Työhösi kuuluu hyvinvoinnin tukemista ja hoitotyötä sekä asukkaiden ohjaamista ja tukemista päivittäisissä toiminnoissa ja asioinnissa. Tehtäviisi kuuluu mm:

- Asukkaiden yksilöllinen hoiva ja huolenpito sekä turvallinen lääkehoito

- Asukkaiden ohjaaminen ja auttaminen päivittäisissä toiminnoissa, kuten kodinhoidossa, kaupassa asioinnissa ja ulkoilussa

- Arjen suunnittelu ja toteuttaminen yhdessä asukkaiden ja tiimin kanssa; esimerkiksi liikuntaa, leivontaa ja retkiä

- Yhteistyö läheisten, hyvinvointialueen ammattilaisten ja muun verkoston kanssa

- Asukkaan vuorovaikutuksen mahdollistaminen ja tukeminen puhetta tukevia ja korvaavia kommunikaatiomenetelmiä hyödyntäen .


**Millaista työkaveria etsimme?**

Etsimme ennen kaikkea ihmisläheistä ja vastuullista ammattilaista, joka haluaa tehdä työtä kehitysvammaisten ihmisten hyvän arjen ja osallisuuden eteen.

**Odotamme sinulta**

- Soveltuvaa sosiaali- ja terveysalan tutkintoa (esim. lähihoitaja tai sosionomi)

- Lupa- ja valvontaviranomaisen rekisteröintiä ja sote-ammattikorttia

jobs.title: Rekrytering Servicechef
jobs.description:
Finnvedsbostäder AB är ett allmännyttigt bostadsbolag som ska bidra till en fungerande bostadsmarknad. Finnvedbostäder ägs av Värnamo kommun med det huvudsakliga ändamålet att främja bostadsförsörjningen i kommunen, och är idag en verksamhet som ska bedrivas enligt affärsmässiga principer. I uppdraget ligger också att ha en strategiskt hållbar förvaltning och fastighetsutveckling för attraktiva boenden – både idag och imorgon. Vi kan idag stolt summera ett fastighetsbestånd på över 3 000 bostäder och lokaler.

Servicechef till Finnvedsbostäder i Värnamo

Vill du vara med och skapa attraktiva, hållbara och välskötta boendemiljöer?

På Finnvedsbostäder tror vi att ett attraktivt bostadsområde handlar om mer än byggnader. Det handlar om gröna och välskötta utemiljöer, trygga och inbjudande mötesplatser och ett långsiktigt arbete för hållbarhet och trivsel.

Nu söker vi en servicechef som vill leda och utveckla arbetet med våra utemiljöer och serviceområden. Vi söker dig som kombinerar ett genuint intresse för människor med ett engagemang för utemiljö, hållbarhetsfrågor och utveckling av attraktiva bostadsområden.

Om rollen

Som servicechef har du det övergripande ansvaret för bolagets grönytor, sophantering, löpande drift och felavhjälpande underhåll inom ansvarsområdet.

Tillsammans med dina medarbetare arbetar du för att våra bostadsområden ska vara välskötta, trivsamma och attraktiva för våra hyresgäster.

Du leder en grupp på 14 medarbetare och är en synlig och närvarande ledare i verksamheten. Du finns nära det dagliga arbetet, skapar engagemang och delaktighet samt arbetar aktivt för att utveckla både verksamheten och medarbetarna.

Vi söker dig som ser möjligheter före problem och som drivs av att arbeta förebyggande och långsiktigt snarare än att enbart lösa uppkomna situationer. Du har förmågan att skapa en kultur där medarbetarna arbetar proaktivt, tar ansvar och känner stolthet över resultatet.

Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsområden

    Leda, coacha och utveckla medarbetarna i den dagliga verksamheten.
    Planera och prioritera arbetet för att skapa attraktiva, välvårdade och trygga bostadsområden.
    Driva utvecklingen av våra utemiljöer med fokus på trivsel, kvalitet och hållbarhet.
    Arbeta aktivt med frågor kopplade till biologisk mångfald, hållbar förvaltning och nya miljökrav.
    Ansvara för bolagets källsorterings- och miljöstationer och utveckla arbetet kring hållbar resurshantering.
    Planera och följa upp verksamhetens budget, mål och resultat.
    Säkerställa att verksamheten använder maskiner, fordon och utrustning på ett effektivt och säkert sätt.
    Bidra till utveckling av arbetssätt som stärker både service, kvalitet och arbetsmiljö.
    Samverka med områdeschefer och övriga funktioner för att skapa bästa möjliga boendemiljö för våra hyresgäster.

Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som är en trygg, engagerad och handlingskraftig ledare. Du trivs ute i verksamheten, bygger starka relationer och motiverar andra att utvecklas och ta ansvar.

Du har ett genuint intresse för utemiljöer, trädgård, skötsel och utveckling av gröna miljöer. Du ser värdet i välplanerade och välskötta bostadsområden och förstår hur de bidrar till både trivsel, trygghet och hållbarhet.

Som person är du initiativrik och lösningsorienterad. Du arbetar strukturerat och långsiktigt och har förmågan att omsätta idéer till konkreta förbättringar i vardagen.

Vi ser gärna att du har

    Flera års erfarenhet av ledarskap med personalansvar.
    Erfarenhet av att leda operativ verksamhet inom utemiljö, park, grönyteskötsel, fastighetsservice eller liknande område.
    Erfarenhet av budget- och resultatansvar.
    Intresse för trädgård, anläggning, hållbarhetsfrågor och utveckling av boendemiljöer.
    Förmåga att planera, organisera och följa upp verksamhet på ett strukturerat sätt.
    Kunskap om eller intresse för biologisk mångfald, hållbar förvaltning och cirkulärt tänkande.
    B-körkort.

Därför ska du välja Finnvedsbostäder

Här får du möjlighet att påverka hur framtidens boendemiljöer ska utvecklas i Värnamo kommun. Du blir en viktig del av arbetet med att skapa attraktiva, hållbara och välskötta bostadsområden där människor trivs, känner trygghet och vill bo kvar länge.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

I denna rekrytering samarbetar Finnvedsbostäder (https://www.finnvedsbostader.se/)med Fasticon. Du söker tjänsten via annonsen. För att säkerställa att dina personuppgifter hanteras i enlighet med GDPR tar Fasticon inte emot ansökningar via e-post. Vi arbetar utifrån en kompetensbaserad rekryteringsprocess med fokus på att rekrytera rätt kompetens utifrån verksamhetens behov.

Har du frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta ansvarig rekryteringskonsult Jenny Tell på jenny.tell@Fasticon.se (mailto:jenny.tell@Fasticon.se)

Vi arbetar med löpande urval, så vänta inte med din ansökan. Så länge annonsen är publicerad tar vi emot ansökningar. Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess använder vi oss av tester samt att en anställning hos Finnvedsbostäder föregås alltid av en bakgrundskontroll och drogtest.

Om Fasticon

Fasticon är marknadsledande specialister på kompetensförsörjning inom fastighetsrelaterade kompetenser. Vi kombinerar skarp expertis med en djup förståelse för ledarskapsutmaningar och hjälper organisationer att hitta rätt kompetens för långsiktig framgång.

Våra kunder finns över hela Sverige och vi utgår från Stockholm, Göteborg och Malmö.

Läs mer på www.fasticon.se (http://www.fasticon.se/) och sök lediga tjänster på www.fasticon.se/lediga-jobb (http://www.fasticon.se/lediga-jobb).

Som elev bliver du en del af et stærkt læringsmiljø med fokus på faglighed, udvikling og læring i både skole- og oplæringsperioder.

    • Eventuelt CV

Vil du vide mere?

Christina Mikkelsen og Mette Plett på uddannelseskonsulent@htk.dk

Du kan også læse mere på sosuh.dk eller kontakte SOSU H's vejledning på tlf. 72 26 60 00 eller vejledning@sosuh.dk.

Oplysningerne registreres på lærepladsen.dk og overføres til Datavarehuset i Styrelsen for It og Læring. Oplysningerne indsamles udelukkende til statistiske formål. De registrerede oplysninger er ikke synlige for dig eller offentligheden. Indsamlingen af disse data sker med hjemmel i §58 i Bekendtgørelse om Erhvervsuddannelser.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Pharmacist
jobs.description:
At Excelya, we combine passion, scientific excellence, and collaboration to support our clients throughout the entire drug development lifecycle. We encourage our employees to be bold, take initiative, and unlock their full potential in an international, fast-growing environment.

We are currently looking for a Quality Assurance Pharmacist to strengthen our Quality team and support pharmaceutical quality systems, product quality activities, and regulatory compliance initiatives.

Key responsibilities :

Quality Management System (QMS)

  • Manage and maintain quality documentation including SOPs, procedures, and quality records.
  • Coordinate document lifecycle activities, including creation, review, approval, archiving, and periodic reviews.
  • Support and deliver GxP and quality-related training programs.
  • Participate in internal audits, supplier audits, and health authority inspections.
  • Manage quality events including deviations, CAPAs, change controls, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable pharmaceutical regulations and quality standards.

Product Quality Activities

  • Manage product quality complaints and associated investigations.
  • Support quality defect reporting and interactions with health authorities when required.
  • Conduct risk assessments and quality impact evaluations.
  • Participate in product recall and shortage management activities.
  • Review Product Quality Reviews (PQRs) and monitor quality trends.
  • Review and approve batch release documentation and distribution-related quality activities.

Quality Oversight & Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor quality KPIs and performance indicators.
  • Contribute to Management Reviews and Annual Quality Reviews.
  • Support cross-functional initiatives such as product launches, technology transfers, and portfolio optimization projects.
  • Drive quality culture and promote continuous improvement across the organization.
  • Collaborate closely with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Regulatory Affairs, Pharmacovigilance, and Quality stakeholders.

Requirements

Education

  • Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD) mandatory.
  • Strong experience in Quality Assurance within the pharmaceutical industry.
  • Experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing or production environments is highly desirable.
  • Registration as a Responsible Pharmacist (PRI) is considered an asset.

Technical Skills

  • Strong knowledge of: GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices) GDP (Good Distribution Practices), GVP and Pharmacovigilance requirements
  • Proven experience managing: Deviations, CAPAs, Change Controls, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Risk Management activities
  • Experience with Quality Management Systems and tools such as: TrackWise, EDMS, SAP, Other electronic Quality Systems

Language

  • Fluent English, both written and spoken.

Benefits

Why join us?

At Excelya, we combine a passion for science with the enthusiasm of teamwork to redefine excellence in healthcare.

Here's what makes us unique:

We are a young and ambitious healthcare company, bringing together 900 Excelyates, driven by the goal of becoming the leading mid-sized CRO in Europe, while offering the best employee experience.

Our "one-stop provider" service model—combining full-service, functional service provider, and consulting—allows you to grow through diverse and stimulating projects. By collaborating with leading experts, you will contribute to the development of scientific, operational, and human knowledge, all in service of improving the patient journey.

Excelling with kindness means evolving in an environment that values ​​your natural talents, encourages boldness, pushes boundaries, and cultivates your potential, so that you can fully contribute to our shared mission.

Notre modèle de services intégré, combinant conseil, Functional Service Provider et Full Service, vous permettra d'évoluer sur des projets variés et à forte valeur ajoutée. Vous travaillerez aux côtés d'experts reconnus et contribuerez concrètement à l'amélioration du parcours patient.

Dans le cadre d'un projet d'extension d'un bâtiment de contrôle qualité au sein d'un site pharmaceutique basé à Toulouse, nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur Projet Génie Civil & Construction.

Vous interviendrez au sein d'une équipe projet pluridisciplinaire et serez responsable du pilotage des activités de construction, depuis les phases de préparation jusqu'à la réception des travaux, en garantissant l'atteinte des objectifs qualité, sécurité, coûts et délais.

Missions Principales :

  • Participer à la définition et à l'optimisation des solutions techniques retenues ;
  • Piloter les lots Génie Civil, VRD et Clos-Couvert du projet ;
  • Coordonner les entreprises, fournisseurs et sous-traitants ;
  • Assurer le suivi des travaux et des interfaces chantier ;
  • Garantir le respect des exigences HSE et qualité du projet ;
  • Suivre les budgets, les contrats et les plannings associés ;
  • Identifier et gérer les risques techniques, financiers et calendaires ;
  • Organiser les réunions de chantier et assurer le reporting auprès de la direction projet ;
  • Participer aux opérations de réception et au transfert des installations vers les équipes utilisatrices.

Requirements

Chez Excelya, nous encourageons chacun à faire preuve d'audace et à développer son potentiel. Nous recherchons des professionnels partageant nos valeurs et souhaitant évoluer dans un environnement stimulant.

  • Expérience : Expérience confirmée en gestion de projets de construction ou de génie civil industriel.
  • Compétences : Expertise en pilotage de travaux, coordination TCE, suivi de chantier et gestion contractuelle. Une expérience dans les secteurs pharmaceutique, chimique ou industriel fortement réglementé est fortement appréciée.
  • Formation : Diplôme d'Ingénieur Génie Civil, Construction, Bâtiment ou équivalent.
  • Langues : Français courant et anglais professionnel requis.

Benefits

Chez Excelya, nous associons passion pour la science et esprit d'équipe afin de redéfinir l'excellence dans le secteur de la santé.

Ce qui nous distingue :

Nous sommes une entreprise de santé ambitieuse réunissant plus de 900 collaborateurs à travers l'Europe, avec l'objectif de devenir le leader européen des CRO de taille intermédiaire tout en offrant la meilleure expérience collaborateur.

Notre modèle de services intégré, combinant conseil, Functional Service Provider et Full Service, vous permettra d'évoluer sur des projets variés et à forte valeur ajoutée. Vous travaillerez aux côtés d'experts reconnus et contribuerez concrètement à l'amélioration du parcours patient.

Exceller avec bienveillance

Chez Excelya, la bienveillance est au cœur de nos actions. Nous favorisons l'égalité des chances et construisons un environnement de travail diversifié, équitable et inclusif, où chacun peut s'épanouir, être reconnu et contribuer pleinement à une mission commune.

Vos défis deviennent notre mission collective. Ensemble, nous transformons les idées ambitieuses en réalisations concrètes, à la manière d'Excelya.

Rejoignez-nous aujourd’hui et devenez un Excelyate !

jobs.title: Cleaner
jobs.description:
**Do you want to do work that matters? Are you customer service-minded and like to see the results of your work right away?** At Siskon Siivous, our cleaners are professionals in cleanliness – they ensure that our customers' facilities are clean and safe.

We are now looking for a cleaner for a health care facility

**What does your workday look like?**

As a cleaner, you are responsible for the cleanliness and safety of the customer's premises. You will follow the agreed instructions and to-do lists to ensure that patient and treatment rooms and waiting rooms meet the required hygiene levels. The work requires special care and precision so that we can do our part to guarantee a high level of patient safety / but don't worry – we will provide you with proper orientation and the necessary training.

**You will succeed in your job if you have:**

- Experience in the cleaning industry

- Good organizational and interaction skills

- A positive service attitude and a responsible approach to work

- Fluent Finnish or English language skills, other language skills are a plus


**Why us?**

With us, you will be given responsibility, but you will not be left alone. Our work community is diverse and fair – we get things done at once. You will receive comprehensive orientation and the opportunity to further your education. In your work, you will be supported by your supervisor and meet your colleagues regularly, e.g. in team meetings. We use high-quality cleaning equipment and environmentally friendly substances.

**Work in a nutshell:**

- **Job location** Hämeenkyrö – please check the location before applying for a job

- **Fixed - term employment:** 16.12.2026 - 28.02.2027


- **Competitive salary** 12,59€/h

- **Weekly working hours** 7 h / week

- **Working hours** are Monday-Friday between 16:00-21:00

- **Honest employer** – we comply with the collective agreement for the facility services sector


**Interested?**

If you recognize yourself in the description, don't hesitate – send your application and join us in doing work that really matters. With us, you will be part of a professional team where cleanliness is not just cleaning – it is safety, well-being and smooth everyday life. Siskon Siivous Oy is a cheerful company founded in 1994, for which it is a matter of the heart to take good care of its employees and offer reliable and high-quality cleaning services to its customers.

jobs.title: Financial Manager
jobs.description:
Me EMU Growth Partnersilla yhdistämme modernilla tavalla tuotetut taloushallinnon ja palkanlaskennan palvelut monipuoliseen valikoimaan neuvonta-, HR-, laki- ja järjestelmäpalveluita. Haluamme luoda alan parhaan asiakaskokemuksen olemalla yrityksille inhimillinen huolenpitäjä ja luotettava suunnannäyttäjä. Ihmiskeskeiset arvot ovat tekemisemme ytimessä ja se näkyy sekä kuuluu jokaisessa päivässä.

EMU jatkaa kasvuaan ja etsimme uusia työkavereita rempseään joukkoomme! EMU on erilaisista taustoista tulevien ihmisten tiivis yhteisö, toimintamme keskiössä ovat EMUlaiset ja asiakkaat. Meitä EMUlaisia on jo reilu 100 kolmessa eri maassa ja haluamme, että meillä on taloushallintoalan paras yrityskulttuuri.

Haemme nyt joukkoomme uutta Financial Manageria!

Onko konsernitilinpäätös sinulle palapeli, jonka ratkaiseminen palkitsee? Kaipaatko työtä, jossa et jumiudu yhden yrityksen kuukausirutiiniin? Silloin tämä rooli voi olla sinulle.

EMUlla työskentelet useammalle erikokoiselle asiakkaalle, kasvuyrityksistä kansainvälisiin konserneihin. Yhtenä päivänä täsmäytät konsernin eliminointeja, seuraavana rakennat kasvuyritykselle ensimmäistä kunnon ennustemallia. Työsi ytimessä on asiakkaidemme konserniraportointi, ja sen rinnalla laajennat business controlling -tehtäviin asiakkaiden tarpeiden ja oman kiinnostuksesi mukaan. Näet talousjohtamista monesta kulmasta ja kehityt samalla.

Työssäsi:

- Vastaat konserniraportoinnista: Laadit kuukausi- ja kvartaaliraportit sekä koordinoit konsernitilinpäätökset ajallaan maaliin.

- Hoidat konsolidoinnin: Huolehdit sisäisistä eristä ja eliminoinneista, valuuttamuunnoksista, vähemmistöosuuksista sekä konsernirakenteen muutoksista.

- Hallitset työkalut ja rakenteet: Rakennat ja ylläpidät konsolidointityökalujen mappauksia sekä raportointirakenteita.

- Koordinoit ja ohjaat: Toimit yhteyshenkilönä konserniyhtiöiden kirjanpitäjille, ja varmistat aikataulujen, sisäisten saldojen täsmäytysten sekä kuukauden sulkemisen sujuvuuden.

- Ennustat ja raportoit johdolle: Teet konsernitason budjetointia ja ennustamista sekä laadit raportteja johdon ja hallituksen päätöksenteon tueksi.

- Kehität ja sparraat: Toimit yhteyshenkilönä tilintarkastajien suuntaan sekä kehität aktiivisesti asiakkaidemme talousprosesseja ja kontrolleja. Automatisoit toistuvan työn ja otat uusia työkaluja, myös tekoälyä, rohkeasti käyttöön.

Odotamme sinulta:

- Vahva tausta konsernilaskennasta: Vähintään 5 vuoden kokemus konserniraportoinnista ja konsernitilinpäätösten laatimisesta sekä vahva osaaminen erityisesti kirjanpitolain (FAS) mukaisesta konsernitilinpäätöksestä.

- Käytännön kirjanpito- ja järjestelmäosaaminen: Vahva kirjanpidon ja tilinpäätöksen käytännön osaaminen sekä kokemus vähintään yhdestä konsolidointityökalusta.

- Koordinointi- ja johtamistaidot: Hyvät koordinointitaidot ja kyky johtaa tekemistä – saat selkeillä ohjeilla, aikatauluilla ja seurannalla useamman yhtiön ja ihmisen toimittamaan oman osuutensa ajallaan.

- Järjestelmällinen ja tarkka työskentelyote: Pidät kokonaisuuden hallussa myös kiireessä. Huomaat, kun luvut eivät täsmää, ja selvität syyn.

- Selkeät viestintätaidot: Viestit sujuvasti ja selkeästi suomeksi ja englanniksi – niin asiakkaan johdolle kuin konserniyhtiöiden tekijöille. Ruotsin kielitaito on plussaa, mutta ei välttämätöntä.

Eduksi katsomme:

- BrightAnalytics-osaaminen

- IFRS-osaaminen

- Tilintarkastus- tai konsulttitausta

- Kokemusta kasvuyhtiöistä

- Vastuullisuusraportoinnin (ESG) tuntemus

Mitä tarjoamme:

- Nykyaikaiset työvälineet ja erinomaiset edut, mm. lounas-, työmatka-, terveys-, hieronta-, liikunta- ja kulttuuriedun sekä kattavan työterveyshuollon.

- Etätyömahdollisuuden ja joustavuuden oman osaamisen kehittämiseen.

- Jäykästä hierarkiasta vapaan työyhteisön.

- Persoonalliset, motivoituneet ja innostuneet kollegat.

- Loistavan työntekijäkokemuksen, jota mitataan ja tutkitaan säännöllisesti.

Työ on vakituinen ja kokoaikainen. EMUlla etätyö ja joustavuus ovat olleet normaaleja tapoja toimia jo pitkään. Etätyön lisäksi olet aina tervetullut EMUn toimipisteille Helsinkiin, Turkuun tai Kajaaniin.

Palkkahaarukka tehtävään on 5000–5700 euroa kuukaudessa osaamisesta ja kokemuksesta riippuen. Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan, mutta toivomme, että voisit aloittaa mahdollisimman pian. Täytämme paikan heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä, joten lähetäthän hakemuksesi jo tänään!

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Head of CFO Services Matias Helle, matias.helle@emu.fi puh. 0407070299. Tavoitat Matiaksen parhaiten puhelimitse 16.10 klo 9.30-10.30 ja 23.10 klo 10-11 välisenä aikana.

Voit tutustua tuleviin työkavereihin ja EMU-meininkiin EMUn Instagramissa (https://www.instagram.com/emulaiset/) ja EMUun työnantajana verkkosivuillamme (https://emugroup.com/ura-emulla).


EMU Growth Partners

Puhelin: 010 318 0953 Sijainti: Työpajankatu 13 A 6krs.

jobs.title: Center for integration søger en jobkonsulent
jobs.description:
Vil du være en del af en integrationsindsats, som understøtter integrationsborgere på Frederiksberg i at blive selvhjulpne i det danske samfund?

Center for integration er en del af Arbejdsmarkedsafdelingen og varetager den samlede integrationsindsats i Frederiksberg Kommune. Dette spænder over at tage imod nyankomne flygtninge, drive indkvarteringsstederne, varetage flygtninge og indvandreres indsats mod beskæftigelse, koordinere danskuddannelsesforløb mv.

Opgaverne som jobkonsulent består primært af

  • afholde lovpligtige kontraktsamtaler, hvor vejledning om danskuddannelse, job og uddannelse indgår.
  • opfølgningssamtaler med fysisk fremmøde, via telefon eller digitalt. Samtaler kan foregå på dansk, engelsk eller med tolk.
  • henvisning til danskuddannelse, opfølgning på progression og dialog med sprogskolerne.
  • administrative opgaver, herunder journalisering og registreringer i fagsystemer.
  • vejledning om jobsøgning og feedback på CV og ansøgninger.
  • kontakt til virksomheder og uddannelsessteder.
  • indgå i samarbejde med en bred vifte af både interne og eksterne samarbejdspartnere.
  • udvikle indsatsen til gavn for borgerne og understøtte fastholdelse i ordinært job eller uddannelse i integrationsperioden.
  • fastholde fokus på jobperspektivet i samarbejde med afdelingens samarbejdspartnere og virksomhedskonsulenter.

Vi søger dig, som har

  • fokus på beskæftigelse som et vigtigt element i integration.
  • en relevant uddannelsesbaggrund (fx socialrådgiver eller inden for humaniora) og/eller relevant erhvervserfaring.
  • digital nysgerrighed.
  • en høj grad af interkulturel forståelse og evne til at tilpasse din kommunikation til målgruppen.
  • evnen til at skrive og give mundtlig information på en letforståelig måde – både på dansk og engelsk.
  • roen og overblikket til at håndtere komplekse sager og mange forskelligartede henvendelser.
  • tålmodighed og en tillidsvækkende tilgang.

Det er en fordel, hvis du har

  • relevant erfaring med at vejlede om jobsøgning og give feedback på CV og ansøgninger.
  • erfaring med motiverende samtaler.
  • godt kendskab til arbejdsmarkedet og hvilke kompetencer, der kræves i forskellige brancher.

Vi tilbyder

  • en hverdag, hvor du møder mennesker fra hele verden og i alle livssituationer.
  • et engageret team og center med kollegaer, der brænder for integrationsindsatsen.
  • et arbejdsfællesskab, hvor vi har fokus på respektfuld dialog.
  • en arbejdsplads, hvor vidensdeling og arbejdsglæde har høj prioritet.
  • en høj grad af selvbestemmelse i opgaveplanlægningen og opgaveløsningen.
  • flekstidsordning og mulighed for hjemmearbejde.

Organisatorisk forankring

Center for Integration består af 40 medarbejdere med forskellige faglige baggrunde, men alle med en meget engageret og ressourceorienteret tilgang til opgaveløsningen. Ledelsesteamet består af centerleder Heidi Olesen og teamleder Lene Odgaard Bramsen, hvor jobkonsulenterne refererer til førstnævnte.

Henvendelse

Vil du vide mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte centerleder Heidi Olesen på telefon 2898 3822.

Vil du vide mere om Frederiksberg Kommune, kan du finde information på www.frederiksberg.dk.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Ansættelse sker i henhold til gældende overenskomst og lønnen forhandles med den forhandlingsberettigede organisation (Frederiksberg Kommunalforening).

Arbejdstiden er 37 timer om ugen med flekstidsordning.

Stillingen er forankret i Center for integration, som er placeret i Frederiksberg Kommunes arbejdsmarkedsafdeling.

Arbejdsmarkedsafdelingen er en røgfri arbejdsplads.

Ansøgning

Frist for ansøgning er torsdag den 13. november 2026 kl. 12.00. Bemærk, at vi kun modtager ansøgninger sendt digitalt via linket i dette stillingsopslag.

Ansættelsessamtaler finder sted i uge 48.

Stillingen er med tiltrædelse den 1. januar 2027.

Frederiksberg er en levende by med et dynamisk bysamfund. Byens sjæl bygger på vores historie og klassiske arv og er med til at præge den spændende udvikling af Frederiksberg som en grøn, sund og pulserende del af Hovedstaden.

Vi er en moderne kommune, der betjener 104.305 borgere. Frederiksberg Kommune ønsker at fremme ligestillingen og opfordrer derfor alle kvalificerede til at søge uanset alder, køn, religion, etnisk tilhørsforhold eller handicap.

jobs.title: Vaskehjelp søkes – fast deltidsstilling i Oslo sentrum
jobs.description:
Vaskehjelp søkes – deltidsstilling i Oslo sentrum

Vi søker en pålitelig, selvstendig og ansvarsbevisst vaskehjelp til fast deltidsstilling i Pilestredet Park 21, Oslo sentrum.

Du trenger ikke være profesjonell renholder, men vi forventer at du er grundig, effektiv, selvstendig og ansvarsbevisst.

Hva vi ser etter

  • Erfaring med renhold er en fordel.

  • Selvstendig, grundig og effektiv.

  • Pålitelig og punktlig.

  • Fleksibel ved behov for ekstra arbeidsoppgaver.

  • Kan kommunisere på norsk eller engelsk.

  • Evne til å følge arbeidsrutiner og instrukser.

  • Søkeren må allerede være bosatt i Oslo eller nærområdet og kunne møte fast til arbeid. Stillingen er ikke aktuell som grunnlag for flytting til Oslo Norge

Arbeidsoppgaver

Fast ukentlig renhold -- 4 timer:

  • Renhold av hovedtrapper og baktrapper i en bygning med 5 etasjer.

  • Vask av inngangspartier, korridorer og øvrige fellesarealer.

  • Støvtørking og rengjøring av gelendere, dører og andre berøringsflater.

  • Renhold av et lite kontor.


  • Ekstra renholdsoppgaver ved behov:

  • Vask av kjøkken og garderober.

  • Flyttevask og klargjøring av leiligheter.

  • Andre forefallende renholdsoppgaver i våre eiendommer.

Vi tilbyr

  • Fast deltidsstilling i et etablert eiendomsselskap.

  • Selvstendig arbeid og forutsigbare faste arbeidsoppgaver.

  • Mulighet for ekstra renholdsoppdrag.

  • Lønn etter avtale


Om arbeidsgiveren:

Oslo CityApartments AS er en del av Nordic Group Holding AS, et etablert eiendomskonsern med virksomhet innen eiendomsutvikling, kjøp, salg og utleie av bolig- og næringseiendommer.

jobs.title: Ingeniør bygg/anlegg
jobs.description:
Vi søker deg som har teknisk forståelse, god gjennomføringsevne og evne til å samarbeide med både kunder, leverandører og kollegaer på tvers. 

 

Arbeidsoppgaver: 

  • Prosjekt- og byggeledelse
  • Driftsoppfølging av bygningsmasser, infrastruktur og tekniske installasjoner
  • Oppfølging av kontraktører og leverandører, inkludert anskaffelser
  • Teknisk tegning
  • Utvikling og innovasjon av industriområdet og konsernets forretningsområder

 

Vi ser gjerne at du har: 

  • Teknisk fagskole, bachelorgrad eller annen relevant utdanning. Lang og relevant erfaring kan kompensere for manglende formell utdannelse
  • Relevant erfaring fra prosjektledelse, gjerne innenfor teknisk drift eller eiendomsforvaltning 
  • Gode digitale ferdigheter
  • Erfaring med bruk av AutoCAD eller andre CAD baserte verktøy
  • God kommersiell forståelse
  • Sertifikat klasse B

 

Vi vet at du kanskje ikke har erfaring med alt, men dersom du kjenner deg igjen i flere av punktene så håper vi at du søker. Det er en bred rolle, men vi vil legge til rette for at du kan utvikle deg videre og få bruke dine styrker. 

 

Vi tror du vil trives og lykkes hos oss dersom du er en person som tar ansvar, og arbeider strukturert. Videre at du er serviceinnstilt, løsningsorientert, og kommuniserer godt med ulike interessenter. 

 

Vi tilbyr en spennende rolle i et selskap med stor betydning for lokal utvikling og arbeidsplasser. Du vil få en rolle med varierte arbeidsoppgaver og påvirkningsmulighet. Vi har et godt arbeidsmiljø, og gode velferdstilbud som trimrom, sosiale treff, og hytte på Stranda. Vi tilbyr konkurransedyktig lønn, og gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger. Utover dette er vi også en arbeidsplass med fokus på balanse mellom jobb og fritid. 

 

Spørsmål? Kontakt oss gjerne for mer informasjon om stillingen; Leder Teknisk Marita Jarstad, mobil 992 62 478, e-post marita.jarstad@fjordbase.no, eller Leder HR Marthe Opheim, mobil 466 50 701, e-post marthe.opheim@fjordbase.no.

 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Bli med og utvikle Fjord Base!
Fjord Base AS er en viktig del av Fjord Base Gruppen og er motoren bak utviklingen av Fjord Base i Florø. Med mer enn 1 100 000 m2 areal, 67 500m2 bygningsmasse og 600 meter kai skaper vi en unik arena for vekst, nyskapning og utvikling, med høyt fokus på bærekraft og miljøvennlige løsninger, og er vertskap for over 65 virksomheter.

Vi forvalter, utvikler og bygger fremtidens baseområde, med fokus på bærekraftige løsninger, effektiv drift og god kundeoppfølging. Dette innebærer alt fra utleie av bygg og areal, til utvikling av infrastruktur, teknisk vedlikehold, og gjennomføring av større prosjekter.

Nå søker vi deg som ønsker å bidra til videre utvikling av Fjord Base. Du blir en del av et faglig sterkt team på ni ansatte i Fjord Base AS, og et konsern med rundt 100 ansatte.

jobs.title: Työvalmentaja
jobs.description:
Sotek-säätiön LounasKahvila Lime etsii tiimiinsä innostunutta ja ihmisläheistä keittiöalan ammattilaista/työvalmentajaa. Haluatko tehdä merkityksellistä työtä laadukkaan ruuan parissa ja tukea valmentaen muiden ammatillista kasvua? Haemme nyt työntekijää City-kodissa sijaitsevaan LounasKahvila Limeen, jossa valmistamme arkisin maistuvia aterioita hoivakotien asukkaille sekä kahvilan asiakkaille.

Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää sinulta erinomaisia tiimityöskentelytaitoja sekä kykyä kohdata erilaisia ihmisiä aidosti ja lämpimästi.

Sotek-säätiö sr auttaa asiakkaitaan suuntaamaan kohti omannäköistä työelämää, vahvaa elämänhallintaa ja osallisuutta. Tarjoamme parempaa ja monipuolista tekemistä, joka edistää työllistymistä ja yhteisöllisyyttä, kasvattaa osaamista ja tuo uutta sisältöä asiakkaidemme elämään. Tätä työtä teemme Kymenlaaksossa ja Uudellamaalla. Henkilökuntaa meillä on noin 120 ja päivätasolla palveluissamme on noin 400 asiakasta. Tervetuloa meidän työkaveriksi! Meille saa ja pitää tulla juuri sellaisena kuin olet.

**Työnkuvaus ja odotukset**

Asiakaspalvelutyöntekijänä osallistut monipuolisesti kaikkiin keittiön arjen tehtäviin:

- Keittiön perustyöt: Reseptiikka, ruuan valmistus, astiahuolto sekä keittiötilojen puhtaanapito.

- Työvalmennus ja ohjaus: Toimit ohjaavana tukena asiakastyöntekijöille, työkokeilijoille ja opiskelijoille. Räätälöit tehtäviä heidän voimavarojensa mukaan ja autat heitä harjaannuttamaan sosiaalisia sekä ammatillisia taitojaan.

- Kunnioittava ja arvostava asiakaspalvelu.


**Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?**

- Merkityksellisen työn: Pääset osaksi yhteisöä, jonka ensisijainen tavoite on valmistaa laadukasta ruokaa samalla valmentaen asiakastyöntekijöitä.

- Säännölliset työajat: Työ sijoittuu arkipäiville klo 7.30–16.30 väliseen aikaan (kahdessa vuorossa).

- Käytössämme on tuotannonohjausjärjestelmä, joka tukee terveellisten ja ravitsevien ateriakokonaisuuksien koostamista.

- Työssäsi pääset kehittämään omaa ohjausosaamistasi monimuotoisessa työyhteisössä.

- Sotek säätiö tarjoaa Epassi edut ja kattavat työterveyspalvelut.


**Odotamme sinulta**

- **Kohtaamiskykyä:** Lämmin, kunnioittava ja kärsivällinen asenne vanhuksia sekä ohjattavia asiakastyöntekijöitä kohtaan.

- **Osaaminen:** Keittiöalan- koulutus ja osaaminen. Sote-alan koulutus katsotaan eduksi.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative (French)
jobs.description:
💡 As a Business Development Representative, you will play a key role in Flinn’s go-to-market success by building and qualifying a strong pipeline of high-quality opportunities. You will work at the intersection of Sales, Marketing, and Events, identifying the right prospects, starting meaningful conversations, and setting up the Sales team for successful first meetings. In this role, you will combine structured prospecting with curiosity, persistence, and strong communication skills to engage senior stakeholders at complex B2B organizations. Fluency in French is required (and in Spanish is preferred), as you will actively engage prospects across these markets. The role is based in Paris, France and includes regular collaboration with the broader go-to-market team as well as travel for conferences and customer meetings.

Why Flinn?

  • We are building a truly exceptional culture: While many companies claim to have a great culture, we invite you to discover what truly sets ours apart. Visit our career page, speak with our team, listen to our founders’ podcast, or experience our culture first-hand during the interview process.

  • Make a Meaningful Impact: Your work at Flinn contributes directly to solutions that improve people’s health and lives by making high-quality health products accessible for everyone.

  • Experienced, well-funded, highly professional: As well-funded startup veterans, we know how to sustain long-term business health and success, ensuring an environment for continuous personal growth.

What’s in it for you?

  • Join a fast-growing, well-funded European startup backed by experienced founders and investors.

  • Be part of a mission-driven health-tech company whose work directly improves people’s lives.

  • Play a key role in scaling Flinn’s GTM, shaping how we grow.

  • Work in a high-trust, low-ego environment with autonomy and clear ownership.

  • Work in a net-zero company where all unavoidable CO₂ emissions are compensated with carefully selected, high-quality removal certificates.

  • Receive one of the most employee-friendly equity packages, including fair vesting terms and profit-sharing opportunities.

  • Grow in a professional, high-standard environment that supports long-term personal and career development.

Your contributions to our journey:

  • Contribute to a strong prospecting strategy: identify and prioritize high-potential businesses across your region that are an ideal fit for Flinn.

  • Build a healthy pipeline: generate new opportunities through targeted outreach, discovery, and account research.

  • Qualify and book introductory meetings: set high-quality first conversations for the Sales team with the right stakeholders.

  • Nurture early-stage opportunities: maintain momentum with emerging leads to develop future pipeline.

  • Collaborate with Marketing & Events: convert conferences, webinars, and field activities into qualified opportunities and measurable pipeline.

What you need to be successful:

  • Strong communication, storytelling, and relationship-building skills with the ability to engage diverse stakeholders.

  • Highly energetic: being a self-starter is an absolute must.

  • Fluent in French, and English (written and spoken); fluency Spanish is a plus.

  • Persistent and driven: you thrive on overcoming objections and turning them into positive outcomes

  • Adaptability is key: you’re constantly trying new approaches, new tools, see what works, and what doesn’t

  • Willingness to travel for business meetings, conferences, and company events.

Attributes we are looking for:

  • 1+ year of experience in a commercial role, ideally as a BDR (or adjacent).

  • Proven experience running outbound sales motions (prospecting, outreach, qualification, and meeting-setting).

  • Entrepreneurial mindset and/or experience—comfortable taking ownership and operating in ambiguity.

  • Detail-oriented and highly organized, with strong problem-solving skills and excellent follow-through.

  • Committed to high-quality execution and consistently meeting deadlines.

jobs.title: Plate fitters, Meyer Turku Oy, Turku
jobs.description:
We are looking for Plate Fitters for the Meyer Turku Shipyard in Turku, Finland. The employment contract will be made directly with Meyer Turku Oy, and StaffPoint will support you throughout the recruitment process. You will have the opportunity to help build some of the world's most impressive cruise ships as part of a community of more than 2,000 professionals.

Summary

Employer: Meyer Turku Oy
Location: Meyer Turku Shipyard, Turku, Finland
Employment Type: Permanent employment
Working Hours: 40 hours per week, willingness to work shifts required
Start Date: As soon as possible
Application Deadline: 8 November 2026
Number of Positions: 2

Job Description

As a Plate Fitter, you will manufacture and assemble steel structures and ship blocks in accordance with technical drawings, quality requirements, and production schedules.

Your responsibilities include:

- Reading technical drawings and work instructions

- Measuring, marking, cutting, bending, and fitting steel plates

- Assembling steel structures and ship blocks and verifying alignments and tolerances

- Tack welding and oxy-fuel cutting as part of the fabrication process

- Identifying and reporting deviations, quality issues, and safety risks

- Collaborating with welders, supervisors, and designers

The work is performed in production halls, around the shipyard area, and outdoors in varying weather conditions. The role includes working at heights and in confined spaces while always using the required personal protective equipment.

Výroba, čalúnenie, oprava a renovácia čalúneného nábytku (stoličky, kreslá, pohovky, postele a iný nábytok). Výroba a montáž čalúnenia pre motorové vozidlá vrátane kompletného čalúnenia interiéru, obkladov, dekoratívnych prvkov a zákazkových úprav. Meranie, strihanie, príprava a spracovanie poťahových materiálov (textil, koža, ekokoža a iné materiály). Montáž výplňových materiálov (pena, vatelín, pružiny, popruhy a ďalšie čalúnnické komponenty). Šitie poťahov na priemyselných šijacích strojoch podľa potreby výroby. Poťahovanie výrobkov a upevňovanie poťahových materiálov pomocou ručného a elektrického náradia. Oprava alebo výmena poškodených častí čalúneného nábytku a interiérov vozidiel. Kontrola kvality hotových výrobkov a dodržiavanie technologických postupov. Udržiavanie čistoty pracoviska, pracovných nástrojov a výrobných priestorov. Pomoc pri nakládke, vykládke a doručovaní hotových výrobkov zákazníkom. Riadenie služobného motorového vozidla pri zabezpečovaní rozvozu alebo prepravy materiálu, ak je držiteľom platného vodičského oprávnenia. Vykonávanie pomocných a upratovacích prác podľa potrieb prevádzky. Plnenie ďalších pracovných úloh súvisiacich s výrobou, montážou, servisom a prevádzkou spoločnosti podľa pokynov zamestnávateľa. Dodržiavanie predpisov bezpečnosti a ochrany zdravia pri práci (BOZP), protipožiarnych predpisov a interných smerníc zamestnávateľa. Požiadavky na uchádzača Minimálne 3 roky preukázateľnej odbornej praxe na pozícii čalúnnik alebo v obdobnej profesii. Skúsenosti s čalúnením nábytku a výhodou sú skúsenosti s čalúnením interiérov motorových vozidiel. Manuálna zručnosť, presnosť a zodpovedný prístup k práci. Schopnosť pracovať samostatne aj v tíme. Dobrý zdravotný stav a fyzická zdatnosť. Vodičské oprávnenie skupiny B je výhodou.
Výhody:Hradené, vlastná doprava zamestnávateľa

jobs.title: Welders, Meyer Turku Oy, Turku
jobs.description:
We are looking for welders for the Meyer Turku Shipyard. The employment contract will be made directly with Meyer Turku Oy, and StaffPoint will support you throughout the recruitment process. This is your opportunity to help build some of the worlds most impressive cruise ships, working with demanding steel structures.

Summary

Employer: Meyer Turku Oy
Location: Meyer Turku Shipyard, Turku, Finland
Employment Type: Permanent employment
Working Hours: 40 hours per week, willingness to work shifts required
Start Date: as soon as possible
Application Deadline: 8.11.2026
Number of Positions: 2

Job Description

As a welder, you will join steel components and structures using approved welding methods in accordance with technical drawings, Welding Procedure Specifications (WPS), and quality requirements.

Your responsibilities include:

- Welding steel structures and components and preparing joint surfaces

- Reading technical drawings and welding symbols

- Checking welding parameters and following WPS instructions

- Performing visual inspections of your own work and identifying and reporting welding defects

- Grinding, finishing, and approved repair work

- Cooperating with platers, supervisors, and inspectors

The work is performed in production halls, around the shipyard area, and in dry docks, including outdoor environments in varying weather conditions. The role requires working at heights, in confined spaces, and in different welding positions while always using the required personal protective equipment.

What We Expect From You

- Experience in welding within industry, shipbuilding, offshore projects, or construction

- Hands-on experience with the welding process required for the role

- Ability to read technical drawings and work according to WPS and quality requirements

- Ability to inspect your own welds and recognize common welding defects

- Strong commitment to safety and quality

- Readiness to work indoors and outdoors, at heights, and in confined spaces

- Ability to communicate in either Finnish or English regarding work-related matters

Experience in shipbuilding or heavy steel structures, proficiency in multiple welding processes, and relevant vocational education in metalworking or welding are considered advantages.

Welding Skills and Qualifications

Approved welding methods may include:

- MIG/MAG

- TIG

- FCAW

- MMA

The exact welding process required will depend on the project.

Main Requirements

- Welding process: primarily 136 and 138

- Base material and thickness range: primarily carbon steel, 5 mm to 60 mm

Please attach copies of any available welding certificates to your application. The certificates will be reviewed for:

- Welding process

- Base material

- Material thickness range

- Welding positions

- Joint type

- Validity of certification

What We Offer

- Direct employment with Meyer Turku Oy

- Opportunity to work at the forefront of global shipbuilding

- Challenging and diverse welding tasks alongside experienced professionals

- A work community where everyones contribution is essential to achieving common goals

- Employee wellbeing and sports benefits, as well as support from the shipyards own occupational healthcare center

How to Apply

Submit your application and CV no later than 8.11.2026.

In your application, please describe:

- Welding processes you have used

- Materials and thicknesses you have welded

- Welding positions and joint types you are familiar with

- Your experience with WPS documentation and technical drawings

- Your valid welding certifications

- Your earliest possible starting date

We review applications on an ongoing basis and make hiring decisions as soon as suitable candidates are found.

The selection process includes:

- StaffPoint interview

- Meyer Turku interview

- Verification of qualifications

- Medical examination and drug test

- Shipyard access permit and onboarding process

The selected candidate must pass a drug test and be declared fit for the position through the occupational health assessment.

Contact Information

Siiri Tietäväinen
Recruitment Consultant
siiri.tietavainen@staffpoint.fi
+358 44 420 4427

About Meyer Turku and StaffPoint

Meyer Turku Oy builds some of the worlds most advanced and energy-efficient cruise ships, ferries, and special-purpose vessels. The company holds approximately 17% of the global cruise shipbuilding market, with major customers including Royal Caribbean and the Finnish Border Guard.

Meyer Turku employs more than 2,000 professionals at the Turku shipyard, where ships have been built since 1737. Its subsidiaries include: Piikkio Works Oy, a cabin manufacturing facility in Piikkiö, Shipbuilding Completion Oy, providing turnkey solutions for ship public spaces, ENGnD Oy, a shipbuilding and offshore engineering company located in Rauma

The company is committed to more sustainable shipbuilding and has identified five UN Agenda 2030 Sustainable Development Goals where it can make a significant impact through its operations and cooperation with customers and partners.

StaffPoint is a Finnish HR services company and serves as Meyer Turkus recruitment partner in this hiring process.


Meyer Turku

Meyer Turku Oy rakentaa maailman uudenaikaisimpia ja energiatehokkaimpia risteilyaluksia, autolauttoja ja erikoisaluksia. Turun telakalla on rakennettu laivoja vuodesta 1737 lähtien.

Meyer Turun telakalla työskentelee yli 2 000 ammattilaista ja telakalla on yli 450 eri ammattia. Jokaisen työpanosta tarvitaan yhteisen päämäärän saavuttamiseen.

Lujzy de Marillac a pridaj sa k nám do tímu opatrovateľov! Ako opatrovateľ, opatrovateľka budeš mať možnosť: ​ • prispievať k zlepšeniu zdravotného stavu klienta formou starostlivosti o osobnú hygienu klienta, či pomoci pri presune na lôžko či invalidný vozík • zabezpečovať výdaj stravy, ako aj nevyhnutného ošatenia a obuvi • asistovať pri sprevádzaní klienta k lekárovi a bežných denných aktivitách • podporovať klienta pri každodenných činnostiach • vykonávať administratívne činnosti spojené s poskytovaním služieb klientom • podieľať sa na tímových poradách a skupinových supervíziach Láka Ťa práca opatrovateľa, ale máš obavu, či to zvládneš? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude sprevádzať šikovný kolega a neskôr budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať certifikovaný opatrovateľský kurz hradený organizáciou. Okrem toho Ťa počas roka čakajú vzdelávacie programy, ktoré Ti pomôžu pri práci s klientom Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce, ktorí by radi počas štúdia pretavili svoje doterajšie vedomosti pri priamej práci s klientom v praxi Týždenný pracovný čas je 37,5h (za mesiac to je 13-14 pracovných zmien). Práca je rozložená na denné a nočné zmeny (v priemere 5-6 nočných zmien mesačne). Denná služba v čase 7:45 - 20:15h a nočná služba v čase 19:45 - 8:15h. ☝️Čo je Útulok a ZOS sv. Lujzy de Marillac a aký Ťa čaká pracovný tím? V zariadení sociálnych služieb sa už 15 rokov venujeme pomoci ľuďom ohrozeným stratou bývania alebo skúsenosťou so životom na ulici, ktorí majú zdravotné ťažkosti a častokrát nemajú dostupné možnosti k doliečeniu svojho stavu. Práve u nás im poskytujeme celodennú starostlivosť s víziou zlepšenia či stabilizovania ich zdravia. V zariadení máme kapacitu 35 klientov, väčšinou v staršom veku. Aj napriek ťažkým životným skúsenostiam našich klientov neopúšťa radosť a snaha o riešenie svojho stavu. Počas týždňa sa klienti zapájajú do rôznych aktivít, ako ranné rozcvičky, prechádzky, návšteva galérie, trhov, spoločné varenie, výroba bezodpadových podpaľovačov a iné. Náš tím opatrovateľov aktuálne tvorí osem kolegov a kolegýň spolu s vedúcou opatrovateľkou, počas dňa sa stretneš aj s vedúcim a zástupkyňou zariadenia, ako aj so sociálnymi pracovníkmi, zdravotnou sestrou a koordinátorkou aktivít. jobs.title: Terénni sociálni a zdravotní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá má zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Depaul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! ​Len v Bratislave žije odhadom viac ako 5 000 ľudí bez domova. Mnohí z nich navštevujú naše zariadenia, no ešte väčšia skupina sa ukrýva priamo v uliciach, vlastnoručne postavených príbytkoch či opustených chatrčiach. Ako najväčší terénny tím v Bratislave navštevujeme Karlovu Ves, Dúbravku, Lamač a Devínsku Novú Ves, aby sme pomáhali i tým, ktorí za nami prísť nedokážu. Našim cieľom je vyhľadávať a oslovovať ľudí bez domova v ich prirodzenom prostredí, poskytovať im sociálne a psychologické poradenstvo, základné zdravotné ošetrenie, materiálnu pomoc, sprevádzanie v kríze a prepájať ich na dostupné služby a bývanie. Veríme, že solidarita a spoločná práca môže ľuďom v núdzi darovať nádej a silu na nový začiatok. Ako terénny sociálny pracovník/sociálna pracovníčka budeš: - aktívne vyhľadávať a kontaktovať osoby a rodiny so sociálnymi problémami v rámci lokality a cieľovej skupiny (osoby z marginalizovaných rómskych komunít, ľudia bez domova), - posudzovať životné situácie človeka v spoločenskom, ekonomickom, politickom kontexte lokality/regiónu/spoločnosti, - identifikovať zdroje možností a schopností klienta a jeho sociálneho prostredia potrebných pre dosiahnutie stanovených cieľov klientom, - posky­tovať podporu v krízových situáciách osobám z cieľovej skupiny a sprístupnenie ostatných foriem pomoci, - poskytovať sociálne poradenstvo na úrovni základného a špecializovaného sociálneho poradenstva v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, - poskytovať pomoc pri uplatňovaní práv a právom chránených záujmov jednotlivca v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, príp. znevýhodnených skupín obyvateľov na lokálnej/regionálnej úrovni, - vykonávať preventívne aktivity v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách s cieľom predchádzať sociálnemu vylúčeniu alebo jeho prehlbovaniu, zmierňovanie negatívnych dopadov a zvyšovanie kvality života ľudí žijúci v podmienkach sociálneho vylúčenia a generačnej chudoby, - vykonávať aktivity, ktoré prispievajú k zmierňovaniu napätia a latentných konfliktov v lokalite, - spolupracovať s inštitúciami a organizáciami pôsobiacimi v lokalite/regióne a koordinovať ich v záujme klienta/skupiny/komunity, - sprostredkovávať kontakt, prípadne distribuovať a sprevádzať klienta k odborníkovi, do nadväzných služieb (napr. sociálne, psychologické, pedagogické, zdravotné služby a pod.) s ohľadom na potrebu klienta, - vykonávať technicko-administratívne úkony v rámci evidencie terénnej sociálnej práce, - priebežný rozvoj odborných a sociálnych kompetencií, účasť na vzdelávaní a supervíziách, - vykonávať činností prevažne v prirodzenom prostredí klienta (v domácnosti, komunite, vo voľnom priestranstve), - dodržiavať Štandardy terénnej sociálnej práce a terénnej práce vo vylúčení a Etického kódexu sociálneho pracovníka a asistenta sociálne práce Slovenskej republiky.

Na starosti budeš mať najmä: - pomocné činnosti pri poskytovaní sociálnych služieb a zabezpečovania chodu prevádzky nocľahárne - administratívne činnosti spojené s registráciou klienta, vedenie požadovanej evidencie - pripravovanie hygienických potrieb, pranie uterákov, výdaj čistých plachiet pre klientov, pranie oblečenia - upratovacie práce priestorov počas dennej služby a príprava služby na nočnú zmenu - vo výnimočných prípadoch asistencia pri sprevádzaní imobilného klienta v zariadení, pomoc pri presúvaní, atď - výdaj a/alebo príprava stravy (raňajky), výdaj potravín a ošatenia Pozri si, ako vyzerá práca za dverami nocľahárne: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1AfN4dSNk5/ :) Rozvrh pracovného času Ide o prácu na nočné (18:45h – 7:45h) a denné zmeny (7:30h – 20:00h) v nepretržitej prevádzke s týždennou pracovnou dobou 37,5h. Mesačný priemer je spravidla 9 nočných služieb a 4 denné služby. Rozvrhnutie zmien môže byť aj individuálne podľa dohody so zamestnancom​ Kto sme? Nocľaháreň sv. Vincenta de Paul je najväčšou nízkoprahovou nocľahárňou v strednej Európe. Funguje nepretržite už 20 rokov, bez prestávky každý deň v roku. Denne poskytne nocľah, teplé jedlo, sociálne poradenstvo a ďalšie služby pre 200 ľudí v núdzi. Nocľaháreň je jedným z 10 zariadení a projektov neziskovej organizácie Depaul Slovensko, ktorá poskytuje komplexné služby ľuďom bez domova. Pre činnosť našej organizácie sú najdôležitejší naši zamestnanci – Depaul ľudia – profesionáli s veľkým srdcom, trpezlivosťou a empatiou. Pracujeme v priateľskom kolektíve, podporujme vzdelávanie, supervízie a teambulidingové aktivity. Láka ťa práca v nocľahárni, ale premýšľaš, či máš dostatok skúseností? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude v práci sprevádzať skúsený tím kolegov. Postupne budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať školenia a supervízie, ktoré ti pomôžu pri práci s klientmi. Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce alebo príbuzných humanitárnych odborov, ktorí by radi svoje doterajšie vedomosti preniesli do praxe. Náš tím tvorí viacero pomáhajúcich pracovníkov a počas dňa stretneš aj skvelých sociálnych pracovníkov, koordinátorky dobrovoľníkov a komunitné organizátorky či vedúcu nocľahárne s jej zástupkyňami. Viac informácií o nocľahárni a útulku nájdeš na našej webovej stránke https://depaul.sk/, v časti Naše služby, alebo vo video vizitke: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9IufpprxiqU Tešíme sa na teba :) !

Je werkzaamheden zijn breed: van het installeren van groepenkasten en verlichting tot het oplossen van storingen in intercom- en videofoonsystemen. Als storingsmonteur elektrotechniek weet jij altijd de juiste oplossing te vinden.

Taken en verantwoordelijkheden:

Installeren van elektrotechnische systemen bij renovatie- en nieuwbouwprojecten
Verhelpen van storingen in bestaande installaties (zwak- en sterkstroom)
Werken aan intercom- en videofoonsystemen in de woningbouw
Zelfstandig uitvoeren en registreren van opdrachten
Klantvriendelijk en oplossingsgericht communiceren
Wie zoeken wij?

Voor deze vacature als elektromonteur in regio Den Haag zoeken we een ervaren en zelfstandige vakman met:

Minimaal 3 jaar werkervaring als elektromonteur of servicemonteur elektrotechniek
Ervaring in de woningbouw en/of utiliteit
Kennis van intercom- en zwakstroominstallaties is een pré
Geldig VCA-certificaat
Rijbewijs B
Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal
Klantgerichte en nauwkeurige werkhouding

Een afwisselende fulltime baan in de elektrotechniek
Goed salaris en uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden

Je komt terecht bij een betrokken familiebedrijf met jarenlange ervaring in elektrotechniek en domotica. We werken vooral in de regio Eindhoven, binnen een straal van een uur rijden.
