Je steekt de handen uit de mouwen, verdeelt het werk en schakelt gedurende de dag tussen collega's, klanten, leveranciers en transporteurs.

Dit zijn jouw taken:
Je verdeelt dagelijks het werk, stelt prioriteiten en stuurt collega's duidelijk aan. Je zorgt dat bestellingen compleet, correct en op tijd klaarstaan en werkt zelf mee met laden en lossen, hout zagen en bewerken en andere werkzaamheden op de werf.

Je ontvangt en controleert leveringen. Klopt er iets niet? Dan neem je contact op met de leverancier en zorg je dat het wordt opgelost.

Je zorgt voor een veilige en georganiseerde werf en signaleert knelpunten.

Wie zoeken wij? Je bent iemand die dingen snel oppakt en niet wacht tot een ander zegt wat er moet gebeuren. Je blijft rusti wanneer het druk wordt, durft beslissingen te nemen en communiceert duidelijk.

Daarnaast: Je hebt praktisch inzicht en leert nieuwe werkzaamheden en het assortiment snel kennen. Je kunt snelschakelen wanneer klanten, leveranciers, transporteurs en collega's tegelijk iets van je vragen.

Je communiceert duidelijk met collega klanten, transporteurs en leveranciers en durft mensen aan te sprken wanneer dat nodig is.

Je toont initiatef, ziet werk liggen en pakt het op.

Je kunt overweg met digitale ERP Systemen voor orders en voorraad, of maakt deze snel eigen.

Ervaring met hout, bouwmaterialen, logistiek of een vrgelijkbare werkomgeving is een voordeel, maar geen harde eis. Belangrijker is dat je wilt leren en steeds zelfstandiger wordt in de rol. Een heftruckcertificaat is mooi meegenomen, maar kun je ook via Daams behalen.




Daams Houthandel is een groeiend familiebedrijf met ongeveer 15 medewerkers. We leveren onder andere tuinhout, constructiehout, plaatmateriaal en bestrating aan hoveniers, aannemers en particulieren.
Als Meewerkend Voorman Werf heb je binnen Daams een belangrijke rol: jij zorgt er samen met het team voor dat het dagelijkse werk op de werf goed blijft lopen, waardoor Daams verder kan groeien.
Je krijgt verantwoordelijkheid, maar blijft zelf ook praktisch en fysiek meewerken. Daarbij krijg je de ruimte om het assortiment en de werkwijze goed te leren kennen en steeds zelfstandiger te worden in je rol.

jobs.title: Logistiek medewerker magazijn
jobs.description:
Ervaring in logistiek, magazijnwerk of orderpicken is mooi meegenomen. Belangrijker is dat je nauwkeurig werkt, fysiek werk aankunt en afspraken nakomt. Je werkt mee in een logistieke omgeving waar bestellingen zorgvuldig en op tijd verwerkt moeten worden.

Ben jij in november en december beschikbaar en wil je tijdelijk aan de slag in de logistiek? Voor een opdrachtgever in Heerhugowaard zoekt Synvio een logistiek medewerker / orderpicker die graag praktisch bezig is en helpt om bestellingen goed en op tijd klaar te maken.

Je komt te werken bij een jong bedrijf met een informele en gezellige sfeer. Het gaat om een tijdelijke functie voor de laatste weken van november tot en met kerst. Als het van beide kanten goed bevalt en er werk beschikbaar blijft, is verlenging mogelijk.

jobs.title: Medior System & Cloud Engineer
jobs.description:
Met welke techniek krijg je te maken?

Onder andere met Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID, Intune, Windows Server, Hyper V, networking, VLANs, routing, switching, WiFi, firewalls, VPN, DNS, back up en recovery, endpoint security, EDR, monitoring, scripting en automatisering. We werken daarnaast met professionele MSP tooling voor monitoring, beheer, documentatie en automatisering.

Je hoeft echt niet alles al te beheersen. Sterker nog, iemand die beweert alles te weten over ICT vertrouwen we waarschijnlijk minder dan iemand die weet wat hij nog niet weet.

Wie zoeken we?

Je hebt ongeveer vier jaar of meer relevante ervaring in ICT beheer, systeembeheer, cloud engineering of een vergelijkbare functie.
Je kunt zelfstandig technische problemen analyseren en oplossen.
Je hebt goede kennis van Microsoft 365 en moderne Microsoft omgevingen.
Je begrijpt netwerken. IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs en routing zijn voor jou geen mysterieuze afkortingen.
Je hebt affiniteit met security.
Je kunt normaal met klanten communiceren. Ook met mensen die niet begrijpen wat DNS, MFA of een VLAN is.
Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor wat je doet.
Je durft vragen te stellen en je mening te geven.
Je kunt zelfstandig werken zonder dat iemand continu over je schouder meekijkt.
En misschien wel het belangrijkste: je bent nieuwsgierig. Want ICT verandert continu en wij dus ook.

Wat verwachten we niet?

Dat je iedere technologie uit deze vacature uit je hoofd kent.
Dat je pakken draagt.
Dat je iedere minuut van je dag verantwoordt.
Dat je doet alsof je iets weet wanneer je het niet weet.
En ook niet dat werken het belangrijkste onderdeel van je leven moet zijn.
We willen gewoon goed werk leveren met mensen die hun vak leuk vinden.

Geen zin om de hele dag alleen maar tickets weg te klikken?

Mooi. Wij zoeken namelijk ook geen klassieke supportmedewerker. Bij RealNetwork zoeken we een ervaren ICTer die het vak leuk vindt en inmiddels genoeg kennis heeft opgebouwd om zelfstandig te werken, maar nog lang niet uitgeleerd is.

Iemand die een storing niet alleen oplost, maar zich ook afvraagt waarom die storing überhaupt kon ontstaan. Iemand die met een klant kan praten, een Microsoft 365 omgeving kan verbeteren, een firewall kan configureren en een netwerk kan ontwerpen. Maar die er ook geen probleem van maakt om bij een nieuwe installatie zelf een kabel te trekken of een access point op te hangen.

Kortom: iemand die ICT echt leuk vindt.

jobs.description:
Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in assetmanagement, onderhoudsengineering of technisch projectmanagement
Aantoonbare ervaring met het zelfstandig uitvoeren van analyses, implementaties of verbetertrajecten
Je kunt verschillende perspectieven techniek, proces en organisatie, met elkaar verbinden
Je schakelt makkelijk met stakeholders, begeleid collega's en houdt overzicht in dynamische projecten
je werkt gestructureerd en weet hoe je resultaten borgt in systemen, processen en gedrag,
je kent methodieken als ISO 55001 LCC, FME(C)A of ITIL en weet deze toe te passen
afgeronde HBO of WO-opleiding
stevige persoonlijkheid met een scherp analytisch vermogen
klantgericht, professioneel en communiceert makkelijk met verchillende lagen in een organisatie

Werken bij Compris:
Bij Compris doen ze het net even anders. Er werken zo'n 45 bevlogen assetmanagement professionals die allemaal een zwak hebben voor techniek. Geen logge organisatie, maar korte lijnen, een betrokken directie en volop ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen.
Je werkt hier in een omgeving waar inhoud telt, maar menselijkheid net zo belangrijk is. Samen met collega's die niet alleen energie krijgen van het helpen van klanten, maar ook van elkaar.
Wat je gaat doen:
Als medior consultant pak je zelfstandig assetmanagementtrajecten op van begin tot eind. Je combineert tactisch advies met gewoon doen, en juist daar maak je het verschil. Je werkt aan projecten zoals het inrichten van prestatiecontracten op luchthavens of het slimmer maken van onderhoudsprocessen in de industrie.
Je vertaalt strategie naar uitvoering en zorgt dat plannen ook echt landen. Of het nu gaat om het opzetten van programmeringsprocessen bij een waterbedrijf of het verbeteren van storingsregistratie en werkvoorbereiding in onderhoudssoftware, jij brengt structuur en overzicht.
Je schakelt makkelijk met verschillende stakeholders en weet belangen bij elkaar te brengen in een duidelijke aanpak. Thema's als risico gestuurd onderhoud, datagedreven werken en het vertalen van beleid naar concrete onderhoudsplannen? Daar draai jij je hand niet voor om.
En ondertussen help je ook collega's vooruit. Je begeleidt junior consultants en draagt actief bij aan het delen en borgen van kennis binnen Compris.

In jouw dagelijkse werk coach en motiveer je collega s en externe partijen rondom veiligheid en gedrag. Je neemt deel aan SHEQ-overleggen, zowel intern als met klanten. Adviseren, trainen en coachen van medewerkers over operationele veiligheidsvraagstukken
Deelnemen aan SHEQ-overleggen (intern en extern)
Uitvoeren van incidentonderzoeken en risicoanalyses
Opstellen van SHEQ-rapportages en registreren van meldingen

jobs.title: Schoonmaker Maandag & Vrijdag
jobs.description:

De accommodaties zijn vakantiewoningen. Iedere maandag en vrijdag ben jij beschikbaar. MvH biedt je gratis vervoer aan, rij zeker met ons mee.

Enjoy a job on the coast of Zeeland. You enjoy making the holiday homes look clean and tidy again. As part of the MVH cleaning team you work in Cadzand, at a beautiful holiday park. The accommodations are gorgeous holiday homes. You are available every Monday and/or Friday. With our bus you can be picked up and drive to Cadzand-Bad to deliver the houses spick and span from 10.00 to 16.00 o'clock.

Functie-informatie:
Met ons team ga je met onze bus naar de locatie in Cadzand. We hebben opstapplaatsen in Hulst, Axel, en Terneuzen. Jij maakt de huisjes snel en goed schoon, zodat de nieuwe gasten kunnen genieten van hun welverdiende vakantie. Het werk houdt o.a. in: stofzuigen, natte ruimtes schoonmaken, afstoffen, bedden afhalen en eventueel een raam schoonmaken als het te vies is.
Heb jij oog voor netheid, ben je secuur en zie jij wat anderen niet zien? Meld je dan nu aan en kom terecht in onze leuke pool van werknemers en ga samen met je collega s aan de slag.
Je werkt op maandag en vrijdag van 10:00 uur tot 16:00 uur in Cadzand. soms ook op dinsdag en Donderdag alles is in overleg mogelijk. Wanneer er wordt gevraagd wat langer door te werken, is dat uiteraard geen probleem voor jou.
De CAO schoonmaak vergoedt geen reistijd en reiskosten. Volgens CAO mag je een uurtarief van 14,40 verwachten.

Jij maakt het mogelijk als dorpshuisbeheerder. Bedrijfsinformatie Een kleine gemeente, met veel mogelijkheden. Dat is de gemeente Noord-Beveland, jouw nieuwe werkgever. Vanuit het dorpshuis in Wissenkerke werk je zelfstandig, maar met nauw contact met de gemeente Noord-Beveland, voor de 8000 inwoners van de gemeente. Jij houdt je bezig met het: Beheer en verhuur van zalen; opzetten en/of faciliteren van maatschappelijke activiteiten; verzorgen van consumpties tijdens verhuur bij feesten en partijen; schoon en netjes houden van de accommodatie; alle overige voorkomende werkzaamheden voortvloeiend uit de functie. Je hebt of bent bereid te

behalen: Verklaring Sociale Hygiëne; Inschrijving Kamer van Koophandel als zelfstandige onderneming; Bedrijfshulpverlening (BHV). Your job
Are you motivated to advance operational forest disturbance monitoring using radar satellite data and to contribute to global efforts to understand and combat forest loss?
We are seeking a highly motivated postdoctoral researcher to advance near-real-time forest disturbance and regrowth monitoring using radar satellite observations. The position combines methodological research with the further development and operation of the RADD (Radar for Detecting Deforestation) forest disturbance alerts , using established and newly available radar satellite missions, including Sentinel-1 and NISAR.
Radar remote sensing is particularly valuable for forest monitoring because of its sensitivity to vegetation structure and its ability to provide systematic observations largely independent of daylight and cloud cover. Translating these observations into accurate, consistent, and operational information on forest disturbance and post-disturbance regrowth, however, remains challenging. Radar responses are influenced by wavelength, acquisition geometry, forest structure, seasonality, and environmental conditions.
The project will address these challenges in two main directions. First, you will extend the RADD framework from disturbance detection towards continuous forest change monitoring, including the detection and characterization of post-disturbance forest regrowth and structural recovery. Second, you will expand the geographic applicability of the RADD alerts beyond their current implementations in the humid tropics and Europe.

jobs.title: Senior Security Operations Engineer
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a member of our Security Operations Team, you will collaborate with a global team of engineers to monitor and respond to security events, lead security incidents as Incident Commander, and lead digital forensic investigations in support of Employee Relations, Legal, Compliance, or Information Security cases.

Although you will be focused on security incident response, you will also have the opportunity to create and maintain runbooks, and automated workflows, and assist in process refinement and implementation. You will collaborate with a diverse team of engineers, and key stakeholders on security initiatives across the company. Above all, your focus is bringing Security expertise to the table in a collaborative, humble, and practical manner.

Location: This role is open to candidates residing in Netherlands

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will: 

  • Monitor security events and provide technical analysis on alerts
  • Lead information security incidents and employee insider investigations by developing the incident response strategy, lead the execution through incident closure, while providing incident updates to key stakeholders throughout the incident
  • Deliver security guidance clearly and concisely for incident response and insider threat initiatives
  • Coordinate the building of services, capabilities, integrations, and implementations of technologies to support security operations, incident response, and insider threat
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
  • Participate in our on-call rota covering weekends

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years of experience in Security Incident Response
  • Ability to communicate investigative findings and strategies to technical staff, executive leadership, and legal
  • Ability to build scripts or tools to support Samsara's investigation processes, with proficiency in Python
  • Mentor and train security operation engineers on data collection, analysis, and reporting technical analysis
  • Practical experience acting as a lead during security incident response, including monitoring and triaging alerts, and coordinating across teams
  • Understanding of analysis and forensics techniques on macOS, Windows, and Linux
  • Experience utilizing SIEM tools to perform log reviews
  • Experience in cloud architecture and security (AWS, GCP) and cloud-based services
  • Participation in an on-call rotation, with the potential to work outside standard business hours, including late evenings, when responding to high-severity incidents as part of our global incident response team.
  • This role will be part of our EMEA so your hours will be aligned to the UK. As an operational time you may be expected to work flexible hours around this to support the load of the team

An ideal candidate also has:

  • 2+ years of experience working on insider threat initiatives or employee investigations
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field - or relevant industry experience
  • GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH) or similar Certification
  • Familiarity with common security frameworks and standards, including NIST Cybersecurity Framework, ISO 27001, FedRAMP

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. jobs.title: Research Engineer, GPU Performance
jobs.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

About the Role

As a Research Engineer, GPU performance, you will sit at the heart of that spectrum: your low-level work directly determines how fast our frontier models can be trained and served. Working hand-in-hand with Research Scientists, you'll make every GPU count.

Mistral AI is hiring an expert in pushing large language model's GPU utilization and performance to their limits.. In this role, you will own the performance of our models end-to-end: writing the low-level code that extracts the maximum capacity from high-end hardware, and rethinking model architectures so they run efficiently at scale.

What You Will Do

  • Develop low-level code that takes full advantage of high-end GPUs and maxes out their capacity — from custom kernels to memory-layout and communication optimisations.

  • Rethink parts of the generative model architecture to make them more suitable for efficient inference, in collaboration with Research Scientists.

  • Integrate low-level efficient code into a high-level MLOps framework, so that optimisations benefit every training run and deployment rather than a single experiment.

  • Profile, benchmark and squeeze performance out of large-scale training and inference on thousands of GPUs.

  • Model LLM execution on various GPUs with high fidelity to assess hardware usage and build serving performance estimates.

What We're Looking For

  • High technical competence for writing custom low-level kernels and pushing GPUs to their limits.

  • High expertise in the distributed computation infrastructure of current-generation GPU clusters.

  • Overall understanding of the field of generative AI; knowledge of, or interest in, fine-tuning and using language models for applications.

  • Strong software-design instincts: testing, code review, CI/CD.

  • Self-starter, low-ego, collaborative.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

Missions principales

  • Concevoir et modéliser sous Fusion 360 et Solidworks des pièces et sous-ensembles : structures, carters, supports, fixations, interfaces

  • Concevoir des mécanismes imprimés en 3D : charnières, verrouillages, clips, pièces mobiles

  • Intégrer les composants électroniques dans la CAO : implantation des cartes, moteurs, ESC, batteries et capteurs, passage des câbles, refroidissement, accessibilité pour la maintenance

  • Appliquer les règles de conception FDM et autres procédés : orientation, épaisseurs, jeux et tolérances d'assemblage, inserts, limitation des supports

  • Structurer les assemblages (paramétrage, composants réutilisables) pour faciliter les évolutions

  • Assurer la gestion des versions des fichiers CAO

  • Réaliser des conceptions paramétriques et modifiables

Prototypage rapide (15 %)

  • Enchaîner des cycles courts conception → impression 3D → test → correction

  • Préparer les impressions sous OrcaSlicer et assembler les prototypes

  • Faire évoluer les designs à partir des retours d'impression et d'essais

Plans et documentation de production (10 %)

  • Réaliser les mises en plan et les nomenclatures des pièces et sous-ensembles validés

  • Participer à la rédaction des gammes de montage et des instructions d'assemblage

  • Participer aux modifications des schémas de câblage

Essais (5 %)

  • Participer aux essais de validation : banc, sol et, le cas échéant, essais en vol encadrés

  • Présenter régulièrement l'avancement à l'équipe technique

Profil recherché

Formation et expérience

  • Bac+2/+3 (BTS CPRP ou CPI, BUT GMP, licence pro) en conception mécanique, génie mécanique ou mécatronique

Compétences techniques

  • Bonne maîtrise d'un logiciel de CAO 3D, idéalement Autodesk Fusion et SolidWorks (CATIA ou d'autres)

  • Conception de mécanismes et d'assemblages

  • Règles de conception pour l'impression 3D FDM ; pratique d'OrcaSlicer ou d'un autre slicer

  • Mise en plan, cotation et tolérancement

  • Bases en électronique embarquée : lecture de schémas, câblage, soudure

Atouts

  • Connaissance du monde des drones (multirotors, voilure fixe, ArduPilot / PX4)

  • Notions d'aérodynamique (portance, traînée, profils, hélices)

  • Projets personnels ou associatifs en drone, robotique ou impression 3D (portfolio CAO apprécié)

  • Intérêt pour l'aéronautique, le spatial ou la défense

Qualités personnelles

  • Goût pour le prototypage et le travail « hands-on » et la CAO "bien faite"

  • Rigueur et sens du détail, indispensables dans un contexte défense où la fiabilité des pièces est critique

  • Autonomie, force de proposition et esprit d'équipe

jobs.description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

About the Programme

This is a structured 18–24 month global programme designed to launch high-potential commercial careers. You don’t need prior sales or payments experience; what you need is ambition, curiosity, resilience, and the drive to build relationships and solve complex problems.

You will join a global cohort of Business Development Representatives (BDRs) with structured learning, dedicated coaching from sales leaders, and real commercial responsibility from month one. Throughout the programme, you will master enterprise sales: researching strategic accounts, engaging senior decision-makers, conducting sharp discovery conversations, and building pipeline that drives real business growth.

High performers transition into Sales, Account Management, and other commercial roles across the business. Many of our top commercial leaders, including our Chief Revenue Officer, started their journey at Checkout.com as BDRs or interns. Whether you are a recent graduate, an early-career professional with 1–3 years of experience, or a career switcher, what matters most is your hunger to learn and achieve.

What You’ll Do

  • Research Strategic Accounts: Identify high-value targets by researching key organizations, industries, and executive stakeholders.

  • Initiate High-Impact Outreach: Open doors with senior decision-makers using personalized outreach across email, phone, and LinkedIn.

  • Build Qualified Pipeline: Drive consistent growth momentum through disciplined prospecting, rigorous follow-up, and account mapping.

  • Run Consultative Discovery: Uncover merchants' technical and business challenges to align Checkout.com’s solutions with their goals.

  • Partner on Live Deals: Work alongside Sales Representatives to support opportunities through to deal execution.

  • Leverage AI & Modern Tech: Use CRM, intent data, and approved AI tools to streamline research, refine outreach, and work smarter.

Who We’re Looking For

We welcome applications from recent graduates and professionals with 1–3 years of experience looking to change careers. Regardless of your background, we are looking for the following core skills to set you up for success:

  • Driven & Goal-Oriented: You set high personal standards, work hard, and stay motivated when tackling challenging commercial goals.

  • Resilient & Adaptable: You bounce back quickly from rejection, view obstacles as practice, and maintain consistent output.

  • Relational & Engaging: You genuinely enjoy starting conversations, asking sharp questions, and building trust with diverse stakeholders.

  • Track Record of Achievement: You demonstrate drive and ownership through professional, academic, athletic, or entrepreneurial success.

  • Commercial & Tech Curiosity: You are eager to learn complex fintech products and use AI and sales tools to work smarter.

jobs.title: Director, Luxury Market Intelligence & Insights
jobs.description:
We are growing! We are currently looking to hire a Director, Luxury Market Intelligence & Insights.  

About CXG:

Founded in 2006, CXG is a global customer experience company uniquely positioned at the intersection of data-driven retail performance, customer experience transformation, and operational execution across 200+ luxury brands worldwide.

The mission of our 270 collaborators is to help brands transform customer and employee experiences through tailored insights, strategy, and implementation.

We are passionate about delivering impact.

Our clients include the world's most admired luxury houses, and our solutions combine research, technology, and human expertise to elevate every customer interaction.

We are looking for a thought leadership expert with the editorial vision to spot what matters next, the conviction to shape CXG's point of view, and the writing talent to make it influential across luxury retail, beauty and cosmetics, watches and jewellery, automotive, and hospitality.

Context and role

Reporting to the Chief of Staff, you will lead CXG's Thought Leadership and Market Intelligence functions. You will define the topics on which CXG should have a distinctive and credible point of view, turn CXG's proprietary data, expertise and market knowledge into original external content, and position the company ahead of emerging developments in customer experience, luxury and its priority verticals.

This is a hands-on role: you will research, analyse, write and produce content yourself, while mobilising expertise and data from across the business. You will be accountable for ensuring that every publication presents a recognisable CXG angle rather than simply reporting market developments or repeating established industry views. You will manage one Market Intelligence team member.

Thought Leadership Development

  • Define the thought leadership strategy and roadmap, including priority themes, target audiences, formats and a realistic publication calendar.
  • Drive and coordinate content creation across Practices, Solutions and Regions.
  • Work closely with Practices, Regions and Solutions to:
    • Push: scan for trends and hot topics and ensure CXG has a voice and perspective, commenting regularly on these subjects.
    • Pull: identify and collect new ideas and proposed topics from the relevant stakeholders, prioritise and incorporate them into the thought leadership roadmap.
  • Use market intelligence, CXG's proprietary data, internal expertise and client-facing insights to identify emerging topics early, develop a clear CXG point of view and decide where CXG can make a credible contribution to the conversation.
  • Research, interview internal experts, write and edit articles, perspectives and other thought leadership content directly. Challenge generic claims and ensure each piece advances a clear argument and is supported by credible evidence.
  • Ensure that analysis is methodologically sound, appropriately contextualised and presented without compromising client confidentiality.
  • Develop topics that connect expertise across Practices and Regions, while reflecting relevant differences between markets.

Thought Leadership Communication

  • Ensure relevant thought leadership pieces (e.g., perspectives, publications) are disseminated on a periodic basis.
  • Work with Marketing on the publication, distribution and promotion of content, while retaining ownership of the editorial strategy, substance, quality and consistency of CXG's point of view. In addition, collaborate with Marketing to maximise impact by communicating through the channels relevant to each market.
  • Track the reach, engagement and qualitative response generated by CXG's thought leadership, as well as relevant business enquiries influenced by published content. Use the findings to refine the roadmap.
  • Shape and host or contribute to CXG's podcast "The Luxury Edit", working with internal experts and guests to develop topics, prepare interviews and turn conversations into useful content.
  • Develop the content and key messages for CXG-hosted events and external conferences, panels and talks; act as a CXG speaker where appropriate; and work with internal experts to prepare other CXG speakers and turn the company's point of view into compelling presentations and discussion topics.
  • Look for and test new thought leadership formats (e.g., interactive reports, data visualisations, short-form video, newsletters, social-first content) to broaden reach, engage new audiences and keep CXG's content distinctive.
  • Identify and build collaborations with conferences, specialised industry magazines and universities (e.g., content partnerships, guest articles, co-branded publications, joint research, guest lectures, speaking slots) to extend CXG's visibility and credibility with target audiences.

Market Intelligence

  • Keep abreast of market and competitive developments and ensure relevant findings are communicated across CXG.
  • Translate these findings into clear implications for CXG's strategic priorities, client conversations, commercial opportunities and external thought leadership.
  • Contribute market intelligence, evidence and relevant CXG perspectives to priority proposals and client deliverables, working with Practices, Solutions and Regions to strengthen the quality and relevance of the final output.
  • Manage and develop the Market Intelligence team member, setting clear priorities and reviewing the quality and usefulness of their work.

Competitive Analysis

  • Develop and continuously update a list of CXG competitors.
  • Research competitor performance, including revenues and market share where reliable information is available.
  • Identify and assess the impact of new competitors' offerings.
  • Review competitors' thought leadership, influence and presence.
  • Identify gaps in the conversations competitors are leading and opportunities for CXG to establish a distinct position.

Industry Analysis

  • Research and review clients' developments (e.g., new strategy, launch of new product or service, restructuring, M&A, key managerial appointments).
  • Track public financial announcements (e.g., quarterly and annual earnings).
  • Monitor developments in luxury, retail, customer experience and adjacent sectors; distinguish lasting shifts from short-lived topics and explain their implications for CXG and its clients.
  • Publish the weekly "This Week in Luxury" news brief and issue timely flash updates when significant developments require immediate attention, such as financial announcements, major transactions or leadership changes.

Internal Dissemination and Application

  • Synthesise research and findings into concise, actionable outputs tailored to the needs of relevant internal stakeholders. Feed findings into the Thought Leadership roadmap.
  • Proactively bring relevant market signals to Practices, Regions and leadership early enough to inform decisions, client conversations and potential cross-practice opportunities.
  • Disseminate new thought leadership across CXG and equip Practices, Regions and client-facing teams with the key messages and supporting materials needed to use it in client conversations and commercial activities.

Requirements

What will you bring along?

    • Proven experience developing thought leadership, editorial content or insight-led communications in a consulting, research, customer experience, retail or luxury environment.
    • Excellent English writing and editing skills, with a portfolio demonstrating original, well-argued, evidence-led articles or publications written personally. If possible, include examples that turn proprietary research, data or specialist expertise into a distinctive point of view. Additional languages (e.g., French, Mandarin) are a plus.
    • Strong oral communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to represent CXG as a speaker at conferences, panels and client events.
    • Proven ability to build relationships and influence senior stakeholders across functions and regions without direct authority.
    • An established network or demonstrated ability to build partnerships with media, conference organisers, academic institutions or industry bodies.
    • Comfort working with quantitative data and research methods, and the ability to translate data into clear, credible narratives and visualisations.
    • Ability to define and track content performance indicators and use them to refine editorial priorities.
    • Strong research and analytical skills: able to assess sources critically, connect market signals and form a clear point of view rather than simply summarise trends.
    • Familiarity with AI-assisted research and content tools, used with appropriate rigour.
    • Sound knowledge of luxury, retail and customer experience, and curiosity about how these sectors are evolving across markets.
    • Ability to interview senior experts, challenge ideas constructively and turn specialist knowledge into accessible, credible content.
    • Comfort working independently in a remote setting, managing an editorial roadmap and delivering finished work without a large production team.
    • Experience managing or coaching at least one team member.
    • Confidence preparing and hosting interviews or podcasts is a plus.

The International Supply Chain Manager manages relationships with non-US external vendors and suppliers, ensuring contractual obligations are fulfilled while protecting the organization's interests, maintaining compliance, and optimizing.

Relocation provided
Travel expected up to 25% of the time
Interviews may will include a technical assessment

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Global Supplier Development & Relationship Management

International Contract & Financial Management

Negotiate and administer agreements compliant with multiple legal jurisdictions and international standards
Leverage global market intelligence to secure optimal pricing while balancing quality and risk
Manage currency fluctuations, payment terms, and financial controls across international transactions
Maintain comprehensive documentation of all contract activities and changes

Global Compliance & Risk Mitigation

Ensure adherence to international trade regulations, export/import laws, and country-specific requirements
Identify and address risks unique to global procurement (political instability, logistics disruptions, trade disputes)
Implement appropriate risk management strategies through contract terms, insurance requirements, and contingency planning
Coordinate quality assurance across international suppliers to maintain consistent standards

Global Supply Chain Optimization

Manage international logistics, customs clearance, and documentation requirements
Implement efficiency improvements in global procurement processes and inventory management
Generate performance analytics on international supplier metrics and compliance reporting
Stay informed about international market trends and regional business conditions that impact supply chain decisions

Strategic Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner with legal, finance, engineering, and logistics teams across global operations
Align international procurement activities with organizational objectives and program requirements
Facilitate effective communication between international suppliers and internal stakeholders
Serve as subject matter expert on global sourcing strategies and international supply markets

Minimum Qualifications:

Education: Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, international business, or related field
Experience: 5+ years in international procurement or supplier management
Language Skills: Proficiency in multiple languages relevant to key supplier regions
Knowledge: Understanding of international trade laws, customs regulations, and global logistics
Travel Capability: Willingness to travel internationally (typically 20-30%)
Cultural Competence: Demonstrated ability to work effectively across cultures and business environments
Technical Skills: Proficiency with global procurement systems and international payment platforms
Domain Expertise: Engineering, Manufacturing or Procurement experience across multiple aerospace domains and commodities

Preferred Qualifications:

Bachelors degree and/or previous working experience as an Engineer, Apprentice or Technician
Experience working in a multi-cultural environment with both internal and external customers and stakeholders
Experience with ISO 9001, AS9100, or other quality management systems in aerospace
Fluent in multiple languages

jobs.description:
Votre mission :

    Vous préparerez les plans de conception, d'approbation et d'exécution des infrastructures techniques sur la base de données topographiques ou de plans d'architecte.

    Vous réalisez des études techniques sur la base de cahiers des charges.

    Vous proposez des solutions techniques ou les mettez en œuvre dans le détail.

    Vous modélisez les girations horizontale et verticale.

MIBL provides a wide range of financial services to institutional investors including depositary, custody, fund administration, and other banking-related services.

MIBL now has an opening in its Compliance Department for a:

                                                                                                                                                                                            
Senior Financial Crime Compliance Officer (CDI)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   (Ref:MIBLSFCCO_092026)

About the Role

The role focuses on coordinating the collection, consolidation, and analysis of compliance information, performing oversight reviews, assessing compliance governance arrangements, and supporting the implementation and maintenance of effective compliance and reporting frameworks across the organization.

Responsibilities

• Coordinate the collection, consolidation and analysis of compliance information received from affiliated entities and internal stakeholders for governance, oversight, and reporting purposes.
• Perform oversight reviews to assess compliance with group policies, regulatory requirements, internal standards, and governance frameworks.
• Review periodic compliance reports, key risk indicators, incidents, breaches, complaints, regulatory developments, and remediation actions to identify trends, emerging risks and areas requiring escalation.
• Assess the adequacy and effectiveness of compliance governance arrangements, policies, procedures, and internal control frameworks.
• Conduct thematic reviews and targeted assessments covering governance, conduct, regulatory compliance, outsourcing oversight, conflicts of interest, regulatory reporting, and related compliance risk areas.
• Support the implementation and maintenance of an effective information collection, escalation, and reporting framework across the organization.
• Evaluate whether identified findings represent isolated issues, recurring deficiencies or broader governance and control weaknesses.
• Ensure timely escalation of material issues, overdue actions, and significant compliance matters.
• Review and challenge information submitted by stakeholders to ensure completeness, accuracy, and consistency.
• Support the implementation of regulatory change initiatives and assess the impact of new regulatory requirements on the compliance framework.
• Assist in maintaining governance documentation, compliance inventories, registers, frameworks, and oversight records.
• Support continuous improvement initiatives aimed at strengthening compliance oversight, transparency, reporting quality and regulatory readiness.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Law, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

Required Skills

• Typically, 4–5+ years of relevant experience in Compliance Monitoring, Internal Audit, Risk, or a comparable control function within financial services, including demonstrable experience performing independent monitoring or control testing.
• Knowledge of Luxembourg and EU regulatory requirements and supervisory expectations including on CRD/CRR, Outsourcing, ICAAP/ILAAP, Financial Crime, PSR/PSD.
• Experience supporting multi-entity governance models, cross-border oversight, or consolidated compliance frameworks.
• Sound judgement when determining the materiality and severity of findings.
• Ability to challenge stakeholders constructively and independently.

• Analyser les variations par rapport aux objectifs et par rapport à l'année précédente, en coordination avec la Direction Commerciale, en comprendre la cause et définir des plans d'actions adéquats pour sécuriser la réalisation des objectifs.
• Définir les actions commerciales dites « challenges » en coordination avec la Direction Commerciale : définir les critères en cohérence avec les priorités du plan stratégique, en prenant en considération les aspects de disponibilité des informations, de communication fluide et transparente avec les réseaux et les contraintes de compliance.
• Assurer le suivi des actions commerciales, notamment mesurer la performance commerciale (taux de conversion, etc).
• Suivre la rentabilité des points de vente en coordination avec l'actuariat business et notamment, calcul de l'intéressement technique pour les points de vente concernés.

Responsabilités ad-hoc :

• Mener des analyses ciblées, à la demande et en conjonction avec la direction commerciale, par exemple sur le taux de multi-détention, l'impact d'une campagne marketing sur le chiffre d'affaires…etc
• Participer aux réflexions et mesures d'impact en cas de modification des conventions et des schémas de rémunération des intermédiaires, en étant vigilant et critique face aux contraintes règlementaires et à l'enjeu de rester attractif pour nos clients & intermédiaires.

Assurer un lien continu entre les Directions Finance et Commerciale :

• Favoriser une culture financière au sein de la Direction Commerciale en apportant un angle financier aux réunions de suivi commercial en fournissant aux ARMAs les outils et tableaux de bord nécessaires à l'animation du réseau. Le cas échéant, organiser des formations ciblées.
• Analyser la performance commerciale, à la lumière des informations remontées du terrain.

Assurer un lien avec la Direction IT / Equipe Data :

• Solliciter la Direction IT / Equipe Data pour la production des rapports et des extractions nécessaires à l'exécution des missions.
• Veiller à la qualité des données mises à disposition des équipes commerciales et des intermédiaires, notamment les données de rémunération des intermédiaires.
• Mise en place de contrôles et de réconciliations avec les reportings Finance.

Votre profil  

• Vous êtes titulaire d'un master à orientation économique, en mathématiques ou statistiques.
• Vous bénéficiez d'une expérience de 3 à 5 ans au sein d'une Direction Finance ou d'une Direction Commerciale. L'expérience dans le secteur financier ou assuranciel représente un atout.
• Vous maitrisez Excel et les outils de bases de données.
• Vous manifestez une forte appétence, à la fois commerciale et pour l'analyse et les chiffres. Vous manifestez une aisance pour manipuler, synthétiser et expliquer les chiffres.
• Vous avez une fibre commerciale et une excellente orientation client.
• Vous possédez d'excellentes capacités à travailler en équipe avec plusieurs Directions.
• Vous travaillez en autonomie et vous bénéficiez d'une excellente capacité d'organisation.
• Vous maîtrisez le français et l'anglais.

Vos avantages

Vous avez envie de mettre votre énergie et votre talent au service de nos clients et de la société dans son ensemble ? Faites partie de notre grande famille en rejoignant :

• Un cadre stimulant où la formation continue permet sans cesse d'enrichir ses compétences et développer son employabilité ;

We see a world of opportunity. From uncovering ways to digitalize, to enabling new sectors to take off, to building sustainability and resilience into economies, we know insights reveal new opportunities for all.

Job Description

We are seeking for a Digital Risk Oversight Expert.

The Digital Risk Oversight Expert will play a crucial role in ensuring that the organization's digital security risks are effectively identified, monitored, and managed. This position focuses on oversight and governance, ensuring that solutions, processes, and behaviors align with KPMG policies, standards, and security best practices. The expert will provide independent oversight and advisory support to the first line of defense, contributing to a robust digital risk management framework.
What you will be working on

Independent Reviews

• Conduct independent reviews of security controls and provide actionable recommendations for improvement.
• Assess and validate the adequacy of security measures implemented by the first line of defense.

Security Processes Implementation

• Elaborate, implement, and monitor security-related processes to ensure compliance with established standards.
• Lead investigations on security incidents, containing, mitigating, and reporting the impact effectively. Ensure root cause analysis and lessons learned are addressed effectively.

Reporting & Metrics

• Produce regular reports on the state of information security and key risks for senior management and stakeholders.
• Track key performance indicators (KPIs) and key risk indicators (KRIs) to evaluate security effectiveness.
• Identify, evaluate, and report on the criticality of identified vulnerabilities and prioritize remediation based on potential business impact.

Training & Development

• Elaborate and deliver training sessions to all stakeholders to strengthen the security culture within the organization.
• As an Expert, coach, motivate and review the work done by junior team members.

Collaboration & Liaison

• Work closely with the first line of defense to address security gaps and vulnerabilities.
• Liaise with third parties, auditors, and regulators on security matters, ensuring compliance with relevant regulations.

What we look for

Technical Skills & Qualifications

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in IT, ideally with a specialty in Information Security.
• At least 8 years of experience with information security concepts and practices.
• Knowledge of IT security standards (ITIL, ISO27001, OWASP, etc.).
• Proficiency in IT security tools (Firewall, EDR, IPS N/H, WAF, SIEM, DLP, Compliance, etc.).
• Strong knowledge in network security and incident management.
• Strong Cloud security knowledge and IT Security certifications are an advantage e.g. CCSP, AZ- 500
• Strong Knowledge on development technologies and languages.

Experience & Knowledge

• Ability to lead security assessments and audits.
• Strong understanding of cybersecurity threats and vulnerabilities
• Experience in vulnerability management and cloud security.
• Excellent communication and management skills.
• Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment.
• Motivated and organized, capable of taking ownership of projects from A to Z while respecting tight deadlines and being receptive to new ideas.
• Strong issue resolution skills with a focus on risk controls and client focus.

What will you get

We offer more than jobs. With our flexible work model, you can enjoy work and rest and recharge. Our competitive compensation packages, paid time away from work, recognition bonuses and dedicated programs for personal development and wellbeing help to keep everyone refreshed and motivated.

SD-26155- POST-DOC SOIL HEALTH AND REMEDIATION

Fixed term contract | Belvaux | 24 Months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defense technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

As part of LIST's SUSTAIN unit (Environmental Sustainability Assessment and Circularity), the Environmental Policies (EPS) group provides science-based input to the definition and implementation of environmental policies at national and EU level, in particular policies around chemical safety, soil pollution, circular (bio-)economy (e.g. construction, textile, water), and climate - and feeds, at the interface of science, technologies and policies, the regulatory perspective into RDI projects around these topics.

As postdoc (R&T Scientist), you will further strengthen the activities around soil health and the management of contaminated sites via contributing to:
• The further development (implementation-phase) of an Urban Soil Living Lab in Luxembourg (Horizon Europe project URSOILL - Innovative Solutions for Sustainable Urban Soil Restoration Through Living Labs) and participation in a working group on soil remediation and stabilization with nature-based solutions, especially phytoremediation and phytomanagement. Main tasks: literature review; design of field experiments and monitoring protocols across multiple urban sites; support and supervision of fieldwork; data analysis and interpretation; stakeholder engagement in the Living Lab; and scientific publications and project deliverables.
• The establishment of a cross-border network of ‘Lighthouses' of phytomanagement for soil remediation, biodiversity and the regenerative economy in the Greater Region (Interreg project Light4Green),
• Scientific and regulatory support, e.g. via bibliography and the preparation of a review article, on nature-based remediation solutions for Persistent organic pollutants (POPs) contamination (Interreg project Naturem),
• The set-up of a laboratory for testing and evaluating soil remediation technologies (especially bioremediation and phytoremediation),
• Support the definition, submission and implementation of research and collaborative project proposals of the group, and participate to the network of LIST's different activities around soil protection.

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!
Education

• You hold a Master's degree and a PhD in soil or environmental sciences/engineering, or another relevant natural science or engineering domain.
• You have practical and solid experience in the design, testing, evaluation and application of nature-based soil remediation technologies, e.g. phytoremediation, bioremediation, mycoremediation.
• Interdisciplinary thinking, well-developed communication skills (oral and written) and team spirit to successfully integrate into the multicultural, multilingual and multidisciplinary work environment at LIST and effectively communicate with LIST's partners,
• Client orientation mindset and great sense of service are required. The candidate should be highly motivated, pro-active and open for new challenges and can work independently,
• Not mandatory but considered an asset:
o First experience in an RTO/academic environment, scientific/technical consulting, authorities, or industry on contaminated site management, pollution risk assessment or remediation
o Knowledge of Luxembourg and the Greater Region

Language skills

• Fluency in English, both oral and written. Other relevant languages, especially French, German, or Luxembourgish are a strong asset.

Your LIST benefits

• An organization with a passion for impact and strong RDI partnerships in Luxembourg and Europe that works on responsible and independent research projects
• Sustainable by design, empowering our belief that we play an essential role in paving the way to a green society
• Innovative infrastructures and exceptional labs occupying more than 5,000 square metres, including innovations in all that we do
• An environment encouraging curiosity, innovation and entrepreneurship in all areas
• Personalized learning programme to foster our staff's soft and technical skills
• Multicultural and international work environment with more than 60 nationalities represented in our workforce
• Diverse and inclusive work environment empowering our people to fulfil their personal and professional ambitions

jobs.title: Lead AI Engineer
jobs.description:
We are AI builders

Since 2018, Enjins has done one thing: ship AI that works in production. From Utrecht and Berlin, we build machine learning systems, data infrastructure, and agentic AI layers for European tech companies, with a deliberate focus on climate and energy, where we believe the biggest technological shift of our generation should meet its most critical challenge.

We embed directly with the engineering teams of high-growth scale-ups like Crisp, PlanBlue, NextSense, and Groendus. We take ownership of the full technical lifecycle: from first architecture decision to a production-grade system running inside our partner's infrastructure, long after go-live.

The role

As Lead AI Engineer, you are the technical owner of client engagements. You architect the solution, ship it to production, and make sure it still performs a year later. Alongside the other Leads, you shape the engineering team and the way we build.

In practice:

  • Design AI roadmaps with client leadership and own them through to production
  • Create and implement the AI solution architectures to deliver on those roadmaps
  • Set and uphold Data Platform and MLOps standards across your client portfolio, so systems stay healthy after handover
  • Mentor engineers and weigh in on hiring, team growth, and accounts
  • Push our engineering practice forward, including how we use agentic coding workflows to build faster without compromising reliability. We test, document, and share what works, so the whole team levels up
  • Elevate our product mindset to ensure we build the right things, not just more things

Why a Lead role here, not somewhere else

You'll work across more stacks, clouds, and frontier frameworks in a year than most engineers see in five, with the collective knowledge of the whole team behind you, not the isolation of freelance work. And because our clients build grid software, energy forecasting, and climate infrastructure, you develop real domain expertise in energy and climate systems on top of production-grade AI engineering.

In your first months you'll join a client project alongside an experienced Enjins engineer, supported by a dedicated coach. Within half a year, you own the technical roadmap of at least one engagement, mentor engineers, and have a recognised voice in our Asset strategy.

Requirements

What matters most: you think in systems, own outcomes end-to-end, and grow the people around you.

  • 5+ years building and scaling data & AI solutions in production environments
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals: you write production-grade code and know your way around infrastructure (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, data pipelines)
  • Mastery of at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, GCP) and experience leading MLOps/LLMOps architectures
  • Proven experience taking LLM-based or agentic systems to production
  • Experience mentoring engineers, overseeing delivery, and managing client accounts
  • You can translate technical complexity into clear decisions for non-technical stakeholders
  • Fluent in English and eligible to work in the Netherlands

Benefits

We publish our salary ranges and keep terms straightforward. No surprises.

Compensation

  • €5,950 - €7,800 gross per month (excl. holiday allowance, pension, bonus, equity, and AI-Leap benefits)
  • Annual performance bonus of 1.5 months' salary
  • Equity participation (VSOP)


Growth

  • AI-Leap: our structured development programme with a dedicated certification budget and a specialised track for Leads

ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion sits at a rare intersection: a product people love, a flexible system businesses run on, and a new platform for people and AI to work together. We’re hiring a Product Manager to turn that opportunity into products that feel inevitable. You’ll find consequential customer problems, set a bold but grounded strategy, and build alongside design, engineering, data science, research, and go-to-market partners. This is a high-agency role for someone excited to shape what Notion becomes next—and make powerful new capabilities feel simple, trustworthy, and delightful to millions of customers.

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.



WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Uncover the customer problems and product opportunities that will define Notion’s next chapter, then turn them into a focused strategy and roadmap.

 - Make the hard calls—balancing customer impact, business opportunity, technical complexity, speed, and long-term product quality.

 - Shape how AI changes both the product and the way we build, using it to improve research, decisions, experimentation, and execution.

 - Raise the bar for product thinking across the team by creating clarity, accelerating learning, and establishing principles and success measures that endure.

 - A track record of moving ambiguous, cross-functional work from problem definition to shipped outcomes while creating clear ownership and alignment.

 - Customer depth: you can learn directly from users across segments and translate differing needs into a coherent strategy rather than a collection of one-off requests.

 - Practical AI fluency: you use AI to sharpen research, product thinking, decisions, and execution, and you’re excited to rethink how people and agents work together.


NICE TO HAVES:

jobs.description:
Ihre Karriere in der Steuerung komplexer Systementwicklungsprojekte.

Mit BRÜGGEN ENGINEERING übernehmen Sie eine zentrale Rolle in der Entwicklung elektronischer Fahrzeugsysteme. Sie steuern die Systementwicklung von den Kundenanforderungen bis zur Systemfreigabe, koordinieren Releases und Entwicklungsumfänge und führen das Systemprojektteam fachlich. Der Tätigkeitsschwerpunkt liegt im Remote-Arbeiten mit regelmäßigen Projekteinsätzen in Luxemburg.

So tragen Sie zu unserem gemeinsamen Erfolg bei

- Systementwicklung: Sie verantworten die termingerechte Bearbeitung der Systems-Engineering-Arbeitspakete von der Anforderungsdefinition bis zur Systemfreigabe
- Entwicklungsplanung: Sie planen Arbeitspakete, Zuständigkeiten, Abhängigkeiten, Ressourcen, Termine und Meilensteine und steuern die Umsetzung über Releases und Sprints hinweg
- Releaseplanung: Sie definieren Produkt- und Release-Umfänge, koordinieren Änderungen und stellen die technische Reife für anstehende Releases und Meilensteine sicher
- Anforderungsmanagement: Sie steuern die Entwicklung von Stakeholder- und Systemanforderungen und gewährleisten deren Qualität, Priorisierung und durchgängige Rückverfolgbarkeit
- Systemintegration: Sie stellen die konsistente Umsetzung der Anforderungen und Architekturspezifikationen in Software, Hardware und Test sicher
- Schnittstellen: Sie koordinieren die technische Abstimmung mit Kunden sowie Software, Hardware, Test, funktionaler Sicherheit, Cybersecurity, Fertigung und weiteren Fachbereichen
- Teamsteuerung: Sie führen das Systemprojektteam fachlich, verfolgen Risiken und Entwicklungsfortschritte und vertreten den Systemstatus in Kunden-, Release- und Projektbesprechungen

Das bringen Sie mit

- Qualifikation: Abgeschlossenes Studium in Mechatronik, Elektrotechnik, Elektronik oder einer vergleichbaren technischen Fachrichtung
- Berufserfahrung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Automotive, Automobilelektronik, E-Mobilität oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld sowie Erfahrung in der fachlichen Steuerung von Projekten oder Teams
- ECU-Entwicklung: Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Entwicklung elektronischer Steuergeräte, idealerweise im Bereich Hochvolt-Inverter
- Systems Engineering: Solide Kenntnisse in Systems Engineering, Anforderungsmanagement, Systemintegration und Release-Prozessen sowie ausgeprägtes prozessorientiertes Denken
- Normen: Kenntnisse relevanter Automotive-Standards wie ISO 26262 und Automotive SPICE
- Tools: Erfahrung mit Projekt-, Anforderungs- und Ticketmanagementsystemen wie Microsoft Project, Polarion, DOORS, JIRA oder IBM Rational RTC
- Kommunikation: Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse, interkulturelle Kompetenz sowie Bereitschaft, rund 30 % der Tätigkeit vor Ort in Luxemburg zu arbeiten

Was wir bieten

- Attraktive Konditionen: Unbefristete Vollzeitstelle mit einer Vergütung, die Ihrer Qualifikation und Erfahrung entspricht
- Flexible Arbeitsweise: Verbinden Sie überwiegend mobiles Arbeiten mit gezielten Projekteinsätzen vor Ort in Luxemburg
- Dynamisches Team: Werden Sie Teil eines internationalen Entwicklungsumfelds, das technische Verantwortung und interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit fördert

  • dokaz o stručnoj spremi (preslika),
  • dokaz o državljanstvu (preslika),
  • Potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje ili elektronički zapis o ravnopravnom statusu, ne starija od dana objave natječaja,
  • Uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak za neko od kaznenih djela navedenih u članku 25. stavku 1. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (NN 10/97,107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22,101/23 i 22/26), ne starije od dana objave natječaja,
  • Uvjerenje Prekršajnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi prekršajni postupak za djela navedena u čl. 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i naobrazbi (10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22,101/23) i 22/26), ne starije od dana objave natječaja.
  • Dokaz o poznavanju talijanskog jezika
Za oglašeno radno mjesto mogu se prijaviti osobe oba spola koje ispunjavaju propisane uvjete. Kandidati su dužni priložiti dokaz o promjeni prezimena/imena ukoliko je došlo do promjene u odnosu na priloženu dokumentaciju. Kandidat/kinja predložen/a za izbor, ako nema utvrđenu zdravstvenu sposobnost za obavljanje poslova, bit će upućen/a na zdravstveni pregled radi njenog utvrđivanja. Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (NN 121/17, 98/19, 84/21) uz prijavu na natječaj dužni su priložiti, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, i sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (NN 157/ 13, 152/ 14, 39/18, 32/20) uz prijavu na natječaj dužni su, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom. Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju iz članka 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (NN 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 02/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), uz ostale dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, dužni su priložiti i odgovarajuće dokaze o ostvarivanju prava prednosti, kao i rješenje, odnosno potvrdu iz koje je vidljivo spomenuto pravo te dokaz o tome na koji način je prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca. Da bi kandidat ostvario pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju, osoba iz članka 48. stavaka 1. – 2. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine, broj 84/21) koji u trenutku podnošenja prijave ispunjava uvjete za ostvarivanje toga prava dužni su uz prijavu na natječaj priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja te ovisno o kategoriji koja se poziva na prednost pri zapošljavanju priložiti sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja (https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843). Kandidatom prijavljenim na natječaj smatrat će se samo osoba koja podnese pravovremenu i urednu prijavu sa svim prilozima te ispunjava formalne uvjete iz natječaja. Kandidati koji podnesu pravovremenu i urednu prijavu i ispunjavaju formalne uvjete iz natječaja mogu biti pozvani na testiranje, razgovor i/ili pisanu provjeru znanja, sposobnosti i vještina bitnih za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta. Nepravodobne i nepotpune prijave neće se razmatrati. Do donošenja odluke o izboru, natječaj može biti poništen. Prijavom na natječaj kandidati, u skladu sa Uredbom EU 20167679 Europskog parlamenta i Vijeća od 17.04.2016. te Zakona o provedbi Opće uredbe o zaštiti osobnih podataka (NN 42/18), daju privolu za prikupljanje i obradu podataka iz natječajne dokumentacije, a sve za svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka i rezultata natječaja. Rok za podnošenje prijava je 8 dana od dana objavljivanja natječaja. Prijave za natječaj s obaveznom dokumentacijom dostavljaju se na adresu: Dudova 24a , 52474, Brtonigla, Istarska županija, Hrvatska. Dječjinvrtić “Kalimero”-Scuola dell’infanzia “Calimero” Brtonigla - Verteneglio uz naznaku: ''Prijava na natječaj –zdravstveni/na voditelj/ica)''. O rezultatima provedenog natječaja kandidati će biti obaviješteni u roku od osam (8) dana od dana donošenja odluke o odabiru kandidata na sjednici Upravnog vijeća Vrtića putem mrežne stranice Vrtića. Kandidati prijavljeni na natječaj mogu tražiti vraćanje svoje dokumentacije, uz prethodnu najavu, u tajništvu vrtiću. NATJEČAJ VRIJEDI od 13. listopada 2026. do 21. listopada 2026. god PREDSJEDNICA UPRAVNOG VIJEĆA : Keti Visintin
