jobs.title: Head of Security
jobs.description:
About Morpho

Morpho is a leading Decentralized Finance (DeFi) lending protocol backed by a16z crypto, Paradigm, Ribbit Capital, Apollo, Vaneck, Coinbase Ventures, Variant and 50 others to build an open credit network giving anyone, anywhere, access to the best possible terms. Morpho is experiencing exponential adoption, with over billion in deposits on the network and used by institutional clients including Bitwise, Galaxy, and Anchorage Digital and the largest crypto exchanges, such as Coinbase, Binance, and Kraken. Now, Morpho is scaling its team of contributors to establish itself as the open credit network, not just of DeFi, but of the world.

 

Why Morpho Exists

Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Even when capital is available, it sits fragmented across disconnected networks and hidden behind intermediaries. The result is a system that fails most of the people it should serve. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. Morpho exists to solve this. Full article here.

Location:

Paris or remote (from -5h GMT up to +2h GMT to ensure sufficient overlap with the rest of the team).

About the role:

As Head of Security, you'll define and drive Morpho's security strategy across the entire organization - corporate IT, cloud and infrastructure, application, supply chain, identity, incident response, threat intelligence, and counterparty security - and you'll build the team and function to deliver it. This is a hands-on leadership role: in the early days you'll personally do the work while you hire, and you'll stay close enough to the technical detail to earn the trust of a deeply technical organization. You'll also be Morpho's credible security voice, internally to leadership, and externally to the integrators, institutions, and ecosystem partners who depend on us. You'll partner closely with Engineering on infrastructure and deployment integrity, and with our Integration team, which works with various partners across the Morpho ecosystem.

Responsibilities:

  • Own and continuously evolve Morpho's security strategy and roadmap across, cloud/infrastructure, application, supply-chain, identity, and operational security.

  • Build and lead the security function - hire, grow, and develop the team, recruiting skillsets across security operations and application security.

  • Oversight of the IT function

  • Stay hands-on. Personally execute critical security work - threat modeling, architecture review, control implementation, and incident command - while the team scales.

  • Set the governance architecture: a coherent security framework that ties tooling and controls together, rather than accumulating tools in isolation.

  • Own incident response end to end - runbooks, incident command, severity and escalation structure, and market communication during an event.

  • Build and run a counterparty security program for curators and partners - identity verification, screening, operational diligence, and bidirectional incident-coordination channels.

  • Lead Morpho's certification strategy (e.g. SOC 2, ISO 27001), meeting both the spirit and the letter sustainably.

  • Represent Morpho's security posture externally - to fintechs, financial institutions, and the broader ecosystem - and internally to executives.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Engineering, Protocol, and Integrations, driving security outcomes through both direct ownership and influence.

What Success Looks Like:

First 30 Days

  • You've built a clear, independent picture of Morpho's posture, architecture, threat model, and in-flight work - and pressure-tested the existing strategy against it.

  • You've met the team and established working relationships with the people who own the surfaces you'll most depend on.

  • You understand the path-to-funds attack surface in depth and have an early, evidence-based view of the highest-severity risks and quick wins.

  • You know exactly where incident-response readiness stands today.

First 60 Days

  • You've published a clearly prioritized security roadmap with clear sequencing, owners, and the rationale for what's deferred and aligned leadership behind it.

  • You've defined the team build-out plan and opened the first hire.

  • You're personally driving the top-severity gaps - identity and authentication enforcement, deployment guardrails, and a documented incident-response runbook among them.

  • You've set the governance framework and the certification path in motion.

First 90 Days

  • Demonstrable progress closing the highest-priority gaps, with key controls enforced rather than optional.

jobs.title: Finance Manager, Financial Control & Accounting
jobs.description:
At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

💰 Our Finance team

The Finance team ensures Joko's financial health and long-term success. We manage everything from financial planning and accounting to financing and cash management.

We make sure every euro is put to its best use, working closely with all teams, we provide the insights and structure needed to scale efficiently.

As we scale, we're splitting Finance into three specialized poles: FP&A, Finance Operations (Financial Control & Accounting), and Procurement. This role anchors Finance Operations (Financial Control & Accounting) — the pole that keeps Joko's financial information accurate, timely, and audit-ready. You'll report directly to Quentin, our COO.

 

✨ Why this role is special

Finance Operations (Financial Control & Accounting) is a brand-new specialized pole at Joko — previously bundled into a single generalist Finance Manager role. You'll be the first person to own this scope end to end, with direct visibility to the COO and VP Finance with real influence over how the function is built as the company scales past 200 people across multiple geographies.

  • You set the standards, not just follow them: as the pole's first hire, the processes, controls, and calendar you establish now become the backbone the rest of Finance builds on.

  • A true partner in automation: you'll work hand-in-hand with a dedicated BizOps partner to automate what can be automated — this isn't a role where you're expected to grind through manual work alone.

  • International scope from day one: France, the US, and future markets — you'll help build the multi-entity, multi-country accounting backbone as Joko expands.

 

🎯 What you will do

As Finance Manager, Finance Operations (Financial Control & Accounting), your main mission is to own the reliability, timeliness, and completeness of Joko's financial information. Rather than doing the bookkeeping — we have an external accounting partner for that — you set the standards, drive the calendar, and hold your internal and external stakeholders accountable.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Drive the closing calendar: own the monthly and annual closing calendar, holding our external accounting partner and auditors to a high standard;

  • Own our legal reporting package: make sure the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement are always accurate and delivered on time;

  • Oversee AP/AR end to end: keep invoicing, payment runs, and collections under control;

  • Lead our international accounting build-out: as we open new entities and markets, including our IFRS consolidation framework;

  • Own cash management: reconciliation, yield optimization, and day-to-day treasury;

  • Be the main point of contact for our banking and accounting partners, and a key interface for auditors as we scale toward IPO readiness;

  • Continuously strengthen and document our financial processes and controls, working hand-in-hand with a dedicated BizOps partner to automate what can be automated, making everything more robust and less error-prone as the company scales.

 

👀 Who we're looking for

  • Experience: 4–8 years, with a strong foundation in accounting or audit (Big 4 or equivalent), ideally combined with in-house experience in a scale-up.

  • Education: A master's degree from a top business school. A double degree in accounting (DCG/DSCG) is a plus.

  • Financial rigor: Deep understanding of French GAAP and treasury fundamentals — you bring the same discipline to a closing cycle as you do to a cash position.

  • International mindset: Excited to build a multi-entity, multi-country accounting backbone as we expand; IFRS exposure is a plus.

  • Stakeholder management: You build trust with partners inside and outside Joko, and you're comfortable holding them accountable.

  • Problem solving: You dig into the root cause and fix things.

  • AI centricity: You use AI in your daily work today, and you're excited to help automate reporting and reconciliation as part of Joko's AI-first finance ambition.

  • Languages: Fluent French and English.

💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

  • Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

  • Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

  • 💸 Top-market compensation

  • 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build

  • 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

  • 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings

  • 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription

  • 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent

  • …and much more, check the full list here!

🤝 Our hiring process

  1. Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.

  2. Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).

  3. Step 2 – Role-specific assessments

    • For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).

    • For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).

  4. Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder.

  5. References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers.

☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture.

Compensation: €61.5K – €84K

jobs.title: Process Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Functieprofiel

Als Process Automation Engineer speel je een cruciale rol in het hart van onze productieomgeving. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het beheren, onderhouden en continu verbeteren van het procesautomatiseringslandschap (ISA‑niveaus 1, 2 en 3 – zowel hardware als software).

Je borgt de betrouwbaarheid en beschikbaarheid van onze productieprocessen en vertaalt data en technologie naar slimme, praktische verbeteringen die de organisatie vooruithelpen. Dit is een hands‑on functie met veel impact, waarin je nauw samenwerkt met Operations, Production Support Engineering en externe technologiepartners.

Bedrijfsomschrijving

NX Filtration bevindt zich in een spannende groeifase, gedreven door een unieke en impactvolle technologie. Met onze missie “pure en betaalbare wateroplossingen voor iedereen” ontwikkelen en produceren wij geavanceerde holle‑vezelmembranen voor nano‑, ultra‑ en microfiltratie.

Onze technologie verwijdert de kleinste verontreinigingen uit water, waaronder nanoplastics, organische stoffen, kleurstoffen, medicijnresten, bacteriën en virussen. Hiermee maken wij eenvoudige, efficiënte en duurzame oplossingen mogelijk voor waterzuivering, hergebruik van afvalwater en drinkwaterproductie wereldwijd. Door bij NX Filtration te werken, draag je direct bij aan het oplossen van mondiale uitdagingen op het gebied van waterkwaliteit en waterschaarste.


Wat ga jij doen!

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Role summary

Bluerock TMS builds the autonomous orchestration platform that keeps global logistics moving — orchestrating complex, multi-modal transport networks for customers across fashion, food & beverage, manufacturing, healthcare, and more. Real complexity, at real scale, every single day.

We're looking for a Product Manager who has actually lived inside logistics or TMS operations. Someone who can understand operations complexity and who is willing to take on this challenge and contribute hands on to build the next level of TMS. You'll own the products that turn that complexity into clarity, working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering, sales, and implementation to make sure what we build actually gets adopted.

Responsibilities

  • Product vision, grounded in real user needs

You dig past what customers ask for to find the problem underneath, and turn that into a direction for your area the company can rally behind.

  • Market scoping and opportunity-spotting

Scanning the logistics landscape, competitor moves, and customer signals to find where Bluerock should build next, not just what's already on the backlog.

  • Logistics know-how turned into product decisions 

Planning, transport execution, freight, last-mile — decisions that hold up against how operations actually run, not just how they're described to you.

  • The full lifecycle

From first idea to adoption. You don't hand off and disappear.

  • The connective tissue across the company 

When priorities compete or a customer escalation needs an answer fast, you're the one pulling the threads together.

The team you’ll join

You'll join an international product team with complementary skills and a shared passion for a good challenge, real, hands-on experience in logistics paired with genuine enthusiasm for technology. We don't settle for quick patches: we strive for quality, look for the sustainable solution over the easy one, and keep an eye on what next-level TMS should look like, not just what's in front of us today.

Life at Bluerock

We're a distributed team across the Netherlands, Italy, the US, and Canada that operates like one crew: local insight, global perspective. We're curious by default, self-driven without needing to be told twice, and genuinely joyful about solving hard logistics problems together. We're team-minded because the best answers rarely come from one person alone, and unapologetically reliable because our customers' supply chains don't get a “we'll fix it next sprint.” As one of us put it: at the end of the day, it's the people that make Bluerock.


  • 5+ years in product or project management within logistics, supply chain, or TMS — hands-on TMS experience is required.

  • An appetite for ambiguity and change: a messy, fragmented workflow reads to you as an interesting problem.

  • Excellent leadership and team management skills, with the ability to motivate and guide cross-functional teams.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage customer relationships and stakeholder expectations effectively.

  • Exceptional problem-solving and decision-making abilities, with a focus on delivering results in a fast-paced environment

jobs.title: Senior interim manager in de zorg in loondienst
jobs.description:
Ben jij een ervaren leider die energie krijgt van het aanbrengen van structuur in uitdagende situaties? Wat ga je doen? 
Als interim manager word je ingezet op locaties van Cordaan waar extra leiderschap en verandering nodig zijn. Dit betekent dat je tijdelijke projectmatige opdrachten uitvoert in de organisatie, waar je snel schakelt, structuur aanbrengt en teams in crisis helpt stabiliseren. Je start elke opdracht met het maken van een projectplan en zorgt dat dit succesvol wordt uitgevoerd. Je zorgt ervoor dat medewerkers optimaal kunnen functioneren en kwalitatieve zorg kunnen bieden. 

Jouw belangrijkste taken:

Wat krijg je van ons? 
Bij Cordaan krijg je de kans om impact te maken binnen een kleurrijke organisatie die de ambitie heeft de beste zorgverlener en zorgwerkgever van Amsterdam te zijn. Voor deze functie zijn de arbeidsvoorwaarden conform cao VVT:

  • Salaris conform CAO VVT FWG 60: min. € 4.157 en max. € 6.171 bruto (o.b.v. 36 uur per week); 

  • Extra’s: Eindejaarsuitkering (8,33%) en vakantiegeld (8%); 

  • Reiskosten: een vergoeding á € 0,21 per km en een fietsplan; 

  • Pensioenopbouw via Pensioenfonds Zorg & Welzijn;   

  • Ontwikkelmogelijkheden: Volop mogelijkheden om je persoonlijk en professioneel te ontwikkelen;  

  • Collega aandragen? Ontvang in totaal een aanbrengbonus van € 500,- netto.


Wie ben jij? 
Jij bent een manager met een sterke persoonlijkheid en ruime ervaring in crisis- en verandermanagement in de zorg. Je kan projectmatig werken en weet hoe je teams motiveert en veranderingen succesvol implementeert.

  • Aantoonbare beheersing van minimaal 3 van de volgende competenties (blijkend uit recente talentenscan of 360⁰ feedback): resultaatgerichtheid, visie, verandermanagement en beïnvloedingskracht. 

Waar ga je werken? 
Als interim manager kun je ingezet worden binnen een van de verschillende zorgdomeinen van Cordaan in Amsterdam in de ouderenzorg, Jeugd, GGZ en gehandicaptenzorg. Je wordt flexibel ingezet op locaties waar tijdelijke versterking nodig is, zodat jij impact kunt maken waar het écht telt.

Kleurrijk en betekenisvol met elkaar
Cordaan vindt een inclusief werving- en selectiebeleid belangrijk. We omarmen de eigenheid van collega’s en stimuleren ontwikkeling van talenten. We willen dat cliënten en collega's zichzelf herkennen in onze organisatie. Dit vraagt om een goede representatie van medewerkers en leidinggevenden met verschillende achtergronden. Cordaan streeft ernaar om meer mensen uit groepen die nog ondervertegenwoordigd zijn, aan te nemen en te behouden.

We are looking for a Senior Growth Marketing Manager (Underwater Security) to drive our go-to-market strategy, accelerate growth, and strengthen our position in the rapidly evolving underwater security market.

Optics11 is a fast-growing technology company developing advanced fiber-optic sensing solutions for some of the world’s most demanding environments.

Within our Underwater Security business, we develop innovative sensing technologies that help detect and monitor underwater threats. Our solutions include OptiBarrier, designed for immediate, over-the-horizon threat detection, and OptiArray, our low-power optical thin-line towed array for unmanned underwater vehicles and submarines.

As our business continues to grow internationally, we are looking for a Senior Growth Marketing Manager to strengthen our commercial growth and demand generation capabilities.

About the role:

This is a senior, hands-on B2B marketing role with a clear commercial focus.

You will take ownership of our growth marketing and digital demand engine, turning market interest into engaged target accounts and qualified pipeline.

From ABM and integrated campaigns to HubSpot, content, LinkedIn and customer journeys, you will connect our marketing activities into one measurable growth approach.

Working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering and Events, you will help us reach the right accounts, build engagement throughout long and complex buying cycles, and continuously improve how Marketing contributes to commercial growth.

What will you do?

  • Own and execute our B2B growth, demand generation and account-based marketing (ABM) strategy.

  • Build targeted campaigns around priority accounts, audiences, products and different stages of the buying journey.

  • Lead campaigns end to end – from concept and planning to launch, optimization, reporting and scaling.

  • Develop integrated campaigns across content, LinkedIn, email, webinars, landing pages, website and events.

  • Own our content marketing approach and work with Product, Engineering and Sales to turn complex technical topics into clear and compelling content.

  • Optimize the customer journey from first interaction through lead, MQL and SQL to qualified opportunity.

  • Own and continuously improve HubSpot, including lead scoring, workflows, nurture campaigns, lifecycle stages, reporting and attribution.

  • Drive website conversion, organic and paid LinkedIn, SEO and other relevant digital marketing activities.

  • Measure account engagement, conversion and pipeline performance and turn insights into concrete improvements.

  • Manage relevant agencies and external marketing partners.

What we offer

  • A senior role with significant ownership and the opportunity to shape our growth marketing approach.

  • The chance to work with innovative technology with real-world applications in underwater security.

  • An international, fast-growing working environment.

  • 30 vacation days per year.

  • Employer pension contribution.


Who are you?

You are strategic but hands-on. You can define the growth strategy, but you are equally comfortable building the campaign, improving a HubSpot workflow or digging into performance data yourself.

You are commercially driven and focused on meaningful outcomes: engaged accounts, qualified opportunities and measurable pipeline.

You are analytical, curious and comfortable experimenting, learning from data and continuously improving your approach. And because our technology is complex, you can quickly understand technical concepts and translate them into clear and credible stories for different audiences.

What do you bring?

  • Strong hands-on experience in B2B growth marketing, demand generation or a similar senior marketing role.

  • Experience working with complex, multi-stakeholder B2B buying cycles.

  • Proven experience with account-based marketing (ABM) and close collaboration with Sales.

  • Strong experience owning and executing end-to-end marketing campaigns.

  • Hands-on experience with HubSpot, including campaigns, lead scoring, workflows, nurture, reporting and attribution.

  • Experience across content marketing, LinkedIn, website conversion, SEO and email marketing.

  • A strong track record of connecting marketing activities to account engagement, qualified pipeline and commercial outcomes.

  • Strong stakeholder management skills and confidence working across commercial and technical teams.

Nice to have

  • Experience marketing complex technical products or solutions.

  • Experience within underwater security, maritime, defense, critical infrastructure, offshore energy or adjacent industries.

  • Experience working with government, naval, security, procurement or other complex stakeholder environments.

Interested?

We would love to hear from experienced B2B marketers who combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution and want to build measurable growth in a complex, technology-driven market. Apply and help us shape the next stage of growth for Optics11 Underwater Security.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager Software
jobs.description:
About Optics11

Optics11 is a fast-growing high-tech company based in Amsterdam, developing advanced fiber optic sensing systems for the most demanding environments. Our technology detects the earliest signs of failure in critical assets – from high-voltage energy infrastructure to subsea and defense applications – and gives our customers precise, real-time data they can act on.

The Role

As Senior Product Manager Software you will build a deep understanding of the software we supply to our defense partners and clients.

You will have full product ownership including strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle and contribute to adjacent hardware product strategy and propositions to, jointly with our hardware product managers, build end-to-end solutions for our defense partners and clients. You build and structure our product discovery and delivery ways of working for the software domain.

You will be part of the Product team in Underwater Security and work closely with our hardware Product Managers, Data science, Software, R&D, Engineering Sales, Projects and Application Engineering teams.

No two weeks will look the same. You might speak with a defense partner about an operational challenge, turn feedback from a deployed product into a roadmap decision, test the feasibility of a new capability with System Engineering, or work with the Product Owner to translate priorities into executable increments. You will also collaborate with hardware Product Managers, Engineering, Sales and Customer Projects to ensure our software and hardware come together as one coherent solution.

You will own the software product strategy, roadmap and lifecycle, from discovery and business case through prioritization, delivery and performance.

Within your first 6–12 months, you will have established a clear, evidence-based software strategy, strengthened our discovery and delivery practices, and aligned teams around the capabilities that matter most. Your work will reduce uncertainty, improve investment decisions and help Optics11 deliver scalable, commercially strong software products that solve real problems for customers operating in demanding, high-stakes environments.

Key Responsibilities

• Own the software product strategy by defining and articulating the direction for assigned software products or value streams, identifying customer problems and market opportunities, and balance near-term opportunities with long-term company goals.

• Provide product design authority by ensuring software concepts, capabilities and development choices remain aligned with the Underwater Security product vision and strategy throughout the product lifecycle.

• Lead customer and market discovery by developing a deep understanding of customer needs, operational use cases and buying contexts, validating direction with customers and partners, and synthesizing feedback from deployed products.

• Own software roadmap development and prioritization by defining the capabilities required to address validated needs, balancing improvements, new functionality and technology evolution, and communicating priorities across relevant teams.

• Develop business cases and commercial input by defining success measures and commercial objectives, providing evidence for portfolio investment decisions, and supporting Product Marketing with product knowledge for pricing and launch readiness.

• Coordinate the product core team by working with System Engineering on requirements and feasibility, Product Ownership on executable increments, and Project Management on customer delivery, while aligning Sales, Business Development, Customer Projects and Engineering around progress, quality and outcomes.


• Master’s degree in engineering or design, or equivalent experience.

• 5+ years of experience in Software Product Management, with a proven track record of developing, deploying and maintaining software (platform) driven solutions in defense industry or another industrial high-tech / high compliance environment

• Strong understanding of software products, particularly in complex and regulated environments, e.g., industrial environments.

• In-depth knowledge of software product management and – strategy methodologies.

• Demonstratable experience in defining software product strategy and creating complete business cases.

• Strong cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills at operational and management level

• Demonstrated critical thinking, adaptability to challenges, and a problem-solving mindset to creatively address user pain points.

• Proficiency in software industry standard tooling for software development and road mapping such as Jira / Jira Product Discovery / Jira Service Management, Confluence, BigPicture

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of conveying product level knowledge, decisions and roadmaps to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Willingness to travel

• Drivers’ license B (or international equivalent)

Nice to Have

• Experience in defense industry or another industrial high-tech / high compliance environment

• Proficiency in JAMA Connect, Siemens Polarion, SAFe, Miro, Figma, Dovetail, Amplitude, PowerBI

• Proficiency in Dutch language is a plus

Security screening

You'll be working with clients in the defense and security sectors, obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD (Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service) is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. For more information, please check:

https://english.aivd.nl/topics/s/security-screening

jobs.title: Stage AI & Automatisering | Amsterdam hbo/wo
jobs.description:
Wat ga je doen?

Binnen Flagship Amsterdam zijn we volop bezig om met AI en automatisering ons werk slimmer en makkelijker te maken. Daar kunnen we jouw hulp goed bij gebruiken! Als stagiair AI & Automatisering ben je de rechterhand van de specialist voor IT en automatisering. Je onderzoekt bestaande processen, denkt mee over verbeteringen en helpt bij het ontwikkelen van nieuwe tools. Je krijgt veel ruimte om zelf ideeën uit te werken en leert tijdens deze stage ontzettend veel over AI, technologie en automatisering.

Wat ga je leren?

  • AI en automatisering inzetten in de praktijk;

  • Zelf slimme tools en oplossingen ontwikkelen;

  • Bestaande processen verbeteren en efficiënter maken;

  • Werken met verschillende AI-tools en technologieën;

  • Ervaring opdoen met echte projecten binnen een groeiend bedrijf;

  • Je eigen ideeën uitwerken en veel nieuwe vaardigheden ontwikkelen.

Praktisch

Startdatum: in overleg;

Beschikbaarheid: 3–5 dagen per week, in te richten rond je studierooster;

Locatie: kantoor in hartje Amsterdam;

Stagevergoeding: €500 per maand bij 5 dagen per week.

Dit bieden wij

  • Een uitdagende en leerzame stage waarin je écht meedraait in het team;

  • Intensieve begeleiding door een ervaren IT-specialist, met ruimte voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling;

  • Een centraal gelegen kantoor op ca. 15 minuten lopen van Amsterdam Centraal;

  • Een gezellige werksfeer en een heerlijke, verzorgde lunch op kantoor;

  • Legendarische vrijdagmiddagborrels, sportieve uitjes en bedrijfsfeesten;

  • 25% personeelskorting op rondvaarten en andere activiteiten binnen Flagship Holding;

  • De mogelijkheid om je stage af te sluiten met een concrete showcase- of portfolio-project.

Functievereisten

  • Je volgt een HBO- of WO-opleiding in bijvoorbeeld AI, ICT, Informatica, Business IT of een vergelijkbare richting;

  • Ervaring met API-koppelingen en databases is mooi meegenomen;

  • Je hebt basiskennis van programmeren en vindt het leuk om hierin verder te leren;

  • Zelfstandig werken gaat je goed af en je neemt graag zelf initiatief;

  • Je kunt goed communiceren in het Engels, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.


Over Flagship

Flagship Amsterdam is een jonge en snelgroeiende rederij in het hart van Amsterdam. Wat in 2017 begon met drie boten, is inmiddels uitgegroeid tot een vloot van meer dan 70 boten, en we groeien nog steeds elke dag verder! Jaarlijks verwelkomen we gasten uit meer dan 55 verschillende landen, en we varen het hele jaar door. Dit doen we met een gedreven en ambitieus team van meer dan 800 (seizoensgebonden) medewerkers.

Maar Flagship is meer dan alleen rondvaarten. Vanuit dezelfde energie bouwen we aan verschillende concepten die allemaal draaien om beleving, gastvrijheid en de stad Amsterdam. Zo ontdek je de stad op de fiets met Flagship Bike Tours, proef je de sfeer bij Flagship Waffle Experience Amsterdam, en werken we bij Shipyard aan unieke events en creatieve projecten op en rond het water. Daarnaast hebben we labels zoals Voyage Amsterdam, Captain Jack en Aemstelland, elk met hun eigen stijl en doelgroep. Samen vormen ze één organisatie, maar met verschillende manieren om mensen de stad te laten ervaren.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
Als Senior Machine Learning Engineer bij BigData Republic combineer je diepgaande technische expertise met consultancy. Je ontwikkelt niet alleen machine-learningoplossingen, maar brengt ze daadwerkelijk naar productie en adviseert klanten over architectuur, technologie en de beste aanpak om duurzame businesswaarde te realiseren.

Voor deze senior positie zoeken we een ervaren professional met minimaal 6 jaar relevante werkervaring, waarvan minimaal 3 jaar hands-on ervaring met machine learning in professionele productieomgevingen.

Wat ga je doen?

Machine Learning Engineering bevindt zich bij BigData Republic op het snijvlak van Machine Learning, MLOps, Software Engineering, Data Engineering en Cloud Engineering.

Je werkt in multidisciplinaire teams bij klanten aan end-to-end machine-learningoplossingen: van probleemdefinitie en architectuur tot ontwikkeling, deployment, monitoring en optimalisatie.

Je;

  • analyseert complexe business- en technische vraagstukken en vertaalt deze naar robuuste ML-oplossingen;

  • adviseert klanten en stakeholders over machine learning, MLOps, architectuur en technische keuzes;

  • ontwikkelt en productionaliseert machine-learningmodellen;

  • ontwerpt schaalbare ML- en MLOps-architecturen;

  • bouwt production-grade software rondom machine-learningoplossingen;

  • werkt aan deployment, CI/CD, model serving, monitoring en observability;

  • werkt samen met Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Software Engineers en Cloud Engineers;

  • helpt klanten en collega's inhoudelijk naar een hoger niveau;

  • draagt actief bij aan kennisdeling en thought leadership binnen BigData Republic.

De technische uitdagingen variëren van machine-learningmodellen met directe businessimpact tot toepassingen rond deep learning, generative AI, Large Language Models (LLM's), predictive modelling, causal inference en reinforcement learning.

Bij BigData Republic zien we een machine-learningmodel niet als het eindproduct. Een model levert pas waarde wanneer het betrouwbaar, schaalbaar en beheersbaar in productie draait. Daarom benaderen we ML-oplossingen als volwaardige softwareproducten.

Technologieën waarmee we veel werken zijn onder andere;

  • Python

  • Airflow

  • Apache Spark

  • Kafka

  • Docker

  • Tensorflow

  • Pytorch

  • Kubernetes

  • Terraform

  • AWS/ Azur/ GCP en private-cloud omgevingen


Welke technologie je inzet, hangt af van het vraagstuk. We zoeken daarom geen engineer die simpelweg zoveel mogelijk tools kent, maar een ervaren professional die begrijpt welke technische oplossing in welke situatie passend is en waarom.

Je werkt aan complexe data-, AI- en machine-learningvraagstukken voor grote organisaties in verschillende sectoren. Tegelijkertijd ben je onderdeel van een klein, informeel en inhoudelijk gedreven team van ervaren Machine Learning Engineers, MLOps Engineers, Data Engineers en Data Scientists.

Kennisdeling en thought leadership zijn fundamentele onderdelen van BigData Republic. We organiseren iedere vrijdag kennissessies op kantoor, schrijven inhoudelijke artikelen, organiseren meetups en bezoeken en spreken op conferenties. Je krijgt veel vrijheid om je eigen expertise verder te ontwikkelen en tegelijkertijd collega's en klanten verder te helpen.


Dit is nadrukkelijk een senior consultancyrol. Om succesvol te kunnen zijn in deze functie zoeken we iemand die beschikt over:

  • minimaal 6 jaar relevante professionele werkervaring binnen software engineering, data engineering, data science en/of machine learning;

  • minimaal 3 jaar hands-on professionele ervaring met machine learning, waarbij je aantoonbaar ML-oplossingen naar productie hebt gebracht en beheerd, verbeterd of opgeschaald;

  • ervaring met het zelfstandig analyseren van complexe technische vraagstukken en het adviseren van klanten en stakeholders over oplossingen, architectuur en technische keuzes;

  • ruime professionele programmeerervaring met Python;

  • gedegen kennis van software-engineeringprincipes en ervaring met het bouwen van production-grade oplossingen;

  • ervaring met minimaal één grote cloudomgeving: AWS, Azure en/of GCP;

  • ervaring met MLOps, waaronder deployment, CI/CD, monitoring, observability en schaalbaarheid;

  • academisch werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur met een achtergrond in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering of een vergelijkbaar vakgebied;

  • uitstekende beheersing van het Nederlands (minimaal C1) en Engels, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

Daarnaast is het van toegevoegde waarde als je ervaring hebt met:

  • consultancy binnen complexe enterprise-omgevingen;

  • solution architecture of technical leadership;

  • Kubernetes en Terraform;

  • Spark, Kafka en/of Airflow;

  • TensorFlow en/of PyTorch;

  • generative AI en Large Language Models (LLM's);

  • deep learning, causal inference of reinforcement learning;

  • Scala, Kotlin en/of SQL;

  • open-sourceprojecten, meetups, conferenties of andere vormen van kennisdeling.

We verwachten niet dat je met iedere technologie uit onze stack hebt gewerkt. De senioriteit van je ervaring, het daadwerkelijk in productie brengen van machine-learningoplossingen, je vermogen om klanten inhoudelijk te adviseren en je beheersing van het Nederlands zijn voor deze rol wel essentieel.

Je bent technisch sterk, maar kijkt verder dan alleen de technologie. Je kunt complexe situaties doorgronden, alternatieven afwegen en uitleggen waarom een bepaalde oplossing wel of niet verstandig is. Je voelt je comfortabel in gesprekken met engineers, architecten en business stakeholders.

Tegelijkertijd blijf je graag zelf bouwen. BigData Republic zoekt geen consultant die alleen vanaf de zijlijn adviseert: je combineert senior technisch advies met hands-on Machine Learning Engineering.




Benefits

  • Salaris tot €6.700 bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur), afhankelijk van kennis, ervaring en senioriteit

  • Daarbovenop ontvang je 8% vakantietoeslag, jaarlijks uitgekeerd in mei

  • Mobiliteitsbudget van €825 of een leasebudget van €925 per maand

  • Bonus- en pensioenregeling

  • 25 vakantiedagen

  • 36 of 40 uur per week

  • Hybride werken: de juiste balans tussen thuis, kantoor en klant

  • Vrije keuze in laptop en telefoon die het beste bij jou passen

  • Uitdagende én leuke projecten bij aansprekende klanten

  • Ruimte om conferenties te bezoeken, te spreken en certificeringen te behalen

  • Actieve deelname aan ons career path framework: groei met ons mee

  • Een informele cultuur met ruimte voor initiatief en innovatie

  • Vrijdagmiddagborrels, sportactiviteiten en sociale events (vrijblijvend)

CAO & arbeidsvoorwaarden

jobs.title: AUXILIARES DE ENFERMERÍA
jobs.description:
SE OFERTA PUESTO DE TRABAJO PARA AUXILIAR DE ENFERMERÍA CUYAS FUNCIONES Y TAREAS SERÁN: 1. HIGIENE PERSONAL DE LOS RESIDENTES CORRESPONDIENTES A SU GRUPO DE TRABAJO. 2. EFECTUAR LA LIMPIEZA Y MANTENIMIENTO DE LOS UTENSILIOS DE LOS RESIDENTES, HACER LAS CAMAS, COLABORAR EN MANTENER ORDENADAS LAS HABITACIONES, RECOGER LA ROPA, LLEVARLA A LA LAVANDERÍA Y ENCARGARSE DE LA ROPA PERSONAL DE LOS RESIDENTES. 3. DAR DE COMER A AQUELLOS RESIDENTES QUE NO LO PUEDAN HACER POR SÍ MISMOS. EN ESTE SENTIDO, SE OCUPARÁ IGUALMENTE DE LA RECEPCIÓN, DISTRIBUCIÓN Y RECOGIDA DE LAS COMIDAS EN LOS COMEDORES CORRESPONDIENTES. 4. REALIZAR LOS CAMBIOS DE POSTURA, HIDRATACIÓN Y AQUELLOS SERVICIOS AUXILIARES QUE DE ACUERDO CON SU PREPARACIÓN TÉCNICA LE SEAN ENCOMENDADOS. 5. COMUNICAR Y REGISTRAR LAS INCIDENCIAS QUE SE PRODUZCAN SOBRE LA SALUD DE LOS RESIDENTES. 6. LIMPIAR Y PREPARAR LOS MATERIALES DEL CARRO DE CURAS DE ENFERMERÍA. 7. ACOMPAÑAR A LOS RESIDENTES EN LAS SALIDAS PROGRAMADAS POR EL DEPARTAMENTO DE PSICOLOGÍA Y FISIOTERAPIA. 8. COLABORAR CON EL EQUIPO DE PROFESIONALES MEDIANTE LA REALIZACIÓN DE TAREAS ELEMENTALES QUE COMPLEMENTEN LOS SERVICIOS ESPECIALIZADOS DE AQUELLOS, EN ORDEN A PROPORCIONAR LA AUTONOMÍA PERSONAL DE LOS RESIDENTES Y SU INSERCIÓN EN LA VIDA SOCIAL. 9. ATENDER, SIEMPRE DENTRO DE LAS PAUTAS QUE MARQUEN LA DIRECCIÓN Y EL PLAN FUNCIONAL, A FAMILIARES DE LAS PERSONAS USUARIAS Y COLABORAR A LA INTEGRACIÓN DE ÉSTAS EN LA VIDA DEL CENTRO. 10. EN TODAS LAS RELACIONES O ACTIVIDADES CON LOS RESIDENTES, PROCURAR COMPLEMENTAR EL TRABAJO ASISTENCIAL, EDUCATIVO Y FORMATIVO QUE RECIBAN DE PROFESIONALES. 11. BAJO DELEGACIÓN DEL PERSONAL DE ENFERMERÍA PODRÁ HACER LA PRUEBA DE GLUCOSA, UTILIZAR LA VÍA SUBCUTÁNEA PARA ADMINISTRAR INSULINA Y HEPARINA A LOS RESIDENTES, SIEMPRE QUE LA DOSIS Y EL SEGUIMIENTO DEL TRATAMIENTO SE REALICE POR PERSONAL MÉDICO O DE ENFERMERÍA. 12. EN GENERAL, TODAS AQUELLAS ACTIVIDADES QUE NO HABIÉNDOSE ESPECIFICADO ANTES LE.

Sagaidām:

  • izglītību atbilstoši Ministru kabineta noteikumiem Nr.569 “Noteikumi par pedagogiem nepieciešamo izglītību un profesionālo kvalifikāciju un pedagogu profesionālās kompetences pilnveides kārtību”;
  • prasmi plānot, organizēt un kvalitatīvi veikt savu darbu;
  • atbildības sajūtu, disciplinētību, precizitāti;
  • spēju analizēt un risināt konfiktsituācijas, saglabāt konfidencialitāti un toleranci;
  • spēju cieņpilni komunicēt ar bērniem un pieaugušajiem;

jobs.title: Asennustyönjohtaja / vastaava työnjohtaja
jobs.description:
_Me Parmacolla uskomme, että rakennusten tulisi olla yhtä joustavia kuin yhteisöt, joita ne palvelevat. Muutamme yhteiskuntaa dynaamisella arkkitehtuurilla – muunneltavilla, siirrettävillä ja kiertotalouteen perustuvilla rakennuksilla, jotka elävät käyttäjiensä mukana. Tule mukaan tekemään tilaa kestävälle tulevaisuudelle!_

Haemme kokenutta **asennustyönjohtajaa / vastaavaa työnjohtajaa** itsenäiseen ja vastuulliseen rooliin johtamaan rakennushankkeitamme Helsingin seudulla. Vastaat samanaikaisesti yhden tai useamman hankkeen päivittäisestä johtamisesta ja varmistat, että työt etenevät turvallisesti, laadukkaasti, aikataulussa ja suunnitelmien mukaisesti.

Rakennustemme moduulit valmistetaan tehtaillamme ja asennetaan sekä viimeistellään valmiiksi työmaalla. Johdat työmaata kokonaisvaltaisesti, vastaat työmaan viranomaisvelvoitteista, sovitat yhteen työvaiheita ja aliurakoitsijoiden työtä, koordinoit toimituksia sekä laadit tarvittavat työmaasuunnitelmat ja -dokumentaation. Seuraat ja raportoit työn etenemistä, ratkaiset työmaalla syntyviä tilanteita sekä osallistut työmaakokouksiin, katselmuksiin, tarkastuksiin ja luovutuksiin. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä projektinjohdon, suunnittelun, hankinnan, asiakkaiden, aliurakoitsijoiden ja tehtaidemme kanssa.

Tehtävässä ei ole ennalta määriteltyä päivittäistä työaikaa, vaan suunnittelet ja rytmität työsi itsenäisesti hankkeiden tavoitteiden ja työmaiden vaiheiden mukaan. Tämä tuo työhön vapautta, mutta edellyttää myös valmiutta mukauttaa työpäivää työmaiden tilanteisiin.

Työskentelet pääasiassa Helsingin seudun rakennuskohteissa. Tehtävään kuuluu lisäksi satunnaisia käyntejä Parmacon tehtailla Hämeenlinnassa, Leppävirralla ja Pyhäjoella. Voimassa oleva B-ajokortti vaaditaan, mutta omaa autoa ei edellytetä.

**Menestyt tehtävässä hyvin, kun**

- Sinulla on soveltuva rakennusalan korkeakoulututkinto, esimerkiksi rakennusmestarin, rakennusinsinöörin tai diplomi-insinöörin tutkinto.

- Sinulla on vaativan luokan vastaavan työnjohtajan pätevyys tai valmiudet hakea sitä sekä osaamista toimia vastaavana työnjohtajajana.

- Työmaan eri työvaiheet ovat sinulle tuttuja ja hallitset tarvittavien työmaasuunnitelmien ja -dokumentaation laatimisen.

- Pystyt johtamaan ja priorisoimaan useita samanaikaisia hankkeita ja työvaiheita.

- Osaat johtaa aliurakoitsijoita ja tehdä sujuvaa yhteistyötä eri osapuolten kanssa.

- Sinulla on toimiva ja kattava rakennusalan yhteistyö- ja aliurakoitsijaverkosto.

- Toimit käytännönläheisesti ja ratkaisukeskeisesti sekä viet sovitut asiat määrätietoisesti maaliin.

- Turvallisuus ja laatu ohjaavat toimintaasi.

- Hallitset tietotekniset työvälineet ja viestit sujuvasti suomeksi.


Kokemus koulu-, päiväkoti- tai muista julkisista rakennushankkeista sekä moduuli-, elementti- tai teollisesta rakentamisesta katsotaan eduksi. Arvostamme myös erittäin vaativan luokan vastaavan työnjohtajan pätevyyttä, muuta kielitaitoa ja Dalux-osaamista.

**Mitä tarjoamme?**

- Itsenäisen ja vastuullisen tehtävän, jossa johdat työmaan toteutusta ja vaikutat suoraan hankkeen onnistumiseen.

- Monipuolisia, yhteisöille tärkeitä rakennushankkeita pääosin koulu- ja päiväkotisektorilla.

- Perehdytyksen tehtävään ja Parmacon toimintamalleihin.

- Esihenkilön sekä projektinjohdon, suunnittelun, hankinnan ja tuotannon tuen tehtävässä onnistumiseen.

- Mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa osaamistasi ja työmaidemme toimintatapoja.

- Kokemukseesi ja osaamiseesi perustuvan palkan sekä tehtävän hoitamiseen tarvittavat työvälineet.

- Kattavan työterveyshuollon, ePassi Flex -edun sekä henkilöstöetuja ja -alennuksia.


**Haku ja lisätiedot**

Rakennusala tarvitsee erilaisia osaajia ja näkökulmia. Kannustamme erilaisista taustoista tulevia osaajia hakemaan tehtävää. Arvioimme hakijat tehtävän kannalta olennaisen osaamisen, kokemuksen ja valmiuksien perusteella.

Haastatteluihin edetään arviolta viikoilla 45–46. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa tehtävän esihenkilö, työpäällikkö Jussi Lavikainen, p. 040 145 5221.

jobs.title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager, Campaign Strategy & Execution
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is looking for an experienced Lifecycle Marketing Manager, Campaign Strategy & Execution to develop and execute campaigns that help users discover value, adopt key workflows, and deepen their use of Notion.

You'll own campaigns end to end: translating business and customer opportunities into clear strategies, defining audiences and journeys, coordinating creative and technical production, launching across email and in-product channels, and measuring incremental impact.

This role combines strategic judgment with hands-on execution. You'll partner closely with Lifecycle Marketing, Product Marketing, Product Growth, Data Science, Marketing Operations, and creative partners. You should be equally comfortable shaping a campaign brief, building a journey in Customer.io http://Customer.io, resolving execution details, and interpreting results.

Scope guardrails: this role owns campaign strategy, hands-on execution, cross-functional delivery, and performance analysis. It is not the primary Customer.io http://Customer.io architect or incident-response owner, a general intake coordinator, or a production-only role receiving prewritten briefs. The person should operate as an independent campaign owner who can take work from an ambiguous opportunity to a high-quality, measured launch.

This role may be based in either our San Francisco or New York City offices. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own the campaign portfolio. Independently lead a portfolio of launch, one-off, and evergreen lifecycle campaigns with clear prioritization and predictable delivery.

 - Turn opportunities into strategies. Translate product launches, lifecycle moments, and business priorities into clear objectives, audiences, journeys, channel plans, and success metrics.

 - Build high-impact lifecycle programs. Develop campaigns across onboarding, activation, adoption, collaboration, monetization, retention, and resurrection.

 - Execute from brief to measurement. Own audience creation, build, QA, localization, launch readiness, and post-campaign analysis across email and in-product messaging.

 - Improve foundational journeys. Audit existing programs and recommend which should be maintained, improved, rebuilt, or retired; lead the rebuild of priority onboarding or adoption journeys.

 - Raise the experimentation bar. Develop testable hypotheses and use segmentation, personalization, holdouts, and A/B tests to understand incremental impact.

 - Measure customer and business outcomes. Connect campaigns to activation, product adoption, collaboration, conversion, retention, or qualified sales outcomes—not only opens and clicks.

 - Lead cross-functional delivery. Coordinate dependencies across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Product Marketing, Marketing Operations, Demand Generation, Sales, and external partners.

 - Create repeatable systems. Turn recurring campaign work into templates, playbooks, and reusable operating patterns that improve quality and velocity.

 - Enable safe self-service. Help cross-functional partners execute effectively while maintaining Lifecycle's strategic, customer-experience, and quality standards.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - Significant experience owning lifecycle, CRM, growth, or product-marketing campaigns from strategy through execution.

 - A track record of independently leading complex, cross-functional campaigns at meaningful scale.

 - Strong customer-journey thinking across activation, adoption, engagement, conversion, and retention.

 - Hands-on experience with a lifecycle platform such as Customer.io http://Customer.io, Braze, Iterable, or Salesforce Marketing Cloud.

jobs.title: PhD Research Fellow position in Knowledge-Grounded LLM Agents for Defensive Cyber Operations
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for a PhD Research Fellow position in Knowledge-Grounded LLM Agents for Defensive Cyber Operations, available at the Digital Security Research Group within the Department of Informatics at the University of Oslo.

Starting date as soon as possible and no later than 01.05.2027. The fellowship period is three years.

A fourth year may be considered, which would involve 25% other career-promoting work. Other career-promoting work may consist of teaching, supervision, and/or research assistance. This depends on the applicant's qualifications and the department's current needs.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo.


Project description

The position will investigate knowledge-grounded and neuro-symbolic approaches to large language models and agentic AI for defensive cyber operations. The PhD project will be carried out in close collaboration with the Norwegian Defence Research Establishment (FFI), including co-supervision from FFI with potential to connect the research to relevant cybersecurity and cyber-defence challenges.

The research will explore how heterogeneous cybersecurity intelligence and evidence sources, including telemetry and observations, can be transformed into structured cybersecurity knowledge, represented through semantic knowledge graphs, and combined with symbolic reasoning, modern language models, and autonomous agents to support security analysis, situational awareness, decision-making, and response. Particular emphasis will be placed on developing trustworthy, reliable, interpretable, and secure AI systems, including methods for grounding, reasoning, validation, and the control of agentic behaviour in security-critical environments. 

The security and robustness of LLM-based and agentic systems, including adversarial manipulation, uncertainty, provenance, and the validation of AI-generated decisions and actions, may also be explored as part of this position.


What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in cybersecurity, computer science (informatics), artificial intelligence, or a closely related field. Foreign completed degree (M.Sc.-level) corresponding to a minimum of four years in the Norwegian educational system
  • Strong foundation in computer science or artificial intelligence/machine learning, with knowledge of cybersecurity or a demonstrated motivation to apply AI/ML in cybersecurity
  • Strong programming and software development skills, demonstrated through relevant projects, research, or equivalent experience
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English

Candidates who have not yet completed their master’s degree must have completed all requirements for the degree by 31.12.2026.

The position will involve cooperation with stakeholders related to Norwegian national security, and candidates' suitability for this will also be taken into account.

Desired qualifications:

  • Knowledge of or experience with large language models (LLMs), agentic AI, and related AI/ML methods
  • Knowledge of or experience with semantic technologies, including knowledge graphs, ontologies, knowledge representation, and/or symbolic reasoning
  • Knowledge of or experience with cybersecurity, particularly cybersecurity operations, security analysis, threat detection and response, cyber threat intelligence, or security automation
  • Knowledge of or interest in trustworthy and secure AI, including robustness, interpretability, validation, uncertainty, or the security of LLM-based and agentic systems
  • Previous research experience, for example, through a master’s thesis, scientific publication, research project, or equivalent work, is considered an advantage

Language requirement:

  • Good oral and written communication skills in English
  • English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/ EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements:
    https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8

Grade requirements:
The norm is as follows:

  • The average grade point for courses included in the Bachelor’s degree must be C or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The average grade point for courses included in the Master’s degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The Master’s thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system

For more information see:

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. 

UiO is subject to the Security Act, which governs the organisation's protection of security-sensitive objects and knowledge, in addition to other relevant legislation concerning access to and handling of sensitive information. Based on this, it is a requirement that successful applicants are security-eligible. We may use background checks as part of our recruitment process.


What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • Ability to work independently and take initiative, while also contributing effectively to collaborative research
  • Analytical, critical, and structured approach to research and problem-solving
  • Curiosity and willingness to learn, with the ability to adapt to new research questions, methods, and technologies
  • Good communication and collaboration skills, and the ability to engage constructively in interdisciplinary research
  • Positive attitude and the ability to handle hectic periods

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.


We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organisation with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment
  • Good welfare schemes
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities
  • Career development programmes
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes
  • Oslo’s family-friendly surroundings with their rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities
  • Salary in position as PhD Research Fellow, position code 1017 in salary range NOK from 550 800 - 595 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund 

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter (statement of motivation, summarising scientific work and research interest)
  • CV (summarising education, positions, pedagogical experience, administrative experience and other qualifying activity)
  • Transcripts of records, copies of the original Bachelor’s and Master’s degree diplomas (see below)
  • Documentation of English Language requirements. The appointed candidate cannot start in the position until approved documentation of English language proficiency has been submitted.
  • A complete list of publications and related academic or research works, including software artefacts that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".
Foreign applicants should attach an official explanation of their University's grading system.

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

The best qualified candidates will be invited for interviews.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we can't, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to post doctoral and research posts at UiO (Norwegian) and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.  

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees that is intended to secure the rights to all research results etc.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society. 

The Department of Informatics (IFI) is one of nine departments belonging to the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences. IFI is Norway’s largest university department for general education and research in Computer Science and related topics. 

The Department has more than 1800 students on bachelor level, 600 master students, and over 240 PhDs and postdocs. The overall staff of the Department is close to 370 employees, about 280 of these in full time positions. The full time tenured academic staff is 75, mostly Full/Associate Professors.

jobs.title: Pædagogiske og sundhedsfaglige medarbejdere samt en sygeplejerske med fokus på kvalitet og undervisning
jobs.description:
Vil du bruge din faglighed til at skabe tryghed og udviklingsmuligheder for børn og unge? Hos MerVib søger vi både medarbejdere til det daglige arbejde på vores børne- og ungehjem i Herrestrup og Grevinge og en sygeplejerske til sundhedsfaglig kvalitet, medicinhåndtering og undervisning.

Vores tilgang
Et barn eller en ung kommer med erfaringer, interesser og håb – og ofte med andres fortællinger, der med tiden kan være blevet til faste sandheder om, hvem de er.

Hos MerVib er vi nysgerrige på barnets egen oplevelse: Hvad er vigtigt? Hvad lykkes? Og hvad kan vi voksne have overset?

På vores fire børne- og ungehjem arbejder vi for, at børn og unge oplever tryghed, tilhørsforhold og indflydelse på eget liv. Vores narrative tilgang præger, hvordan vi taler med og om børnene. Vi undersøger vores egne antagelser og får sammen med barnet øje på færdigheder, initiativer og håb. Barnets perspektiv er med til at forme vores støtte.

Pædagogiske og sundhedsfaglige medarbejdere til Herrestrup og Grevinge
Du arbejder med tydelig struktur, professionel omsorg og relationer – både i fællesskaber og i individuelle opgaver med 1:1-støtte. Du tilpasser støtten til det enkelte barn og bidrager til en tryg og forudsigelig hverdag.

Vi søger dig der
  • Har en relevant faglig uddannelse og erfaring med børn og unge i sårbare positioner.
  • Har viden om og erfaring med autisme, ADHD og omsorgssvigt.
  • Har erfaring med eller interesse for narrativ praksis og TEACCH.
  • Er nysgerrig på barnets perspektiv og kan tilpasse støtten inden for trygge, tydelige rammer.
  • Arbejder ud fra en Low Arousal-tilgang, tager ansvar, dokumenterer systematisk og er åben for faglig sparring.

Du kan eksempelvis være uddannet pædagog, socialpædagog, pædagogisk assistent, social- og sundhedsassistent, sygeplejerske, socialrådgiver, skolelærer, fysioterapeut eller ergoterapeut. Du kan også have en anden relevant socialfaglig, sundhedsfaglig eller pædagogisk uddannelse.

Der er tale om faste fuldtidsstillinger med 12-timers dagvagter, 24-timers døgnvagter og weekendarbejde. Arbejdsstederne er vores børne- og ungehjem i Herrestrup og Grevinge.

Sygeplejerske til sundhedsfaglig kvalitet medicinhåndtering og undervisning
Som sygeplejerske skal du have et solidt fagligt og lovgivningsmæssigt fundament. Du kombinerer praktiske medicinopgaver med undervisning og kvalitetsudvikling og hjælper ledelsen og medarbejderne med at omsætte gældende regler til tydelige og forsvarlige arbejdsgange.

Dine opgaver omfatter at
  • Varetage medicinopgaver, herunder dispensering efter gældende ordinationer og instrukser.
  • Undervise og vejlede medarbejderne i medicinhåndtering og følge op på oplæring og kompetencer.
  • Gennemgå, opdatere og versionsstyre sundhedsfaglige instrukser i overensstemmelse med gældende regler og vejledninger samt følge op på, at de anvendes korrekt i hverdagen.
  • Omsætte faglige krav til brugbare arbejdsgange inden for blandt andet ansvar og kompetencer, journalføring, samtykke, hygiejne, utilsigtede hændelser og egenkontrol.
  • Indgå i det pædagogiske arbejde i husene i dagtimerne eller i weekender. Tilrettelæggelsen aftales med udgangspunkt i dine interesser og stillingens øvrige opgaver.

Vi søger dig der
  • Er uddannet og autoriseret sygeplejerske med solid erfaring med medicinhåndtering, dispensering og sundhedsfaglig dokumentation.
  • Har solidt kendskab til relevant sundhedslovgivning, herunder regler om medicinhåndtering, journalføring, samtykke, tavshedspligt og delegation af sundhedsfaglige opgaver.
  • Kender og kan anvende relevante vejledninger fra Sundhedsstyrelsen og Styrelsen for Patientsikkerhed og holder dig ajour med ændringer.
  • Kan underbygge din vejledning med gældende regler og faglige kilder og afklarer tvivlsspørgsmål, før du vejleder eller ændrer en instruks.
  • Kan skrive klare instrukser og gøre faglig viden anvendelig for medarbejdere med forskellige uddannelsesbaggrunde.
  • Kan undervise og vejlede præcist og praksisnært samt følge op på, at medarbejderne forstår deres opgaver, ansvar og kompetencegrænser.
  • Arbejder systematisk og selvstændigt og trives i et tæt tværfagligt samarbejde.
  • Møder børn og unge med respekt, nysgerrighed og blik for deres perspektiv.

Erfaring fra et børne- og ungehjem eller et andet socialt tilbud er en fordel.

Stillingen er en fast fuldtidsstilling med opgaver på MerVibs børne- og ungehjem i Herrestrup, Grevinge og Jyderup. Vi har desuden undervisningslokaler i Herlev. Du skal være villig til at bruge egen bil.

Hos MerVib får du
Et arbejdsfællesskab med varme, engagement og høj faglig standard. Du introduceres til vores hverdag, værdier og metoder og deltager fra start med støtte fra kolleger og ledelse.

Vores årshjul rummer intern og ekstern undervisning samt faglige oplæg gennem hele året. Derudover får du tæt ledelsesmæssig sparring og supervision.

For begge stillingsprofiler gælder:
  • Løn og tiltrædelse efter aftale.
  • Pension og sundhedsforsikring.
  • Kørekort til almindelig bil (B) er et krav.
  • Vi indhenter børne- og straffeattest før ansættelse.

Ansøgning og kontakt
Fortæl os, hvorfor du har lyst til at bringe din faglighed i spil hos MerVib.

Angiv tydeligt i din ansøgning, om du søger en medarbejderstilling i Herrestrup eller Grevinge eller stillingen som sygeplejerske med fokus på sundhedsfaglig kvalitet og undervisning.

Upload din ansøgning, CV og dit uddannelsesbevis via linket "Ansøg" her på siden.

Vil du høre mere om stillingerne, er du velkommen til at kontakte:
  • Medarbejderstillinger i Grevinge: Afdelingsleder Rikke Gjesing, telefon 92 90 42 24.
  • Medarbejderstillinger i Herrestrup: Afdelingsleder Nada Shouhani, telefon 92 90 42 16.
  • Sygeplejerskestillingen: Gitte Praastrup, specialkonsulent – drift, HR og kommunikation, telefon 92 90 42 22 eller job@mervib.dk .

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når de rette kandidater er fundet.

Tehtävässä huolehdit logistiikkakeskuksemme kiinteistöjen arjen sujuvuudesta ja turvallisuuteen liittyvien käytäntöjen koordinoinnista. Työssäsi huomioit kiinteistö-, tuote- ja työturvallisuuden sekä liiketoiminnan jatkuvuuden vaatimukset.

Tehtäviisi kuuluvat lisäksi palveluntuottajien työn seuranta, turvallisuuskierrokset, kulunhallinta, henkilöstöviestintä, riskienarvioinnit, pelastussuunnittelu ja harjoitukset. Kehität toimintatapoja jatkuvasti, ja tehtävän tarkempi sisältö muotoutuu osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi perusteella.

Työskentelet järjestelmällisesti ja oma-aloitteisesti, osaat priorisoida ja viet sovitut asiat loppuun. The opportunity
Are you an experienced interventional cardiologist looking to join a highly specialised university hospital with a strong clinical, academic and collaborative environment?

The Department of Cardiology at Aalborg University Hospital is seeking one or more Consultant Interventional Cardiologists from the EU/EØS to join our team. We welcome applications from candidates who are already qualified to participate in a PCI on-call service, as well as experienced PCI operators who are motivated to develop the additional competencies required for on-call duties.

The position is available as soon as possible or by mutual agreement.

This is an opportunity to work in a busy interventional cardiology environment, contribute to the development of specialised cardiac care and collaborate with highly skilled colleagues across cardiology, cardiac surgery and other disciplines.

The position
Your primary clinical responsibilities will be within interventional cardiology, particularly percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI).
The position includes participation in the department's PCI on-call service.

You will be part of a multidisciplinary team providing specialised care for patients with ischaemic heart disease, including patients requiring urgent and complex coronary interventions.
Depending on your experience, qualifications and the department's clinical needs, there may also be opportunities to contribute to the development of other specialised interventional services, including transcatheter aortic valve implantation (TAVI) and chronic total occlusion (CTO) procedures.

Alongside your clinical responsibilities, you will contribute to the department's research, teaching and professional development activities, as well as relevant administrative and organisational tasks.

What we offer
The opportunity to work in a busy university hospital with an established PCI service and a broad range of specialised cardiology services.
Professional development: Opportunities to further develop your interventional skills and, where appropriate, expand your expertise into complex PCI, TAVI or CTO procedures.
A strong multidisciplinary team: Close collaboration with cardiologists across subspecialties, cardiothoracic anaesthetists and cardiac surgeons.
An academic environment: Opportunities to participate in clinical research, teaching and the development of new treatment pathways.
Supportive colleagues and leadership: We value professional respect, constructive collaboration and a positive working environment.
Flexible working arrangements: Working hours and duty schedules are organised within the applicable employment framework.
An international perspective: The opportunity to join a university hospital committed to clinical excellence, research, education and continuous improvement.

Qualifications and experience
Essential requirements
You hold specialist certification in cardiology.
You have or are able to obtain a Danish Authorization to practice medicine
You are fluent in or command a professional working proficiency in Danish. Norwegian or Swedish (B2/C1 level)
Or are willing to learn Danish
You can perform PCI procedures independently.
You have the clinical judgement and professional skills required to manage patients with ischaemic heart disease.
You communicate effectively and work constructively with colleagues across clinical disciplines.
You can maintain an overview and make sound clinical decisions in a demanding and sometimes unpredictable environment.
You are committed to high standards of patient care, patient safety and continuous professional development.
You are willing to contribute to the department's clinical, organisational and educational activities and to take on the leadership and supervisory responsibilities associated with a consultant position.

Desirable qualifications
Experience participating in a PCI on-call service.
Experience from a university hospital or another highly specialised cardiac centre.
Experience in complex PCI, TAVI or CTO procedures.
A PhD, or other research qualifications or a strong record of scientific publications.
Experience in clinical research, teaching or quality improvement.
Experience in a PCI on-call service is an advantage but is not essential, provided you are an independent PCI operator and are motivated to acquire the necessary competencies following an appropriate period of training and induction.

About the Department
The Department of Cardiology at Aalborg University Hospital is a large, specialised and research-active department providing advanced care across a broad range of cardiovascular conditions, including ischaemic heart disease, cardiac arrhythmias, heart failure, valvular heart disease, thoracic aortic aneurysms, pericardial diseases, thromboembolic disorders and dyslipidaemia.

Our department performs approximately:
6,000 invasive procedures annually
8,000 inpatient admissions annually
More than 30,000 outpatient consultations annually
Approximately 14,000 echocardiographic examinations annually

Our medical team comprises doctors at different stages of postgraduate training and 32 consultant cardiologists, including two professors.
We provide inpatient and outpatient services, operate a cardiac catheterisation laboratory and maintain a dedicated cardiology research unit.
Our work is guided by a shared commitment to clinical excellence, patient safety and involving patients and their families in shared decision-making. We also have a strong responsibility for undergraduate medical education and postgraduate specialist training.
The department operates across three hospital sites in Aalborg, Thisted and Hobro, with the vast majority of clinical activity based at the newly built Aalborg University Hospital.

Salary and terms of employment
This is a full-time position. Salary and terms of employment are in accordance with the applicable Danish collective agreement.
The position includes participation in the department's PCI on-call service.
Further details regarding the on-call arrangement and employment conditions can be discussed with the Head of Department or Lead Senior Physician Bent Raungaard tlf. 27201096, e-mail: b.raungaard@rn.dk

Application
Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and interviews will be arranged continuously.
Please include:
Curriculum Vitae (CV).
Letter of motivation
Proof of specialist certification in cardiology.
List of publications, if applicable.
