jobs.title: Jurist
jobs.description:
Som den största svenskspråkiga yrkeshögskolan i Finland är Novia en stark kraft i det finlandssvenska samhället. Med verksamhet i Vasa, Åbo, Jakobstad och Raseborg skapar vi förutsättningar för att studerande, arbetslivspartners och regioner ska utvecklas och växa.


I arbetsuppgiften ingår
Som jurist vid Novia har du en central expertroll med ett brett kontaktnät i organisationen. Du ger juridisk rådgivning i frågor som berör högskolans verksamhet, förvaltning och beslutsfattande. Tyngdpunkten i arbetet är avtalsrätt som stöder högskolans forsknings-, utvecklings- och innovationsverksamhet. Arbetet är både rådgivande och operativt, det omfattar självständiga utredningar, juridisk kvalitetssäkring samt utveckling av anvisningar och processer. Du är också högskolans dataskyddsombud.

Vi vill betona följande
Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av flera av följande områden: avtalsrätt, offentlig upphandling, dataskydd, förvaltningsrätt, arbetsrätt, immaterialrätt samt juridiska frågor inom forskning, utbildning och extern finansiering.

Vi söker dig som
- har högre högskoleexamen i juridik och erfarenhet av kvalificerat juridiskt arbete
- har god kännedom om finländsk lagstiftning
- uttrycker dig mycket väl på svenska och kan arbeta på finska och engelska
- gör komplex juridik begriplig och ger tydliga, praktiska råd
- arbetar självständigt, strukturerat och lösningsorienterat med hög integritet.

Med den sökandes samtycke kan en begränsad säkerhetsutredning utföras.


Hos Novia får du ett mångsidigt och meningsfullt arbete i en organisation som bidrar till kvalitativ utbildning, forskning och hållbar samhällsutveckling. Vi erbjuder en självständig expertroll med stort ansvar, ett brett kontaktnät inom högskolan och möjligheter att utveckla både verksamheten och din egen kompetens. Du blir en del av en inkluderande och samarbetsinriktad arbetsgemenskap där vi värdesätter professionalism, utveckling och välmående i arbetet.
Lön enligt kollektivavtal för yrkeshögskolor och interna direktiv. Till befattningen hör en prövotid på sex månader.

Anställning
från och med 1.1.2027, eller enligt överenskommelse.

Placeringsort
Vasa eller Åbo. Vi är även öppna för flexibla lösningar.

Närmare information
Kontakta förvaltnings- och personaldirektör Ulrica Karp mobil 050 502 5550.

Ansökan
Vi ser fram emot din ansökan senast måndag 2.11.2026 kl. 23:59. Ansökan inlämnas via vårt elektroniska system. Till ansökan bifogas ansökningsbrev och CV.

jobs.title: Tukitiimin asiantuntija, 50 % – Tampere
jobs.description:
**Tee digiarjesta helpompaa sosiaalialan ammattilaisille!**

Osaatko ratkaista tietoteknisen pulman ja selittää ratkaisun niin, että toinenkin oppii? Käytätkö tekoälyä sujuvasti ja löydät sen avulla parempia tapoja tehdä työtä? Meillä osaamisellasi on konkreettinen vaikutus: autat sosiaalialan ammattilaisia keskittymään ihmisten auttamiseen.

ANNU sosiaalipalvelut tuottaa kotiin vietäviä sosiaalihuollon palveluja. Etsimme Tampereen toimistollemme osa-aikaista tukitiimin asiantuntijaa, joka yhdistää teknisen osaamisen erinomaisiin vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoihin. Olet henkilöstömme helposti lähestyttävä tuki järjestelmien ja digitaalisten työvälineiden käytössä. Neuvot, näytät käytännössä ja laadit ymmärrettäviä ohjeita. Henkilöstön digitaidot vaihtelevat, joten osaat aloittaa tarvittaessa aivan perusteista ja mukauttaa opastuksen jokaisen osaamiseen.

Työhösi kuuluu:

- Henkilöstön opastaminen sekä arjen IT-pulmien ratkaiseminen.

- Järjestelmien, käyttöoikeuksien ja lisenssien hallinta. Työvälineitä ovat muun muassa Microsoft 365, DomaCare, Hailer sekä Kanta-, Soteri- ja palvelusetelijärjestelmät.

- Asiakirjojen valmistelu ja selkeiden kokonaisuuksien kokoaminen toimitusjohtajan, palvelujohtajan ja taloushallinnon tarpeisiin.

- Verkkosivujen sekä markkinoinnin ja sosiaalisen median tekninen ylläpito.

- Kilpailutusten valmistelun ja hallinnon tukeminen sekä käytännön toimintatapojen kehittäminen.

- Työskentelet suoraan toimitusjohtajan alaisuudessa ja yhteistyössä palvelujohdon ja muun hallinnon kanssa.

Millainen osaaja sopii meille?

Tärkeintä on, että osaat tehdä tekniikasta ymmärrettävää. Olet kärsivällinen ja selkeä opastaja, jonka puoleen uskaltaa kääntyä myös ihan peruskysymyksissä. Kuuntelet, teet yhteistyötä ja viet asiat loppuun.

Edellytämme:

- Soveltuvaa suoritettua tutkintoa, esimerkiksi tieto- ja viestintätekniikan perustutkintoa tai tietojenkäsittelyn tradenomin tutkintoa. Loppuvaiheen opiskelijat huomioidaan.

- Hyvää käytännön IT-osaamista ja kykyä omaksua uusia järjestelmiä.

- Sujuvaa ja tehokasta tekoälyn käyttöä työvälineenä esimerkiksi asiakirjojen ja ohjeiden laatimisessa, tiedonhaussa ja ongelmanratkaisussa. Tarkistat tuotosten oikeellisuuden ja huomioit tietosuojan.

- Selkeää suullista ja kirjallista suomen kielen taitoa sekä kykyä jäsentää tietoa ymmärrettäviksi kokonaisuuksiksi.

- Kokemus käyttäjien opastamisesta, Microsoft 365 -ympäristöstä tai sosiaali- ja terveysalalta on eduksi. Kaikkia käyttämiämme järjestelmiä ei tarvitse tuntea ennestään.


Miksi meille?

- Saat monipuolisen tehtävän, jossa työsi tulokset näkyvät suoraan muiden arjessa.

- Pääset kehittämään käytännön ratkaisuja, hyödyntämään tekoälyä ja vaikuttamaan siihen, miten digitaalisia työvälineitä käytetään yrityksessämme.

- Sosiaalialan kollegasi tuovat yhteistyöhön oman osaamisensa – sinä autat heitä saamaan enemmän irti teknologiasta.

- Voit vaikuttaa työaikoihisi. Työ tapahtuu arkisin kello 8:00-18:00 välillä.

- Työ tehdään Tampereen toimistollamme. Toivomme että viihdyt yhteisessä toimistossa ja tulet hyvin toimeen erilaisten ihmisten kanssa. Autat muita mielelläsi, mutta osaat myös keskittyä omiin tehtäviisi ja jatkaa niitä keskeytysten jälkeen. Huomioit työtoverisi ja annat heille työrauhan.

- Työaika on **50 % kokoaikaisesta työajasta**. Työsuhteessa noudatetaan yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimusta. Palkkaluokka on **G24D**, ja palkka 50 %:n työajalla on **1 405,55–1 535,55 €/kk** hyväksyttävästä palvelusajasta riippuen.

Työn aloitus mahdollisimman pian.

jobs.title: Er du typen, der tager ansvar og får tingene til at spille? Så læs med her!
jobs.description:
Vi søger en ansvarsbevidst og praktisk anlagt medarbejder til en fuldtidsstilling på daghold hos en mindre produktionsvirksomhed i Herning.

Virksomheden producerer blandt andet bordplader og trapper, og her er stolte håndværkstraditioner og høj kvalitet en vigtig del af hverdagen.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan lide at tage fat, holde overblik og gå forrest, når der er brug for det. Du behøver ikke at være leder, men du skal have lyst til at tage ansvar for dine opgaver og bidrage til, at hverdagen fungerer godt.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Du får en alsidig hverdag, hvor dine primære opgaver bliver:

  • Pakning og klargøring af varer til forsendelse

  • Forsendelse og håndtering af tilhørende papirer

  • Truckkørsel

  • Betjening af pudsemaskine

  • Læsning af tegninger, ordrer og arbejdsinstruktioner

Der kan også være andre praktiske opgaver i produktionen, så det er vigtigt, at du trives med en varieret arbejdsdag og er klar til at hjælpe dér, hvor der er behov.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du er en voksen og moden person, som har en naturlig ansvarsfølelse og kan arbejde selvstændigt. Du tager gerne initiativ, følger dine opgaver til dørs og har øje for både kvalitet og orden.

Derudover ser vi gerne, at du:

  • Har erfaring fra træindustrien og/eller med lager og logistik

  • Har truckcertifikat og erfaring med truckkørsel

  • Er praktisk anlagt og ikke bange for at tage fat

  • Er stabil, kvalitetsbevidst og god til at samarbejde

  • Kan tale, læse og forstå dansk – det er et krav, da du skal kunne læse tegninger, ordrer, forsendelsespapirer og vigtige arbejdsinstruktioner på dansk

Hvad kan du forvente?

Du bliver en del af en mindre virksomhed med omkring 15 engagerede kolleger, som står klar til at tage godt imod dig og lære dig op i opgaverne.

Her er der kort vej fra tanke til handling, og du får mulighed for at blive en vigtig del af den daglige drift. Det er en arbejdsplads, hvor man hjælper hinanden, tager ansvar og arbejder sammen om at levere et godt resultat.

Du bliver i første omgang ansat gennem Medarbejderne ApS i en prøveperiode. For den rette medarbejder er der gode muligheder for fastansættelse hos virksomheden på sigt.

Lyder det som en stilling for dig?

Så ansøg om stillingen via dette link; https://medarbejderne.peopletrust.dk/candidate/?module=candidateweb&page=Job&action=readMore&jobId=1020175

Bemærk at ansøgninger og CV via mails bliver IKKE behandlet.

Arbejdssted: Herning
Arbejdstid: Fuldtid på daghold

Medarbejderne ApS håndterer ansættelsen for virksomheden. Vi er et veldrevet Vikar & Rekrutterings Bureau, med mange års erfaring og en høj standard. Vi er medlem af VikarBranchen DI, som bla. andet forpligtiger os til at overholde mange etiske regler så som GDPR og overenskomster. Vi lever af at knytte kontakt mellem arbejdsgiver og arbejdstager.

jobs.title: Morgen Tjener/Kok til Bandholm badehotel!
jobs.description:
Er du morgenfrisk og glad for at give gæster en god start på dagen?

Bandholm Badehotel søger morgenmadspersonale til både fuldtids- og deltidsstillinger med opstart hurtigst muligt.

En god morgen starter med en varm velkomst, frisk kaffe og en indbydende morgenbuffet. Derfor søger vi engagerede kollegaer, som har lyst til at gøre morgenmaden til en god oplevelse for vores gæster.

Du bliver en del af Bandholm Badehotel – en del af Horizon – og et team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og sætter pris på godt værtskab, kvalitet og en god tone.

Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet at:

  • Klargøre morgenmaden og sørge for, at buffeten er indbydende og løbende fyldt op.

  • Tage imod gæsterne med et smil og hjælpe dem godt til rette.

  • Holde morgenmadsområdet pænt og ryddeligt.

  • Rydde af, vaske op og gøre klar til næste dag.

  • Samarbejde med køkkenet og hotellets øvrige medarbejdere.

Vi søger dig, der:

  • Er morgenfrisk, mødestabil og tager ansvar for dine opgaver.

  • Er smilende og imødekommende og kan lide at have kontakt med gæster.

  • Arbejder selvstændigt og bevarer overblikket, når der er travlt.

  • Har øje for detaljerne og hjælper til, hvor der er brug for det.

Erfaring fra hotel, restaurant eller café er en fordel, men det vigtigste er din indstilling og lyst til at lære. Vi sørger for en god oplæring.

Arbejdstid og opstart

Vi søger medarbejdere til både fuldtid og deltid. Vagterne ligger typisk kl. 06.00–12.00 eller kl. 06.00–14.00, og du skal regne med at arbejde hver anden weekend i gennemsnit.

Vi ønsker opstart hurtigst muligt og aftaler timetal nærmere med dig.

Vi tilbyder

En varieret hverdag i smukke omgivelser ved vandet, gode kollegaer og en arbejdsplads, hvor din indsats er med til at gøre en forskel for gæsterne. Løn efter kvalifikationer.

Vil du være en del af holdet?

Send en kort ansøgning og gerne dit CV til Kasper@couloir.dk. Skriv “Morgenmad – Bandholm Badehotel” i emnefeltet, og fortæl os, om du søger fuldtid eller deltid, samt hvornår du kan starte.

Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte Kasper Nielsen på kasper@couloir.dk

Vi holder samtaler løbende og glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager Strategic Initiatives
jobs.description:
OUR MISSION

We exist to create a more connected, compassionate, and confident experience for people with cancer and those who care for them. We make it easier to get answers, access high-quality care quickly, and feel supported throughout treatment and beyond.

Today, Thyme Care is a market-leading value-based oncology care enabler, partnering with national and regional health plans, providers, and employers to deliver better outcomes and lower costs for thousands of people across the country. Our model combines high-touch human support with powerful technology and AI to bring together everyone involved in a person's cancer journey: caregivers, oncologists, health plans, and employers.

As a tech-native organization, we believe technology should strengthen the human connection at the center of care. Through data science, automation, and AI, we simplify complexity, improve collaboration, and help our care team focus on what matters most: supporting people through cancer.

Looking ahead, our vision is bold: to become a household name in cancer care, where every person diagnosed asks for Thyme Care by name. If you're inspired to make cancer care more human and to help reimagine what's possible, we'd love to meet you. Together, we can build a future where every person with cancer feels truly cared for, in every moment that matters.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

We're hiring a Principal Product Manager to set the product direction for new, zero-to-one initiatives focused on applying AI to make better care decisions in oncology â helping people receive the right, evidence-based treatment at the moment it matters. Working closely with senior clinical, operations, engineering, and business leaders, you will shape the strategy, identify the highest-value opportunities, and lead the most complex and consequential product work needed to build a solution with the potential to become a category-defining platform.

This is a hands-on, zero-to-one role for a product leader who can operate at both the strategic and implementation levels â moving fluidly between learning from users, defining product direction, partnering with engineering and other stakeholders to shape solutions , and driving execution to launch. You will establish the product foundation across workflow tooling, data integrations, and AI systems, while creating patterns that can scale across future products and initiatives. Much of this work sits at the intersection of applied AI, clinical guidelines, and operational workflows in a regulated setting where fidelity, auditability, and trust are non-negotiable. This is an individual contributor role today, with the opportunity to build and lead a product team over time as this business line grows.

Additionally, you will:

  • Drive the roadmap for a zero-to-one AI initiative to improve care decisions in oncology

  • Prototype, test, and ship AI powered products with engineering and other teams cross functionally

  • Build the workflow tooling and decision support surfaces clinicians and care teams need to act on AI recommendations

  • Own the evaluations, guardrails, and observability standards to ensure recommendations are accurate, safe, and trusted across, auditable, and defensible to clinical, provider, and health-plan stakeholders

  • Partner with engineering to shape the technical architecture around AI systems, data models, and integrations

  • Communicate tradeoffs and profess clearly to senior clinical, engineering, and business stakeholders

  • Leverage AI to accelerate your own work and help decide how the team uses AI tooling to move faster and prototype more efficiently

WHAT YOU'VE DONE

  • 6+ years of product management experience, including leading zero-to-one or early-stage initiatives when the problem, requirements, and path forward were not fully defined

  • You have healthcare experience, ideally building workflow, data, or integration products for enterprise contexts

  • Youâre comfortable with ambiguity and defining a path forward for yourself and others

  • You have hands-on experience building or shipping AI/LLM-powered products

  • You communicate clearly and build alignment across engineering, clinical, and business stakeholders

  • You like to operate close to the technical details, such as data models, edge cases, evaluations, and impacts of implementation

Nice to haves:

  • Experience in oncology, serious illness / palliative care, or chronic condition management

  • Hands-on experience shipping AI/LLM-powered product features, including safety guardrails, evaluation, and quality measurement

OUR VALUES

At Thyme Care, our core values guide us in everything we do: Act with our members in mind, Move with purpose, and Seek diverse perspectives. They anchor our business decisions, including how we grow, the products we make, and the paths we chooseâor donât choose.

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of the total compensation package that also includes equity, benefits, and other opportunities at Thyme Care. Individual pay decisions are based on several factors, including qualifications, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to other Thyme Care employees. The base salary for this role is $195,500-$230,000. The salary range could be lower or higher than this if the role is hired at another level. This position is also bonus-eligible.

We recognize a history of inequality in healthcare. Weâre here to challenge the status quo and create a culture of inclusion through the care we give and the company we build. We embrace and celebrate a diversity of perspectives in reflection of our members and the members we serve. We are an equal-opportunity employer.

Be cautious of recruitment fraud, and always confirm that communications are coming from an official Thyme Care email.

jobs.description:

In this role, you will play a key part in supporting the planning, coordination, and follow-up of business and IT demands, projects, and development activities. You will help ensure that new initiatives are properly captured, evaluated, and guided through governance processes, while also providing hands-on project coordination support.

The position is located in Espoo with a hybrid model, requiring office attendance at least twice a week.

You are offered
- A structured onboarding process and an environment that strongly supports your professional growth in demand planning, portfolio management, and project management.
- Flexible hybrid working model with a minimum office presence in Espoo (approx. 2 days per week).

Work tasks

- Governance Support: Prepare overview materials and dashboards for prioritization and governance meetings, while carefully tracking approvals, deferrals, and action items.
- Project Coordination: Support project planning, administration, and execution, including updating schedules, maintaining action logs, tracking milestones, and identifying basic risks
- Financial Administration: Help manage financial tracking, purchase orders, consultant time reporting, budget monitoring, and related documentation.
- Stakeholder Communication: Coordinate transparent communications, prepare clear presentation materials, and contribute to the continuous improvement of coordination processes.

We are looking for

- A relevant educational background (Bachelor's degree, ongoing studies, or equivalent experience in Business, IT, Project Management, or a related field).
- Some previous exposure to demand planning, project coordination, portfolio administration, or general project support (e.g., through work, internships, or academic projects).
- Strong proficiency in Microsoft 365 tools
- Basic understanding of project budgets, cost tracking, and resource allocation.
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to bridge the gap between business and IT needs.
- Fluent skills in spoken and written English.

It is meritorious if you have
- Good knowledge of Finnish or Swedish
- Knowledge of ServiceNow SPM, demand management, or IT governance

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
- Trustful
- Supportive
- Orderly
- Responsible
- Intellectually curious

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.title: Restaurantchef til Bandholm Badehotel - Vil du være med til at definere det næste skridt?
jobs.description:
Restaurantchef søges til Bandholm Badehotel – en del af Horizon

Vil du være med til at sætte retningen for service og gæsteoplevelser på Bandholm Badehotel?

Vi søger en engageret restaurantchef, der har passion for værtskab og lyst til at udvikle både vores service og vores team.

På Bandholm Badehotel er nærvær, kvalitet og gode gæsteoplevelser omdrejningspunktet. Som restaurantchef får du ansvaret for vores Restaurant Alba samt morgenmad, konferencer og selskaber – i tæt samarbejde med køkkenet, hotellets øvrige afdelinger og dit tjenerteam og vores driftchef Rasmus.

Vi søger en dygtig og struktureret leder, som skaber overblik, går forrest i driften og sørger for, at både gæster og medarbejdere føler sig godt tilpas.

Vi tilbyder

  • En selvstændig fuldtidsstilling med ansvar for dit team af tjenere og evt. elever.

  • Mulighed for at sætte dit præg på service, arbejdsgange og gæsteoplevelser.

  • En varieret arbejdsdag i smukke omgivelser ved vandet.

  • En arbejdsplads med en god tone, stærkt sammenhold og tæt samarbejde på tværs af huset.

  • Mulighed for faglig sparring på tværs af Horizon, som Bandholm Badehotel er en del af.

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

  • Ansvar for den daglige restaurantdrift og service, herunder morgenmad, frokost, à la carte, konferencer og selskaber.

  • Planlægning af vagter og bemanding i tjenerteamet.

  • Sikring af høj kvalitet i værtskab, servering og den samlede gæsteoplevelse.

  • Opfølgning på økonomi, lønforbrug og relevante nøgletal.

  • Oplæring og udvikling af dit team, både fagligt og servicemæssigt.

  • Sikring af, at medarbejderne kender menuer, vine og hotellets tilbud, så de kan vejlede gæsterne med sikkerhed og engagement.

  • Selskabssamtaler og planlægning i samarbejde med vores koordinator.

  • Tæt samarbejde med køkkenet og hotellets øvrige afdelinger.

Vi forventer, at du

  • Er faglært tjener eller har tilsvarende erfaring og faglig viden.

  • Er en tydelig, motiverende og nærværende leder, som selv går forrest, men også giver andre ansvar og plads til at udvikle sig.

  • Arbejder selvstændigt og struktureret og bevarer overblikket, når der er travlt.

  • Indgår aktivt i driften og tror på, at et stærkt team skabes ved at arbejde sammen.

  • Har forståelse for sammenhængen mellem god service, kvalitet og en sund økonomi.

  • Har erfaring med overenskomster og arbejdstidsregler eller er klar til at lære.

  • Har lyst til at være med til at videreudvikle Bandholm Badehotel som et sted, gæsterne glæder sig til at besøge og vende tilbage til.

Kort om Bandholm Badehotel og Horizon

Bandholm Badehotel ligger i smukke omgivelser ved vandet på Lolland. Her danner hotellet og Restaurant Alba rammen om ophold, restaurantbesøg, konferencer og selskaber med fokus på nærvær, gastronomi og godt værtskab.

Vi er en del af Horizon, som driver flere hoteller og restauranter. Det giver os et fællesskab med mulighed for at dele erfaringer, udvikle medarbejdere og hente inspiration på tværs af vores steder.

Hos os får du mulighed for at få indflydelse på din arbejdsplads og være med til at omsætte ambitioner til gode oplevelser for vores gæster.

Ansøgning og yderligere information

Vi ønsker stillingen besat snarest muligt – gerne med tiltrædelse den 1. november 2026.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat. Send derfor gerne din ansøgning allerede nu.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Kasper Nielsen på +45 6017 4832.

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til Kasper@couloir.dk, og skriv “Restaurantchef – Bandholm Badehotel” i emnefeltet.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: PhD-fellowship
jobs.description:
About the position

A 3-year position as Ph.D. Research Fellow is available at the Center for Lifespan Changes in Brain and Cognition (LCBC), at the Department of Psychology, University of Oslo. The position will fit a motivated candidate with interest in memory and task-based functional imaging (fMRI). The primary objective of the position is to uncover the neural mechanisms underlying age-related memory change.

The research centre

The goal of LCBC is to understand differences and changes in brain and cognition across the entire lifespan, and to identify how brain function and cognition can be optimized. LCBC is an active, multidisciplinary research center with around 25 full-time staff members, including four professors, two researchers, several postdoctoral fellows and PhD candidates, chief and senior data engineers, full- and part-time research assistants, administrative support, and several affiliated international researchers. 

LCBC has excellent research infrastructure, including access to a 3T Siemens Prisma MRI scanner, PET and EEG facilities, and comprehensive neuropsychological and somatic testing facilities. English is the main working language at the center.

LCBC has secured several large grants, including four European Research Council (ERC) grants, a Horizon 2020 and a Horizon Europe grant, and several grants from the Research Council of Norway, the National Health Association of Norway, and the University of Oslo. In 2015, the group was designated “world-leading” and is one of only five such groups at the University of Oslo. More information is available on the LCBC website: https://www.lcbc.uio.no.


Project description

The Ph.D. fellow will work primarily on existing experimental fMRI data collected in the project "Lifespan Memory Imaging", funded by the Research Council of Norway. Using longitudinal imaging of brain activity and task-based connectivity, the project aims to predict early who will show memory decline and who will maintain good function as they age. This unique longitudinal fMRI dataset of episodic memory includes encoding and retrieval scans at both baseline and follow-up 6-8 years later. The project also leverages multimodal imaging data, including DTI, PET and ASL, and longitudinal cognitive and neuropsychological assessments. The position will focus specifically on the fMRI data to identify neural mechanisms underlying individual differences in age-related memory changes.


Your tasks
  • Process and analyze task-based fMRI data to estimate how memory processing changes throughout life.
  • Integrate data from multiple sources, including longitudinal cognitive assessments and PET imaging, genetic information and other types of data.
  • Write and publish scientific articles.
  • Collaborate extensively with the PI/supervisor, as well as other researchers at the center and collaborators of the center, including scientists in psychology, statistics, and genetics.
  • As the main purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a Ph.D. degree, the research fellow must take part in the Faculty’s approved Ph.D. program.

Qualifications
  • Applicants must either hold a Master’s degree (or equivalent) in psychology, medicine, cognitive science, neuroscience, or a closely related field with an average grade of A or B. 
  • To be employed as a PhD Research Fellow, admission to a doctoral program is required. Read about admission and requirements to the Faculty's PhD program here: Applying for a PhD fellowship at the Faculty of Social Sciences.
  • Strong interest in cognitive processes and underlying brain mechanisms.
  • Applicants must have experience working with a high-level programming language such as MATLAB, Python, and/or R.
  • Good written and oral proficiency in English. If the person appointed does not have skills in Norwegian, Swedish or Danish at level A2 at the time of employment, we will offer Norwegian language courses with the aim of achieving Norwegian language skills at least this level.

The following will be considered advantages

  • Experience in using neuroimaging data to study brain function.
  • Experience with longitudinal analyses.
  • Experience with processing task-based fMRI data.
  • Experience with fMRI analytic methods including network metrics.
  • Experience with task-based connectivity methods (i.e. beta-series correlation or psychophysiological interaction [PPI]).
  • Good understanding of quantitative methods.
  • Experience with research in interdisciplinary environments.

Personal qualities

In the evaluation of applicants, emphasis will be placed on the following personal skills: 

  • Candidate’s good co-operative skills, and the ability to successfully join in academic collaboration.
  • Candidate’s professional and personal ability to work independently.

We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


We offer
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • Committed, highly competent colleagues in a good working environment. 
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities. 
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Doctoral Research Fellow, position code 1017 in salary range NOK from 558 000 - to 625 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.

 

Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.


Application

Your application should include:

  • Letter of application, 1-2 pages, explaining the motivation for applying.
  • CV summarizing education, positions, and academic work.
  • Copies of educational certificates, publications/academic work (if any) that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee.
  • Names and contact details of at least two references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail, and telephone number).
  • International applicants are advised to attach an explanation of their University’s grading system.

Your CV must be entered in Jobbnorge’s CV form and cannot be submitted only as an attachment. This requirement is intended to ensure correct documentation and record-keeping in accordance with the Public Administration Act, Section 15.

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

Please note that we are unable to add documentation after the application deadline. As the deadline applies equally to all applicants, this policy ensures equal treatment throughout the recruitment process. If you experience difficulties uploading documents in Jobbnorge, please contact their customer service: Phone: +47 75 54 22 20 or Email: support@grade.com 

The primary method of communication throughout the process will be e-mails and messages through the recruitment system Jobbnorge. When you receive a notification of a message in Jobbnorge, please log in to read it, as it may be important.

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews. 

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to recruitment positions at UiO and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees to secure the rights to all research results and related intellectual property.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Department of Psychology is one of seven units of the Faculty of Social Sciences, and has 75 permanent and 70 temporary members of scientific staff. Degrees are offered at bachelor and master level, plus a clinical training programme, and the PhD programme has 140 students.

jobs.title: Vil du forme fremtidens grønne og levende arbeidsplasser på Sunnmøre?
jobs.description:
Er du en relasjonsbygger som motiveres av å skape visuelle endringer og bedre trivsel for ansatte?

 

Har du lyst til å selge et produkt alle vil ha, og som beviselig forbedrer arbeidsmiljøet? Safari Planter AS opplever solid vekst, og nå søker vi deg som vil ta eierskap til B2B-markedet vårt i Ålesund og omegn.

 

Hvorfor er dette en unik mulighet?

De fleste selger software, forsikring eller kaffemaskiner. Hos Safari Planter selger du en opplevelse, bedre inneklima og estetiske arbeidsplasser. Grønne vegger, spektakulære atriumløsninger og skreddersydd planteinteriør er i vinden som aldri før. Bedrifter investerer tungt i å få de ansatte tilbake til kontoret – og her sitter du med nøkkelen.

 

Som B2B-selger hos oss får du en sjelden kombinasjon av kreativ rådgivning og rendyrket business-to-business-salg. Du blir vårt ansikt utad mot regionens mest spennende bedrifter, eiendomsutviklere og arkitekter.

 

 

Hva vil hverdagen din bestå i?

Du vil ha stor frihet til å legge opp din egen arbeidsdag, med base fra vårt kontor i Ålesund. Hovedfokus er å fylle egen portefølje og skape grønnere rom for næringsliv og offentlig sektor:

 

  • Oppsøkende salg og relasjonsbygging: Du identifiserer muligheter, booker møter og bygger langsiktige partnerskap med beslutningstakere.
  • Kreativ rådgivning: Du lytter til kundens behov og tegner ut helhetlige løsninger i grensesnittet mellom interiør, arkitektur og biophilia (menneskets behov for natur).
  • Anbud og prosjekter: Du driver prosessene fra første kontakt og tilbudsskriving til forhandlinger og avtaleinngåelse – inkludert offentlige anskaffelser.

  • Nettverksbygging: Du representerer Safari Planter på messer, bransjetreff og i samarbeid med lokale arkitekter og interiørarkitekter.

     

 

Hvem er du?

Vi ser etter deg som trigges av å lukke avtaler, men som forstår at et godt salg starter med tillit. Du har gjerne erfaring fra prosjektsalg, kapitalvaresalg eller interiørløsninger mot bedriftsmarkedet

 

  • Du er en jeger med rådgiverhatt: Du trives med oppsøkende aktivitet, men fremstår som en profesjonell og lyttende sparringspartner for kunden.
  • Du har kommersiell teft: Du forstår B2B-markedet, hvordan offentlige innkjøp fungerer, og hvordan du posisjonerer Safari Planter som den foretrukne leverandøren.
  • Du har nettverk på Sunnmøre: Det er en stor fordel om du allerede kjenner det lokale næringslivet i regionen.
  • Språk og logistikk: Du kommuniserer flytende på norsk (skriftlig og muntlig), har gode engelskkunnskaper, og førerkort klasse B er et krav da du vil være mye på farten.

 

 

Hva kan vi tilby deg?
  • En attraktiv lønnsmodell: Konkurransedyktig fastlønn i bunn, kombinert med en provisjonsmodell som belønner gode resultater.
  • Høy påvirkningskraft: Vi er en fremoverlent organisasjon der veien fra idé til beslutning er kort. Du får være med på å forme våre fremtidige konsepter og salgsstrategier.
  • Et sterkt fagmiljø: Du blir en del av et uformelt, engasjert og faglig sterkt team som brenner for det de leverer.
  • Et takknemlig produkt: Du selger løsninger som bidrar direkte til økt trivsel, lavere sykefravær og flottere visuelle rammer hos kundene dine.

jobs.title: Siivoojia tehdassiivoukseen Nokialle
jobs.description:
Etsimme aurinkoiseen joukkoomme vähintään kuutta huolellista ja luotettavaa

PALVELUVASTAAVAA TEOLLISUUSKOHTEEN SIIVOUSTEHTÄVIIN NOKIALLE

vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Tarjolla on sekä osa-aikaisia että kokoaikaisia työsuhteita.



Työt alkavat 29.12.2026.

Monipuolinen ja vastuullinen työnkuva

Tehtävässäsi palveluvastaavana huolehdit siisteydestä ja puhtaudesta monipuolisessa teollisuuskohteessa Nokialla. Työpäiväsi ovat vaihtelevia ja pääset vaikuttamaan suoraan työympäristön viihtyvyyteen ja turvallisuuteen. Teollisuuden tuotantotiloissa työskenneltäessä on tärkeää ottaa huomioon ympäristön erityispiirteet. Tuotantotiloissa työolosuhteet voivat olla ajoittain lämpimät ja tiloissa voi esiintyä tuotantoprosessista aiheutuvia hajuja. Turvallisuus on kohteessa kaiken keskiössä: tuotannon tiloissa on paljon liikennettä, kuten trukkeja ja AGV-vaunuja, joten tarkkaavaisuus ja turvallisuusohjeiden noudattaminen on välttämätöntä. Teet työtä itsenäisesti, mutta kuulut isoon tiimiin ja kohtaat päivittäin lukuisia asiakkaan edustajia, joten asiakaspalveluasenne on avainasemassa.

Työtehtäviisi sisältyvät:

- Sosiaali- ja taukotilojen siivous.

- Toimistojen, neuvottelutilojen ja aulojen sekä muiden yleisten tilojen siivous.

- Tuotantotilojen siivous sopimuksen mukaan ja turvallisesti.

- Varmistat osana työyhteisöä, että tilat ovat turvalliset ja esteettömät.

- Vahinkojen ja huoltotarpeiden raportointi ohjeistuksen mukaisesti.

Työvuorot sijoittuvat kello 6–20 välille maanantaista lauantaihin työvuorolistan mukaisesti. Työtunteja kertyy tehtävästä riippuen 15–37,5 tuntia viikossa. Tarjolla on sekä osa-aikaisia että kokoaikaisia työsuhteita, joten kerrothan hakulomakkeella kummasta vaihtoehdosta olet kiinnostunut. Koska työajat vaihtelevat aamu- ja iltavuorojen välillä, toivomme sinulta joustavuutta työaikojen suhteen sekä valmiutta työskennellä aikaisissa aamuissa ja myöhäisissä illoissa.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

- Aiempaa työkokemusta vastaavista tehtävistä.

- Hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja. Kohteessa toimii suuri tiimi ja asiakkaan edustajia, joten sujuva kommunikaatio on tärkeää.

- Joustavuutta työajoissa aamu- ja iltavuorojen välillä.

- Täysi-ikäisyyttä.

- Suomen kielen taitoa (taso B1-B2). Turvallisuusvaatimusten vuoksi sinun tulee kyetä kommunikoimaan suomeksi ja ymmärtämään suomenkieliset työ- ja turvallisuusohjeet täysin.
[Good Proficiency in Finnish (B1-B2 level) is required. Due to safety requirements, you must be able to communicate in Finnish and fully understand work-related and safety instructions provided in Finnish.]

Eduksi katsomme:

- Eritoten kokemus teollisuuden puhtauspalveluiden tuottamisesta katsotaan eduksi.

- Voimassa olevan työturvallisuuskortin.

Mitä me tarjoamme sinulle?

- Merkityksellisen työn.

- Mukavan ja kannustavan työyhteisön sekä esimiehen ja tiimin tuen.

- Laadukkaat ja toimivat työvälineet.

- Koeajan jälkeen lakisääteistä laajemmat työterveyden palvelut sekä liikunta- ja hierontaedut käyttöösi.

- SOL Life -ohjelman mukaisen panostuksen työturvallisuuteesi ja hyvinvointiisi.

- Mahdollisuuden kehittyä ja edetä urallasi. Tarjoamme koulutuksia ja erilaisia urapolkuja.

Palkkaus noudattaa kiinteistöpalvelualan työehtosopimusta palkkaryhmässä 2-3.



Kiinnostuitko? Haethan paikkaa mahdollisimman pian täyttämällä sähköisen hakemuslomakkeemme huolella ja liittämällä mukaan ansioluettelosi ja/tai hakukirjeesi. Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana ja täytämme paikat heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Miia Mustalahti, miia.mustalahti(at)sol.fi. Huomaathan, että otamme hakemukset vastaan ainoastaan sähköisen hakujärjestelmämme kautta.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral position in computational modeling of visual perception
jobs.description:
The Department of Psychology, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for a fully funded postdoctoral position in computational modeling of visual perception. The position is available for up to 36 months and is part of a project led by Dr. Gregory Scott Francis that is supported by the SDU Department of Psychology. The starting date is March 15, 2026, or as soon as possible thereafter.

Research environment

The postdoc will be affiliated with the Research Unit of Health and Cognitive Psychology. The position is at the SDU Esbjerg campus but will also involve interaction with staff at the SDU Odense campus. 

Project description

A basic process of the visual system is to monitor the location and characteristics of objects in a scene, and the multiple object tracking (MOT) paradigm has identified many fundamental aspects of this process. With a rich literature of empirical results, this paradigm is ready for theoretical development, which this project intends to pursue using an integrate-and-fire neural network model known as LAMINART. A key aspect of the model is the ability to select/segment visual objects, which may explain how people can (seemingly) effortlessly track multiple objects in a dynamic visual scene. 

The successful candidate will be required to design, program and analyze an integrate-and-fire neural network model of visual perception. Good programming (Python) skills are required along with a good understanding of empirical methods and ways to connect empirical findings with model behavior. The position also involves teaching duties.

The project involves collaboration with Prof. Søren Krogh Andersen, also at SDU.

Qualifications

Ideally, applicants for the position should satisfy the following requirements:

  • PhD level in psychology, cognitive (neuro)science, vision science, or a related field

  • Research experience as evidenced by conference contributions and peer-reviewed journal articles in a field related to the offered position

  • Expertise in visual attention and perception

  • Strong analytical skills, including the ability to design, implement, and analyze complex experiments

  • Be willing and able to teach for the Department of Psychology

  • Prior experience with neural network modeling is a plus

  • Prior experience with cognitive modelling is a plus

  • Good command of statistics

  • Good command of Python (or similar programming languages and a willingness to learn)

  • Very good command of the English language in spoken and written form

  • Some knowledge of the Danish language is a plus

Candidates who are about to obtain these qualifications are also encouraged to apply. 

Contact information

For further information about the position, please contact Dr. Greg Francis, SDU (email: gfrancis@health.sdu.dk; phone: +45 65 50 16 98), or Professor Søren Krogh Andersen (email: skandersen@health.sdu.dk; phone: +45 65 50 49 57)

Application deadline

The application deadline is November 08, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. CET.

Salary and terms of employment

The base salary for a postdoctoral researcher is DKK 36,877.42, with an additional job structure supplement of DKK 5,230.75. This brings the total monthly salary to DKK 42,108.16.

The successful applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Application

Applications must be in English and submitted electronically using the link "Apply now". 

Attached files must be in Adobe PDF format.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • A letter of motivation (max. 1 page)

  • A detailed CV

  • Master and PhD degree certificates, if available

  • A complete and numbered list of publications 

  • Three scientific publications (or preprints) considered to be most important for the advertised position (please note that one file per publication must be submitted)

  • Contact details of at least two university supervisors or employers who can provide references

If you experience technical problems, you must contact hcm-support@sdu.dk.

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application. 

Incomplete applications and applications received after the application deadline will not be considered. 

Shortlisting of applications may be used in the initial selection process.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
jobs.description:
**Join us in building the teams behind some of Finland's most exciting projects**

CTS Finland is growing, and we are looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our local HR team.

This is a great opportunity for a recruiter who enjoys working close to the business, taking ownership and seeing the direct impact of their work. You will join a small and hands-on HR team consisting of an HR Business Partner and HR Coordinator and take an important role in strengthening our recruitment capability in Finland.

Our environment is fast-paced and project-driven. Recruitment needs can range from highly specialized technical professionals and project leadership to commercial, procurement and corporate roles. You will work directly with hiring managers and HR to turn those needs into successful hires.

**What you will do**

You will take ownership of recruitment processes from need to hire, including:

- Partnering with hiring managers to understand recruitment needs, priorities and required candidate profiles

- Managing recruitment processes from job opening through sourcing, screening, interviews and offer stage

- Proactively sourcing candidates through LinkedIn and other relevant channels

- Building talent pipelines for current and anticipated recruitment needs

- Conducting candidate screening and coordinating interviews with hiring managers

- Ensuring candidates receive a professional, responsive and positive experience throughout the process

- Keeping recruitment pipelines, candidate information and recruitment systems up accurate and up to date

- Supporting recruitment forecasting and workforce planning together with HR and the business

- Coordinating with recruitment agencies and external recruitment partners when additional support is needed

- Developing our local recruitment practices, tools and ways of working as the organization grows

- Supporting employer branding and identifying effective ways to attract talent in the Finnish market

- Monitoring recruitment activity and providing clear pipeline and recruitment status reporting to HR and hiring managers


**What we are looking for**

We are looking for someone who enjoys recruitment as a craft and is comfortable operating independently.

Ideally, you have:

- Previous experience in recruitment or Talent Acquisition, preferable managing several vacancies simultaneously

- Strong hands-on sourcing skills and experience identifying candidates proactively

- Experience partnering directly with hiring managers

- Good understanding of the Finnish recruitment market

- Strong organization and follow-up skills

- The ability to prioritize when recruitment needs change quickly

- A proactive mindset. You don't wait for applicants when the right candidate needs to be found

- Strong communication and interpersonal skills

- Fluent or professional working proficiency in English

- Finnish language skills are highly valued


Experience recruiting within construction, engineering, data centers, industrial projects or other technical/project-based environments would be a strong advantage.

International recruitment experience is also beneficial, as our recruitment needs may extend beyond Finland.

**Who will you work with?**

You will be part of the CTS Finland HR team, working closely with the HR Business Partner and HR Coordinator.

The team works directly with project and business leadership, so this is not a recruitment role removed from the operation. You will be close to hiring decisions, workforce planning and the projects themselves. CTS operates in a project-driven data center, engineering and construction environment where delivery depends on attracting specialist and project-critical expertise.

**What we offer**

This role gives you the opportunity to:

- Build and shape Talent Acquisition practices in a growing organization

- Work closely with senior stakeholders and hiring managers

- Recruit across a broad range of professional and specialist positions

- Develop deep expertise in recruitment for a fast-growing technical and project environment

- Join a small HR team where you contribution will be visible and meaningful

- Help us build talent pipelines that support CTS Finland's continued growth


Most importantly, you will have genuine ownership. We are looking for someone who sees a difficult vacancy as a sourcing challenge to solve, keeps the process moving and enjoys finding the person the business thought would be difficult to find.

**Interested?**

If you enjoy recruitment, sourcing and working directly with the business, we would love to hear from you.

Apply and tell us a little about yourself, your recruitment background and what attracts you to joining CTS Finland.

jobs.title: Project Controller
jobs.description:
**Do you want to join CTS as Project Controller?**

**About the role**

The Project Controller is one of the most critical positions within the project organization. Acting as the project's independent performance analyst, the Project Controller provides the Project Director with accurate, objective, and timely information on schedule, cost, progress, and forecast performance.

The Project Controller transforms project data into management information, allowing the Project Director to make informed decisions before problems become critical.

A successful Project Controller ensures that the project team always knows:

- Are we on schedule or behind schedule?

- Are we under budget or over budget?

- What are the key risks to project delivery?

- What corrective actions are required?


The role follows internationally recognized AACE International, ISO, PMI and best practices Project Controls principles and integrates planning, cost control, progress measurement, forecasting, and performance analysis.

**Your key responsibilities**

**Schedule Control**

- Ensure the Critical Path accurately reflects the actual execution strategy.

- Continuously protect the Critical Path by identifying emerging delays and recovery opportunities.

- Analyze schedule impacts and propose mitigation measures.


**Progress Measurement**

- Develop objective progress measurement systems.

- Measure physical progress across engineering, procurement, manufacturing, logistics, construction, commissioning, and handover.

- Ensure progress reporting reflects actual project status rather than subjective opinions.

- Produce weekly and monthly progress reports.


**Performance Analysis**

- Analyze project performance using Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), including:


- Schedule Performance Index (SPI)

- Cost Performance Index (CPI)

- Productivity indicators

- Earned Value Management (EVM)


- Identify trends before they become major issues.

- Prepare concise management dashboards.


**Forecasting**

- Support scenario analysis and recovery planning.

- Assess the impact of risks and opportunities on project objectives.


**Reporting**

- Prepare accurate weekly and monthly project control reports.

- Present project status to the Project Director and senior management.

- Highlight deviations, root causes, and recommended corrective actions.

- Ensure reporting is factual, transparent, and data-driven.


**Who this is for**

This role is ideal for a detail-oriented and analytical professional who enjoys turning complex project data into meaningful insights that support informed decision-making. You are highly organized, proactive, and able to work independently while maintaining an objective approach and collaborating effectively with project teams and stakeholders.

You have a degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Quantity Surveying, or a related discipline, along with a good understanding of project delivery methodologies. Experience working on mission-critical facilities or data center projects is highly desirable.

You are comfortable working with project controls and planning tools, including Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, and advanced Excel. Experience with Power BI is an advantage, and you have knowledge of Earned Value Management, cost control, schedule analysis, progress measurement, risk analysis, and KPI development and reporting.

Most importantly, you have a decision-support mindset and are confident in challenging assumptions using factual evidence. You are a proactive problem solver with strong communication skills, high integrity, and a commitment to delivering accurate, reliable insights that support successful project outcomes.

**How you'll make an impact**

As a Project Controller, you will play a critical role in ensuring project success by providing accurate, objective, and forward-looking project controls that enable informed decision-making. Rather than simply reporting past performance, you will identify potential risks and deviations early, helping the project team take timely corrective action before schedule delays or cost overruns become critical.

Your work will provide Project Directors and key stakeholders with a clear understanding of project performance through meaningful analysis, reliable forecasting, and actionable insights. By protecting the project's critical path and measuring true physical progress, you will help drive the successful delivery of complex, fast-paced data center construction projects.

Key deliverables include:

- Critical Path Analysis

- Progress Measurement Reports

- Earned Value Analysis

- Project Dashboards

- Schedule Recovery Analysis

- Executive Project Status Reports


**Location**: Seinäjoki, Finland. Site-based role with daily presence on site required.

jobs.title: Myyjä ilta- ja viikonloppuvuoroihin (15-20h/vko) K-Market Ilmarinkatu & K-Market Kissanmaa, Tampere
jobs.description:
Me etsimme heimoomme innostunutta ja huippua tyyppiä, jolla hymy ei hyydy ja jonka tiimitaidot ovat huipussaan.

Vapaus, heimous, nälkä ja sydän - nämä ovat arvoja, jotka ohjaavat meidän toimintaamme ja ovat yhteisen tekemisemme peruskallio.

Sä olet taatusti täydellinen tyyppi meidän heimoon, mikäli...
- ...sulla on kyky vastaanottaa "vapautta", tehdä ja toteuttaa. Me nimittäin pyritään jakamaan vapautta ja halutaankin, että sen voimin sä vaikutat, osallistut ja otat vastuuta arjesta ja osastostasi sekä sen toiminnasta. - ...sulla on heimoutta eli oikeaa tiimipelaamisen taikaa. Meidän mielestä hyvän heimon voimatekijöitä ovat luottamus, kunnioitus, avoimuus ja menestymisen asenne. Hyvä heimo muodostaa toimivan tiimikulttuurin, mikä on edellytys huipputuloksiin pääsemiselle. Meidän heimon kulttuurissa vaaditaan, että asiat käsitellään keskustellen kasvokkain eikä selän takana juoruillen ja yhteistä tekemistä sabotoiden. Mikäli siis rakastat ihmisten välistä draamaa ja villejä käänteitä, ei tämä paikka ole sulle. - ... sulla on nälkää tehdä hommia hyvällä draivilla ja haluat menestyä tiiminä. jobs.description:
**Do you want to join CTS as Project Administrator?**

**About the role**

The Project Administrator is responsible for ensuring the efficient day-to-day operation of site activities, including logistics, accommodation, office management, and employee support. This is a highly operational role requiring continuous on-site presence, strong coordination skills, and the ability to manage multiple time-sensitive tasks.

**What you will do**

**Site Logistics & Daily Operations**

- Coordinate daily vehicle usage, carpooling, and employee transportation.

- Support HR with employee accommodation coordination and related practical matters.

- Maintain and update employee rotation schedules.

- Coordinate site food and refreshment arrangements.

- Monitor purchase orders to ensure budget compliance.


**Office, PPE & IT-Equipment Management**

- Procure PPE, office supplies, and coordinate IT equipment needs.

- Maintain accurate inventories (PPE, IT, office assets).

- Ensure office spaces, storage rooms, and PPE areas are organized and functional.

- Collect deliveries and manage incoming orders and mails.


**Onboarding, Offboarding & Employee Support**

- Manage onboarding and offboarding processes on site.

- Provide daily support to employees (practical assistance, coordination, document handling).


**Administration & Coordination**

- Manage administrative communication

- Participate in HR coordination and weekly meetings

- Distribute important updates to employees and subcontractors

- Follow up on weekly reporting deadlines

- Approve and track invoices in PowerOffice


**Who this is for**

This role is a great fit for a proactive and well-organized person who enjoys being at the heart of day-to-day site operations. You are comfortable taking ownership, coordinating with different people, and keeping track of multiple practical matters at the same time. You thrive in a hands-on environment where priorities can change quickly and your ability to keep things running smoothly makes a real difference.

**We wish you have**

- Strong organizational and multitasking skills

- Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, operational environment

- Excellent communication and follow-up abilities

- High attention to detail and a problem-solving mindset

- Flexibility and willingness to handle both administrative and practical tasks

- A proactive and service-oriented approach

- Fluency in both written and spoken English


**What we offer**

We offer you a varied and hands-on role in an international working environment, where you will have an important part in keeping daily site operations running smoothly. You will have the opportunity to work with a diverse group of people and take ownership of a wide range of practical and administrative responsibilities. In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a lunch benefit and the opportunity to develop your skills and experience in a growing organization.

**Location**: Seinäjoki, Finland. Site-based role with daily presence on site required.

jobs.title: PhD Candidates in advanced arc and friction stir welding processes for recycled aluminium
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

The position is a 3-year doctoral research fellowship starting in 2027. The PhD candidate will be embedded in the welding and joining research activities of SFI FAST and will work closely with NTNU, SINTEF, and leading international industrial partners in the aluminium value chain.

The PhD position focuses on understanding the influence of impurities coming from recycled Aluminium on the weldability of different alloys. These impurities can alter the weldability, microstructure, and performance of Aluminium welds compared to the reference alloy. Solidification and liquation cracking, pore formation, heat-affected zone softening, and degradation of corrosion resistance are some examples of possible challenges. However, the knowledge is limited about any of these possible changes. Therefore, the candidate needs to provide a thorough investigation of the welding process using conventional techniques and develop new methodologies. In addition, the welding procedure adoption to enhance the performance of the alloys based on their metallurgical characteristics shall be developed. Therefore, the candidate should have a great understanding of the welding process-microstructure-performance. 

 Your immediate leader will be the Head of Department. You will be supervised by Professor Vahid Hosseini.


About the project

SFI FAST (Future Aluminium Structures) is a national Centre for Research-based Innovation (SFI) funded by the Research Council of Norway and the aluminum industry. The Centre is led by NTNU in close collaboration with SINTEF and a broad consortium of 15 leading industrial partners across the aluminium value chain. FAST runs from 2026 to 2034 and represents one of Norway’s most ambitious long-term research initiatives within aluminium materials, manufacturing technologies, and circular economy.

The primary objective of FAST is to establish the scientific and technological knowledge base required to enable the large-scale use of post-consumer scrap (PCS) aluminium in high-value, structural, and safety-critical products. FAST adopts a through-scale and through-process research methodology, integrating materials science, manufacturing processes, product and structural design, and lifecycle performance.

A key outcome of FAST is the development of the FAST Virtual Lab, a digital framework combining experimental data, physics-based models, and data-driven methods to support design, manufacturing, and decision-making across aluminium value chains.

Education and competence building are central pillars of FAST. The Centre will educate more than 18 PhD and postdoctoral researchers and over 100 MSc students, strengthening Norway’s international position in aluminium research and innovation. The two positions posted here will be among the first ones to start in the Centre.

Please see the centre’s website: Future Aluminium Structures (FAST) - NTNU


Duties of the position
  • Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate
  • Take part in the mandatory PhD research education programme
  • Develop arc welding (GTAW and GMAW) and Friction stir welding for alloys with different impurity levels to minimize welding defects and improve mechanical and corrosion performance
  • Develop knowledge in the influence of impurities on the weld’s physics, defects, microstructure, and performance
  • Thermodynamic modelling of solidification and precipitation behaviour of recycled aluminium
  • Development of weldability tests to quantify welding performance of Aluminium Alloys 
  • Advanced characterization of welded samples using Laser Confocal Microscopy, In-situ mechanical testing, SEM, FIB, and EBSD.
  • Conduct and publish high-level research in peer-reviewed journals and international conferences
  • Work closely with industrial and academic partners and participate in relevant SFI FAST activities, including mentoring and supervising MSc students

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.


Required selection criteria
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme, see Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information.
  • You must have a relevant Master's degree in Mechanical engineering, Materials Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering or equivalent. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis
  • Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position
  • You must have a strong and relevant academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may be considered if you can document that you are exceptionally suited for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works.
  • You must have an academically relevant background within fusion and solid-state welding, welding metallurgy, and material characterization
  • Documented strong background in:
    • Experimental welding research
    • Material characterization and testing
  • Excellent written presentation skills and oral English language skills

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.


Preferred selection criteria
  • Basic knowledge of robotic welding
  • Knowledge of weld monitoring systems with focus on arc characteristics and thermal cycle analysis
  • Knowledge of thermomechanical modelling of welding process
  • Scandinavian language skills

Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • Highly motivated
  • Able to work independently
  • Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them
  • Present and discuss your research with other professionals
  • Get involved and contribute constructively with feedback
  • Work constructively under pressure or in the face of adversity 
  • Show curiosity and strong motivation for the subject
  • Analyse data, assess different perspectives and draw well-founded conclusions 
  • Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed
  • Keen interest in learning and working in teams

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.


We offer
  • Exciting and stimulating tasks in a strong international academic environment
  • SFI FAST facilities, industrial network, and a joint PhD environment 
  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality.


Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,- per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Engineering within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme through out the period of employment.

The position is conditional on external funding.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to bein conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.


About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in English.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees
  • CV 
  • Copy of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • Project outline containing proposals for an overall description of research questions, theoretical perspectives, methodological design for the project, and progress plan (maximum 1500 words/4 pages) 
  • Short letter of motivation (400 words/1 page). The motivation letter must be aligned with the subject of this call and why the candidate finds themselves suitable for this position.
  • Possibly publications or other relevant research work (the candidate’s contribution to each work must be clarified (performed tasks and percentage of contribution)) 
  • Possibly certificates
  • Names and contact information of three relevant referees, their relation to the applicant, and their recommendation letters for your application for this position (Note: the referees will also be directly contacted for shortlisted candidates for the position) 
  • documentation of the required criteria


If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.


Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).


General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Professor Vahid Hosseini, e-mail: vahid.hosseini@ntnu.no

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR Senior Consultant Hedda Winnberg, e-mail: hedda.winnberg@ntnu.no

Application deadline: 02.11.2026

-----------------

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage. 

The city of Trondheim is a modern European city with a rich cultural scene. Trondheim is the tech capital of Norway with a population of 200,000. The Norwegian welfare state, including healthcare, schools, kindergartens and overall equality, is probably the best of its kind in the world. Professional subsidized day-care for children is easily available. Furthermore, Trondheim offers great opportunities for education (including international schools) and possibilities to enjoy nature, culture and family life and has low crime rates and clean air quality.

Tämä rooli sopii henkilölle, joka haluaa yhdistää käytännön tekemisen, ihmisten johtamisen ja toiminnan kehittämisen. Pääset vaikuttamaan aidosti oman tiimisi arkeen, asiakaskokemukseen ja siihen, miten FitPit kehittyy tulevaisuudessa.

Saat mahdollisuuden liittyä mukaan kasvavaan liikunta-alan yritykseen, jossa jokainen asiakas on yhtä tärkeä ja jokainen työntekijä on tasa-arvoinen. Me FitPitillä haluamme rakentaa tulevaisuutta välittäen ympärillä olevista asioista. Olemme muutoskykyinen organisaatio, jossa työntekijöiden palaute kuullaan ja jossa työntekijöiden kehittyminen on tärkeää. Lisäksi liittyessäsi tiimiimme saat seuraavaa:

- Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa tiimin arkeen ja kehittymiseen

- Tiimin ja organisaation tuen arjen johtamiseen – et jää yksin vastuusi kanssa (HR ja muu organisaatio)

- Mahdollisuuden kasvaa ja kehittyä esihenkilönä nopeasti kasvavassa organisaatiossa

- Liukuva työaika ja etätyöskentely mahdollisuus

- Epassi 200 € vuodessa

- Palkkaus 2700-3200 €/kk riippuen kokemuksestasi ja osaamisestasi + bonukset


**MITÄ TYÖSI TULEE PITÄMÄÄN SISÄLLÄÄN**

- Uinninopetus ja uinninvalvonta eri kohderyhmille

- Oman tiimin arjen johtaminen ja tukeminen

- Kehityskeskusteluiden, one-to-one-keskusteluiden ja varhaisen tuen keskusteluiden pitäminen

- Oman tiimin viikkopalavereiden vetäminen ja aktiivinen läsnäolo tiimin arjessa

- Suorituksen johtaminen, palautteenanto ja sitoutumisen tukeminen

- Vastaat oman tiimisi uintiopetuksen laadusta, asiakaskohtaamisista ja siitä, että toiminta vastaa FitPitin 5 tähden palvelulupausta

- Seuraat ja kehität oman tiimisi toimintaa asiakaskokemuksen, laadun ja kaupallisuuden näkökulmasta

- Uusien uimaopettajien rekrytointi ja perehdyttäminen

- Työvuorosuunnittelun kokonaisuudesta vastaaminen

- Kokemusta esihenkilötyöstä tai vahva halu kehittyä esihenkilönä

- Kykyä hahmottaa isoja kokonaisuuksia ja hyviä organisointitaitoja

- Kykyä kohdata ihmiset arjessa ja johtaa käytännön tasolla

- Nautit arjen johtamisesta ja haluat aidosti vaikuttaa oman tiimisi onnistumiseen, ilmapiiriin ja asiakaskokemukseen

- Otteesi työhön on aktiivinen, ratkaisukeskeinen ja vastuunkantoon tottunut

jobs.title: Sjåfør og montør
jobs.description:
Ønsker du en fleksibel ekstrajobb der du kan jobbe når det passer deg?

Utleiekompaniet søker praktiske og pålitelige personer som kan hjelpe oss med montering, demontering, transport av utstyr til arrangementer og selskaper.

Vi har varierende arbeidsmengde gjennom året og trenger derfor ekstra mannskap som kan stille opp ved behov.

Stillingen innebærer tunge løft og arbeidet foregår for det meste utendørs eller i bil.

Vi har egne lastebiler og varebiler.

Arbeidstiden er normalt fra kl. 8.00 - 16.00. Kvelds- og helgejobbing forekommer.

Vi har ordnede arbeidsforhold. Opplæring vil bli gitt.

Krav til kompetanse

  • Snakke norsk eller engelsk

  • Førerkort kl. B

  • Erfaring som sjåfør på stor varebil (3500 kg)

Ønsket kompetanse

  • Henger BE

  • Truckførerbevis T2-T5

Personlige egenskaper

  • God arbeidsvilje

  • Serviceinnstilt

  • Du må kunne utføre fysisk krevende arbeidsoppgaver, inkludert tunge løft.

  • Pålitelig, fleksibel og samarbeider godt i team

Vi søker ekstra medarbeidere til konkrete oppdrag og midlertidige arbeidstopper gjennom året, spesielt i forbindelse med arrangementer, festivaler og vår travle sommersesong.

Arbeidsmengden vil variere, og dette er tilkallingsarbeid uten garantert antall arbeidstimer. Du får tilbud om oppdrag når vi trenger ekstra hjelp, og står fritt til å takke ja eller nei.

I sommersesongen kan det også være aktuelt med egne tidsavgrensede arbeidsavtaler med opptil 100 % stilling i noen sammenhengende måneder.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Utleiekompaniet driver med utleie av partytelt, møbler, dekketøy og arrangementutstyr til festivaler, bryllup og alle typer events. Vi er en totalleverandør og vårt konsept er at man kan leie alt på et sted. Våre kunder holder til i hele østlandsområdet.

Utleiekompaniet har gjennom 30 år opparbeidet et godt renome og vi anser oss selv som en betydelig og seriøs aktør innen utleie. Pålitelighet og kvalitet er vårt varemerke og våre største kunder er eventbyråer, festivalarrangører og bryllupsverter. Vi er 6 heltidsansatte med 15 sesongarbeidere. Vi har stort lager og kontorer på Solgaard skog.

Vi søker flere fleksible sjåfører, montører og tilkallingshjelp.
