jobs.title: Technical Customer Support
jobs.description:
QuickMail is a cold email and LinkedIn outreach platform for markets you can't afford to burn. Our customers can't easily replace leads that land in spam, which is why deliverability matters more to us than anything else. We have been running since 2014, and we pioneered deliverability technology such as Inbox rotationâ¢ and deliverability AIâ¢.

The Role

We are hiring a technical customer support person with an owner's mentality.

You will own support for QuickMail and Mailflow, our deliverability add-on. There is no first or second line. You are the first and last person our customers talk to.

Customers count on you to solve their problems and find the real cause when something breaks. You work closely with engineering, and you tell the founder what we need to know to make the product better: where the friction is and where the opportunities are.

The role covers the help desk, system health checks, testing new releases before they ship, and leading the weekly team meeting. It takes excellent communication, solid technical understanding and sharp critical thinking.

This is not a script-reading job. Most tickets involve deliverability, DNS records, LinkedIn automation or campaign setup. You dig into customer accounts in our Support Dashboard, reproduce the issue, then decide what to do and how to explain it to the customer.

We are a remote team spread across time zones. Most routine tasks have a written guide with a checklist, so you know what done looks like. You are expected to refine and improve those processes. When something new comes up, you work out the most efficient way to handle it.

If you want a lot of autonomy across many areas, real responsibility and a fast-paced environment, this role is for you.

What Work Looks Like

You own two things: customers get unstuck fast, and the product stays reliable.

Every day

  • Set the day's support priorities and work the Help Scout queue for QuickMail and Mailflow. Triage, resolve, and dig deeper when a ticket needs it.
  • Check the support dashboard: job queue, event-stream latency, blacklist status, newly purchased domains. If something is off, investigate, diagnose, and drive it to resolution.
  • Review fraud alerts and disable accounts that are scams or abusing the platform.

Delighting customers

  • Comfortable jumping on calls with customers, building rapport fast, and setting them up for success.
  • Update the changelog and help articles based on what shipped and what customers asked.
  • Share customer feedback with the team, ask happy customers for reviews and case studies, and watch NPS for testimonial candidates.

Making support smarter with AI

  • Improve the AI support agent. Review its answers, fix the docs it drew from when it is wrong, and contact the customer when its reply was off.
  • Write and maintain automated tests, built with AI, that try to break staging before customers do.
  • Use the MCP connections we have in place (Helpscout, GitHub, Postmark, and others) to get an accurate picture of support and find the next thing worth improving.

Keeping the product solid

  • Gatekeep releases. New fixes and features land on staging every week. Test them, confirm when staging is ready to ship, and think through how existing and new users will be affected.
  • Report bugs as GitHub issues with everything the developer needs: steps to reproduce, screenshots or a Loom, and any GraphQL or console errors.
  • Captain red alerts. When a core feature breaks (emails not sending, login down), confirm it, alert the team on Slack or Telegram, update the status page every 30 minutes, keep affected customers informed, and drive the fix. Then run the retrospective so it does not happen twice.

Running the week

  • Lead the weekly team meeting in MonsterOps: issues written up, to-dos done, numbers updated.
  • Keep rock status and KPIs current in MonsterOps.

Tools you'll use: Helpscout, our Support Dashboard, Sidekiq, GitHub, Slack, Telegram, MonsterOps, Outline, MxToolbox, Postmark, Bento, TidyCal, Fathom, Visual Code and Claude.

Who You Are

  • You build rapport fast. You are warm, positive, and relatable in writing and on calls.
  • You are a good communicator. Externally, you can show warmth, empathy and care. Internally, you are able to communicate clearly and concisely about important things.
  • You can operate with minimal instructions. You understand a short brief without every detail spelled out. You can prioritize well (especially when you have a lot on your plate), and get things done without hand-holding.
  • You are comfortable on video. You are natural on live calls with Zoom and Meet, and on recorded video through tools like Loom.
  • Your teammates can always count on you. You say what you'll do and you do what you said.
  • You act with a constant sense of urgency. You can execute fast and find new ways to improve your productivity.
  • You are resourceful. You use all the tools at your disposal to get great results.
  • You have a low ego. You don't take offense easily and you handle disagreement as a discussion, not a personal attack.
  • Growth mindset. You are positive about new workflow/process/product/tool changes. You love giving and receiving positive and negative feedback without getting defensive.
  • Hours that overlap with East coast US and UK, where most of our customers are.

A Plus If You Have

  • Experience with customer facing work, or if you don't have it, tell us why you are perfect for this role.
  • Working knowledge of deliverability and LinkedIn outreach. Warmup, DNS, inbox rotation, DKIM, SPF, Outlook and Gmail technical setup. We can teach this, but a head start helps.
  • Comfort with agency setups. Workspaces, guest seats, inbox purchases and what happens when an agency loses a client.
  • Light data skills. You can pull numbers from Help Scout or our MCP to back up what you report.
  • An eye for happy customers. You notice them and ask for testimonials and case studies at the right moment.

How We Work Together

You'll work directly with the founder and with our lead developer.

Working with the founder can be intense. Here is what that looks like in practice:

  • Replies are short and can come across as harsh. If something written lands badly or isn't clear, ask.
  • Direction can change. The founder may say one thing, then something different a few days later as they learn more. When that happens, check what changed and adapt.
  • Information should be short and to the point. Lead with what matters, then give more details if asked.
  • The founder can stay frustrated about a problem until it's solved. That's something they are aware of and working on. You'll do well here if you can stay calm and focused when the pressure is on.
  • The team often thinks fast and interrupts each other when discussing ideas. If that would bother you, this role probably isn't for you.

This role suits someone with high emotional intelligence, who doesn't take things personally, asks when something is unclear, and keeps many things moving at once.

Your schedule can be flexible. If you have a martial arts class every Thursday at 3 pm, go and make up the time later. In return, on the rare occasion the team needs your help on a weekend, we ask you to be flexible too.

Benefits

  • Contract type: full-time or part-time
  • Compensation: $2,500 to $4,000 USD per month, depending on experience and location. US-based hires will work as independent contractors (1099).
  • Start date: negotiable

jobs.title: PhD Candidate in Fatigue Assessment and Enhancement of Aluminium Welded Structures
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

The Department of Mechanical and Industrial Engineering (MTP) at the Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU) has a vacancy for a PhD candidate within fatigue and structural integrity, funded through the Centre for Research-based Innovation SFI FAST Future Aluminium Structures. 

The position is 3-year doctoral research fellowships starting in 2026. The PhD candidate will be embedded in the fatigue and structural integrity research activities of SFI FAST and will work closely with NTNU, SINTEF, and leading international industrial partners in the aluminium value chain.

Your immediate leader will be the Head of Department. You will be supervised by Associate Professor Nima Razavi.


About the project

SFI FAST (Future Aluminium Structures) is a national Centre for Research-based Innovation (SFI) funded by the Research Council of Norway and the aluminum industry. The Centre is led by NTNU in close collaboration with SINTEF and a broad consortium of 15 leading industrial partners across the aluminium value chain. FAST runs from 2026 to 2034 and represents one of Norway’s most ambitious long-term research initiatives within aluminium materials, manufacturing technologies, and circular economy.

The primary objective of FAST is to establish the scientific and technological knowledge base required to enable the large-scale use of post-consumer scrap (PCS) aluminium in high-value, structural, and safety-critical products. FAST adopts a through-scale and through-process research methodology, integrating materials science, manufacturing processes, product and structural design, and lifecycle performance.

A key outcome of FAST is the development of the FAST Virtual Lab, a digital framework combining experimental data, physics-based models, and data-driven methods to support design, manufacturing, and decision-making across aluminium value chains.

Education and competence building are central pillars of FAST. The Centre will educate more than 18 PhD and postdoctoral researchers and over 100 MSc students, strengthening Norway’s international position in aluminium research and innovation. 

Please see the centre’s website: Future Aluminium Structures (FAST) - NTNU

PhD project

This PhD position focuses on the fatigue performance of welded aluminium structures, with particular emphasis on understanding and improving fatigue-critical regions in the weldment. Welding introduces local variations in microstructure, mechanical properties, residual stresses and defects across the heat-affected zone (HAZ) and fusion zone, which can strongly influence fatigue crack initiation and propagation. The research will investigate how these local characteristics, together with weld geometry and the processing route of the substrates, govern fatigue performance and the transferability of fatigue assessment methods across different structural configurations.

The candidate will investigate strategies for fatigue-life enhancement through selected local post-weld heat treatments, mechanical treatments and in-situ thermo-mechanical modification techniques. Experimental work will include fatigue testing supported by relevant local characterization, XCT-based defect characterization and in-situ mechanical testing to study damage and crack evolution. The experimental findings will be combined with local, defect-based and fracture-mechanics-based fatigue prediction approaches to assess fatigue performance and treatment effectiveness. The research will also explore the implications of thickness-dependent behaviour and local weld properties for existing fatigue design approaches and potential future design recommendations.

The candidate will work in close collaboration with industrial partners and other researchers within FAST and will be responsible for reporting progress and delivering research outputs to the centre.


Duties of the position
  • Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate
  • Take part in the mandatory PhD research education programme
  • Investigate the fatigue behaviour and damage mechanisms of aluminium weldments, considering local variations in mechanical properties, microstructure, residual stresses, and weld-induced defects
  • Develop and evaluate local post-weld heat treatment and mechanical modification strategies to improve the properties and fatigue performance of critical weld regions
  • Investigate the applicability of in-situ thermal and mechanical modification techniques during welding for controlling local material properties and improving fatigue resistance
  • Perform fatigue testing combined with XCT-based defect characterization and in-situ mechanical testing to investigate fatigue crack initiation and evolution and their relationship with local material and geometrical features
  • Develop and validate local, defect-based and fracture-mechanics-based fatigue prediction approaches using the experimental findings, and assess their applicability to welded aluminium structures
  • Evaluate the implications of the obtained results for existing fatigue design approaches, particularly regarding material thickness, local weld properties, presence of post-consumer scrap, and potential recommendations for fatigue design standards
  • Conduct and publish high-level research in peer-reviewed journals and international conferences
  • Work closely with industrial and academic partners and participate in relevant SFI FAST activities, including mentoring and supervising MSc students

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.


Required selection criteria
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme, see Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information.
  • You must have a relevant Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Material Engineering, Solid Mechanics or equivalent. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis
  • Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position
  • You must have a strong and relevant academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may be considered if you can document that you are exceptionally suited for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works.
  • Documented strong background in experimental mechanics, solid mechanics, and mechanics of materials
  • Excellent written presentation skills and oral English language skills

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.


Preferred selection criteria
  • Scandinavian language skills
  • Knowledge of fatigue and fracture mechanics
  • Knowledge and testing skills in material characterization and microstructural analysis  
  • Knowledge and experience in mechanical testing of materials or components
  • Experience in using Finite Element Codes such as ABAQUS, ANSYS, etc. for numerical analysis

Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • Highly motivated
  • Able to work independently
  • Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them
  • Present and discuss your research with other professionals
  • Get involved and contribute constructively with feedback
  • Work constructively under pressure or in the face of adversity 
  • Show curiosity and strong motivation for the subject
  • Analyse data, assess different perspectives and draw well-founded conclusions 
  • Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed
  • Keen interest in learning and working in teams

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.


We offer
  • Exciting and stimulating tasks in a strong international academic environment
  • SFI FAST facilities, industrial network, and a joint PhD environment 
  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality.


Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,- per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Engineering within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme through out the period of employment.

The position is conditional on external funding.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to bein conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.


About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in English.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees
  • CV 
  • Copy of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • Project outline containing proposals for an overall description of research questions, theoretical perspectives, methodological design for the project and progress plan (maximum 1500 words/4 pages) 
  • Short letter of motivation (400 words/1 page). The motivation letter must be aligned with the subject of this call and why the candidate finds themselves suitable for this position.
  • Possibly publications or other relevant research work (the candidate’s contribution to each work must be clarified (performed tasks and percentage of contribution)) 
  • Possibly certificates
  • Names and contact information of three relevant referees, their relation to the applicant, and their recommendation letters for your application for this position (Note: the referees will also be directly contacted for shortlisted candidates for the position) 
  • documentation of the required criteria


If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.


Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).


General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Associate Professor Nima Razavi, e-mail: nima.razavi@ntnu.no

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR Senior Consultant Hedda Winnberg, e-mail: hedda.winnberg@ntnu.no.

Application deadline: 26.10.2026

The city of Trondheim is a modern European city with a rich cultural scene. Trondheim is the tech capital of Norway with a population of 200,000. The Norwegian welfare state, including healthcare, schools, kindergartens and overall equality, is probably the best of its kind in the world. Professional subsidized day-care for children is easily available. Furthermore, Trondheim offers great opportunities for education (including international schools) and possibilities to enjoy nature, culture and family life and has low crime rates and clean air quality. 


Om arbeidsgiveren:

NTNU - knowledge for a better world

The Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU) creates knowledge for a better world and solutions that can change everyday life.

jobs.title: Technician for lab management and user support
jobs.description:
Technician for lab management and user support

CONTEXT:
The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL) is an international centre for scientific research situated in Grenoble, France. It is Europe's leading neutron science facility. Every year we host over 2000 visits by scientists, who come to the Institute to carry out world-class research in a wide variety of scientific fields. The Biology, Deuteration, Chemistry and Soft Matter (BDCS) group operates the Chemistry and Soft Matter support laboratories, which offer equipment, lab space and support for sample preparation and characterisation, serving both external users and in-house scientists. The BDCS group also operates the Lipid and Deuteration laboratories, which are equipped with state-of-the-art instrumentation for the production and characterisation of tailor-made deuterated biological molecules for the ILL user community.

YOUR TASKS:
In the context of the European FEDER EPN-AVENIR-ILL project and the arrival of new laboratory equipment in the BDCS group, you will reinforce the team in the management of the different labs, support the users with their scientific projects, including the activities of the ILL Science Hubs, and liaise between the members of the group. You will welcome and interact with users before, during and after their stay, assist with operating equipment, and help with sample preparation. Your activities will include:
. Supporting the scientists and lab managers by communicating with, welcoming and assisting users with their scientific projects in the different labs
. Management of laboratory supplies and stocks, and regular calibration of lab equipment
. Organisation of lab space and equipment, as well as participation in waste management and the chemical inventory
. Supporting the Lipid Lab staff with the user programme, in particular with running the chromatography equipment (HPLC, GC, TLC,.), including the new FEDER equipment
. The successful candidate will interact with various actors at ILL, including members of the BDCS group, safety engineers, technicians, as well as ILL users and external companies.

YOUR PROFILE:
You have a Level 5 qualification (HND or equivalent) in chemistry (or biochemistry)
. Expertise in the operation of standard (bio-)chemistry laboratory equipment
. Sound knowledge of laboratory safety rules and regulations
. Autonomy and good communication skills
. Experience of working in a research facility, in industry or at a large-scale research infrastructure would be an asset
. You must have a sound knowledge of written and spoken English. Knowledge of French would be a plus (a language course could be paid for by the ILL)

QUALITY OF LIFE:
This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!

jobs.title: BLIV OPERATØR PÅ VORES MOBILE GRANULERINGSANLÆG
jobs.description:
Kan du lide maskiner, praktisk arbejde og nye arbejdssteder?

PH Plastic Recycling ApS søger 2 operatører, der har lyst til at tage ansvar for driften av vores mobile granuleringsanlæg og samtidig blive en del af en branche med fokus på genanvendelse.

Her får du ikke en ensformig hverdag. Du arbejder ude hos kunder i Danmark og resten af Norden, hvor du er med til at omdanne plastaffald til nye råmaterialer.

Vi søger både dig, der kommer alene, og jer, der allerede kender hinanden og gerne vil arbejde sammen. Arbejdet indebærer stor rejseaktivitet, og du skal derfor trives med at være væk hjemmefra i længere perioder.

 

EN PRAKTISK HVERDAG MED ANSVAR

Som operatør bliver du en vigtig del af den daglige drift. Du arbejder tæt på anlægget, følger produktionen og sørger for, at processen kører sikkert og effektivt.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Betjening og overvågning af granuleringsanlægget

  • Justering af anlægget under produktionen

  • Kontrol af det færdige granulat

  • Påfyldning og håndtering af plastmaterialer

  • Klargøring af materialer og arbejdsområde

  • Daglig rengøring og vedligeholdelse

  • Mindre fejlfinding og praktiske reparationer

  • Samarbejde med kolleger og kunder på arbejdsstedet

Du behøver ikke have erfaring med granulering. Vi sørger for en grundig oplæring, så du bliver tryg ved både anlægget, arbejdsprocesserne og ansvaret.

 

VI SØGER DIG, DER KAN LIDE AT FÅ TINGENE TIL AT VIRKE

Du behøver ikke have en bestemt uddannelse. Det vigtigste er, at du er praktisk anlagt, tager ansvar og har lyst til at arbejde med maskiner.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har interesse for maskiner, teknik og produktion

  • Kan lide at arbejde praktisk og tage fat

  • Er stabil, ansvarsbevidst og løsningsorienteret

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og bevare overblikket

  • Trives med en hverdag, hvor arbejdsstedet skifter

  • Har dit bagland i orden, så du kan være væk hjemmefra i længere tid ad gangen

  • Kan samarbejde med både kolleger og kunder på pladsen

  • Kan gøre dig forståelig på dansk eller engelsk

Erfaring fra f.eks. produktion, landbrug, entreprenørbranchen, maskinbetjening eller lignende er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

 

Krav og certifikater:

  • Gyldigt kørekort B er et krav.

  • Truckkort er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

 

REJSEARBEJDE I DANMARK OG NORDEN

jobs.title: Senior Security Consultant – Incident Response
jobs.description:
Do you want to be on the frontline when serious cyber incidents hit? You will lead complex investigations, guide customers through crises, and help shape our incident response services. You will join a highly skilled, collaborative team working with some of the most interesting and challenging cyber cases in the market. 

 

Make a real impact in high‑stakes incidents 

You will be part of a small, expert Incident Response team handling everything from ransomware to targeted attacks across large, complex environments. You will work closely with customers, helping them stay calm, informed and in control during critical situations. You will collaborate with specialists across MDR, Intelligence and Consulting, learn from unique cases, and contribute to the development of tools, methodologies and publications. At CSIS, we invest in your growth with dedicated training time, certifications, and peer learning - in an open, diverse and friendly culture built on “We commit, We care, We succeed together.” 

When you join CSIS, you will get an interesting job in a company and an industry which is growing. You will get interesting challenges, that truly make a difference for our customers, and you will be able to take ownership for your work from start to finish. And you will not least get 130+ fantastic colleagues from all over the world. Besides that, you will get: 

  • Flexible work from home arrangements 

  • A competitive salary and personal benefit package 

  • 5 weeks holiday, plus 5 extra days off each year 

  • Health Insurance, a pension, plus life and disability insurance 

  • Healthy, varied lunches (incl. vegetarian and allergy options) 

  • Home-baked goods, healthy snacks, coffee, tea and sodas in the office

  • Social activities and company events throughout the year

  • Paid mobile phone subscription and home internet 

 

Your new job 

In this client-facing role, you will lead major incident response engagements, support multiple customers, guide junior responders, and help clients strengthen their detection and response capabilities. You will work across diverse environments, industries, and technologies, making adaptability and strong communication essential.  

Your responsibilities will be: 

  • Incident Response & Investigations (Client-Facing) 

  • Lead complex and high-severity incident response engagements for customers across varied infrastructures (on-prem, cloud, hybrid). 

  • Perform advanced forensic analysis across a variety of data sources (disk, memory, network, malware, cloud) and provide clients with clear, actionable findings. 

  • Coordinate response activities with client technical teams, management, and legal/compliance contacts. 

  • Develop accurate incident timelines, attribution assessments (where possible), and root-cause analyses. 

  • Customer Communication & Advisory 

  • Act as a trusted advisor to clients during and after incidents, providing guidance on containment, recovery, and long-term improvements. 

  • Deliver polished, professional technical reports and executive summaries for clients. 

  • Present findings to technical teams as well as to senior leadership and non-technical stakeholders. 

  • Preparedness, Consulting & Continuous Improvement 

  • Assist clients with incident readiness assessments, IR playbook creation, tabletop exercises, and contribute to CSIS’s MDR detection engineering. 

  • Contribute to development of internal incident response methodologies, tooling, and best practices. 

  • Mentor and guide junior team members during engagements and internal training. 

 

About you 

You are an experienced incident responder who remains calm and structured under pressure. You enjoy working closely with customers, translating complex technical issues into clear business language, and you value collaboration and knowledge sharing. You are curious, proactive and driven by making a real difference in the fight against cybercrime. 

You bring most of the following: 

Qualifications & Technical Expertise 

  • Hands-on incident response experience, ideally in a consultancy, MSSP, DFIR, or CSIRT environment. 

  • Proven track record leading multi-client or multi-environment incident investigations. 

  • Deep knowledge of Windows, Linux, and Active Directory security.  

  • Strong knowledge of network protocols and security 

  • Strong experience with SIEM and EDR tools, including detection logic, log correlation, and threat analysis. Hands-on experience with Sentinel/Defender and CrowdStrike a plus. 

  • Advanced digital forensics experience (memory, disk, log, network). 

  • Familiarity with evidence handling, chain-of-custody standards, and forensic reporting. 

  • Strong understanding of attack techniques and threat actor behaviours (MITRE ATT&CK). 

  • Experience in cloud investigations (Azure/AWS/GCP logs, identity, telemetry). 

 

Consultancy-Specific Requirements 

  • Ability to manage multiple parallel client engagements and prioritize effectively. 

  • Excellent client-facing communication: confident, calm, and credible during crises. 

  • Strong written documentation skills for both highly technical and non-technical readers. 

  • Ability to scope engagements, set expectations, and represent the company professionally. 

 

Regulatory & Governance Knowledge 

  • Familiarity with European cybersecurity requirements, especially NIS2, GDPR breach handling, and relevant ISO standards. 

  • Ability to advise clients on improving governance, detection maturity, and incident readiness. 

 

Preferred Skills 

  • Danish speaker – English only can be accomodated. 

  • Threat hunting experience or development of hunting hypotheses. 

  • Scripting/automation (Python, PowerShell, Bash). 

  • Experience in red team/purple team activities or adversary emulation. 

  • Experience providing IR training or running tabletop exercises. 

 

Relevant Certifications  

  • GIAC: GCIH, GCIA, GCFA, GCFE, GPEN, GNFA. 

  • OSCP, CISSP, CISM, or cloud security certs (Azure/AWS/GCP). 

  • Equivalent real-world experience also highly considered and appriciated. 

 

Personal Competencies 

  • Professional, customer-oriented communication style. 

  • Ability to remain composed and decisive under pressure. 

  • Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail. 

  • Leadership qualities and ability to mentor junior responders. 

  • Curiosity and passion for threat research, attacker behaviour, and continuous learning. 

 

This is a 24/7/365 function — flexibility, out-of-hours work, on-call coverage and occasional travel is required. 

 

Other conditions 

  • Security Clearance: As you may work with some of our public sector customers, a Security Clearance may be required. 

  • Relocation: The position is based out of our offices in Denmark, with some flexibility of remote working. Relocation can also be offered to Denmark if relevant

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer, Metso
jobs.description:
Metso is a frontrunner in sustainable technologies, end-to-end solutions and services for the aggregates, minerals processing and metals refining industries globally. We improve our customers energy and water efficiency, increase their productivity, and reduce environmental risks with our product and service expertise. We are the partner for positive change.

Metso is headquartered in Espoo, Finland. At the end of 2025 Metso had close to 18,000 employees in around 50 countries, and sales in 2025 were about EUR 5.3 billion. Metso is listed on the Nasdaq Helsinki.

[https://images.teamtailor-cdn.com/images/s3/teamtailor-production/original-v3/image_uploads/0caa4c4f-4e73-4f0c-aa33-154152533e2f/original.png]

Would you be our new Electrical Engineer?

We are looking for an Electrical Engineer to join the EIA Delivery team within Metso, working on large-scale international plant delivery projects. In this role, you will participate in the design and delivery of process electrification solutions for metallurgical plants, including MV and LV systems, transformers, drives, and cabling. You will also support conceptual design, cost estimation, and technical sales activities, while occasionally participating in installation supervision and commissioning at customer sites. Most of our projects are delivered internationally, and project durations vary depending on their scope and complexity.

You will work alongside experience engineers who will support you in project work. As your expertise grows, you will gradually take on greater responsibility and manage larger project entities independently.

This is a full-time, permanent position, and you will be employed by Biisoni. The role is based at our Espoo office, and we offer a flexible hybrid working model with the possibility to work remotely a few days per week. As our projects are global, occasional travel may also be part of the role.

What are we looking for?

To succeed in this position, you will need a B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in a relevant field (e.g., Electrical Engineering or Electrical Power Engineering) and some experience in industrial process electrification projects. Familiarity with industrial electrification, power distribution systems, electrical drives, and international standards such as IEC and NEMA is considered an advantage. You may be a recent graduate or already have a few years of experience, but we hope you have gained exposure to heavy industrial environments, for example through internships or summer jobs. As you will be working in an international environment, fluent written and spoken English skills are required.

As a person, you are a detail-oriented and self-driven problem solver who takes ownership of your work. You work systematically and remain calm and solution-focused even in demanding situations. You have good interpersonal and communication skills, which help you work smoothly with different stakeholders. You are committed to continuous learning and eager to deepen your expertise.

Why us?

We value our dedicated and driven professionals. As an important part of our highly motivated and skilled team, you contribute directly to our shared success. We offer you an exciting opportunity to collaborate with various stakeholders, supported by an open-minded, international, and friendly community of experts. Once you have a solid grasp of the job, you will have the flexibility to work partly remotely, along with excellent opportunities to develop your professional skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge company at the forefront of its industry. We're committed to your success and will provide you with a comprehensive onboarding and a supportive environment where you can truly thrive.

Are you interested?

If you are interested, we want to hear from you as soon as possible! Please submit your application in either English or Finnish via the link by 2.11.2026. The interviewing process will begin during the application period. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide relocation assistance to Finland.

The recruitment process is carried out in cooperation with Biisoni. For more information on the position, please contact Elise Niinimäki, HR Coordinator, e-mail: elise.niinimaki@biisoni.fi [elise.niinimaki@biisoni.fi].

jobs.title: Agroforestry Manager til Grove Farm Management
jobs.description:
Hos Grove Farm Management bygger for fremtidens landbrug. Vi etablerer og driver produktionssystemer med træer og buske. Vi oplever stor vækst og leder efter en operationel, faglig og handlekraftig person der kan tage ansvar for plantning og drift i Midtjylland og Sønderjylland. 

Rollen 

Du bliver ansvarlig for at planlægge og etablere beplantninger med træer og buske på vores egne arealer og hos kunder. Derudover får du ansvaret for drift af vores eget skovlandbrug på 50 ha samt løbende drift-opgaver for vores kunder og samarbejdspartnere. 

Dine ansvarsområder 

  • Etablering: Lede planlægning og etablering af skovlandbrug på tværs af vores lokationer. 

  • Drift: Drift og pleje af arealer med træer. Renholdelse af beplantninger, beskæring, gødskning. Vi driver alle vores arealer økologisk. 

  • Høst: Høst af nødder, bær, frugt, gavntræ, biomasse. 

  • Planteskole: Bistå i driften af vores planteskole – fra indkøb af frømateriale og stiklinger til podning og klargøring af salgsklare træer.

  • Plantesundhed & Vedligehold: Sikre systematisk beskæring, ukrudtshåndtering og høstoptimering, så vores udbytte matcher vores kommercielle kontrakter. 

  • Udvikling og innovation: Arbejde tæt sammen med vores udviklings-team om udvikling og innovation indenfor skovlandbrug. Vi søger hele tiden at skubbe grænserne for kommercielle skovlandbrug og laver løbende markforsøg på vores kommercielle arealer og deltager i forskningsprojekter. 

  • Rundvisninger: Faciliteter rundvisninger og markvandringer for diverse grupper (landbrugsskoler, kommuner, virksomheder, ERFA, ). 

Om dig

  • Du har en stærk faglig baggrund (skov- og landskabsingeniør, agronom, produktionsgartner, jordbrugsteknolog eller lignende).

  • Du trives i et tværfagligt miljø hvor hoved og hænder skal arbejde sammen. Du kan planlægge en beplantning om morgenen og sidde på traktoren eller beskære træer om eftermiddagen. 

  • Du har maskinerfaring og er vant til at side bare rattet i større maskiner. 

  • Ideelt set bor du omkring Kolding, Vejle eller Skanderborg, da det er herfra vi har flest aktiviteter. 

Vi tilbyder

  • En absolut nøglerolle i en af Danmarks mest ambitiøse landbrugsvirksomheder. 

  • Muligheden for at bygge og forme morgendagens landbrugs-infrastruktur fra bunden.

  • Et dynamisk, uformelt miljø, hvor der er kort fra idé til handling.

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer og stor mulighed for at vokse med virksomheden, når vi skalerer mod 500+ hektar skovlandbrug under drift. 

Ansøgning Send dit CV og en kort, mail om, hvorfor du er den rette til at drive vores marker. Vi holder samtaler løbende.

jobs.title: On-Call Trainee
jobs.description:
We are looking for an On-Call Trainee with the main responsibility of maintaining internal sales applications. The preferred location for this position isVaasa, Finland but Helsinki, Finland is also negotiable. We offer the possibility of hybrid work.

In this role, you can work up to 25 hours per week. To be considered for this position, you need to be a full-time student currently pursuing a degree in Finland.


Your role and responsibilities

As an On-Call Trainee, your work will include writing HTML, JavaScript, and CSS to ensure web applications are up to date. Youll be working as a part of an agile, goal-driven Sales Tools team with diverse expertise.


Your work will focus on these responsibilities:

* Help develop and maintain internal sales applications known as Product Configurators
* Assist in migrating an older codebase to new technologies
* Keep product configuration data up to date



To be able to succeed in the position, we expect you to have:

* Ongoing studies in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
* Good skills in HTML, JavaScript, and CSS
* Good skills in Git and SQL
* Basic understanding of C# and .NET
* Fluent spoken and written English
* Good teamwork skills
* A proactive mindset and eagerness to learn



Why you and us?

We at Wärtsilä believe in empowerment, ownership, and taking responsibility for our work. We support each others growth, and co-creation is the true basis of our innovation. We have the courage to see opportunities and take initiative.

We are authentic and honest, and we strongly believe that by being your true self, you can accomplish so much more. We dont always get it right the first time, and if mistakes are made, we make sure to learn and grow from them. We want everyone to voice their opinions freely. That is why we have built an environment that empowers you and everyone around you, and where you can feel safe and cared for. Are you eager to be part of this ambition?

We have an amazing team, and we are excited about our work and the impact it has on building sustainable societies. We are looking to find a colleague with this shared passion for smart technologies and a sustainable future.


Contact & next steps

We hope to hear from you soon by submitting your application through our Careers portal. We aim to keep you updated on the process throughout.

In this fulltime role, you will be supporting Individuals with complex communication needs and a range of hearing and/or sight loss, to live self-directed lives in homes in the community. In some cases, the Individuals you support may have physical and cognitive difficulties and behaviours that challenge. Key Responsibilities Facilitate and promote a person-centred approach, appropriate to the needs and wishes of the Service User Work with Service Users, to enable them live in a community of their choosing, facilitating their ongoing involvement in their interests and hobbies ensuring access to local resources Work with Service Users in a way that promotes safeguarding, equality, dignity, diversity and their rights Supporting Service Users in directing their own lives, ensuring positive risk taking, in an environment that reflects the comforts of home Supporting Service Users to enjoy the good things in life, make sense of their environment, learn new skills and maximise their independence Assist with cooking, cleaning, shopping and general domestic tasks in the Service User’s home Understand and facilitate Service User’s needs, using their preferred communication system Establish, through continuity of work with Service Users, trusting professional relationships Ensure respect of the Service User’s will and preference to take on new tasks ensuring a positive risk assessment is carried out Provide assistance with aspects of personal care, people handling, ensuring dignity, safe practices for Service User’s Accompany Service Users to appointments and other events Act as advocate for Service users, who may have difficulty in expressing their needs Support Service User’s to have meaningful relationships, keep in contact with family and friends and to develop their social networks if they choose to. Assist with keyworking Adopt a positive behaviour support approach to respond effectively to any potentially challenging situations Adhere to all ASC Policies, Employee Handbook and work practices Adhere to all relevant national policies, including (but not limited to) HIQA Standards, HSE Policies, safeguarding Adhere to procedures to maintain the Service User’s home to the appropriate standards Adhere to Health & Safety standards and ensure that the health and safety of each Service user is central Maintain a high level of infection prevention and control within the Service User’s home Report any health and safety issues to the Health and Safety officer Ask questions to check when unsure of protocols, share information with the team that has a direct impact on Service users, be clear and factual in communications Attend Team Meeting Complete daily logs and show respect to other team members Reach out to more experienced RSWs and learn from them Work collaboratively and supportively with the multi-disciplinary team Undertake duties as may be assigned by the Manager or Team Leader to support the care of Service users.

  • Du sætter en ære i at gøre et godt og grundigt stykke arbejde

  • Du bevarer overblikket i en til tider hektisk hverdag

Vi er et entreprenørfirma, der beskæftiger sig med arbejdsopgaver inden for jordarbejde, kloakarbejde, betonarbejde og belægningsarbejde. jobs.title: Are you a Flight Instructor? Explore Multiple Career Paths at Greybird, no matter your level.
jobs.description:
GreyBird Pilot Academy is expanding and is looking for Flight Instructors to join our team fulltime or parttime in Denmark.

Are you passionate about training and developing the next generation of commercial pilots? Do you thrive in a professional aviation environment where you can combine flight instruction with classroom and simulator-based teaching?

Three profile opportunities

Whether you are a newly graduated or an experienced Flight Instructor, already hold CRI/SPA privileges, or are ready to take the next step through our sponsored development program, we offer exciting opportunities to build your aviation career while helping future pilots achieve their goals:

Career Path 1: Flight Instructor DK summer / Spain winther

About the Role

As a Flight Instructor, your primary responsibility will be delivering flight training onboard our aircraft. Depending on operational needs, you may also conduct simulator sessions and classroom-based theoretical instruction.

You will guide students throughout their training journey and help ensure the highest standards of pilot education.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI

  • Set to have a split base between Denmark in the summer and Spain in the winter

  • Based in either DK or Spain

Read more and apply here

Career Path 2: Flight Instructor – Sponsored CRI/SPA Program

About the Role

This position is designed for pilots who meet the requirements for CRI/SPA training but have not yet obtained the qualification.

As a Flight Instructor, you will deliver flight training, simulator instruction, and classroom teaching while participating in our sponsored development pathway.

Sponsored Development Opportunity

GreyBird will sponsor the CRI/SPA training required for the role if you meet the eligibility criteria below.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for sponsorship for a full-time position based at Aarhus Airport in Denmark, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Experience as PIC on MEP aircraft

  • Meet EASA FCL requirements for:

  • CRI/SPA ME, or

  • IRI MEP

Read more and apply here

Career Path 3: Flight Instructor CRI/SPA/(ME) (fulltime / or flexible planned partime)

About the Role

This position is aimed at experienced instructors already holding CRI/SPA qualifications.

You will primarily conduct flight training and may also deliver simulator and classroom instruction as part of our integrated training programs.

For candidates with these qualifications, GreyBird offers a full-time position or a flexible employment for candidates who are interested in a combination of working as an instructor at GreyBird and an airline job or commute between residence and Aarhus airport.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • CRI/SPA qualification (mandatory)

  • ME qualification (preferred but not required)

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI)

Read more and apply here

Ready for Take-Off?

If you meet the requirements for one of the three career paths, we encourage you to apply for the position that matches your current qualifications.

Join GreyBird Pilot Academy and help shape the future of aviation.

We can’t wait to hear from you.

Relocation: Candidates must be willing to relocate and live within commuting distance of our base in Aarhus, DK fulltime or parttime depending on the position.

jobs.title: Pakettiautohuolto -franchisingyrittäjä Tampereelle
jobs.description:
Pakettiautohuolto on erikoistunut pakettiautojen huolto- ja korjauspalveluihin. Ketjun toiminnan perustana ovat laadukas palvelukokemus, asiantuntijuus ja tulevaisuuden rakentaminen. Ketju keskittyy erityisesti yritys- ja ammattiasiakkaisiin, yhtenä merkittävä kilpailuetuna mm. huollon sijaispakettiautot. Tällä hetkellä toimintaa on kolmella eri paikkakunnalla Suomessa, ketjun laajentuminen tulee tapahtumaan Suomen kaikkiin kasvukeskuksiin. Kasvunäkymät ovat vahvat ja konseptin mukaisella toiminnalla sekä ketjun vahvalla tuella on erinomaiset mahdollisuudet kannattavaan sekä laadukkaaseen yritystoimintaan. Ketju hyödyntää alan uusinta teknologiaa ja panostaa jatkuvaan kehitykseen, jotta palvelut pysyvät kilpailukykyisinä ja laadukkaina.

Franchising-yrittäjänä vastaat oman yksikkösi ja yhtiösi päivittäisestä toiminnasta. Tehtäviisi kuuluvat erityisesti asiakaspalvelu, huoltotöiden organisointi sekä henkilöstön johtaminen. Yrittäjänä olet myös vastuussa liiketoiminnan kehittämisestä, paikallisesta markkinoinnista ja asiakassuhteiden rakentamisesta. Työ on monipuolista ja käytännönläheistä – päivät voivat sisältää sekä teknistä työtä että yrityksen hallinnollisia tehtäviä. Ketjun tuki ja selkeät toimintamallit auttavat sinua onnistumaan yrittäjänä.

Menestyvä Pakettiautohuollon yrittäjä on:

1. Yrittäjähenkinen ja toimialasta kiinnostunut
Kokemus autoalalta on hyödyksi, mutta tärkeintä on halu ja motivaatio oppia sekä kasvaa yrittäjänä
Riskinkantokyky ja vastuunotto yrityksen toiminnasta

2. Asiakaslähtöinen ja myyntihenkinen
Asiakaspalveluhenkinen, asiakaslähtöinen ajattelutapa ja myynnillinen ote

3. Tiimin ja tiimityöskentelyn johtaja
Yhteistyökykyinen ja luotettava tiimipelaaja
Rekrytoi ja kehittää henkilöstöä

4. Toiminnan kehittäjä ja laadun varmistaja
Järjestelmällinen ja pitkäjänteiseen kehittymiseen sitoutuva
Myönteinen ketjuasenne ja ketjun konseptin mukaiseen toimintaan sekä laatuvaatimuksiin sitoutuva

5. Taloudelliset edellytykset omaava
Vakaa ja hyvä taloudellinen tilanne, mahdollisuus rahoittaa alkuinvestointi joko vapaana omana pääomana tai ulkopuolisella rahoituksella. Yksikön alkuinvestointivaatimus on: 20.000-50.000€
Yrityksen talouden ymmärrys ja tarkka talouden hallinta

Miksi yrittäjäksi Pakettiautohuolto-ketjuun:

1. Valmis konsepti ja toimintamallit
2. Tunnettuutta ja luottavuutta omaava Pakettiautohuollon brändi
3. Kilpailukyiset hankintasopimukset ja pakettiautoihin erikoistuminen. Lopputuloksena suoraviivainen ja tehokas korjaamotoiminta, onnistunut asiakaspalvelukokemus ja kannattava yritystoiminta
4. Markkinoinnin ja myynnin tuki ketjulta, ketjun valmiit asiakasrekisterit ja valtakunnalliset asiakkuudet
5. Ketjun kattava perehdytys, tärkeät tukipalvelut, valmiit järjestelmät ja jatkuva koulutus
6. Yhteistyö muiden yrittäjien kanssa

Yhteisössämme jokainen yrittäjä saa olla osa suurempaa joukkoa, jossa apua ja kannustusta on aina saatavilla – yksin ei tarvitse pärjätä ja yrittää. Aloitus on helppoa, autamme liikepaikan löytämisessä ja sopimusneuvotteluissa. Koneiden ja työkalujen hankinnan osalta meillä on valmiit paketit olemassa.

Mikäli kiinnostuit, lue lisää ja jätä hakemus:

jobs.title: Tenure-track position in Archaeology
jobs.description:
About the position 

A tenure-track position (tenure-track in a postdoctoral position and tenured as associate professor) in Archaeology is available at The Department of Archaeology, Conservation and History (IAKH), University of Oslo. IAKH comprises the three disciplinary fields of archaeology conservation and history. The archaeology section has nine academic faculty positions, each with teaching and research components. The section’s research profile and teaching program are internationally oriented and span archaeologies of the Stone Age to the present. The announced position is focused on GIS, statistics and Mesolithic archaeology in Scandinavia.

The announced tenure-track position starts as a full-time postdoctoral position (SKO 1352) for a period of six years, including a 25 % component devoted to teaching and administrative duties. These duties include obtaining basic pedagogical qualifications. A formal midterm evaluation will be held in the fourth year of this period, and the candidate will receive feedback on performance relative to the requirements for the six-year tenure-track period. Toward the end of the six-year period, the candidate will be evaluated for a tenured position as associate professor (SKO 1011). During the final assessment, the candidate’s research performance will first be assessed by an expert (adjudication) committee within the candidate’s subject area. Subsequently, the candidate will be interviewed by an internal interview committee assessing the full range of criteria in the contract of employment.


More about the position 

Applicants apply with a research project including GIS, statistics and the Mesolithic in Scandinavia to be carried out in the initial six years period. In the application letter, candidates should also describe long term plans for building an international research group, for future development of the teaching in Stone Age Archaeology, for contributing to the public dissemination of research, and for developing their own academic career. 

The contract of employment will specify results, requirements, and criteria regarding academic production, public dissemination, research leadership and teaching that the candidate must fulfil during the six-years period to be favourably evaluated for a tenured position. According to the Regulations on appointments to tenure-track positions, with supplementary provisions for UiO, the contract of employment will also specify the criteria for the midterm and final assessment of competencies and milestones. Candidates will also be evaluated on personal suitability and ability to contribute to academic citizenship, both during the initial hiring process and during the mid-term and final evaluations. The contract of employment will further outline the Department’s obligations in supporting the candidate’s research as well as offering academic mentorship, guidance and training. 

Make sure to follow the description of required results necessary in order to be eligible for the tenured position as associate professor.


Requirements 
  • PhD or equivalent academic qualifications within archaeology of the Mesolithic in Scandinavia, with a clear profile in GIS and statistical analysis, granted within the past five years (excluding documented parental and sickness leaves) 
  • Thorough knowledge of the material culture of the Mesolithic in Scandinavia 
  • Demonstrated ability to handle large datasets, geographical information systems and theoretical perspectives on archaeological methodology/practice 
  • Experience in handling of archaeological data using high-end digital tools for quantitative and/or qualitative analysis 
  • Experience with interdisciplinary research approaches within the environmental humanities and/or crossing over to natural sciences 
  • Documented pedagogical skills (either a teaching course certificate or based on teaching experience), see how to document your pedagogical skills 
  • Documented potential for project acquisition 
  • Interest and ability in leadership and administration 
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English and a Scandinavian language 
  • Personal suitability and motivation for the position 

To be eligible, candidates must have submitted for final evaluation or defended their doctoral dissertation within five years preceding the application deadline. In the former case, the appointment will be contingent upon the successful defence of the thesis. Someone who has been employed for more than one year in an ordinary postdoctoral position at the University of Oslo cannot be employed in a postdoctoral position on tenure-track terms.


In the evaluation of the applications, emphasis will be placed on:
  • The research project’s scientific merit and contribution to GIS-based and statistical approaches to the Mesolithic in Scandinavia, including the applicant’s academic and personal ability to carry out the project 
  • The applicant’s long-term plans for building and leading an international research group and successfully join in academic collaboration within and across disciplines, including plans for obtaining external research funding 
  • Academic qualifications and academic production. Originality and quality of publications will be weighted more heavily than quantity 
  • Interest in and motivation for teaching, ability to inspire and provide guidance to students, and potential to teach university-level courses about Stone Age Archaeology and within Archaeology more generally 
  • Interest and ability in leadership and administration, including collaborative skillsExperience with and potential for popular dissemination and public outreach 
  • Academic citizenship, personal suitability and potential to contribute to a positive working environment and the long-term development of teaching and research at the Department 

In the evaluation of the qualified candidates the full range of these criteria will be explicitly addressed and assessed. Academic quality, development, potential and breadth will be prioritised in this order. 

The appointed candidate should demonstrate mastery of both English and one of the Scandinavian languages as working languages.


We can offer you 
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment. 
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities. 
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Postdoctoral Fellow, position code 1352 in salary range NOK from 595 000 to 677 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.

Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.


We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


Application

Your application must include: 

  • Application letter describing the applicant’s qualifications and motivation for the position 
  • Curriculum Vitae (including list of education, previous and current positions, teaching experience, administrative experience, and other qualifying activities) 
  • List of publications 
  • Project description (3 - 5 pages, maximum 14,000 characters. See Template for project descriptions) 
  • A realistic progress plan for all six years, including activities beyond the postdoctoral research project itself, such as teaching, professional development and project development 
  • Two writing samples (e.g. two chapters from the PhD dissertation or two academic articles) 
  • Copies of educational certificates 

Please note that all documents should be in English (or a Scandinavian language), either in the original or in translation. 

The application with attachments must be delivered in our electronic recruiting system, jobbnorge.no. Applicants with education from non-Norwegian universities must attach an explanation of their grading systems.


Selection procedure

As the first step in the evaluation process, a Selection Committee will assess all applications and invite the most qualified applicants to submit a teaching portfolio and academic works (up to 7 publications) for expert assessment. Academic texts, except for the two writing samples, shall therefore not be enclosed with the initial application. Applicants who are invited to submit academic works are asked to select three works, published within the last 5 years, to be considered as most relevant for the position. In longer publications (monographs), applicants should specify the most relevant pages. Applicants are also asked to submit a teaching portfolio of 3-6 pages documenting educational certificates, competence and experience, including a reflection note in which your own practice and learning vision is anchored in the principles of Scholarship of Teaching and Learning (SoTL). 

Finally, the most highly ranked candidates will be invited for at least one interview and trial lecture. Ranked candidates will be asked to provide a list of 3 reference persons (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and phone number). References are contacted after the interviews.


General information

Please note that we are unable to add documentation after the application deadline. As the deadline applies equally to all applicants, this policy ensures equal treatment throughout the recruitment process. If you experience difficulties uploading documents in Jobbnorge, please contact their customer service: Phone: +47 75 54 22 20 or Email: support@grade.com 

The primary method of communication throughout the process will be e-mails and messages through the recruitment system Jobbnorge. When you receive a notification of a message in Jobbnorge, please log in to read it, as it may be important.

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews. 

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian) and Guidelines concerning appointment to recruitment positions at UiO. 

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees to secure the rights to all research results and related intellectual property.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Department of archaeology, conservation and history (IAKH) is comprised of three disciplines which in different ways study the past.The department has internationally oriented archaeologists, the only conservation program in Norway and the biggest group of historians in Scandinavia. The department has close to 100 employees, including non-permanent research fellows. The study programs span archaeology from the Stone Age to the Middle Ages, object and paintings conservation, and history from Antiquity to the present age.

jobs.title: Postdoc in environmental medicine
jobs.description:
The translational pharmacology research group at Clinical Pharmacology, Pharmacy and Environmental Medicine (CPPEM), Department of Public Health, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark, invites applications for a fully funded 18 months postdoctoral position. The position is to be filled from January 1st, 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.


About the Research Environment

The research areas of CPPEM span from pharmacoepidemiology to clinical studies, and cell-based basic pharmacology and environmental medicine. Collectively, CPPEM has a strong background in exposure to environmental chemicals, pharmacoepidemiology, pharmacogenetics, pharmacokinetics, drug-drug interactions, and therapeutic drug monitoring. Specifically, the translational pharmacology group aims to understand variability in drug toxicity, drug metabolism and drug transport. Examples of this include cell-based models such as induced-pluripotent stem cells, primary human hepatocytes, and clinical studies. The pharmacoepidemiological research group utilizes the world-class Danish registries as well as international data sources to assess pharmacological questions in large populations. The environmental medicine group studies the impact of early life exposures to environmental chemicals. In particular PFAS is a focus area, with studies of the adverse health effects of exposure, biomonitoring and advising national and international authorities. The analytical chemistry laboratory analyzes concentrations of drugs or environmental chemicals in various matrices. 

In the Environmental Medicine group we are looking for a post doc funded by Novo Nordic Foundation and ERC advanced grant. The projects focus on the Odense Child Cohort and study the impact of early life exposures to environmental chemicals. Especially PFAS and their adverse effects on maternal and child health (e.g. the brain, immune, metabolic and reproductive system). In addition, we aim to identify toxicity of short PFAS including trifluoroacetic acid, widely used but considered less toxic due to their short half-life. 

We are seeking a candidate with a PhD in medicine, pharmacology, public health, or a related discipline. Work within environmental medicine is an advance, and epidemiological and statistical skills are essential. Motivation, curiosity, and a strong drive to excel in environmental research are very important. Excellent communication skills in written and spoken English is a requirement. The position includes independent scientific writing, clinical project leading, and supervision of students. You should be interested in contributing both to the scientific armamentarium in our department and to our collegial culture. It is also expected that the post doc contributes to additional fundraising for the projects as well as research collaborations and the continuation of the Odense Child Cohort, and takes on teaching responsibilities within the department. You will, in your daily work, refer to Professor Tina Kold Jensen, but also engage in a very active collaboration with the full research group.


Your qualifications

  • PhD in medicine, pharmacology, public health, or a related discipline.

  • Experience within environmental medicine is considered an advantage

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

  • Ability to work independently with scientific writing and publication

  • Interest in and experience with supervision of students

  • Commitment to contributing to both scientific excellence and a positive collegial culture within the department

  • Interest in establishing and maintaining national and international research collaboration
     

Further information

Interviews can be performed online if needed. If you will need to relocate to Denmark for the position, both the University and the research group will provide ample support.

Additional information about the position can be obtained from Tina Kold Jensen (tkjensen@health.sdu.dk; 0045 29464350).


Salary and terms of employment

The successful applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).


Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link "Apply now".

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • a motivational letter

  • a detailed CV

  • degree certificates (including documentation of Master’s and PhD degree) 

  • a complete and numbered list of publications

  • Up to 3 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. 

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • a description of research experience

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk 

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.  

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered. 


Application deadline

November 4, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. (CET).


Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.


Living and working in Denmark 

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment.  

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark.  

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background. 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding society and encourages all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of personal background.
 

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark is a world-class university driven by an ambition to promote research results that develop society. The major challenges of the 21st century are complex and multifaceted; sustainable change and solutions require new – often interdisciplinary – research-based knowledge, and the University of Southern Denmark is an indispensable stakeholder in the transition process. 

Value, quality, talented people and outstanding environments are pivotal for the University of Southern Denmark’s strategic initiatives. 

Read more: https://www.sdu.dk/en/om_sdu

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding society and encourages all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of personal background.
